169 1-phosphatidylinositol phosphodiesterase
- /ˌfɒsfəˌtaɪdɪlɪˈnəʊsɪtɒl ˌfɒsfədaɪˈestəreɪs/
- phr.["1-磷脂酰肌醇磷酸二酯酶"]
- phr.["former official nomenclature for a phospholipase C specific for phosphoinositides, catalyzing the cleavage of a diacylglycerol residue from 1-phosphatidylinositol. It is part of a mechanism for mobilization of calcium in response to hormones; it is activated by hormonal binding via a G protein and begins the cycle of phosphoinositide metabolism. It can also play a role in the liberation of arachidonic acid from phosphatidylinositol. Note: While this enzyme has officially been renamed phosphatidylinositol diacylglycerol-lyase [EC 4.6.1.13], that name and number cover only the bacterial enzyme. The enzyme activity in animals has been determined instead to be part of the activity of the enzyme phosphoinositide phospholipase C (q.v.)."]

The enzyme can also oxidize the 3-hydroxy derivative of Δ1-pyrroline 5-carboxylate to form 4-hydroxyglutamate. Deficiency of the enzyme, an autosomal recessive trait, is the cause of hyperprolinemia, type II."]

The acetate and pivalate salts are used for mineralocorticoid replacement therapy. Called also cortexone, deoxycortone, desoxycorticosterone, and desoxycortone."]

178 11β-hydroxylase deficiency
- 
- phr.["11β-羟化酶缺乏症"]
- phr.["an autosomal recessive disorder of steroidogenesis caused by a mutation in the CYP11B1 gene (locus: 8q21), which encodes steroid 11β-monooxygenase; the resulting enzyme deficiency causes classic and nonclassic forms of one type of congenital adrenal hyperplasia (type IV). In the classic (hypertensive) form, the enzyme deficiency results in increased levels of cortisol precursors such as 11-deoxycortisol and the salt-retaining hormone 11-deoxycorticosterone, and decreased cortisol and aldosterone synthesis. Clinical manifestations include hypertension and, due to increased androgens, female pseudohermaphroditism and postnatal virilization of both sexes. The nonclassic (late onset) form is milder, and patients are frequently normotensive. See table at hyperplasia."]

- 
- phr.["11β-羟类固醇脱氢酶缺乏症"]

Deficiency of the type 1 isozyme is caused by mutations involving two genes and three alleles and gives rise to a phenotype resembling polycystic ovary syndrome. Deficiency of the type 2 isozyme results in apparent mineralocorticoid excess (q.v.)."]

- phr.["17α-羟化酶缺乏症"]
- phr.["an autosomal recessive disorder of steroidogenesis caused by mutation in the CYP17A1 gene (locus: 10q24.3), which encodes steroid 17α-monooxygenase; the resulting enzyme deficiency causes one type of congenital adrenal hyperplasia (type V). The disorder is characterized by decreased cortisol, androgens, estrogens, and aldosterone production and increases in 17-deoxysteroids such as corticosterone and deoxycorticosterone, resulting in hypertension, hypokalemia, and hypogonadism. Severe deficiency during fetal life can cause male pseudohermaphroditism; postnatally, it can impair sexual development in both males and females. See table at hyperplasia and see also 17,20 lyase deficiency."]

Deficiency of enzyme activity is called 17,20-lyase deficiency. Called also 17,20-lyase and 17,20-desmolase."]

Deficiencies of types 3, 4 (D-bifunctional protein, q.v.), and 10 cause disease."]

210 21-hydroxylase deficiency
- 
- phr.["21-羟化酶缺乏症"]
- phr.["an autosomal recessive disorder of steroidogenesis caused by mutation in the CYP21 gene (locus: 6p21.3), which encodes steroid 21-monooxygenase, and the adjacent pseudogene CYP21P; the resulting enzyme deficiency impairs the ability to produce all glucocorticoids. It is lethal if severe and untreated. It causes several forms of the most common type of congenital adrenal hyperplasia (type III): the more severe classic forms present at birth (salt-wasting and simple virilizing), and the less severe nonclassic forms of later onset (late-onset, or attenuated, and cryptic). The simple virilizing form is characterized clinically by female pseudohermaphroditism and postnatal virilization with advanced somatic development and biochemically by elevated androgens and decreased corticoids. The salt-wasting form is additionally characterized by aldosterone deficiency and salt wasting. Patients with nonclassic forms display variable expression of androgen excess later in life, ranging from hirsutism and infertility (late onset) to absence of clinical signs (cryptic). See also table at hyperplasia."]

240 3β-hydroxysteroid dehydrogenase deficiency
- 
- phr.["3β-羟类固醇脱氢酶缺乏症"]
- phr.["an autosomal recessive disorder of steroidogenesis caused by mutation in the HSD3B2 gene (locus: 1p13.1), which encodes 3β-hydroxysteroid dehydrogenase, resulting in several forms of one type of congenital adrenal hyperplasia (type II): the classic forms are salt-wasting and the milder non–salt-wasting, and the nonclassic form is late onset. The enzyme deficiency is present in adrenals and gonads; pathways to cortisol, sex steroids, and aldosterone are blocked; and pregnenolone, 17α-hydroxypregnenolone, and dehydroepiandrosterone are elevated in plasma. Males affected during fetal life are pseudohermaphroditic; both sexes have slight postnatal virilization. 366 abdomen
- /ˈæbdəmen，æbˈdəʊmen/
- n.["腹（部）"]
- n.["that portion of the body which lies between the thorax and the pelvis; it contains a cavity (abdominal cavity) separated by the diaphragm from the thoracic cavity above and by the plane of the pelvic inlet from the pelvic cavity below and lined with a serous membrane, the peritoneum. This cavity contains the abdominal viscera (see Plate 50) and is enclosed by a wall (abdominal wall) formed by the abdominal muscles, the vertebral column, and the ilia. Called also belly and venter. It is divided into nine regions by four imaginary lines projected onto the anterior wall (see illustration); two of the lines pass horizontally around the body (the upper at the level of the cartilages of the ninth ribs, the lower at the tops of the crests of the ilia), and two extend vertically on each side of the body from the cartilage of the eighth rib to the center of the inguinal ligament. The regions are: three upper—right hypochondrium, epigastric region, left hypochondrium; three middle—right flank (right lateral region), umbilicus, left flank (left lateral region); and three lower—right groin (right inguinal region), pubic region, left flank (left inguinal region).Regions of abdomen: 1, epigastric region; 2, right hypochondrium; 3, left hypochondrium; 4, right flank; 5, umbilicus; 6, left flank; 7, right groin; 8, pubic region; 9, left flank. A, transpyloric plane; B, transtubercular plane; C, midclavicular line."]

505 ABO blood group
- 
- phr.["ABO 血型"]
- phr.["the major human blood group system, dependent on the presence or absence of A and B antigens, which are largely glycolipids on the cell membrane. The gene for A is responsible for synthesis of N-acetyl-α-d-galactosaminyl transferase, whereas that for B is responsible for α-d-galactosyl transferase. Either A or B is created when one of these hexasaccharides is positioned by a specific transferase in 1→3 linkage to the β-d-galactose of an H-active oligosaccharide. Type O occurs when neither transferase is present or, very rarely (Bombay phenotype), when H antigen does not exist. When both transferases are present, type AB results. Differences in degree of transferase activity are determined at the same locus: weak transferase gives rise to weak antigens (A2, A3Ax, B3Bx). Similar oligosaccharides, especially in bacterial cell walls, immunize persons lacking A or B so that their serum contains anti-A or anti-B activity. A and B antigens are on the mucopolysaccharides of secretors; persons with dominant genes have H-active mucoids."]

1065 acid
- /ˈæsɪd/
- n.["酸"]
- n.["any of a large class of chemical substances defined by three chemical concepts of increasing generality. An Arrhenius acid is a substance that lowers the pH (increases the hydrogen ion concentration) when added to an aqueous solution; such substances have a sour taste, turn litmus red, and react with alkalis to form salts. A Bronsted-Lowry acid is a species that acts as a proton donor in solution; e.g., the ammonium ion (NH4+) can donate a proton, leaving ammonia (NH3); such species are termed conjugate acid-base pairs. A Lewis acid is a species that can accept a pair of electrons to form a covalent bond; e.g., BF3 in the reaction BF3 + NH3 → BF3NH3. Aqueous solutions of certain compounds that dissociate in solution, e.g., hydrogen chloride, are designated acids by names beginning with hydro-, e.g., hydrochloric acid. Most other common inorganic acids are oxo acids (q.v.); common organic acids include carboxylic acids, sulfonic acids, and phenols. The name of the anion formed by the removal of hydrogen from an acid (its conjugate base) and the names of salts and esters of acids are formed by removing the suffix -ic and the word acid and adding the suffix -ate, except for oxo acids ending in -ous, when the suffix is -ite. For particular acids, see the specific name."]

Such agents are cytotoxic, producing their effects by the scission and cross-linking of DNA chains, and are not cell cycle–specific, but cell killing occurs primarily in rapidly proliferating tissues in which there is not time between mitoses for DNA repair systems to reverse the effects of the agent. Classes of antineoplastic alkylating agents include nitrogen mustards, ethylenimine derivatives, alkyl sulfonates, nitrosoureas, triazenes, and platinum compounds. Hematopoietic, reproductive, and epithelial tissues are particularly sensitive to alkylating agents, and their use may cause depressed blood cell counts, amenorrhea or impaired spermatogenesis, damage to intestinal mucosa, alopecia, and increased risk of malignancy."]

3413 Alzheimer disease
- 
- phr.["阿尔茨海默病"]
- phr.["a progressive central neurodegenerative disorder; it may be inherited or sporadic, and inherited forms may show autosomal dominant or multifactorial inheritance. It is believed to be caused by defects in β-amyloid precursor protein metabolism, and is characterized by diffuse atrophy throughout the cerebral cortex with distinctive lesions called neuritic plaques and clumps of fibrils called neurofibrillary tangles. There is a loss of choline acetyltransferase activity in the cortex, and many of the degenerating neurons are cholinergic neurons of the hippocampus and other limbic areas. The plaques contain numerous proteins, including an altered form of Aβ amyloid and apolipoprotein E, and the tangles contain mainly hyperphosphorylated tau protein. The first signs of the disease are slight memory disturbance or changes in personality; deterioration progresses to profound dementia over 5 to 10 years on average. Women are affected twice as often as men, and onset may occur at any age; the disorder is currently divided into early-onset and late-onset forms, with the dividing age being approximately 65 years, but there is no clinical distinction between the two forms. Mutations associated with the early-onset autosomal dominant form have been identified in the β-amyloid precursor protein (APP), presenilin 1 (PSEN1), and presenilin 2 (PSEN2) genes, all of which lead to increased production of the altered form of Aβ amyloid. Both familial and sporadic late-onset forms have been associated with a particular allele (ε4) of the apolipoprotein E gene (APOE).Neurofibrillary tangles (arrows) and neuritic plaques (NP) in the neuronal cytoplasm in Alzheimer disease (silver stain)."]

The most common cause is thiamine deficiency from chronic alcohol abuse (Wernicke-Korsakoff syndrome), but it may also result from any pathological process causing bilateral damage to parts of the medial temporal lobe or diencephalon, such as the hippocampal formations, mammillary bodies, or dorsal medial nuclei of the thalamus. This is also called male pattern a. or baldness. In women it may begin later, with less severe hair loss in the front area of the scalp. This is also called female pattern a. or baldness. In affected areas, hair follicles produce finer and lighter terminal hairs until terminal hair production ceases; the phase called anagen becomes longer, while telogen becomes shorter. Associated features often include denial of the illness and resistance to psychotherapy, depressive symptoms, markedly decreased libido, and obsessions or peculiar behavior regarding food, such as hoarding. The disorder is divided into two subtypes, a restricting type, in which weight loss is achieved primarily through diet or exercise, and a binge-eating/purging type, in which binge eating or purging behavior also occurs regularly; the latter type resembles bulimia nervosa, which is not diagnosed in the presence of anorexia nervosa."]

- adj.["conducting impulses in a direction opposite to the normal; see under conduction. Cf. orthodromic."]

5451 antidromic atrioventricular reciprocating tachycardia
- 
- phr.["逆向房室交互性心动过速"]
- phr.["a reentrant tachycardia in which the reentrant circuit involves anterograde conduction over the accessory pathway and retrograde conduction over the normal pathway through the AV node and the His bundle. Cf. orthodromic atrioventricular (AV) reciprocating t."]

5452 antidromic conduction
- 
- phr.["逆向传导"]
- phr.["the conduction of a nerve impulse in a direction contrary to the normal direction, as occurs in experimental conduction studies. It may occur naturally in some neurons of the dorsal roots of the spinal cord, although evidence suggests that the phenomenon may actually result from ephaptic transmission rather than backward transmission."]

5453 antidromic volley
- 
- phr.["逆行冲动排，逆排放"]
- phr.["a volley of nerve impulses that travel in a direction opposite to normal, usually under experimental stimulation."]

5454 antidysenteric
- /ˌæntɪˌdɪsənˈterɪk/
- adj.["抗痢疾药；抗痢疾的"]
- adj.["preventing, alleviating, or curing dysentery.","an agent that prevents, alleviates, or cures dysentery."]

5455 antidyskinetic
- /ˌæntɪˌdɪskɪˈnetɪk/
- adj.["抗运动障碍药"]
- adj.["relieving or preventing dyskinesia.","an agent that relieves or prevents dyskinesia."]

5456 antieczematic
- /ˌæntɪekzɪˈmætɪk/
- adj.["抗湿疹药；抗湿疹的"]
- adj.["alleviating eczema.","an agent that alleviates eczema."]

5457 antiedematous
- /ˌæntɪɪ(ː)ˈdemətəs/
- adj.["消水肿药；消水肿的"]
- adj.["antiedemic (def. 1)."]

5458 antiedemic
- /ˌæntɪɪ(ː)ˈdemɪk/
- adj.["消水肿药；消水肿的"]
- adj.["preventing or alleviating edema.","an agent that prevents or alleviates edema."]

5459 antiemetic
- /ˌæntɪɪˈmetɪk/
- adj.["止吐药；止吐的"]
- adj.["preventing or alleviating nausea and vomiting.","an agent that prevents or alleviates nausea and vomiting; see also antinauseant."]

5460 antiepileptic
- /ˌæntɪˌepɪˈleptɪk/
- adj.["镇癫痫药；抗癫痫的"]
- adj.["combating epilepsy.","an agent that combats epilepsy."]

5461 antiepithelial
- /ˌæntɪˌepɪˈθiːlɪəl/
- adj.["抗上皮的"]
- adj.["destructive to epithelial cells."]

5462 antiestrogen
- /ˌæntɪˈestrədʒən/
- n.["抗雌激素药；抗雌激素的"]
- n.["a substance capable of inhibiting the biological effects of estrogens."]

5463 antiestrogenic
- /ˌæntɪˌestrəˈdʒenɪk/
- adj.["抗雌激素的"]
- adj.["counteracting or suppressing estrogenic activity."]

5464 antifebrile
- /ˌæntɪˈfebrɪl/
- n.["退热药；退热的"]
- n.["antipyretic (def. 1)."]

5465 antifibrillatory
- /ˌæntɪˈfaɪbrɪləˌtərɪ/
- n.["抗心脏纤颤药；抗心脏纤颤的"]
- n.["preventing or stopping fibrillation of the heart.","an agent that prevents or stops fibrillation of the heart."]

5466 antifibrinolysin
- /ˌæntɪˌfaɪbrɪˈnɒlɪsɪn/
- n.["抗纤维蛋白溶素，抗纤维蛋白溶酶"]
- n.["antiplasmin."]

5467 antifibrinolytic
- /ˌæntɪˌfaɪbrɪnəˈlɪtɪk/
- adj.["抗纤维蛋白溶解的"]
- adj.["inhibiting fibrinolysis.","an agent that inhibits fibrinolysis."]

5468 antifibrotic
- /ˌænɪfaɪˈbrɒtɪk/
- adj.["抗纤维化药；抗纤维化的"]
- adj.["causing regression of fibrosis.","an agent that causes regression of fibrosis."]

5469 antifilarial
- /ˌæntɪfɪˈleərɪəl/
- adj.["抗丝虫药；抗丝虫的"]
- adj.["suppressing or killing filaria.","an agent that suppresses or kills filaria."]

5470 antiflatulent
- /ˌæntɪˈflætjʊlənt/
- n.["抗（肠胃）气胀药；抗（肠胃）气胀的"]
- n.["relieving or preventing flatulence.","an agent that relieves or prevents flatulence."]

5471 antiflux
- /ˈæntɪflʌks/
- n.["抗焊媒"]
- n.["a substance that prevents the attachment of solder."]

5472 antifoaming inhalant
- 
- phr.["止泡吸入剂"]
- phr.["an agent inhaled as a vapor to prevent the formation of foam in the respiratory passages of a patient with pulmonary edema."]

5473 antifol
- /ˈæntɪfəʊl/
- n.["抗叶酸剂，叶酸拮抗剂"]
- n.["folic acid antagonist."]

5474 antifolate
- /ˌæntɪˈfəʊleɪt/
- n.["抗叶酸剂，叶酸拮抗剂"]
- n.["folic acid antagonist."]

5475 antifungal
- /ˌæntɪˈfʌŋgəl/
- adj.["抗真菌药；抗真菌的"]
- adj.["destroying fungi, or suppressing their reproduction or growth; effective against fungal infections.","an agent that destroys fungi or inhibits their growth; called also antimycotic."]

5476 antigalactic
- /ˌæntɪgəˈlæktɪk/
- adj.["制乳药；制乳的"]
- adj.["diminishing or stopping lactation.","an agent that has this effect. Called also lactifuge."]

5477 antigen
- /ˈæntɪdʒən/
- n.["抗原"]
- n.["any substance capable, under appropriate conditions, of inducing a specific immune response and of reacting with the products of that response, that is, with specific antibody or specifically sensitized T lymphocytes, or both. Antigens may be soluble substances, such as toxins and foreign proteins, or particulate, such as bacteria and tissue cells; however, only the portion of the protein or polysaccharide molecule known as the antigenic determinant (q.v.) combines with antibody or a specific receptor on a lymphocyte. Abbreviated Ag."]

5478 antigen capture assay
- 
- phr.["抗原捕获测定"]
- phr.["a method for identifying minute quantities of antigen in solution: large quantities of antibody against the desired antigen are fixed to a solid support matrix, over which the solution is passed. The antigen is retained by the matrix and can be identified by reaction with labeled antibody."]

5479 antigen excess
- 
- phr.["抗原过剩"]
- phr.["see precipitin reaction, under reaction."]

5480 antigen gain
- 
- phr.["抗原获得"]
- phr.["the acquisition by cells of new antigenic determinants not normally present or not normally accessible in the parent tissue."]

5481 antigen presentation
- 
- phr.["抗原呈递，抗原提呈"]
- phr.["the activity in which macrophages ingest and partially digest antigens and then present the processed antigen on their surfaces to B and T lymphocytes. (See antigen-presenting cells, under cell.) The presented antigen is more immunogenic than unprocessed antigen, possibly because it has been broken down into pieces more easily recognized by B and T cells, because it remains on the surface of the presenting cell for a long time, or because it is presented in association with self MHC antigen and thus able to stimulate helper T cells."]

5482 antigen spreading
- 
- phr.["抗原扩散"]
- phr.["the expansion of antigen-producing capabilities within a cell or from one cell to another, thought to be an important mechanism for the development of certain autoimmune conditions."]

5483 antigen unit
- 
- phr.["抗原单位"]
- phr.["in complement fixation tests, the smallest amount of antigen that will fix one unit of complement."]

5484 antigen-antibody complex
- 
- phr.["抗原-抗体复合物"]
- phr.["the complex formed by the noncovalent binding of an antibody and an antigen. Complexes of antibodies belonging to certain immunoglobulin classes may activate complement. Antigen-antibody complexes are mediators of Type III immune responses (Arthus reactions, serum sickness, and immune complex diseases). Called also immune c., particularly in discussing disease processes."]

5485 antigen-antibody reaction
- 
- phr.["抗原-抗体反应"]
- phr.["the reversible binding of antigen to homologous antibody brought about by the formation of weak bonds between antigenic determinants on antigen molecules and antigen binding sites on immunoglobulin molecules. Certain effects, e.g., precipitation and agglutination reactions and viral neutralization, result from the binding itself; other effects, e.g., complement activation and opsonization, result from conformational changes that occur in immunoglobulin molecules with antigen binding and enable them to interact with complement proteins and Fc receptors on phagocytes."]

5486 antigen-binding site
- 
- phr.["抗原结合部位"]
- phr.["the region of the immunoglobulin molecule that binds to antigens; there is one such site on each of the two Fab regions of each immunoglobulin monomer."]

5487 antigen-presenting cells
- 
- phr.["抗原呈递细胞"]
- phr.["cells that take part in antigen presentation (see under presentation); a group of dendritic cells that arise in the bone marrow and migrate to other body sites. They process antigens and put them on their surfaces to react with lymphocytes and induce an immune response. The group includes follicular dendritic cells in B-dependent areas of lymphoid tissues, interdigitating cells in T-dependent areas, Langerhans cells in the epidermis, and veil cells in lymphoid tissue."]

5488 antigen-reactive cells
- 
- phr.["抗原反应细胞"]
- phr.["T lymphocytes that rapidly proliferate in response to challenge by antigen.","antigen-sensitive c's."]

5489 antigen-sensitive cells
- 
- phr.["抗原敏感细胞"]
- phr.["small lymphocytes that when exposed to antigen can differentiate into antibody-producing cells. Called also antigen-reactive c's."]

5490 antigen-specific T-cell helper factor
- 
- phr.["抗原特异性T-细胞辅助因子"]
- phr.["a soluble factor produced by helper T cells that activates other lymphocytes that are specific for the stimulating antigen; it may itself bind antigen."]

5491 antigen-specific T-cell suppressor factor
- 
- phr.["抗原特异性T-细胞抑制因子"]
- phr.["a soluble factor produced by suppressor T cells following immunization; it produces antigen-specific suppression of the immune response and may itself bind antigen."]

5492 antigenemia
- /ˌæntɪdʒɪˈniːmɪə/
- n.["抗原血症"]
- n.["the presence of antigen in the blood."]

5493 antigenemic
- /ˌæntɪdʒɪˈniːmɪk/
- adj.["抗原血症的"]
- adj.["exhibiting antigenemia."]

5494 antigenic
- /æntɪˈdʒenɪk/
- adj.["抗原的"]
- adj.["having the properties of an antigen."]

5495 antigenic competition
- 
- phr.["抗原竞争"]
- phr.["an altered response to an immunogen resulting from the simultaneous or close administration of two immunogens: the response to one is normal, while the response to the second is suppressed or diminished."]

5496 antigenic deletion
- 
- phr.["抗原缺失"]
- phr.["loss or masking of antigenic determinants in daughter cells of cells whose parent tissue normally carries them; it may result from neoplastic or other mutational change in the parent tissue or may be due to loss or repression of genetic material from the cell."]

5497 antigenic determinant
- 
- phr.["抗原决定簇"]
- phr.["a site on the surface of an antigen molecule to which a single antibody molecule binds; generally an antigen has several or many different antigenic determinants and reacts with antibodies of many different specificities. Called also epitope."]

5498 antigenic diversion
- 
- phr.["抗原转换"]
- phr.["the change in the antigenic structure of tumor cells or tissue to that normally found in different cells or tissue."]

5499 antigenic drift
- 
- phr.["抗原漂移"]
- phr.["relatively minor changes in the antigenic structure of a virus strain, probably resulting from natural selection of virus variants circulating among an immune or partially immune population. Cf. antigenic shift, under shift."]

5500 antigenic modulation
- 
- phr.["抗原调变"]
- phr.["alteration or loss of reactivity of cell surface antigens resulting from redistribution of antigenic sites due to the presence of bound antibody."]

5501 antigenic profile
- 
- phr.["抗原全貌，抗原图"]
- phr.["the total antigenic content and structure of a tissue or cell."]

5502 antigenic reversion
- 
- phr.["抗原性逆转"]
- phr.["a change in the antigenic structure of adult cells to that of immature cells, as in certain tumors."]

5503 antigenic shift
- 
- phr.["抗原转换，抗原位移"]
- phr.["a sudden, major change in the antigenicity of a virus, seen especially in influenza viruses, resulting from the recombination of the genomes of two virus strains; it is associated with pandemics because hosts do not have immunity to the new strain. Cf. antigenic drift, under drift."]

5504 antigenic structure
- 
- phr.["抗原结构"]
- phr.["(of microorganisms), the mosaic of individual antigens present in cells of a microorganism."]

5505 antigenic variation
- 
- phr.["抗原变异"]
- phr.["a mechanism whereby microorganisms or parasites, such as trypanosomes, plasmodia, and Borrelia, are enabled to escape immune surveillance of a host by modifying or completely altering their surface antigens.","a phenomenon occurring in the influenza virus, in which the virus spontaneously exhibits both slow antigenic drift and sharp antigenic changes at intervals."]

5506 antigenicity
- /ˌæntɪdʒɪˈnɪsətɪ/
- n.["抗原性"]
- n.["the property of being able to induce a specific immune response or the degree to which a substance is able to stimulate an immune response. Called also immunogenicity."]

5507 antigerminal pole
- 
- phr.["植物性极，卵黄极"]
- phr.["vegetal p."]

5508 antiglaucoma
- /ˌæntɪˌglɔːˈkəʊmə/
- n.["抗青光眼"]
- n.["preventing or alleviating glaucoma."]

5509 antigliadin antibodies
- 
- phr.["抗麦胶蛋白抗体"]
- phr.["circulating IgA and IgG antibodies to gliadin, found in the serum of patients with celiac disease; measurement of these antibodies is used in diagnosis of celiac disease."]

5510 antiglobulin
- /ˌæntɪˈglɒbjʊlɪn/
- n.["抗球蛋白"]
- n.["an antibody directed against gamma globulin; see also under test."]

5511 antiglobulin consumption test
- 
- phr.["抗球蛋白消耗试验"]
- phr.["a test for serum antibodies against cellular antigens. Cells are incubated with the serum sample and then with antiglobulin; any serum antibody that binds to the cells will take up antiglobulin. The amount of antiglobulin consumed is determined by testing the supernatant with antibody-coated red cells; the amount of agglutination is inversely proportional to the antiglobulin consumption."]

5512 antiglobulin reaction
- 
- phr.["抗球蛋白反应"]
- phr.["the agglutination of particles (usually erythrocytes) that have been (1) sensitized by the adsorption of soluble antigen, (2) treated with antibody to that antigen, and (3) treated with antiserum to the serum globulin of the animal species that produced the antibody."]

5513 antigoitrogenic
- /ˌæntɪˌgɔɪtrəʊˈdʒenɪk/
- adj.["抗甲状腺肿发生的"]
- adj.["preventing or inhibiting the development of goiter."]

5514 antigonadotropic
- /ˌæntɪgɒnədəʊˈtrɒpɪk/
- adj.["抗促性腺激素的"]
- adj.["inhibiting the secretion or actions of the gonadotropins."]

5515 antigravity
- /ˌæntɪˈgrævətɪ/

- n.["counteracting the pull of gravity."]

5516 antigravity muscles
- 
- phr.["抗重力肌，抗引力肌"]

5517 antihallucinatory
- /ˌæntɪhəˈluːsɪnəˌtərɪ/
- n.["抗幻觉的"]

5518 antihelix
- /ˌæntɪˈhiːlɪks/

5519 antihelmintic
- /ˌætɪhelˈmɪntɪk/
- adj.["抗蠕虫药；抗蠕虫的"]
- adj.["anthelmintic."]

5520 antihemagglutinin

5521 antihemolysin

5522 antihemolytic

5523 antihemophilic

- phr.["抗血友病因子A"]

5528 antihemorrhagic

- adj.["止血药，抗出血药；抗出血的"]
- adj.["preventing or stopping hemorrhage.","an agent that prevents or stops hemorrhage."]

- /ˌæntɪˈhʒːpiːz/
- n.["抗疱疹"]

5530 antiherpetic
- /ˌæntɪhʒːˈpetɪk/
- adj.["抗疱疹药；抗疱疹的"]
- adj.["acting against herpes.","an agent that acts against herpes."]

5531 antiheterolysin
- /ˌæntɪˌhetəˈrɒlɪsɪn/
- n.["抗异种溶素"]
- n.["a substance that counteracts heterolysin."]

5532 antihistamine
- /ˌæntɪˈhɪstəmɪ(ː)n/
- n.["抗组胺药"]
- n.["an agent that counteracts the action of histamine. While the term can broadly include any agent that blocks any histamine receptor, in practice it is usually used to denote those blocking H1 receptors (H1 receptor antagonists), which are the drugs conventionally used to treat allergic reactions and are also components of many cough and cold preparations. Agents blocking H2 receptors are usually called histamine H2 receptor antagonists, and include the agents used to inhibit gastric secretion in peptic ulcer. See also histamine."]

5533 antihistaminic
- /ˌæntɪhɪstəˈmɪnɪk/
- adj.["抗组胺药；抗组胺的"]

5534 antihormone
- /ˌæntɪˈhɔːməʊn/

5535 antihypercholesterolemic
- /ˌæntɪˌhaɪpə(ː)kɒˌlestərəˈliːmɪk/

5536 antihyperglycemic
- /ˌæntɪˌhaɪpə(ː)glaɪˈsiːmɪk/

- adj.["counteracting high levels of glucose in the blood.","an agent that counteracts high levels of glucose in the blood."]

5537 antihyperkalemic
- /ˌæntɪˌhaɪpə(ː)kəˈliːmɪk/
- adj.["抗高钾血药；抗高钾血的"]
- adj.["effective in decreasing or preventing an excessively high level of potassium in the blood.","an agent that decreases or prevents high levels of potassium in the blood."]

5538 antihyperlipidemic
- /ˌæntɪˌhaɪpə(ː)ɪlɪpɪdiːmɪk/

5539 antihyperlipoproteinemic
- /ˌæntɪˌhaɪpə(ː)ˌlɪpəʊˌprəʊtiːˈniːmɪk/

5540 antihypertensive
- /ˌæntɪˌhaɪpə(ː)ˈtensɪv/

5541 antihypnotic
- /ˌæntɪhɪpˈnɒtɪk/

5542 antihypoglycemic
- /ˌæntɪˌhaɪpəʊglaɪˈsiːmɪk/

5543 antihypotensive
- /ˌæntɪˌhaɪpəʊˈtensɪv/

5544 antiicteric
- /ˌæntɪɪkˈterɪk/

5545 antiinfective

- /ˌæntɪˌkiːtəʊˈdʒenɪsɪs/

5548 antiketogenic
- /ˌæntɪˌkiːtəʊˈdʒenɪk/

5549 antileishmanial
- /ˌæntɪleʃˈmeɪnɪəl/

5552 antileukocytic

5553 antileukotoxin
- /ˌæntɪˌljuːkəˈtɒksɪn/

5554 antileukotriene

5555 antilewisite
- /ˌæntɪˈljʊ(ː)ɪsaɪt/

5656 antipsychotic

- adj.["抗精神病药，精神抑制药；抑制精神的，抗精神活动的"]
- adj.["effective in treatment of psychosis.","an agent for treating psychosis. Antipsychotics are a chemically diverse group (including phenothiazines, thioxanthenes, butyrophenones, dibenzoxazepines, dibenzodiazepines, dihydroindolones, and diphenylbutylpiperidines), although they are pharmacologically similar; used to treat schizophrenic, paranoid, schizoaffective, and other psychotic disorders; acute delirium and dementia and manic episodes; to control the movement disorders associated with Huntington chorea, Gilles de la Tourette syndrome, and ballismus; and to treat intractable hiccups and severe nausea and vomiting. Antipsychotic agents bind to dopamine, histamine, muscarinic cholinergic, α-adrenergic, and serotonin receptors. Blockade of dopaminergic transmission in various areas is thought to be responsible for their major effects: antipsychotic action by blockade in the mesolimbic and mesocortical areas; extrapyramidal side effects (dystonia, akathisia, parkinsonism, and tardive dyskinesia) by blockade in the basal ganglia; and antiemetic effects by blockade in the chemoreceptor trigger zone of the medulla. Sedation and autonomic side effects (orthostatic hypotension, blurred vision, dry mouth, nasal congestion, and constipation) are caused by blockade of histamine, cholinergic, and adrenergic receptors. Called also neuroleptic."]

6110 Apley test
- 
- phr.["阿普利试验"]
- phr.["(for torn meniscus) the patient lies prone and flexes the knee of the leg being examined to 90 degrees, with the thigh stabilized by the examiner. For the Apley compression test, the examiner places one or both hands firmly on the heel of the flexed leg and opposes the tibia to the femur, then rotates the tibia externally and internally. An increase in pain, clicking, or locking on compression indicates a torn meniscus. For the Apley distraction test, the ankle is grasped with one or both hands, and the tibia is pulled upward, away from the femur, and then rotated externally and internally. Lessening of pain on distraction indicates a torn meniscus, while increase in pain indicates ligament injury.Apley test for detection of a meniscal tear of the knee."]

They concentrate the amino acid precursors of certain amines and decarboxylate them, forming amines that function as regulators and neurotransmitters. They produce substances such as epinephrine, norepinephrine, dopamine, serotonin, enkephalin, somatostatin, neurotensin, and substance P, the actions of which may affect contiguous cells, nearby groups of cells, or distant cells, thus functioning as local or systemic hormones. - n.["the arenaviruses: a family of RNA viruses having a pleomorphic virion 50–300 nm in diameter consisting of a lipid bilayer envelope, with large peplomers, surrounding a coiled nucleocapsid with two members and a variable number of ribosomes. The genome consists of two circular molecules of ambisense single-stranded RNA, designated L (MW 1.1×106) and S (MW 2.2–2.8×106) (size of total genome 10–14 kb). Viruses contain three major polypeptides, including a transcriptase, and are ultraviolet- and gamma radiation–sensitive. Replication and assembly occur in the cytoplasm; virions are released by budding through the plasma membrane. Host ranges are narrow. There is a single genus, Arenavirus."]

- phr.["central retinal artery: origin, ophthalmic artery; branches, superior and inferior nasal, and superior and inferior temporal; distribution, courses within dural sheath and then pierces and runs within optic nerve (extraocular part) to retina (intraocular part). Called also central artery of retina and artery of Zinn."]

6840 arteria cerebri anterior
- 
- phr.["大脑前动脉"]
- phr.["anterior cerebral artery: divided into two parts, the precommunicating part (pars precommunicalis), and the postcommunicating part (pars postcommunicalis); origin, internal carotid artery; branches, (precommunicating part) anteromedial central arteries; (postcommunicating part) distal medial striate, medial frontobasal, polar frontal, callosomarginal (and its branches), and pericallosal (and its branches) arteries; distribution, orbital, frontal, and parietal cortex, corpus callosum, diencephalon, corpus striatum, internal capsule, and choroid plexus of lateral ventricle. The artery is often described as comprising a number of segments; see segments of anterior cerebral artery, under segment."]

6841 arteria cerebri media
- 
- phr.["大脑中动脉"]
- phr.["middle cerebral artery: the larger terminal branch of the internal carotid artery. It begins as single vessel (sphenoid part or pars sphenoidalis) and branches at the limen insulae, turning posterosuperiorly, usually into inferior terminal branches (rami terminales inferiores) that distribute below the sylvian fissure, and superior terminal branches (rami terminales superiores) that distribute above the sylvian fissure. The superior and inferior branches run first in the sylvian fissure (insular part or pars insularis), through the inner aspects of the opercula (opercular part), and finally end along the lateral surface of the cerebral hemisphere. Branches, anterolateral central, polar temporal, anterior temporal, and insular arteries, anterior temporal, middle temporal, posterior temporal, and temporooccipital branches, branch to angular gyrus, lateral frontobasal, prefrontal, anterior parietal, and posterior parietal arteries, and arteries of precentral, central, and postcentral sulci; distribution, orbital, frontal, parietal, and temporal cortex, corpus striatum, internal capsule. Called also sylvian artery. See also specific parts and see segments of middle cerebral artery, under segment."]

6842 arteria cerebri posterior
- 
- phr.["大脑后动脉"]
- phr.["posterior cerebral artery: divided into four segments: the precommunicating part (pars precommunicalis), the postcommunicating part (pars postcommunicalis), the lateral occipital artery, and the medial occipital artery; origin, terminal bifurcation of basilar artery; branches, (precommunicating part) posteromedial central, short circumferential, thalamoperforating, and collicular arteries; (postcommunicating part) posterolateral central and thalamogeniculate arteries, and medial and lateral posterior choroidal, and peduncular branches; (lateral occipital artery) anterior, intermediate, and posterior temporal branches; (medial occipital artery) parietal, parietooccipital, calcarine, and occipitotemporal branches, and dorsal branch to corpus callosum; distribution, occipital and temporal cortex, diencephalon, midbrain, choroid plexus of lateral and third ventricles, and visual area of cerebral cortex and other structures associated with the visual pathway. See also segments of posterior cerebral artery under segment."]

6843 arteria cervicalis ascendens
- 
- phr.["颈升动脉"]
- phr.["ascending cervical artery: origin, inferior thyroid artery or directly from thyrocervical trunk; branches, spinal branches; distribution, muscles of neck, vertebrae, vertebral canal."]

6844 arteria cervicalis profunda
- 
- phr.["颈深动脉"]
- phr.["deep cervical artery: origin, costocervical trunk; branches, none; distribution, deep neck muscles."]

6845 arteria choroidea anterior
- 
- phr.["脉络丛前动脉"]
- phr.["anterior choroidal artery: origin, cervical part of internal carotid or sometimes middle cerebral artery; branches, many small branches; distribution, interior of brain, including choroid plexus of lateral ventricle and adjacent parts."]

6846 arteria circumflexa femoris lateralis
- 
- phr.["旋股外侧动脉"]
- phr.["lateral circumflex femoral artery: origin, deep femoral artery; branches, ascending, descending, and transverse branches; distribution, hip joint, thigh muscles."]

6847 arteria circumflexa femoris medialis
- 
- phr.["旋股内侧动脉"]
- phr.["medial circumflex femoral artery: origin, deep femoral artery; branches, deep, superficial, ascending, transverse, and acetabular branches; distribution, hip joint, thigh muscles."]

6848 arteria circumflexa humeri anterior
- 
- phr.["旋肱前动脉"]
- phr.["anterior circumflex humeral artery: origin, axillary artery; branches, none; distribution, shoulder joint and head of humerus, long tendon of biceps, tendon of pectoralis major muscle."]

6849 arteria circumflexa humeri posterior
- 
- phr.["旋肱后动脉"]
- phr.["posterior circumflex humeral artery: origin, axillary artery; branches; none; distribution, deltoideus, shoulder joint, teres minor and triceps muscles."]

6850 arteria circumflexa ilium profunda
- 
- phr.["旋髂深动脉"]
- phr.["deep circumflex iliac artery: origin, external iliac artery; branches, ascending branches; distribution, iliac region, abdominal wall, groin."]

6851 arteria circumflexa ilium superficialis
- 
- phr.["旋髂浅动脉"]
- phr.["superficial circumflex iliac artery: origin, femoral artery; branches, none; distribution, groin, abdominal wall."]

6852 arteria circumflexa scapulae
- 
- phr.["旋肩胛动脉"]
- phr.["circumflex artery of scapula: origin, subscapular artery; branches, none; distribution, inferolateral muscles of the scapula."]

6853 arteria cochlearis communis
- 
- phr.["蜗总动脉"]
- phr.["common cochlear artery: origin, labyrinthine artery; branches, vestibulocochlear, proper cochlear, and spiral modiolar arteries; distribution, cochlea and vestibule."]

6854 arteria cochlearis propria
- 
- phr.["蜗固有动脉"]
- phr.["proper cochlear artery: origin, common cochlear artery; branches, none; distribution, cochlea. Called also cochlear artery."]

6855 arteria colica dextra
- 
- phr.["右结肠动脉"]
- phr.["right colic artery: origin, superior mesenteric artery; branches, none; distribution, ascending colon. See illustration at arteria mesenterica superior."]

6856 arteria colica media
- 
- phr.["中结肠动脉"]
- phr.["middle colic artery: origin, superior mesenteric artery; branches, none; distribution, transverse colon. Called also accessory superior colic artery."]

6857 arteria colica sinistra
- 
- phr.["左结肠动脉"]
- phr.["left colic artery: origin, inferior mesenteric; branches, none; distribution, descending colon."]

6858 arteria collateralis media
- 
- phr.["中副动脉"]
- phr.["middle collateral artery: origin, profunda brachii artery; branches, none; distribution, triceps muscle, elbow joint."]

6859 arteria collateralis radialis
- 
- phr.["桡侧副动脉"]
- phr.["radial collateral artery: origin, profunda brachii artery; branches, none; distribution, brachioradialis and brachialis muscles."]

6860 arteria collateralis ulnaris inferior
- 
- phr.["尺侧下副动脉"]
- phr.["inferior ulnar collateral artery: origin, brachial artery; branches, none; distribution, arm muscles at back of elbow."]

6861 arteria collateralis ulnaris superior
- 
- phr.["尺侧上副动脉"]
- phr.["superior ulnar collateral artery: origin, brachial artery; branches, none; distribution, elbow joint, triceps muscle."]

6862 arteria collicularis
- 
- phr.["丘体动脉"]
- phr.["collicular artery: origin, precommunicating part of posterior cerebral artery; branches, none; distribution, corpora quadrigemina (superior and inferior colliculi) of the tectum of the mesencephalon. Called also a. quadrigeminalis [TA alternative] and quadrigeminal artery."]

6863 arteria comitans nervi ischiadici
- 
- phr.["坐骨神经伴行动脉"]
- phr.["artery to sciatic nerve: origin, inferior gluteal artery; branches, none; distribution, accompanies sciatic nerve. Called also artery to sciatic nerve and sciatic artery."]

6864 arteria comitans nervi mediani
- 
- phr.["正中神经伴行动脉"]
- phr.["accompanying artery of median nerve: origin, anterior interosseous artery; branches, none; distribution, median nerve, muscles of front of forearm. Called also median artery."]

6865 arteria commissuralis mediana
- 
- phr.["正中连合动脉"]
- phr.["median commissural artery: origin, anterior communicating artery; branches, none; distribution, supraoptic commissures and optic chiasm."]

6866 arteria communicans anterior
- 
- phr.["前交通动脉"]
- phr.["anterior communicating artery: origin, precommunicating part of anterior cerebral artery; branches, anteromedial central arteries; distribution, establishes connection between the right and left anterior cerebral arteries."]

6867 arteria communicans posterior
- 
- phr.["后交通动脉"]
- phr.["posterior communicating artery: establishes connection between internal carotid and posterior cerebral arteries; branches, posteromedial central, thalamotuberal, and mammillary arteries, artery of tuber cinereum, and branches to the optic chiasm, oculomotor nerve, and hypothalamus."]

6868 arteria coronaria dextra
- 
- phr.["右冠状动脉"]
- phr.["right coronary artery: origin, right aortic sinus; branches, conus artery and atrial, atrioventricular node, intermediate atrial, posterior interventricular, right marginal, and sinoatrial node branches; distribution, right ventricle, right atrium.Arteria coronaria dextra (right coronary artery) and arteria coronaria sinistra (left coronary artery) and some of their branches in an anterior view of the heart."]

6869 arteria coronaria sinistra
- 
- phr.["左冠状动脉"]
- phr.["left coronary artery: origin, left aortic sinus; branches, anterior interventricular and circumflex branches; distribution, left ventricle, left atrium."]

6870 arteria cremasterica
- 
- phr.["提睾肌动脉"]
- phr.["cremasteric artery: origin, inferior epigastric artery; branches, none; distribution, cremaster muscle, coverings of spermatic cord. Called also external spermatic artery."]

6871 arteria cystica
- 
- phr.["胆囊动脉"]
- phr.["cystic artery: origin, right branch of hepatic artery proper; branches, none; distribution, gallbladder."]

6872 arteria descendens genus
- 
- phr.["膝降动脉"]
- phr.["descending genicular artery: origin, femoral artery; branches, saphenous, articular; distribution, knee joint, upper and medial leg."]

6873 arteria dorsalis clitoridis
- 
- phr.["阴蒂背动脉"]
- phr.["dorsal artery of clitoris: origin, internal pudendal artery; branches, none; distribution, clitoris."]

6874 arteria dorsalis nasi
- 
- phr.["鼻背动脉，鼻外动脉"]
- phr.["dorsal nasal artery: origin, ophthalmic artery; branches, branch to nasolacrimal sac and branch anastomosing with terminal part of facial artery; distribution, skin of nose. Called also external nasal artery."]

6875 arteria dorsalis pedis
- 
- phr.["足背动脉"]
- phr.["dorsal artery of foot: origin, continuation of anterior tibial artery; branches, lateral and medial tarsal, arcuate, and deep plantar arteries; distribution, foot, toes."]

6876 arteria dorsalis penis
- 
- phr.["阴茎背动脉"]
- phr.["dorsal artery of penis: origin, internal pudendal artery; branches, none; distribution, glans, corona, and prepuce of penis."]

6877 arteria dorsalis scapulae
- 
- phr.["肩胛背动脉，深支"]
- phr.["origin, second or third part of subclavian artery; branches, none; distribution, rhomboid, latissimus dorsi, and trapezius muscles.","TA alternative for the same artery when it occurs as the deep branch of the transverse cervical artery (ramus profundus arteriae transversae colli)."]

6878 arteria ductus deferentis
- 
- phr.["输精管动脉"]
- phr.["artery of ductus deferens: origin, umbilical artery; branches, ureteral artery; distribution, ureter, ductus deferens, seminal vesicles, testes. Called also deferential artery."]

6879 arteria epigastrica inferior
- 
- phr.["腹壁下动脉"]
- phr.["inferior epigastric artery: origin, external iliac artery; branches, pubic branch, cremasteric artery, artery of round ligament of uterus; distribution, abdominal wall."]

6880 arteria epigastrica superficialis
- 
- phr.["腹壁浅动脉"]
- phr.["superficial epigastric artery: origin, femoral artery; branches, none; distribution, abdominal wall, groin."]

6881 arteria epigastrica superior
- 
- phr.["腹壁上动脉"]
- phr.["superior epigastric artery: origin, internal thoracic artery; branches, none; distribution, abdominal wall, diaphragm."]

6882 arteria ethmoidalis anterior
- 
- phr.["筛前动脉"]
- phr.["anterior ethmoidal artery: origin, ophthalmic artery; branches, anterior meningeal, anterior septal, and anterior lateral nasal branches; distribution, dura mater, nose, frontal sinus, anterior ethmoidal cells."]

6883 arteria ethmoidalis posterior
- 
- phr.["筛后动脉"]
- phr.["posterior ethmoidal artery: origin, ophthalmic artery; branches, meningeal and septal and lateral nasal branches; distribution, posterior ethmoidal cells, dura mater, nose."]

6884 arteria facialis
- 
- phr.["面动脉"]
- phr.["facial artery: origin, external carotid artery; branches, ascending palatine, tonsillar, submental, inferior labial, superior labial, septal, lateral nasal, angular, glandular; distribution, face, tonsil, palate, submandibular gland. Called also external maxillary artery."]

6885 arteria femoralis
- 
- phr.["股动脉"]
- phr.["femoral artery: origin, continuation of external iliac; branches, superficial epigastric, superficial circumflex iliac, external pudendal, deep femoral, descending genicular; distribution, lower abdominal wall, external genitalia, lower extremity. note: Vascular surgeons refer to the portion of the femoral artery proximal to the branching of the deep femoral as the common femoral a., and to its continuation as the superficial femoral a. In this classification, the descending genicular artery is a branch of the superficial femoral artery."]

6886 arteria fibularis
- 
- phr.["腓动脉"]
- phr.["peroneal artery: origin, posterior tibial artery; branches, perforating, communicating, calcaneal, and lateral and medial malleolar branches, and calcaneal rete; distribution, outside and back of ankle, deep calf muscles. Called also a. peronea [TA alternative]."]

6887 arteria frontobasalis lateralis
- 
- phr.["额叶底外侧动脉，眶额外侧支"]
- phr.["lateral frontobasal artery: origin, superior terminal branch of middle cerebral artery: branches, none; distribution, cortex of lateroinferior frontal lobe. Called also a. orbitofrontalis lateralis [TA alternative] and orbitofrontal artery."]

6888 arteria frontobasalis medialis
- 
- phr.["额叶底内侧动脉，眶额内侧支"]
- phr.["medial frontobasal artery: origin, postcommunicating part of anterior cerebral artery; branches, none; distribution, cortex of medioinferior frontal lobe. Called also a. orbitofrontalis medialis [TA alternative] and medial orbitofrontal artery."]

6889 arteria gastrica dextra
- 
- phr.["胃右动脉"]
- phr.["right gastric artery: origin, common hepatic artery; branches, none; distribution, lesser curvature of stomach. Called also pyloric artery."]

6890 arteria gastrica posterior
- 
- phr.["胃后动脉"]
- phr.["posterior gastric artery: origin, splenic artery; branches, none; distribution, posterior gastric wall."]

6891 arteria gastrica sinistra
- 
- phr.["胃左动脉"]
- phr.["left gastric artery: origin, celiac trunk; branches, esophageal branches; distribution, esophagus, lesser curvature of stomach. Called also left coronary artery of stomach."]

6892 arteria gastroduodenalis
- 
- phr.["胃十二指肠动脉"]
- phr.["gastroduodenal artery: origin, common hepatic artery; branches, supraduodenal and posterior superior pancreaticoduodenal arteries; distribution, stomach, duodenum, pancreas, greater omentum."]

6893 arteria gastroomentalis dextra
- 
- phr.["胃网膜右动脉"]
- phr.["right gastro-omental artery: origin, gastroduodenal artery; branches, gastric, omental branches; distribution, stomach, greater omentum. Called also right inferior gastric artery."]

6894 arteria gastroomentalis sinistra
- 
- phr.["胃网膜左动脉"]
- phr.["left gastro-omental artery: origin, splenic artery; branches, gastric, omental branches; distribution, stomach, greater omentum. Called also left inferior gastric artery."]

6895 arteria gyri angularis
- 
- phr.["角回动脉"]
- phr.["ramus gyri angularis arteriae cerebri mediae."]

6896 arteria hepatica communis
- 
- phr.["肝总动脉"]
- phr.["common hepatic artery: origin, celiac trunk; branches, right gastric and gastroduodenal arteries and hepatic artery proper; distribution, stomach, pancreas, duodenum, liver, gallbladder, greater omentum."]

6897 arteria hepatica propria
- 
- phr.["肝固有动脉"]
- phr.["hepatic artery proper: origin, common hepatic artery; branches, right and left branches; distribution, liver, gallbladder."]

6898 arteria hyaloidea
- 
- phr.["玻璃体动脉"]
- phr.["hyaloid artery: a fetal vessel that continues forward from the central artery of retina through the vitreous body to supply the lens; it normally is not present after birth."]

6899 arteria hypophysialis inferior
- 
- phr.["垂体下动脉"]
- phr.["inferior hypophysial artery: a small branch from the cavernous part of the internal carotid artery that supplies the pituitary gland."]

6900 arteria hypophysialis superior
- 
- phr.["垂体上动脉"]
- phr.["superior hypophysial artery: a small branch from the cerebral part of the internal carotid artery that supplies the pituitary gland."]

6901 arteria ileocolica
- 
- phr.["回结肠动脉"]
- phr.["ileocolic artery: origin, superior mesenteric artery; branches, anterior and posterior cecal and appendicular arteries and colic (ascending) and ileal branches; distribution, ileum, cecum, vermiform appendix, ascending colon. Called also inferior right colic artery. See illustration at arteria mesenterica superior."]

6902 arteria iliaca communis
- 
- phr.["髂总动脉"]
- phr.["common iliac artery: origin, abdominal aorta; branches, internal and external iliac arteries; distribution, pelvis, abdominal wall, lower limb."]

6903 arteria iliaca externa
- 
- phr.["髂外动脉"]
- phr.["external iliac artery: origin, common iliac; branches, inferior epigastric, deep circumflex iliac arteries; distribution, abdominal wall, external genitalia, lower limb. Called also anterior iliac artery."]

6904 arteria iliaca interna
- 
- phr.["髂内动脉"]
- phr.["internal iliac artery: origin, continuation of common iliac artery; branches, iliolumbar, obturator, superior gluteal, inferior gluteal, umbilical, inferior vesical, uterine, middle rectal, and internal pudendal arteries; distribution, wall and viscera of pelvis, buttock, reproductive organs, medial aspect of thigh. Called also hypogastric artery and posterior pelvic artery."]

6905 arteria iliolumbalis
- 
- phr.["髂腰动脉"]
- phr.["iliolumbar artery: origin, posterior trunk of internal iliac artery; branches, iliac, spinal, and lumbar branches; distribution, pelvic muscles and bones, fifth lumbar segment, sacrum. Called also small iliac artery."]

6906 arteria inferior anterior cerebelli
- 
- phr.["小脑下前动脉"]

6907 arteria inferior lateralis genus
- 
- phr.["膝下外侧动脉"]
- phr.["lateral inferior artery of knee: origin, popliteal artery; branches, none; distribution, knee joint. Called also lateral inferior genicular artery."]

6908 arteria inferior medialis genus
- 
- phr.["膝下内侧动脉"]
- phr.["medial inferior artery of knee: origin, popliteal artery; branches, none; distribution, knee joint. Called also medial inferior genicular artery."]

6909 arteria inferior posterior cerebelli
- 
- phr.["小脑下后动脉"]
- phr.["posterior inferior cerebellar artery: origin, vertebral artery; branches, medial, lateral and cerebellar tonsillar branches, choroidal branch to fourth ventricle, posterior spinal artery; distribution, lower and medial cerebellum, medulla."]

6910 arteria infraorbitalis
- 
- phr.["眶下动脉"]
- phr.["infraorbital artery: origin, maxillary artery; branches, anterior superior alveolar arteries; distribution, maxilla, maxillary sinus, upper teeth, lower eyelid, cheek, nose."]

6911 arteria intercostalis posterior prima

- phr.["第一肋间后动脉"]

6912 arteria intercostalis posterior secunda
- 
- phr.["第二肋间后动脉"]

6913 arteria intercostalis suprema
- 
- phr.["肋间最上动脉，肠系膜间动脉"]

6914 arteria interossea anterior
- 
- phr.["骨间前动脉"]
- phr.["anterior interosseous artery: origin, posterior or common interosseous artery; branches, median artery; distribution, deep parts of front of forearm. Called also volar interosseous artery."]

6915 arteria interossea communis
- 
- phr.["骨间总动脉"]
- phr.["common interosseous artery: origin, ulnar artery; branches, anterior and posterior interosseous arteries; distribution, antecubital fossa."]

6916 arteria interossea posterior
- 
- phr.["骨间后动脉"]
- phr.["posterior interosseous artery: origin, common interosseous artery; branches, recurrent interosseous artery; distribution, deep parts of back of forearm. Called also dorsal interosseous artery."]

6917 arteria interossea recurrens
- 
- phr.["骨间返动脉"]
- phr.["recurrent interosseous artery: origin, posterior interosseous or common interosseous artery; branches, none; distribution, back of elbow joint."]

6918 arteria juxtacolica
- 
- phr.["近结肠动脉"]
- phr.["TA alternative for a. marginalis coli."]

6919 arteria labialis inferior
- 
- phr.["下唇动脉"]
- phr.["inferior labial artery: origin, facial artery; branches, none; distribution, lower lip."]

6920 arteria labialis superior
- 
- phr.["上唇动脉"]
- phr.["superior labial artery: origin, facial artery; branches, septal and alar; distribution, upper lip, nose."]

6921 arteria labyrinthi
- 
- phr.["迷路动脉，内耳道支"]
- phr.["labyrinthine artery: origin, anterior inferior cerebellar or basilar artery; branches, anterior vestibular and common cochlear arteries; distribution, through the internal acoustic meatus to the internal ear. Called also internal auditory artery."]

6922 arteria lacrimalis
- 
- phr.["泪腺动脉"]
- phr.["lacrimal artery: origin, ophthalmic artery; branches, lateral palpebral arteries and anastomotic branch with middle meningeal artery; distribution, lacrimal gland, upper and lower eyelids, conjunctiva."]

6923 arteria laryngea inferior
- 
- phr.["喉下动脉"]
- phr.["inferior laryngeal artery: origin, inferior thyroid artery; branches, none; distribution, larynx, trachea, esophagus."]

6924 arteria laryngea superior
- 
- phr.["喉上动脉"]
- phr.["superior laryngeal artery: origin, superior thyroid artery; branches, none; distribution, larynx."]

6925 arteria lienalis
- 
- phr.["脾动脉"]
- phr.["TA alternative for a. splenica."]

6926 arteria ligamenti teretis uteri
- 
- phr.["子宫圆韧带动脉"]
- phr.["artery of round ligament of uterus: origin, inferior epigastric artery; branches, none; distribution, round ligament of uterus."]

6927 arteria lingualis
- 
- phr.["舌动脉"]
- phr.["lingual artery: origin, external carotid artery; branches, suprahyoid, sublingual, dorsal lingual, deep lingual; distribution, tongue, sublingual gland, tonsil, epiglottis."]

6928 arteria lobaris media pulmonis dextri
- 
- phr.["右肺中叶动脉"]
- phr.["middle lobar artery of right lung: the branch of the right pulmonary artery that carries blood to the middle lobe of the right lung, giving rise to the lateral and medial segmental arteries."]

6929 arteria lobi caudati
- 
- phr.["尾状叶动脉"]

6930 arteria lusoria
- 
- phr.["畸形动脉"]

6931 arteria malleolaris anterior lateralis
- 
- phr.["外踝前动脉"]

6932 arteria malleolaris anterior medialis
- 
- phr.["内踝前动脉"]

6933 arteria marginalis coli
- 
- phr.["结肠缘动脉"]

Called also a. juxtacolica and arcus marginalis coli [TA alternatives], juxtacolic artery, marginal artery of Drummond, and marginal arcade."]

6934 arteria masseterica
- 
- phr.["咬肌动脉"]

6935 arteria maxillaris
- 
- phr.["上颌动脉"]

Called also internal maxillary artery."]

6936 arteria media genus
- 
- phr.["膝中动脉"]

6937 arteria medullaris segmentalis

6938 arteria meningea media
- 
- phr.["脑膜中动脉"]

6939 arteria meningea posterior
- 
- phr.["脑膜后动脉"]
- phr.["posterior meningeal artery: origin, ascending pharyngeal artery; branches, none; distribution, bones and dura mater of posterior cranial fossa."]

6940 arteria mesenterica inferior

7055 arteria suprascapularis
- 
- phr.["肩胛上动脉"]
- phr.["suprascapular artery: origin, thyrocervical trunk; branches, acromial branch; distribution, clavicular, deltoid, and scapular regions. Called also transverse scapular artery."]

7056 arteria supratrochlearis
- 
- phr.["滑车上动脉"]
- phr.["supratrochlear artery: origin, ophthalmic artery; branches, none; distribution, anterior scalp. Called also frontal artery."]

7057 arteria tarsalis lateralis
- 
- phr.["跗外侧动脉"]
- phr.["lateral tarsal artery: origin, dorsalis pedis artery; branches, none; distribution, tarsus."]

7058 arteria temporalis anterior
- 
- phr.["颞叶前动脉"]
- phr.["anterior temporal artery: origin, sphenoid part of middle cerebral artery; branches, none; distribution, cortex of anterior temporal lobe. Called also anterior temporal artery."]

7059 arteria temporalis media
- 
- phr.["颞中动脉，颞叶中动脉"]
- phr.["middle temporal artery: origin, superficial temporal artery; branches, none; distribution temporal region.","ramus temporalis medius arteriae cerebri mediae."]

7060 arteria temporalis profunda anterior
- 
- phr.["颞深前动脉"]
- phr.["anterior deep temporal artery: origin, maxillary artery; branches, to zygomatic bone and greater wing of sphenoid bone; distribution, temporalis muscle, and anastomoses with middle temporal artery."]

7061 arteria temporalis profunda posterior
- 
- phr.["颞深后动脉"]
- phr.["posterior deep temporal artery: origin, maxillary artery; branches, none; distribution, temporal muscle, and anastomoses with middle temporal artery."]

7062 arteria temporalis superficialis
- 
- phr.["颞浅动脉"]
- phr.["superficial temporal artery: origin, external carotid artery; branches, parotid, auricular, and occipital rami, transverse facial, zygomatico-orbital, and middle temporal arteries; distribution, parotid and temporal regions."]

7063 arteria testicularis
- 
- phr.["睾丸动脉"]
- phr.["testicular artery: origin, abdominal aorta; branches, ureteral, epididymal; distribution, ureter, epididymis, testis. Called also funicular artery."]

7064 arteria thalamogeniculata
- 
- phr.["丘脑膝状体动脉"]
- phr.["thalamogeniculate artery: origin, postcommunicating part of posterior cerebral artery; branches, none; distribution, caudal thalamus."]

7065 arteria thalamotuberalis
- 
- phr.["丘脑结节动脉"]
- phr.["thalamotuberal artery: origin, posterior communicating artery; branches, none; distribution, premammillary area. Called also premammillary artery."]

7066 arteria thoracica interna
- 
- phr.["胸廓内动脉"]
- phr.["internal thoracic artery: origin, subclavian artery; branches, mediastinal, thymic, bronchial, tracheal, sternal, perforating, medial mammary, lateral costal, and anterior intercostal branches, pericardiacophrenic, musculophrenic, and superior epigastric arteries; distribution, anterior thoracic wall, mediastinal structures, diaphragm. Called also internal mammary artery."]

7067 arteria thoracica lateralis
- 
- phr.["胸外侧动脉"]
- phr.["lateral thoracic artery: origin, axillary artery; branches, mammary branches; distribution, pectoral muscles, mammary gland. Called also external mammary artery."]

7068 arteria thoracica superior
- 
- phr.["胸上动脉"]
- phr.["superior thoracic artery: origin, axillary artery; branches, none; distribution, axillary aspect of chest wall. Called also highest thoracic artery."]

7069 arteria thoracoacromialis
- 
- phr.["胸肩峰动脉"]
- phr.["thoracoacromial artery: origin, axillary artery; branches, clavicular, pectoral, deltoid, acromial rami; distribution, deltoid, clavicular, and thoracic regions. Called also acromiothoracic artery, thoracicoacromial artery, and thoracic axis."]

7070 arteria thoracodorsalis
- 
- phr.["胸背动脉"]
- phr.["thoracodorsal artery: origin, subscapular artery; branches, none; distribution, subscapularis and teres muscles."]

7071 arteria thyroidea ima
- 
- phr.["甲状腺最下动脉"]
- phr.["lowest thyroid artery: origin, arch of aorta, brachiocephalic trunk, or right common carotid, internal mammary, subclavian, or inferior thyroid arteries; branches, none; distribution, thyroid gland. Called also Neubauer artery."]

7072 arteria thyroidea inferior
- 
- phr.["甲状腺下动脉"]
- phr.["inferior thyroid artery: origin, thyrocervical trunk; branches, pharyngeal, esophageal, and tracheal rami, inferior laryngeal and ascending cervical arteries; distribution, thyroid gland and adjacent structures."]

7073 arteria thyroidea superior
- 
- phr.["甲状腺上动脉"]
- phr.["superior thyroid artery: origin, external carotid artery; branches, hyoid, sternocleidomastoid, superior laryngeal, cricothyroid, muscular, and anterior, posterior, and lateral glandular branches; distribution, thyroid gland and adjacent structures."]

7074 arteria tibialis anterior
- 
- phr.["胫前动脉"]
- phr.["anterior tibial artery: origin, popliteal artery; branches, posterior and anterior tibial recurrent, and lateral and medial anterior malleolar arteries, lateral and medial malleolar retia; distribution, leg, ankle, foot."]

7075 arteria tibialis posterior
- 
- phr.["胫后动脉"]
- phr.["posterior tibial artery: origin, popliteal artery; branches, fibular circumflex branch, peroneal, medial plantar, and lateral plantar arteries; distribution, leg, foot."]

7076 arteria transversa cervicis
- 
- phr.["颈横动脉"]
- phr.["transverse artery of neck: origin, subclavian artery; branches, deep and superficial branches; distribution, root of neck, muscles of scapula. Called also transverse cervical artery and a. transversa colli [TA alternative]."]

7077 arteria transversa colli
- 
- phr.["颈横动脉"]
- phr.["TA alternative for a. transversa cervicis."]

7078 arteria transversa faciei
- 
- phr.["面横动脉"]
- phr.["transverse facial artery: origin, superficial temporal artery; branches, none; distribution, parotid region."]

7079 arteria tympanica anterior
- 
- phr.["鼓室前动脉"]
- phr.["anterior tympanic artery: origin, maxillary artery; branches, none; distribution, tympanic cavity."]

7080 arteria tympanica inferior
- 
- phr.["鼓室下动脉"]
- phr.["inferior tympanic artery: origin, ascending pharyngeal artery; branches, none; distribution, tympanic cavity."]

7081 arteria tympanica posterior
- 
- phr.["鼓室后动脉"]
- phr.["posterior tympanic artery: origin, stylomastoid artery; branches, none; distribution, tympanic cavity."]

7082 arteria tympanica superior
- 
- phr.["鼓室上动脉"]
- phr.["superior tympanic artery: origin, middle meningeal artery; branches, none; distribution, tympanic cavity."]

7083 arteria ulnaris
- 
- phr.["尺动脉"]
- phr.["ulnar artery: origin, brachial artery; branches, palmar carpal, dorsal carpal, and deep palmar rami, ulnar recurrent and common interosseous arteries, superficial palmar arch; distribution, forearm, wrist, hand."]

7084 arteria umbilicalis
- 
- phr.["脐动脉"]
- phr.["umbilical artery: origin, internal iliac artery; branches, artery of ductus deferens and superior vesical arteries; distribution, ductus deferens, seminal vesicles, testes, urinary bladder, ureter. In the fetus, there is also a distal segment of the artery that passes upward along the urinary bladder into the umbilical cord; it is obliterated after birth, becoming the medial umbilical ligament."]

7085 arteria urethralis
- 
- phr.["尿道动脉"]
- phr.["urethral artery: origin, internal pudendal artery; branches, none; distribution, urethra."]

7086 arteria uterina
- 
- phr.["子宫动脉"]
- phr.["uterine artery: origin, internal iliac artery; branches, ovarian and tubal rami, vaginal artery; distribution, uterus, vagina, round ligament of uterus, uterine tube, ovary. Called also fallopian artery."]

7087 arteria vaginalis
- 
- phr.["阴道动脉"]
- phr.["vaginal artery: origin, uterine artery; branches, none; distribution, vagina, fundus of bladder."]

7088 arteria vertebralis
- 
- phr.["椎动脉"]
- phr.["vertebral artery: divided into four parts: the first or prevertebral part (pars prevertebralis), the second or cervical part (pars transversaria), the third or atlantal part (pars atlantica), and the fourth or intracranial part (pars intracranialis); origin, subclavian artery; branches, (cervical part) spinal and muscular branches; (intracranial part) anterior spinal artery and posterior inferior cerebellar artery and its branches, meningeal branches, and lateral and medial medullary branches; distribution, muscles of neck, vertebrae, spinal cord, cerebellum, medulla oblongata. The artery is also described as being subdivided into four segments, V1–V4, corresponding to the four parts, respectively. See also illustration at arteria carotis communis."]

7089 arteria vesicalis inferior
- 
- phr.["膀胱下动脉"]
- phr.["inferior vesical artery: origin, internal iliac artery; branches, prostatic branches; distribution, bladder, prostate, seminal vesicles, lower ureter."]

7090 arteria vestibulocochlearis
- 
- phr.["前庭蜗动脉"]
- phr.["vestibulocochlear artery: origin, common cochlear artery; branches, cochlear and posterior vestibular branches; distribution, cochlea, saccule, semicircular canals."]

7091 arteria zygomaticoorbitalis
- 
- phr.["颧眶动脉"]
- phr.["zygomatico-orbital artery: origin, superficial temporal artery; branches, none; distribution, lateral side of orbit."]

7092 arteriae alveolares superiores anteriores
- 
- phr.["上牙槽前动脉"]
- phr.["anterior superior alveolar arteries: origin, infraorbital artery; branches, dental and peridental rami; distribution, incisor and canine regions of upper jaw, maxillary sinus. Called also anterior dental arteries."]

7093 arteriae arcuatae renis
- 
- phr.["肾弓状动脉"]
- phr.["arcuate arteries of kidney: origin, interlobar artery; branches, interlobular artery and arteriolae rectae; distribution, parenchyma of kidney."]

7094 arteriae azygoi vaginae
- 
- phr.["阴道奇动脉，子宫动脉阴道支"]
- phr.["rami vaginales arteriae uterinae."]

7095 arteriae caroticotympanicae
- 
- phr.["颈鼓动脉"]
- phr.["caroticotympanic arteries: branches of the petrous part of the internal carotid artery that supply the tympanic cavity."]

7096 arteriae centrales anterolaterales
- 
- phr.["前外侧中央动脉，前外侧丘纹动脉"]
- phr.["anterolateral central arteries: origin, sphenoid part (M1 segment) of middle cerebral artery; branches; two sets of branches, proximal lateral and distal lateral; distribution, anterior lenticular and caudate nuclei and internal capsule of brain. Called also anterolateral thalamostriate arteries, lenticulostriate arteries, and lateral striate arteries."]

7097 arteriae centrales anteromediales
- 
- phr.["前内侧中央动脉，前内侧丘纹动脉"]
- phr.["anteromedial central arteries: origin, anterior communicating artery and precommunicating part (A1 segment) of anterior cerebral artery; branches, none; distribution, anterior and medial corpus striatum. Called also anteromedial thalamostriate arteries."]

7098 arteriae centrales posterolaterales
- 
- phr.["后外侧中央动脉"]
- phr.["posterolateral central arteries: origin, postcommunicating part of posterior cerebral artery; branches, none; distribution, cerebral peduncle, posterior thalamus, colliculi, medial geniculate and pineal bodies. The group includes the thalamogeniculate artery and the peduncular and posterior medial and lateral choroidal branches."]

7099 arteriae ciliares anteriores
- 
- phr.["睫前动脉"]
- phr.["anterior ciliary arteries: origin, muscular arteries; branches, episcleral and anterior conjunctival arteries; distribution, iris, conjunctiva."]

7100 arteriae ciliares posteriores breves
- 
- phr.["睫后短动脉"]
- phr.["short posterior ciliary arteries: origin, ophthalmic artery; branches, none; distribution, choroid coat of eye. Called also short ciliary arteries."]

7101 arteriae ciliares posteriores longae
- 
- phr.["睫后长动脉"]
- phr.["long posterior ciliary arteries: origin, ophthalmic artery; branches, none; distribution, iris, ciliary processes. Called also long ciliary arteries."]

7102 arteriae conjunctivales anteriores
- 
- phr.["结膜前动脉"]
- phr.["anterior conjunctival arteries: origin, anterior ciliary arteries; branches, none; distribution, conjunctiva."]

7103 arteriae conjunctivales posteriores
- 
- phr.["结膜后动脉"]
- phr.["posterior conjunctival arteries: origin, medial palpebral arteries; branches, none; distribution, caruncula lacrimalis, conjunctiva."]

7104 arteriae digitales dorsales manus
- 
- phr.["指背动脉"]
- phr.["dorsal digital arteries of hand: origin, dorsal metacarpal arteries; branches, none; distribution, dorsum of fingers."]

7105 arteriae digitales dorsales pedis
- 
- phr.["趾背动脉"]
- phr.["dorsal digital arteries of foot: origin, dorsal metatarsal arteries; branches, none; distribution, dorsum of toes."]

7106 arteriae digitales palmares communes
- 
- phr.["指掌侧总动脉"]
- phr.["common palmar digital arteries: origin, superficial palmar arch; branches, proper palmar digital arteries; distribution, fingers. Called also common volar digital arteries and ulnar metacarpal arteries."]

7107 arteriae digitales palmares propriae
- 
- phr.["指掌侧固有动脉"]
- phr.["proper palmar digital arteries: origin, common palmar digital arteries; branches, none; distribution, fingers. Called also collateral digital arteries and proper volar digital arteries."]

7108 arteriae digitales plantares communes
- 
- phr.["趾足底总动脉"]
- phr.["common plantar digital arteries: origin, plantar metatarsal arteries; branches, proper plantar digital arteries; distribution, toes."]

7109 arteriae digitales plantares propriae
- 
- phr.["趾足底固有动脉"]
- phr.["proper plantar digital arteries: origin, common plantar digital arteries; branches, none; distribution, toes."]

7110 arteriae episclerales
- 
- phr.["巩膜外动脉"]
- phr.["episcleral arteries: origin, anterior ciliary arteries; branches, none; distribution, iris, ciliary processes."]

7111 arteriae gastricae breves
- 
- phr.["胃短动脉"]
- phr.["short gastric arteries: origin, splenic artery; branches, none; distribution, upper part of stomach."]

7112 arteriae helicinae penis
- 
- phr.["阴茎螺旋动脉"]
- phr.["helicine arteries of penis: helicine arteries arising from the vessels of the penis, whose engorgement causes erection of the organ. Called also arteries of Mueller."]

7113 arteriae ileales
- 
- phr.["回肠动脉"]
- phr.["ileal arteries: origin, superior mesenteric artery; branches, none; distribution, ileum. See illustration at arteria mesenterica superior."]

7114 arteriae insulares
- 
- phr.["岛动脉"]
- phr.["insular arteries: origin, insular part of middle cerebral artery; branches, none; distribution, cortex of insula."]

7115 arteriae intercostales posteriores
- 
- phr.["肋间后动脉"]
- phr.["posterior intercostal arteries: for the first two, see a. intercostalis posterior prima and a. intercostalis posterior secunda; there are nine other pairs (III–XI): origin, thoracic aorta; branches, dorsal, collateral, muscular, and lateral cutaneous; distribution, thoracic wall."]

7116 arteriae interlobares renis
- 
- phr.["肾叶间动脉"]
- phr.["interlobar arteries of kidney: origin, lobar branches of segmental arteries; branches, arcuate arteries; distribution, parenchyma of kidney."]

7117 arteriae interlobulares hepatis
- 
- phr.["肝小叶间动脉"]
- phr.["interlobular arteries of liver: arteries originating from the right or left branch of the hepatic artery proper, forming a plexus outside each hepatic lobule and supplying the walls of the interlobular veins and the accompanying bile ducts."]

7118 arteriae interlobulares renis
- 
- phr.["肾小叶间动脉"]
- phr.["TA alternative for arteriae corticales radiatae."]

7119 arteriae intrarenales
- 
- phr.["肾内动脉"]
- phr.["intrarenal arteries: the arteries within the kidney, including the interlobar, arcuate, and cortical radiate (interlobular) arteries, and the arteriolae rectae."]

7120 arteriae jejunales
- 
- phr.["空肠动脉"]
- phr.["jejunal arteries: origin, superior mesenteric; branches, none; distribution, jejunum. See illustration at arteria mesenterica superior."]

7121 arteriae lobares inferiores pulmonis dextri
- 
- phr.["右肺下叶动脉"]
- phr.["inferior lobar arteries of right lung: the branches of the right pulmonary artery that supply the inferior lobe of the right lung, consisting of the superior, anterior basal, lateral basal, medial basal, and posterior basal segmental arteries."]

7122 arteriae lobares inferiores pulmonis sinistri
- 
- phr.["左肺下叶动脉"]
- phr.["inferior lobar arteries of left lung: the branches of the left pulmonary artery that supply the inferior lobe of the left lung, consisting of the superior, anterior basal, lateral basal, medial basal, and posterior basal segmental arteries."]

7123 arteriae lobares superiores pulmonis dextri
- 
- phr.["右肺上叶动脉"]
- phr.["superior lobar arteries of right lung: the branches of the right pulmonary artery that carry blood to the superior lobe of the right lung, consisting of the apical, anterior, and posterior segmental arteries."]

7124 arteriae lobares superiores pulmonis sinistri
- 
- phr.["左肺上叶动脉"]
- phr.["superior lobar arteries of left lung: the branches of the left pulmonary artery that carry blood to the superior lobe of the left lung, consisting of the apical, anterior, and posterior segmental arteries."]

7125 arteriae lumbales
- 
- phr.["腰动脉"]
- phr.["lumbar arteries: origin, abdominal aorta; branches, dorsal and spinal branches; distribution, posterior abdominal wall, renal capsule."]

7126 arteriae lumbales imae
- 
- phr.["腰最下动脉"]
- phr.["lowest lumbar arteries: origin, median sacral artery; branches, none; distribution, sacrum, gluteus maximus muscle. Called also fifth lumbar arteries."]

7127 arteriae mammillares
- 
- phr.["乳腺动脉"]
- phr.["mammillary arteries: origin, posterior communicating artery; branches, none; distribution, mammillary bodies."]

7128 arteriae membri inferioris
- 
- phr.["腰下动脉"]
- phr.["arteries of lower limb: the arteries supplying the thigh, leg, and foot, including the external iliac, femoral, deep femoral, popliteal, anterior and posterior tibial, dorsalis pedis, medial and lateral plantar, and peroneal arteries."]

7129 arteriae membri superioris
- 
- phr.["腰上动脉"]
- phr.["arteries of upper limb: the arteries supplying the arm, forearm, and hand, including the axillary, brachial, radial, and ulnar arteries."]

7130 arteriae mesencephalicae
- 
- phr.["中脑动脉"]
- phr.["mesencephalic arteries: origin, basilar artery; branches, none; distribution, cerebral peduncle."]

7131 arteriae metacarpales dorsales
- 
- phr.["掌背动脉"]
- phr.["dorsal metacarpal arteries: origin, dorsal carpal rete and radial artery; branches, dorsal digital arteries; distribution, dorsum of fingers."]

7132 arteriae metacarpales palmares
- 
- phr.["掌心动脉"]
- phr.["palmar metacarpal arteries: origin, deep palmar arch; branches, none; distribution, deep parts of metacarpus. Called also volar metacarpal or palmar intermetacarpal arteries."]

7133 arteriae metatarsales dorsales
- 
- phr.["跖背动脉"]
- phr.["dorsal metatarsal arteries: origin, arcuate artery of foot; branches, dorsal digital arteries; distribution, dorsum of foot, including toes."]

7134 arteriae metatarsales plantares
- 
- phr.["足心动脉"]
- phr.["plantar metatarsal arteries: origin, plantar arch; branches, perforating branches, common and proper plantar digital arteries; distribution, toes. Called also common digital arteries of foot."]

7135 arteriae musculares
- 
- phr.["眼肌动脉"]
- phr.["muscular arteries: branches of the ophthalmic artery consisting of a superior group and an inferior group; the inferior group gives origin to the anterior ciliary arteries."]

7136 arteriae nasales posteriores laterales
- 
- phr.["鼻后外侧动脉"]
- phr.["posterior lateral nasal arteries: origin, sphenopalatine artery; branches, none; distribution, frontal, maxillary, ethmoidal, and sphenoidal sinuses."]

7137 arteriae nutriciae femoris
- 
- phr.["股骨滋养动脉"]
- phr.["nutrient arteries of femur: origin, third perforating artery; branches, none; distribution, femur. Called also arteriae nutrientes femoris [TA alternative]."]

7138 arteriae nutriciae humeri
- 
- phr.["肱骨滋养动脉"]
- phr.["nutrient arteries of humerus: origin, brachial and profunda brachii arteries; branches, none; distribution, humerus. Called also arteriae nutrientes humeri [TA alternative]."]

7139 arteriae nutrientes femoris
- 
- phr.["股骨滋养动脉"]
- phr.["TA alternative for arteriae nutriciae femoris."]

7140 arteriae nutrientes humeri
- 
- phr.["肱骨滋养动脉"]
- phr.["TA alternative for arteriae nutriciae humeri."]

7141 arteriae palatinae minores
- 
- phr.["腭小动脉"]
- phr.["lesser palatine arteries: origin, descending palatine artery; branches, none; distribution, soft palate, tonsil."]

7142 arteriae palpebrales laterales
- 
- phr.["睑外侧动脉"]
- phr.["lateral palpebral arteries: origin, lacrimal artery; branches, none; distribution, eyelids, conjunctiva."]

7143 arteriae palpebrales mediales
- 
- phr.["睑内侧动脉"]
- phr.["two arteries, superior and inferior medial palpebral arteries: origin, ophthalmic artery; branches, posterior conjunctival arteries and superior and inferior palpebral arches; distribution, eyelids."]

7144 arteriae perforantes
- 
- phr.["穿动脉"]
- phr.["perforating arteries: origin, branches (usually three) of the deep femoral artery that perforate the insertion of the adductor magnus to reach the back of the thigh; branches, nutrient arteries; distribution, adductor, hamstring, and gluteal muscles, and femur."]

7145 arteriae perforantes anteriores
- 
- phr.["前穿动脉"]
- phr.["anterior perforating arteries: origin, precommunicating part of anterior cerebral artery; branches, none; distribution, enter anterior perforated substance."]

7146 arteriae phrenicae superiores
- 
- phr.["膈上动脉"]
- phr.["superior phrenic arteries: origin, thoracic aorta; branches, none; distribution, upper surface of vertebral portion of diaphragm."]

7147 arteriae pontis
- 
- phr.["脑桥动脉"]
- phr.["pontine arteries: origin, basilar artery; branches, none; distribution, pons and adjacent areas of brain. There are shorter (rami mediales pontis) and longer (rami laterales pontis) pontine arteries."]

7148 arteriae retroduodenales
- 
- phr.["十二指肠后动脉"]
- phr.["retroduodenal arteries: origin, first branch of gastroduodenal artery; branches, none; distribution, bile duct, duodenum, head of pancreas."]

7149 arteriae sacrales laterales
- 
- phr.["骶外侧动脉"]
- phr.["lateral sacral arteries: usually two, a superior and an inferior, on each side; origin, posterior trunk of internal iliac artery; branches, spinal branches; distribution, structures about coccyx and sacrum."]

7150 arteriae sigmoideae
- 
- phr.["乙状结肠动脉"]
- phr.["sigmoid arteries: origin, inferior mesenteric artery; branches, none; distribution, sigmoid colon."]

7151 arteriae striatae mediales proximales
- 
- phr.["近内侧线条体动脉"]
