56039 musculi lumbricales pedis
- 
- phr.["足蚓状肌"]
- phr.["lumbrical muscles of foot: origin, tendons of flexor digitorum longus; insertion, extensor expansions of four lateral toes; innervation, medial and lateral plantar; action, flex metatarsophalangeal joints, extend distal phalanges."]

56040 musculi masticatorii
- 
- phr.["咀嚼肌"]
- phr.["masticatory muscles: a group of muscles responsible for the movement of the jaws during mastication, including the masseter, temporal, and medial and lateral pterygoid muscles; called also muscles of mastication."]

56041 musculi membri inferioris
- 
- phr.["下肢肌"]
- phr.["muscles of lower limb: the muscles acting on the thigh, leg, and foot."]

56042 musculi membri superioris
- 
- phr.["上肢肌"]
- phr.["muscles of upper limb: the muscles acting on the arm, forearm, and hand."]

56043 musculi multifidi
- 
- phr.["多裂肌"]

56044 musculi oculi
- 
- phr.["眼肌，眼球肌"]
- phr.["musculi externi bulbi oculi."]

56045 musculi ossiculorum auditoriorum
- 
- phr.["听小骨肌"]
- phr.["muscles of auditory ossicles: the two muscles of the middle ear, the tensor tympani and the stapedius."]

56046 musculi ossis hyoidei
- 
- phr.["舌骨肌"]
- phr.["muscles of the hyoid bone; see musculi infrahyoidei and musculi suprahyoidei."]

56047 musculi palati
- 
- phr.["腭肌"]

56048 musculi palati mollis et faucium

- phr.["腭肌咽门肌"]

- 
- phr.["乳头肌"]

There is an anterior and a posterior papillary muscle in each ventricle, as well as a group of small papillary muscles on the septum in the right ventricle."]

56050 musculi pectinati atrii dextri
- 
- phr.["右心房梳状肌"]
- phr.["pectinate muscles of right atrium: small ridges of muscle fibers projecting from the inner walls of the right auricle of the heart and extending in the right atrium to the crista terminalis."]

56051 musculi pectinati atrii sinistri
- 
- phr.["左心房梳状肌"]
- phr.["pectinate muscles of left atrium: small ridges of muscle fibers projecting from the inner walls of the left auricle of the heart."]

56052 musculi perineales
- 
- phr.["会阴肌"]
- phr.["muscles of perineum: the muscles participating in formation of the perineum."]

56053 musculi pharyngis
- 
- phr.["咽肌"]

- 
- phr.["回旋肌"]

56055 musculi rotatores breves
- 
- phr.["短回旋肌"]

56056 musculi rotatores cervicis
- 
- phr.["颈回旋肌"]

Called also musculi rotatores colli [TA alternative]."]

56057 musculi rotatores longi
- 
- phr.["长回旋肌"]
- phr.["long rotator muscles: a name given the musculi rotatores that cross one or two segments of the vertebral column and insert into the spine of the vertebra next above."]

56058 musculi rotatores lumborum
- 
- phr.["腰回旋肌"]
- phr.["origin, transverse processes of lumbar vertebrae; insertion, base of spinous process of superjacent vertebrae; innervation, spinal nerves; action, extend vertebral column and rotate it toward the opposite side."]

56059 musculi rotatores thoracis
- 
- phr.["胸回旋肌"]
- phr.["rotator muscles of thorax: origin, transverse processes of thoracic vertebrae; insertion, base of spinous process of superjacent vertebrae; innervation, spinal nerves; action, extend vertebral column and rotate it toward the opposite side."]

56060 musculi subcostales
- 
- phr.["肋下肌"]

56061 musculi suboccipitales
- 
- phr.["枕下肌"]

56062 musculi suprahyoidei
- 
- phr.["舌骨上肌"]

56063 musculi thoracis
-

56064 musculi transversospinales
- 
- phr.["横突棘肌"]
- phr.["a general term including the semispinalis and multifidus muscles and the rotatores."]

56065 musculoaponeurotic
- /ˌmʌskjʊləʊˌæpənjʊəˈrɒtɪk/
- adj.["肌腱膜的"]

56066 musculocutaneous
- /ˌmʌskjʊləʊkjʊ(:)ˈteɪnjəs/
- adj.["肌皮的"]
- adj.["pertaining to, composed of, or supplying both muscles and skin. Called also myocutaneous."]

56067 musculocutaneous amputation
- 
- phr.["肌皮瓣切断术"]

56068 musculocutaneous flap
- 
- phr.["肌皮瓣"]

56069 musculocutaneous nerve
- 
- phr.["肌皮神经"]

56070 musculocutaneous nerve of leg

56071 musculodermic
- /ˌmʌskjʊləʊˈdɜ:mɪk/

56072 musculoelastic
- /ˌmʌskjʊləʊɪˈlæstɪk/

56074 musculomembranous
- /ˌmʌskjʊləʊˈmembrənəs/

56075 musculophrenic

56076 musculophrenic artery
- 
- phr.["肌膈动脉"]
- phr.["arteria musculophrenica."]

56077 musculophrenic veins
- 
- phr.["肌膈静脉"]
- phr.["venae musculophrenicae."]

56078 musculoskeletal

- adj.["肌骨骼的"]

56079 musculoskeletal system

56080 musculospiral
- /ˌmʌskjʊləʊˈspaɪərəl/
- adj.["肌螺旋的"]

56081 musculospiral groove

- phr.["桡神经"]

56084 musculotendinous

- adj.["肌腱的"]

56087 musculus
- /ˈmʌskjʊləs/

- phr.["小指展肌"]

56105 musculus aryepiglotticus

- phr.["杓斜肌"]

56109 musculus auricularis posterior

56115 musculus brachioradialis

- phr.["球海绵体肌"]

- phr.["提睾肌"]
- phr.["cremaster muscle: origin, inferior margin of internal oblique muscle of abdomen; insertion, pubic tubercle; innervation, genital branch of genitofemoral; action, elevates testis."]

56135 musculus cricoarytenoideus lateralis
- 
- phr.["环杓侧肌"]
- phr.["lateral cricoarytenoid muscle: one of the intrinsic muscles of the larynx; origin, lateral surface of cricoid cartilage; insertion, muscular process of arytenoid cartilage; innervation, recurrent laryngeal; action, approximates vocal folds."]

56136 musculus cricoarytenoideus posterior
- 
- phr.["环杓后肌"]
- phr.["posterior cricoarytenoid muscle: one of the intrinsic muscles of the larynx; origin, back of cricoid cartilage; insertion, muscular process of arytenoid cartilage; innervation, recurrent laryngeal; action, separates vocal folds."]

56137 musculus cricopharyngeus
- 
- phr.["环咽肌，咽下缩肌环咽部"]
- phr.["TA alternative for pars cricopharyngea musculi constrictoris pharyngis inferioris."]

56138 musculus cricothyroideus
- 
- phr.["环甲肌"]
- phr.["cricothyroid muscle: one of the intrinsic muscles of the larynx; origin, front and side of cricoid cartilage; insertion, lamina of thyroid cartilage; innervation, external ramus of superior laryngeal; action, tenses vocal folds."]

56139 musculus cruciatus
- 
- phr.["交叉肌"]
- phr.["cruciate muscle."]

56140 musculus cutaneus
- 
- phr.["皮肌"]
- phr.["cutaneous muscle: striated muscle that inserts into the skin, such as the platysma."]

56141 musculus dartos
- 
- phr.["肉膜肌"]
- phr.["dartos muscle: the nonstriated muscle fibers of the tunica dartos, the deeper layers of which help to form the septum of the scrotum. Called also dartos."]

56142 musculus deltoideus
- 
- phr.["三角肌"]
- phr.["deltoid muscle: origin, clavicle, acromion, spine of scapula; insertion, deltoid tuberosity of humerus; innervation, axillary; action, abducts, flexes, extends arm."]

56143 musculus depressor anguli oris
- 
- phr.["降口角肌"]
- phr.["depressor muscle of angle of mouth: origin, lower border of mandible; insertion, angle of mouth; innervation, facial; action, pulls down angle of mouth."]

56144 musculus depressor labii inferioris
- 
- phr.["降下唇肌"]
- phr.["depressor muscle of lower lip: origin, anterior portion of lower border of mandible; insertion, orbicularis oris and skin of lower lip; innervation, facial; action, depresses lower lip."]

56145 musculus depressor septi nasi
- 
- phr.["降鼻中隔肌"]
- phr.["depressor muscle of nasal septum: origin, incisor fossa of maxilla; insertion, ala and septum of nose; innervation, facial; action, contracts nostril and depresses ala. Called also depressor muscle of septum of nose and depressor septi nasi muscle."]

56146 musculus depressor supercilii
- 
- phr.["降眉肌"]
- phr.["superciliary depressor muscle: a name given a few fibers of the orbital part of the orbicularis oculi muscle that are inserted in the eyebrow, which they depress."]

56147 musculus digastricus
- 
- phr.["二腹肌"]
- phr.["digastric muscle: origin, venter anterior—digastric fossa on deep surface of inferior border of mandible near symphysis, venter posterior—mastoid notch of temporal bone; insertion, intermediate tendon on hyoid bone; innervation, venter anterior—mylohyoid, venter posterior—digastric branch of facial; action, elevates hyoid bone, lowers jaw."]

56148 musculus dilatator
- 
- phr.["开大肌，扩张肌"]
- phr.["dilator muscle: a general term for a muscle that dilates; called also dilator."]

56149 musculus dilatator pupillae
- 
- phr.["瞳孔开大肌，瞳孔扩大肌"]
- phr.["dilator pupillae muscle: a name given to fibers extending radially from the sphincter pupillae to the ciliary margin; innervation, sympathetic; action, dilates iris."]

56150 musculus dilator naris
- 
- phr.["鼻孔开大肌，鼻肌翼部"]
- phr.["pars alaris musculi nasalis."]

56151 musculus epicranius
- 
- phr.["颅顶肌"]
- phr.["epicranial muscle: a name given the muscular covering of the scalp, including the occipitofrontalis and temporoparietalis muscles, and the galea aponeurotica."]

56152 musculus erector spinae
- 
- phr.["竖脊肌"]
- phr.["erector muscle of spine: a name given the fibers of the more superficial of the deep muscles of the back, originating from the sacrum, spines of the lumbar and the eleventh and twelfth thoracic vertebrae, and the iliac crest, which split and insert as the musculi iliocostalis, longissimus, and spinalis (qq.v.)."]

56153 musculus extensor carpi radialis brevis
- 
- phr.["桡侧腕短伸肌"]
- phr.["short radial extensor muscle of wrist: origin, lateral epicondyle of humerus, insertion, base of third metacarpal bone; innervation, deep branch of radial; action, extends and abducts wrist joint."]

56154 musculus extensor carpi radialis longus
- 
- phr.["桡侧腕长伸肌"]
- phr.["long radial extensor muscle of wrist: origin, lateral supracondylar ridge of humerus; insertion, base of second metacarpal bone; innervation, radial; action, extends and abducts wrist joint."]

56155 musculus extensor carpi ulnaris
- 
- phr.["尺侧腕伸肌"]
- phr.["ulnar extensor muscle of wrist (2 heads): origin, caput humerale—lateral epicondyle of humerus, caput ulnare—posterior border of ulna; insertion, base of fifth metacarpal bone; innervation, deep branch of radial; action, extends and adducts wrist joint."]

56156 musculus extensor digiti minimi
- 
- phr.["小指伸肌"]
- phr.["extensor muscle of little finger: origin, common extensor tendon and adjacent intermuscular septa; insertion, extensor expansion of little finger; innervation, deep branch of radial; action, extends little finger."]

56157 musculus extensor digiti quinti proprius
- 
- phr.["小指固有伸肌"]
- phr.["m. extensor digiti minimi."]

56158 musculus extensor digitorum
- 
- phr.["指伸肌"]
- phr.["extensor muscle of fingers: origin, lateral epicondyle of humerus; insertion, extensor expansion of each (nonthumb) finger; innervation, posterior interosseus; action, extends wrist joint and phalanges."]

56159 musculus extensor digitorum brevis
- 
- phr.["趾短伸肌"]
- phr.["short extensor muscle of toes: origin, superior surface of calcaneus; insertion, tendons of extensor digitorum longus of first, second, third, and fourth toes; innervation, deep peroneal; action, extends toes."]

56160 musculus extensor digitorum longus
- 
- phr.["趾长伸肌"]
- phr.["long extensor muscle of toes: origin, anterior surface of fibula, lateral condyle of tibia, interosseous membrane; insertion, extensor expansion of each of the four lateral toes; innervation, deep peroneal; action, extends toes."]

56161 musculus extensor hallucis brevis
- 
- phr.["𧿹短伸肌"]
- phr.["short extensor muscle of great toe: a name given the portion of the extensor digitorum brevis muscle that goes to the great toe."]

56162 musculus extensor hallucis longus
- 
- phr.["𧿹长伸肌"]
- phr.["long extensor muscle of great toe: origin, front of fibula and interosseous membrane; insertion, dorsal surface of base of distal phalanx of great toe; innervation, deep peroneal; action, dorsiflexes ankle joint, extends great toe."]

56163 musculus extensor indicis
- 
- phr.["食指伸肌，示指伸肌"]
- phr.["extensor muscle of index finger: origin, posterior surface of body of ulna, interosseous membrane; insertion, extensor expansion of index finger; innervation, posterior interosseous; action, extends index finger."]

56164 musculus extensor indicis proprius
- 
- phr.["食指固有伸肌，示指固有伸肌"]
- phr.["m. extensor indicis."]

56165 musculus extensor pollicis brevis
- 
- phr.["拇短伸肌"]
- phr.["short extensor muscle of thumb: origin, posterior surface of radius and interosseous membrane; insertion, dorsolateral base of proximal phalanx of thumb; innervation, posterior interosseous; action, extends thumb."]

56166 musculus extensor pollicis longus
- 
- phr.["拇长伸肌"]
- phr.["long extensor muscle of thumb: origin, posterior surface of ulna and interosseous membrane; insertion, base of distal phalanx of thumb; innervation, posterior interosseous; action, extends thumb, adducts and rotates thumb laterally."]

56167 musculus fibularis brevis
- 
- phr.["腓骨短肌"]
- phr.["short peroneal muscle: origin, lateral surface of fibula; insertion, tuberosity on base of fifth metatarsal bone; innervation, superficial peroneal; action, everts, abducts, plantar flexes foot. Called also m. peroneus brevis [TA alternative]."]

56168 musculus fibularis longus
- 
- phr.["腓骨长肌"]
- phr.["long peroneal muscle: origin, lateral condyle of tibia, head and lateral surface of fibula; insertion, medial cuneiform, first metatarsal; innervation, superficial peroneal; action, abducts, everts, plantar flexes foot. Called also m. peroneus longus [TA alternative]."]

56169 musculus fibularis tertius
- 
- phr.["第三腓骨肌"]
- phr.["third peroneal muscle: origin, anterior surface of fibula, interosseous membrane; insertion, base of fifth metatarsal; innervation, deep peroneal; action, everts, dorsiflexes foot. Called also m. peroneus tertius [TA alternative]."]

56170 musculus flexor accessorius
- 
- phr.["足底方肌，副屈肌"]
- phr.["TA alternative for m. quadratus plantae."]

56171 musculus flexor carpi radialis
- 
- phr.["桡侧腕屈肌"]
- phr.["radial flexor muscle of wrist: origin, medial epicondyle of humerus; insertion, base of second metacarpal; innervation, median; action, flexes and abducts wrist joint."]

56172 musculus flexor carpi ulnaris
- 
- phr.["尺侧腕屈肌"]
- phr.["ulnar flexor muscle of wrist (2 heads): origin, caput humerale—medial epicondyle of humerus, caput ulnare—olecranon, ulna, intermuscular septum; insertion, pisiform, hook of hamate, proximal end of fifth metacarpal; innervation, ulnar; action, flexes and adducts wrist joint."]

56173 musculus flexor digiti minimi brevis manus
- 
- phr.["小指短屈肌"]
- phr.["short flexor muscle of little finger: origin, hook of hamate bone, palmar surface of flexor retinaculum; insertion, medial side of proximal phalanx of little finger; innervation, ulnar; action, flexes little finger."]

56174 musculus flexor digiti minimi brevis pedis
- 
- phr.["小趾短屈肌"]
- phr.["short flexor muscle of little toe: origin, base of fifth metatarsal, sheath of peroneus longus muscle; insertion, lateral surface of base of proximal phalanx of little toe; innervation, lateral plantar; action, flexes little toe."]

56175 musculus flexor digiti quinti brevis manus
- 
- phr.["小指短屈肌"]
- phr.["m. flexor digiti minimi brevis manus."]

56176 musculus flexor digiti quinti brevis pedis
- 
- phr.["小趾短屈肌"]
- phr.["m. flexor digiti minimi brevis pedis."]

56177 musculus flexor digitorum brevis
- 
- phr.["趾短屈肌"]
- phr.["short flexor muscle of toes: origin, medial tuberosity of calcaneus, plantar fascia; insertion, middle phalanges of four lateral toes; innervation, medial plantar; action, flexes four lateral toes."]

56178 musculus flexor digitorum longus
- 
- phr.["趾长屈肌"]
- phr.["long flexor muscle of toes: origin, posterior surface of shaft of tibia; insertion, distal phalanges of four lateral toes; innervation, posterior tibial; action, flexes toes and plantar flexes foot."]

56179 musculus flexor digitorum profundus
- 
- phr.["指深屈肌"]
- phr.["deep flexor muscle of fingers: origin, shaft of ulna, coronoid process, interosseous membrane; insertion, bases of distal phalanges of fingers; innervation, ulnar and anterior interosseous; action, flexes distal phalanges."]

56180 musculus flexor digitorum sublimis
- 
- phr.["指浅屈肌"]
- phr.["m. flexor digitorum superficialis."]

56181 musculus flexor digitorum superficialis
- 
- phr.["指浅屈肌"]
- phr.["superficial flexor muscle of fingers (2 heads): origin, humeroulnar head—medial epicondyle of humerus, coronoid process of ulna, radial head—oblique line of radius, anterior border; insertion, sides of middle phalanges of four (nonthumb) fingers; innervation, median; action, primarily flexes middle phalanges."]

56182 musculus flexor hallucis brevis
- 
- phr.["𧿹短屈肌"]
- phr.["short flexor muscle of great toe: origin, undersurface of cuboid, lateral cuneiform; insertion (2 heads): lateral head—lateral side of base of proximal phalanx of toe; medial head—medial side of base of proximal phalanx of toe; innervation, medial plantar; action, flexes great toe."]

56183 musculus flexor hallucis longus
- 
- phr.["𧿹长屈肌"]
- phr.["long flexor muscle of great toe: origin, posterior surface of fibula; insertion, base of distal phalanx of great toe; innervation, tibial; action, flexes great toe."]

56184 musculus flexor pollicis brevis
- 
- phr.["拇短屈肌"]
- phr.["short flexor muscle of thumb (2 heads): origin, caput superficiale—flexor retinaculum, distal part of tubercle of trapezium, caput profundum—trapezoid and capitate bones and palmar ligaments of distal row of carpal bones; insertion, radial side of base of proximal phalanx of thumb; innervation, median, ulnar; action, flexes and adducts thumb. The deep head varies considerably in size and may be absent."]

56185 musculus flexor pollicis longus
- 
- phr.["拇长屈肌"]
- phr.["long flexor muscle of thumb: origin, anterior surface of radius, interosseous membrane, and medial epicondyle of humerus or coronoid process of ulna; insertion, base of distal phalanx of thumb; innervation, anterior interosseous; action, flexes thumb."]

56186 musculus frontalis
- 
- phr.["额肌，枕额肌"]
- phr.["venter frontalis musculi occipitofrontalis."]

56187 musculus fusiformis
- 
- phr.["梭形肌"]
- phr.["fusiform muscle: a spindle-shaped muscle in which the fibers are approximately parallel to the long axis of the muscle but converge upon a tendon at either end."]

56188 musculus gastrocnemius
- 
- phr.["腓肠肌"]
- phr.["gastrocnemius muscle (2 heads): origin, caput mediale—popliteal surface of femur, upper part of medial condyle, and capsule of knee, caput laterale—lateral condyle and capsule of knee; insertion, aponeurosis unites with tendon of soleus to form calcaneal tendon (Achilles tendon); innervation, tibial; action, plantar flexes ankle joint, flexes knee joint."]

56189 musculus gemellus inferior
- 
- phr.["下孖肌"]
- phr.["inferior gemellus muscle: origin, tuberosity of ischium; insertion, greater trochanter of femur; innervation, nerve to quadratus femoris; action, rotates thigh laterally."]

56190 musculus gemellus superior
- 
- phr.["上孖肌"]
- phr.["superior gemellus muscle: origin, spine of ischium; insertion, greater trochanter of femur; innervation, nerve to internal obturator; action, rotates thigh laterally."]

56191 musculus genioglossus
- 
- phr.["颏舌肌"]
- phr.["genioglossus muscle: origin, superior mental spine; insertion, hyoid bone and inferior surface of tongue; innervation, hypoglossal; action, protrudes and depresses tongue."]

56192 musculus geniohyoideus
- 
- phr.["颏舌骨肌"]
- phr.["geniohyoid muscle: origin, inferior mental spine; insertion, body of hyoid bone; innervation, a branch of first cervical nerve through hypoglossal; action, elevates and draws hyoid forward, or depresses mandible when hyoid is fixed by its depressors."]

56193 musculus glossopalatinus
- 
- phr.["腭舌肌"]
- phr.["m. palatoglossus."]

56194 musculus glossopharyngeus
- 
- phr.["舌咽肌，咽上缩肌舌咽部"]
- phr.["pars glossopharyngea musculi constrictoris pharyngis superioris."]

56195 musculus gluteus maximus
- 
- phr.["臀大肌"]
- phr.["gluteus maximus muscle: origin, posterior aspect of ilium, posterior surface of sacrum and coccyx, sacrotuberous ligament, fascia covering gluteus medius; insertion, iliotibial tract of fascia lata, gluteal tuberosity of femur; innervation, inferior gluteal; action, extends, abducts, and rotates thigh laterally."]

56196 musculus gluteus medius
- 
- phr.["臀中肌"]
- phr.["gluteus medius muscle: origin, lateral surface of ilium between anterior and posterior gluteal lines; insertion, greater trochanter of femur; innervation, superior gluteal; action, abducts and rotates thigh medially."]

56197 musculus gluteus minimus
- 
- phr.["臀小肌"]
- phr.["gluteus minimus muscle: origin, lateral surface of ilium between anterior and inferior gluteal lines; insertion, greater trochanter of femur; innervation, superior gluteal; action, abducts, rotates thigh medially."]

56198 musculus gracilis
- 
- phr.["股薄肌"]
- phr.["gracilis muscle: origin, lower half of body and entire inferior ramus of pubis; insertion, medial surface of shaft of tibia; innervation, obturator; action, adducts thigh, flexes knee joint."]

56199 musculus helicis major
- 
- phr.["耳轮大肌"]
- phr.["helicis major muscle: origin, spine of helix; insertion, anterior border of helix; innervation, auriculotemporal and posterior auricular; action, tenses skin of auditory canal."]

56200 musculus helicis minor
- 
- phr.["耳轮小肌"]
- phr.["helicis minor muscle: origin, anterior rim of helix; insertion, concha; innervation, temporal, posterior auricular."]

56201 musculus hyoglossus
- 
- phr.["舌骨舌肌"]
- phr.["hyoglossal muscle: origin, body and greater cornu of hyoid bone; insertion, side of tongue; innervation, hypoglossal; action, depresses and retracts tongue."]

56202 musculus iliacus
- 
- phr.["髂肌"]
- phr.["iliac muscle: origin, iliac fossa and base of sacrum; insertion, greater psoas tendon and lesser trochanter of femur; innervation, femoral; action, flexes thigh, trunk on limb."]

56203 musculus iliococcygeus
- 
- phr.["髂尾肌"]
- phr.["iliococcygeal muscle: the posterior portion of the levator ani, which originates as far anteriorly as the obturator canal and inserts on the side of the coccyx and the anococcygeal ligament; innervation, third and fourth sacral; action, helps to support pelvic viscera and resist increases in intra-abdominal pressure."]

56204 musculus iliocostalis
- 
- phr.["髂肋肌"]
- phr.["iliocostalis muscle: the lateral division of the erector spinae, which includes the musculus iliocostalis cervicis and musculus iliocostalis lumborum."]

56205 musculus iliocostalis cervicis
- 
- phr.["颈髂肋肌"]
- phr.["iliocostalis cervicis muscle: origin, angles of third, fourth, fifth, and sixth ribs; insertion, transverse processes of fourth, fifth, and sixth cervical vertebrae; innervation, branches of cervical; action, extends cervical spine. Called also m. iliocostalis colli [TA alternative]."]

56206 musculus iliocostalis colli
- 
- phr.["颈髂肋肌"]
- phr.["TA alternative for m. iliocostalis cervicis."]

56207 musculus iliocostalis lumborum
- 
- phr.["腰髂肋肌"]
- phr.["iliocostalis lumborum muscle: the iliocostalis muscle acting on the thoracic and lumbar regions; it is subdivided into a lumbar part (pars lumbalis musculi iliocostalis lumborum) and a thoracic part (pars thoracica musculi iliocostalis lumborum)."]

56208 musculus iliopsoas
- 
- phr.["髂腰肌"]
- phr.["iliopsoas muscle: a compound muscle consisting of the iliacus and the psoas major."]

56209 musculus incisurae terminalis
- 
- phr.["耳轮切迹肌"]
- phr.["an inconstant muscular slip in the external ear, continuing forward from the musculus tragicus to bridge the incisure of the cartilaginous external meatus."]

56210 musculus infraspinatus
- 
- phr.["冈下肌，棘下肌"]
- phr.["infraspinatus muscle: origin, infraspinous fossa of scapula; insertion, greater tubercle of humerus; innervation, suprascapular; action, rotates humerus laterally. Called also infraspinous muscle."]

56211 musculus ischiocavernosus
- 
- phr.["坐骨海绵体肌"]
- phr.["ischiocavernous muscle: origin, ramus of ischium; insertion, crus penis (crus clitoridis); innervation, perineal; action, maintains erection of penis (clitoris)."]

56212 musculus ischiococcygeus
- 
- phr.["坐骨尾骨肌"]
- phr.["ischiococcygeal muscle: origin, ischial spine; insertion, lateral border of lower part of sacrum, upper coccyx; innervation, third and fourth sacral; action, supports and raises coccyx. Called also coccygeal muscle and m. coccygeus (TA alternative)."]

56213 musculus latissimus dorsi
- 
- phr.["背阔肌"]
- phr.["origin, spines of lower thoracic vertebrae, lumbar and sacral vertebrae through attachment to thoracolumbar fascia, iliac crest, lower ribs, inferior angle of scapula; insertion, floor of intertubercular sulcus of humerus; innervation, thoracodorsal; action, adducts, extends, and rotates humerus medially."]

56214 musculus levator anguli oris
- 
- phr.["提口角肌"]
- phr.["levator muscle of angle of mouth: origin, canine fossa of maxilla; insertion, orbicularis oris and skin at angle of mouth; innervation, facial; action, raises angle of mouth."]

56215 musculus levator ani
- 
- phr.["肛提肌"]
- phr.["levator ani muscle: a name applied collectively to important muscular components of the pelvic diaphragm, including the pubococcygeus, puborectalis, and iliococcygeus muscles."]

56216 musculus levator glandulae thyroideae
- 
- phr.["甲状腺提肌"]
- phr.["levator muscle of thyroid gland: an inconstant muscle originating on the isthmus or pyramid of the thyroid gland and inserting on the body of the hyoid bone."]

56217 musculus levator labii superioris
- 
- phr.["提上唇肌"]
- phr.["levator muscle of upper lip: origin, lower orbital margin; insertion, muscle of upper lip; innervation, facial nerve; action, raises upper lip."]

56218 musculus levator labii superioris alaeque nasi
- 
- phr.["提上唇鼻翼肌"]
- phr.["levator muscle of upper lip and ala of nose: origin, upper part of frontal process of maxilla; insertion, cartilage and skin of ala nasi, and upper lip; innervation, infraorbital branch of facial; action, raises upper lip and dilates nostril."]

56219 musculus levator palpebrae superioris
- 
- phr.["上睑提肌"]
- phr.["levator muscle of upper eyelid: origin, sphenoid bone above optic canal; insertion, tarsal plate and skin of upper eyelid; innervation, oculomotor; action, raises upper lid."]

56220 musculus levator prostatae
- 
- phr.["前列腺提肌"]
- phr.["TA alternative for m. puboprostaticus."]

56221 musculus levator scapulae
- 
- phr.["肩胛提肌"]
- phr.["levator muscle of scapula: origin, transverse processes of four upper cervical vertebrae; insertion, medial border of scapula; innervation, third and fourth cervical; action, raises scapula."]

56222 musculus levator veli palatini
- 
- phr.["腭帆提肌"]
- phr.["origin, apex of petrous portion of temporal bone and cartilaginous part of auditory tube; insertion, aponeurosis of soft palate; innervation, pharyngeal plexus of vagus; action, raises and draws back soft palate."]

56223 musculus longissimus
- 
- phr.["最长肌"]
- phr.["longissimus muscle: the largest element of the erector spinae, which includes the musculus longissimus capitis, musculus longissimus cervicis, and musculus longissimus thoracis."]

56224 musculus longissimus capitis
- 
- phr.["头最长肌"]
- phr.["longissimus muscle of head: origin, transverse processes of four or five upper thoracic vertebrae, articular processes of three or four lower cervical vertebrae; insertion, mastoid process of temporal bone; innervation, branches of cervical; action, draws head backward, rotates head."]

56225 musculus longissimus cervicis
- 
- phr.["颈最长肌"]
- phr.["longissimus muscle of neck: origin, transverse processes of four or five upper thoracic vertebrae; insertion, transverse processes of second to sixth cervical vertebrae; innervation, lower cervical and upper thoracic; action, extends cervical vertebrae. Called also m. longissimus colli [TA alternative]."]

56226 musculus longissimus colli
- 
- phr.["颈最长肌"]
- phr.["TA alternative for m. longissimus cervicis."]

56227 musculus longissimus thoracis
- 
- phr.["胸最长肌"]
- phr.["longissimus muscle of thorax: origin, transverse and articular processes of lumbar vertebrae and thoracolumbar fascia; insertion, transverse processes of all thoracic vertebrae, nine or ten lower ribs; innervation, lumbar and thoracic; action, extends thoracic vertebrae. The portion in the lumbar region is sometimes denoted separately (pars lumbalis musculi longissimus thoracis)."]

56228 musculus longitudinalis inferior linguae
- 
- phr.["舌下纵肌"]
- phr.["inferior longitudinal muscle of tongue: origin, inferior surface of tongue at base; insertion, tip of tongue; innervation, hypoglossal; action, changes shape of tongue in mastication and deglutition."]

56229 musculus longitudinalis superior linguae
- 
- phr.["舌上纵肌"]
- phr.["superior longitudinal muscle of tongue: origin, submucosa and septum of tongue; insertion, margins of tongue; innervation, hypoglossal; action, changes shape of tongue in mastication and deglutition."]

56230 musculus longus capitis
- 
- phr.["头长肌"]
- phr.["long muscle of head: origin, transverse processes of third to sixth cervical vertebrae; insertion, basilar part of occipital bone; innervation, branches from first, second, and third cervical; action, flexes head."]

56231 musculus longus cervicis
- 
- phr.["颈长肌"]
- phr.["TA alternative for m. longus colli."]

56232 musculus longus colli
- 
- phr.["颈长肌"]
- phr.["long muscle of neck: origin, superior oblique portion—transverse processes of third to fifth cervical vertebrae; inferior oblique portion—bodies of first to third thoracic vertebrae; vertical portion—bodies of three upper thoracic and three lower cervical vertebrae; insertion, superior oblique portion—tubercle of anterior arch of atlas; inferior oblique portion—transverse processes of fifth and sixth cervical vertebrae; vertical portion—bodies of second to fourth cervical vertebrae; innervation, anterior cervical; action, flexes and supports cervical vertebrae. Called also m. longus cervicis [TA alternative]."]

56233 musculus masseter
- 
- phr.["咬肌"]
- phr.["masseter muscle: origin, pars superficialis—zygomatic process of maxilla and inferior border of zygomatic arch, pars profunda—inferior border and medial surface of zygomatic arch; insertion, pars superficialis—angle and ramus of mandible, pars profunda—superior half of ramus and lateral surface of coronoid process of mandible; innervation, masseteric, from mandibular division of trigeminal; action, raises mandible, closes jaws."]

56234 musculus mentalis
- 
- phr.["颏肌"]
- phr.["origin, incisive fossa of mandible; insertion, skin of chin; innervation, facial; action, wrinkles skin of chin."]

56235 musculus multipennatus
- 
- phr.["多羽肌"]
- phr.["multipennate muscle: a muscle in which the fiber bundles converge to several tendons."]

56236 musculus mylohyoideus
- 
- phr.["下颌舌骨肌"]
- phr.["mylohyoid muscle: origin, mylohyoid line of mandible; insertion, body of hyoid bone and median raphe; innervation, mylohyoid branch of inferior alveolar; action, elevates hyoid bone, supports floor of mouth."]

56237 musculus mylopharyngeus
- 
- phr.["下颌咽肌"]
- phr.["pars mylopharyngea musculi constrictoris pharyngis superioris."]

56238 musculus nasalis
- 
- phr.["鼻肌"]
- phr.["nasal muscle: origin, maxilla; insertion, pars alaris—ala nasi, pars transversa—by aponeurotic expansion with fellow of opposite side; innervation, facial; action, pars alaris—aids in widening nostril, pars transversa—depresses cartilage of nose."]

56239 musculus obliquus auriculae
- 
- phr.["耳郭斜肌"]
- phr.["oblique muscle of auricle: origin, cranial surface of concha; insertion, cranial surface of auricle above concha; innervation, temporal and posterior auricular (branches of facial)."]

56240 musculus obliquus capitis inferior
- 
- phr.["头下斜肌"]
- phr.["inferior oblique muscle of head: origin, spinous process of axis; insertion, transverse process of atlas; innervation, posterior rami of spinal nerves; action, rotates atlas and head."]

56241 musculus obliquus capitis superior
- 
- phr.["头上斜肌"]
- phr.["superior oblique muscle of head: origin, transverse process of atlas; insertion, occipital bone; innervation, posterior rami of spinal nerves; action, extends and moves head laterally."]

56242 musculus obliquus externus abdominis
- 
- phr.["腹外斜肌"]
- phr.["external oblique muscle of abdomen: origin, lower eight ribs at costal cartilages; insertion, crest of ilium, linea alba through rectus sheath; innervation, seventh to twelfth intercostal; action, flexes and rotates vertebral column, increases intra-abdominal pressure, acts as accessory respiratory muscle."]

56243 musculus obliquus inferior bulbi
- 
- phr.["眼下斜肌"]
- phr.["inferior oblique muscle of eyeball: origin, orbital surface of maxilla; insertion, sclera; innervation, oculomotor; action, rotates eyeball upward and outward."]

56244 musculus obliquus inferior oculi
- 
- phr.["眼下斜肌"]
- phr.["m. obliquus inferior bulbi."]

56245 musculus obliquus internus abdominis
- 
- phr.["腹内斜肌"]
- phr.["internal oblique muscle of abdomen: origin, inguinal ligament, iliac crest, thoracolumbar fascia; insertion, inferior three or four costal cartilages, linea alba, conjoined tendon to pubis; innervation, seventh to twelfth intercostal, first lumbar; action, flexes and rotates vertebral column, increases intra-abdominal pressure, acts as accessory respiratory muscle."]

56246 musculus obliquus superior bulbi
- 
- phr.["眼上斜肌"]
- phr.["superior oblique muscle of eyeball: origin, lesser wing of sphenoid above optic canal; insertion, sclera; innervation, trochlear; action, rotates eyeball downward and outward."]

56247 musculus obliquus superior oculi
- 
- phr.["眼上斜肌"]
- phr.["m. obliquus superior bulbi."]

56248 musculus obturatorius externus
- 
- phr.["闭孔外肌"]
- phr.["obturator externus muscle: origin, pubis, ischium, and external surface of obturator membrane; insertion, trochanteric fossa of femur; innervation, obturator; action, rotates thigh laterally."]

56249 musculus obturatorius internus
- 
- phr.["闭孔内肌"]
- phr.["obturator internus muscle: origin, pelvic surface of hip bone and obturator membrane, margin of obturator foramen, ramus of ischium, inferior ramus of pubis; insertion, greater trochanter of femur; innervation, fifth lumbar, first and second sacral; action, rotates thigh laterally."]

56250 musculus occipitalis
- 
- phr.["枕肌，枕额肌枕腹"]
- phr.["venter occipitalis musculi occipitofrontalis."]

56251 musculus occipitofrontalis
- 
- phr.["枕额肌"]
- phr.["occipitofrontal muscle: origin, venter frontalis—galea aponeurotica, venter occipitalis—highest nuchal line of occipital bone; insertion, venter frontalis—skin of eyebrows and root of nose, venter occipitalis—galea aponeurotica; innervation, venter frontalis—temporal branch of facial, venter occipitalis—posterior auricular branch of facial; action, venter frontalis—raises eyebrows, venter occipitalis—draws scalp posteriorly."]

56252 musculus omohyoideus
- 
- phr.["肩胛舌骨肌"]
- phr.["omohyoid muscle, comprising two bellies (superior and inferior) connected by a central tendon that is bound to the clavicle by a fibrous expansion of the cervical fascia; origin, superior border of scapula; insertion, lateral border of hyoid bone; innervation, upper cervical through ansa cervicalis; action, depresses hyoid bone."]

56253 musculus opponens digiti minimi
- 
- phr.["小指对掌肌，小趾对跖肌"]
- phr.["opposing muscle of little finger: origin, hook of hamate bone, flexor retinaculum; insertion, ulnar margin of fifth metacarpal; innervation, eighth cervical through ulnar; action, rotates, abducts, and flexes fifth metacarpal."]

56254 musculus opponens pollicis
- 
- phr.["拇对掌肌"]
- phr.["opposing muscle of thumb: origin, tubercle of trapezium, flexor retinaculum; insertion, radial side of first metacarpal; innervation, sixth and seventh cervical through median; action, flexes and opposes thumb."]

56255 musculus orbicularis
- 
- phr.["轮匝肌"]
- phr.["orbicular muscle: a muscle that encircles a body opening, such as the eye or mouth."]

56256 musculus orbicularis oculi
- 
- phr.["眼轮匝肌"]
- phr.["orbicular muscle of eye: the oval sphincter muscle surrounding the eyelids, consisting of three parts: origin, pars orbitalis—medial margin of orbit, including frontal process of maxilla, pars palpebralis—medial palpebral ligament, pars lacrimalis—posterior lacrimal crest; insertion, pars orbitalis—near origin after encircling orbit, pars palpebralis—fibers intertwine to form lateral palpebral raphe, pars lacrimalis—lateral palpebral raphe, upper and lower tarsi; innervation, facial; action, closes eyelids, wrinkles forehead, compresses lacrimal sac."]

56257 musculus orbicularis oris
- 
- phr.["口轮匝肌"]
- phr.["orbicular muscle of mouth, comprising a pars labialis, fibers restricted to the lips, and a pars marginalis, fibers blending with those of adjacent muscles; innervation, facial; action, closes and protrudes lips."]

56258 musculus orbitalis
- 
- phr.["眶肌"]
- phr.["orbital muscle: a thin layer of nonstriated muscle that bridges the inferior orbital fissure; innervation, sympathetic branches."]

56259 musculus palatoglossus
- 
- phr.["腭舌肌"]
- phr.["palatoglossus muscle: origin, undersurface of soft palate; insertion, side of tongue; innervation, pharyngeal plexus of vagus; action, elevates tongue, constricts fauces."]

56260 musculus palatopharyngeus
- 
- phr.["腭咽肌"]
- phr.["palatopharyngeal muscle: one of the intrinsic muscles of the larynx; origin, soft palate; insertion, aponeurosis of pharynx, posterior border of thyroid cartilage; innervation, pharyngeal plexus of vagus; action, aids in deglutition."]

56261 musculus palmaris brevis
- 
- phr.["掌短肌"]
- phr.["short palmar muscle: origin, palmar aponeurosis; insertion, skin of medial border of hand; innervation, ulnar; action, assists in deepening hollow of palm."]

56262 musculus palmaris longus
- 
- phr.["掌长肌"]
- phr.["long palmar muscle: origin, medial epicondyle of humerus; insertion, flexor retinaculum, palmar aponeurosis; innervation, median; action, flexes wrist joint, anchors skin and fascia of hand."]

56263 musculus papillaris anterior ventriculi dextri
- 
- phr.["右心室前乳头肌"]
- phr.["anterior papillary muscle of right ventricle: the papillary muscle arising from the sternocostal wall of the right ventricle."]

56264 musculus papillaris anterior ventriculi sinistri
- 
- phr.["左心室前乳头肌"]
- phr.["anterior papillary muscle of left ventricle: the papillary muscle arising from the anterior wall of the left ventricle."]

56265 musculus papillaris posterior ventriculi dextri
- 
- phr.["右心室后乳头肌"]
- phr.["posterior papillary muscle of right ventricle: the papillary muscle arising from the diaphragmatic wall of the right ventricle."]

56266 musculus papillaris posterior ventriculi sinistri
- 
- phr.["左心室后乳头肌"]
- phr.["posterior papillary muscle of left ventricle: the papillary muscle arising from the posterior wall of the left ventricle."]

56267 musculus pectineus
- 
- phr.["耻骨肌"]
- phr.["pectineal muscle: origin, pectineal line of pubis; insertion, pectineal line of femur; innervation, obturator and femoral; action, flexes, adducts thigh."]

56268 musculus pectoralis major
- 
- phr.["胸大肌"]
- phr.["greater pectoral muscle: origin, clavicle, sternum, six upper costal cartilages, aponeurosis of obliquus externus abdominis. These origins are reflected in the subdivision of the muscle into clavicular, sternocostal, and abdominal parts; insertion, crest of intertubercular groove of humerus; innervation, medial and lateral pectoral; action, adducts, flexes, rotates arm medially."]

56269 musculus pectoralis minor
- 
- phr.["胸小肌"]
- phr.["smaller pectoral muscle: origin, third, fourth, and fifth ribs; insertion, coracoid process of scapula; innervation, lateral and medial pectoral; action, draws shoulder forward and downward, raises third, fourth, and fifth ribs in forced inspiration."]

56270 musculus pennatus
- 
- phr.["羽状肌"]
- phr.["pennate muscle: a muscle in which the fibers approach the tendon of insertion from a wide area and are inserted through a large segment of its circumference. Called also m. bipennatus [TA alternative] and bipennate or penniform muscle."]

56271 musculus peroneus brevis
- 
- phr.["腓骨短肌"]
- phr.["TA alternative for m. fibularis brevis."]

56272 musculus peroneus longus
- 
- phr.["腓骨长肌"]
- phr.["TA alternative for m. fibularis longus."]

56273 musculus peroneus tertius
- 
- phr.["第三腓骨肌"]
- phr.["TA alternative for m. fibularis tertius."]

56274 musculus pharyngopalatinus
- 
- phr.["腭咽肌"]
- phr.["m. palatopharyngeus."]

56275 musculus piriformis
- 
- phr.["梨状肌"]
- phr.["piriform muscle: origin, ilium, second to fourth sacral vertebrae; insertion, upper border of greater trochanter of femur; innervation, first and second sacral; action, rotates thigh laterally."]

56276 musculus plantaris
- 
- phr.["跖肌"]
- phr.["plantar muscle: origin, oblique popliteal ligament, lateral supracondylar line of femur; insertion, posterior part of calcaneus; innervation, tibial; action, plantar flexes foot; flexes knee."]

56277 musculus pleurooesophageus
- 
- phr.["胸膜食管肌"]
- phr.["pleuroesophageal muscle: a bundle of smooth muscle fibers usually connecting the esophagus with the left mediastinal pleura."]

56278 musculus popliteus
- 
- phr.["腘肌"]
- phr.["popliteal muscle: origin, lateral condyle of femur, lateral meniscus; insertion, posterior surface of tibia; innervation, tibial; action, flexes leg, rotates leg medially."]

56279 musculus procerus
- 
- phr.["降眉间肌，纤肌"]
- phr.["procerus muscle: origin, fascia over nasal bone; insertion, skin of forehead; innervation, facial; action, draws medial angle of eyebrows down."]

56280 musculus pronator quadratus
- 
- phr.["旋前方肌"]
- phr.["origin, anterior surface and border of distal third or fourth of shaft of ulna; insertion, anterior surface and border of distal fourth of shaft of radius; innervation, anterior interosseous; action, pronates forearm."]

56281 musculus pronator teres
- 
- phr.["旋前圆肌"]
- phr.["(2 heads): origin, caput humerale—medial epicondyle of humerus, caput ulnare—coronoid process of ulna; insertion, lateral surface of radius; innervation, median; action, flexes elbow and pronates forearm."]

56282 musculus psoas major
- 
- phr.["腰大肌"]
- phr.["greater psoas muscle: origin, lumbar vertebrae; insertion, lesser trochanter of femur; innervation, second and third lumbar; action, flexes thigh or trunk."]

56283 musculus psoas minor
- 
- phr.["腰小肌"]
- phr.["smaller psoas muscle: origin, last thoracic and first lumbar vertebrae; insertion, pectineal line, iliopectineal eminence, iliac fascia; innervation, first lumbar; action, flexes trunk. Absent in 40 to 50 per cent of persons."]

56284 musculus pterygoideus lateralis
- 
- phr.["翼外肌"]
- phr.["lateral pterygoid muscle (2 heads): origin, caput superius—infratemporal surface of greater wing of sphenoid and infratemporal crest; caput inferius—lateral surface of lateral pterygoid plate; insertion, neck of condyle of mandible, temporomandibular joint capsule; innervation, mandibular; action, protrudes mandible, opens jaws, moves mandible from side to side."]

56285 musculus pterygoideus medialis
- 
- phr.["翼内肌"]
- phr.["medial pterygoid muscle: origin, medial surface of lateral pterygoid plate, tuberosity of maxilla; insertion, medial surface of ramus and angle of mandible; innervation, mandibular; action, closes jaws."]

56286 musculus pterygopharyngeus
- 
- phr.["翼咽肌，咽上缩肌翼咽部"]
- phr.["pars pterygopharyngea musculi constrictoris pharyngis superioris."]

56287 musculus puboanalis
- 
- phr.["耻骨肛门肌"]
- phr.["puboanal muscle: fibers from the medial part of the pubococcygeus muscle that decussate and blend with the longitudinal muscle layer and fascia of the rectum."]

56288 musculus pubococcygeus
- 
- phr.["耻尾肌，耻骨尾骨肌"]
- phr.["pubococcygeal muscle: the anterior portion of the levator ani, originating anterior to the obturator canal; insertion, anococcygeal body and side of coccyx; innervation, pudendal; action, helps support pelvic viscera and resist increases in intraabdominal pressure."]

56289 musculus puboperinealis
- 
- phr.["耻骨会阴肌"]
- phr.["puboperineal muscle: fibers from the medial part of the pubococcygeus muscle that insert into the perineal body."]

56290 musculus puboprostaticus
- 
- phr.["耻骨前列腺肌"]
- phr.["puboprostatic muscle: a part of the anterior portion of the pubococcygeus muscle, inserted in the prostate and the tendinous center of the perineum; innervated by the pudendal nerve, it supports and compresses the prostate and is involved in control of micturition. Called also levator muscle of prostate or m. levator prostatae (TA alternative)."]

56291 musculus puborectalis
- 
- phr.["耻骨直肠肌"]
- phr.["puborectal muscle: a portion of the levator ani having a more lateral origin from the pubic bone, and continuous posteriorly with the corresponding muscle of the opposite side; innervation, third and fourth sacral; action, helps support pelvic viscera and resist increases in intra-abdominal pressure, maintains perineal flexure at anorectal junction. Called also Braune muscle."]

56292 musculus pubovaginalis
- 
- phr.["耻骨阴道肌"]
- phr.["pubovaginal muscle: a part of the anterior portion of the pubococcygeus muscle, which is inserted into the urethra and vagina; innervated by the pudendal nerve, it is involved in control of micturition."]

56293 musculus pubovesicalis
- 
- phr.["耻骨膀胱肌"]
- phr.["pubovesical muscle: smooth muscle fibers extending from the neck of the urinary bladder to the pubis."]

56294 musculus pyramidalis
- 
- phr.["锥状肌"]
- phr.["pyramidal muscle: origin, anterior aspect of pubis, anterior pubic ligament; insertion, linea alba; innervation, last thoracic; action, tenses abdominal wall."]

56295 musculus pyramidalis auriculae
- 
- phr.["耳郭锥状肌"]
- phr.["pyramidal muscle of auricle: a prolongation of the fibers of the tragicus to the spina helicis."]

56296 musculus quadratus
- 
- phr.["方形肌"]
- phr.["quadrate muscle: a square-shaped muscle."]

56297 musculus quadratus femoris
- 
- phr.["股方肌"]
- phr.["origin, upper part of lateral border of tuberosity of ischium; insertion, quadrate tubercle of femur, intertrochanteric crest; innervation, fourth and fifth lumbar and first sacral; action, adducts, rotates thigh laterally."]

56298 musculus quadratus lumborum
- 
- phr.["腰方肌"]
- phr.["origin, iliac crest, thoracolumbar fascia; insertion, twelfth rib, transverse processes of four upper lumbar vertebrae; innervation, first and second lumbar and twelfth thoracic; action, flexes lumbar vertebrae laterally, fixes last rib."]

56299 musculus quadratus plantae
- 
- phr.["足底方肌，跖方肌"]
- phr.["origin, calcaneus and plantar fascia; insertion, tendons of flexor digitorum longus; innervation, lateral plantar; action, aids in flexing toes. Called also m. flexor accessorius [TA alternative] or accessory flexor muscle."]

56300 musculus quadriceps femoris
- 
- phr.["股四头肌"]
- phr.["quadriceps muscle of thigh: a name applied collectively to the rectus femoris, vastus intermedius, vastus lateralis, and vastus medialis, inserting by a common tendon that surrounds the patella and ends on the tuberosity of the tibia, and acting to extend the leg upon the thigh. See individual components."]

56301 musculus rectococcygeus
- 
- phr.["直肠尾骨肌"]
- phr.["rectococcygeal muscle: smooth muscle fibers originating on the anterior surface of the second and third coccygeal vertebrae and inserting on the posterior surface of the rectum, innervated by autonomic nerves, and acting to retract and elevate the rectum."]

56302 musculus rectouterinus
- 
- phr.["直肠子宫肌"]
- phr.["rectouterine muscle: a band of fibers in the female, running between the cervix of the uterus and the rectum, in the rectouterine fold."]

56303 musculus rectovesicalis
- 
- phr.["直肠膀胱肌"]
- phr.["rectovesical muscle: a band of fibers in the male, connecting the longitudinal musculature of the rectum with the external muscular coat of the bladder."]

56304 musculus rectus abdominis
- 
- phr.["腹直肌"]
- phr.["origin, pubic crest and symphysis; insertion, xiphoid process, cartilages of fifth, sixth, and seventh ribs; innervation, branches of lower thoracic; action, flexes lumbar vertebrae, supports abdomen."]

56305 musculus rectus capitis anterior
- 
- phr.["头前直肌"]
- phr.["origin, lateral mass of atlas; insertion, basilar part of occipital bone; innervation, first and second cervical; action, flexes, supports head."]

56306 musculus rectus capitis lateralis
- 
- phr.["头外侧直肌"]
- phr.["origin, upper surface of transverse process of atlas; insertion, jugular process of occipital bone; innervation, first and second cervical; action, flexes, supports head."]

56307 musculus rectus capitis posterior major
- 
- phr.["头后大直肌"]
- phr.["origin, spinous process of axis; insertion, occipital bone; innervation, suboccipital and greater occipital; action, extends head."]

56308 musculus rectus capitis posterior minor
- 
- phr.["头后小直肌"]
- phr.["origin, posterior tubercle of atlas; insertion, occipital bone; innervation, suboccipital and greater occipital; action, extends head."]

56309 musculus rectus femoris
- 
- phr.["股直肌"]
- phr.["origin, anterior inferior iliac spine, rim of acetabulum; insertion, base of patella, tuberosity of tibia; innervation, femoral; action, extends knee, flexes thigh at hip."]

56310 musculus rectus inferior bulbi
- 
- phr.["眼下直肌"]
- phr.["inferior rectus muscle: origin, anulus tendineus communis; insertion, underside of sclera; innervation, oculomotor; action, adducts, rotates eyeball downward and medially."]

56311 musculus rectus lateralis bulbi
- 
- phr.["眼外直肌"]
- phr.["lateral rectus muscle: origin, anulus tendineus communis; insertion, lateral side of sclera; innervation, abducens; action, abducts eyeball."]

56312 musculus rectus medialis bulbi
- 
- phr.["眼内直肌"]
- phr.["medial rectus muscle: origin, anulus tendineus communis; insertion, medial side of sclera; innervation, oculomotor; action, adducts eyeball."]

56313 musculus rectus superior bulbi
- 
- phr.["眼上直肌"]
- phr.["superior rectus muscle: origin, anulus tendineus communis; insertion, upper aspect of sclera; innervation, oculomotor; action, adducts, rotates eyeball upward and medially."]

56314 musculus rhomboideus major
- 
- phr.["大菱形肌"]
- phr.["rhomboid major muscle: origin, spinous processes of second, third, fourth, and fifth thoracic vertebrae; insertion, medial margin of scapula; innervation, dorsal scapular; action, retracts, elevates scapula."]

56315 musculus rhomboideus minor
- 
- phr.["小菱形肌"]
- phr.["rhomboid minor muscle: origin, spinous processes of seventh cervical to first thoracic vertebrae, lower part of ligamentum nuchae; insertion, medial margin of scapula at root of the spine; innervation, dorsal scapular; action, adducts, elevates scapula."]

56316 musculus risorius
- 
- phr.["笑肌"]
- phr.["risorius muscle: origin, fascia over masseter; insertion, skin at angle of mouth; innervation, buccal branch of facial; action, draws angle of mouth laterally."]

56317 musculus sacrococcygeus anterior
- 
- phr.["骶尾前肌，骶尾腹侧肌"]
- phr.["m. sacrococcygeus ventralis."]

56318 musculus sacrococcygeus dorsalis
- 
- phr.["骶尾背侧肌"]
- phr.["dorsal sacrococcygeal muscle: a muscular slip passing from the dorsal aspect of the sacrum to the coccyx."]

56319 musculus sacrococcygeus posterior
- 
- phr.["骶尾后肌，骶尾背侧肌"]
- phr.["m. sacrococcygeus dorsalis."]

56320 musculus sacrococcygeus ventralis
- 
- phr.["骶尾腹侧肌"]
- phr.["ventral sacrococcygeal muscle: a musculotendinous slip passing from the lower sacral vertebrae to the coccyx."]

56321 musculus sacrospinalis
- 
- phr.["骶棘肌，竖脊肌"]
- phr.["m. erector spinae."]

56322 musculus salpingopharyngeus
- 
- phr.["咽鼓管咽肌，耳咽管咽肌"]
- phr.["salpingopharyngeal muscle: origin, auditory tube near its orifice; insertion, posterior part of palatopharyngeus; innervation, pharyngeal plexus of vagus; action, elevates upper lateral wall of pharynx."]

56323 musculus sartorius
- 
- phr.["缝匠肌"]
- phr.["sartorius muscle: origin, anterior superior iliac spine; insertion, proximal part of medial surface of tibia; innervation, femoral; action, flexes leg at knee and thigh at pelvis."]

56324 musculus scalenus anterior
- 
- phr.["前斜角肌"]
- phr.["anterior scalene muscle: origin, transverse processes of third to sixth cervical vertebrae; insertion, scalene tubercle of first rib; innervation, fourth to sixth cervical; action, raises first rib, flexes cervical vertebrae forward and laterally and rotates to opposite side."]

56325 musculus scalenus medius
- 
- phr.["中斜角肌"]
- phr.["middle scalene muscle: origin, transverse processes of second to seventh cervical vertebrae and often atlas; insertion, upper surface of first rib; innervation, third to eighth cervical; action, raises first rib, flexes cervical vertebrae forward and laterally and rotates to opposite side."]

56326 musculus scalenus minimus
- 
- phr.["小斜角肌"]
- phr.["smallest scalene muscle: a band occasionally found between the musculi scalenus anterior and scalenus medius; origin, transverse process of seventh cervical vertebra; insertion, first rib, suprapleural membrane; innervation, seventh cervical; action, raises first rib, flexes and rotates cervical vertebrae, supports suprapleural membrane. Called also Sibson muscle."]

56327 musculus scalenus posterior
- 
- phr.["后斜角肌"]
- phr.["posterior scalene muscle: origin, posterior tubercles of transverse processes of fourth to sixth cervical vertebrae; insertion, second rib; innervation, sixth to eighth cervical; action, raises second rib, flexes cervical vertebrae laterally."]

56328 musculus semimembranosus
- 
- phr.["半膜肌"]
- phr.["semimembranous muscle: origin, tuberosity of ischium; insertion, medial condyle and border of tibia, lateral condyle of femur; innervation, tibial; action, flexes and rotates leg medially, extends thigh at hip."]

56329 musculus semipennatus
- 
- phr.["半羽状肌"]
- phr.["semipennate muscle: a muscle in which the fiber bundles approach the tendon of insertion from only one direction and are inserted through only a small segment of its circumference. Called also m. unipennatus [TA alternative] and unipennate muscle."]

56330 musculus semispinalis
- 
- phr.["半棘肌"]
- phr.["semispinal muscle: a muscle composed of fibers extending obliquely from the transverse processes of the vertebrae to the spine, except for the semispinalis capitis; it includes the m. semispinalis capitis, m. semispinalis cervicis, and m. semispinalis thoracis."]

56331 musculus semispinalis capitis
- 
- phr.["头半棘肌"]

The clinical course usually begins with nausea, vomiting, abdominal pain, and diarrhea, followed by a quiescent period of up to 48 hours, and then signs and symptoms of severe liver, kidney, and central nervous system damage that can be fatal."]

It may evolve into generalized lymphoma with a tendency for nodal, hematogenous, and visceral involvement. Its course has three successive stages: the premycotic stage, associated with intensely pruritic erythematous, eczematous, or psoriasiform eruptions; the mycotic stage, or stage of infiltrated plaques, characterized by the presence of abnormal lymphocytes called Sézary cells; and the tumor stage, characterized by mushroomlike tumors that often ulcerate. In a variant type of tumor stage called mycosis fungoides d'emblée, the tumors may develop without preceding lesions or prodromal symptoms. Called also granuloma fungoides.Mycosis fungoides, with ulcerated plaques and tumors."]

The genus includes the gonococcus, the several meningococcus types, pigmented forms occasionally associated with meningitis, and a number of saprophytic or parasitic but nonpathogenic species. The type species is N. gonorrhoe´ae."]

Most children recover completely, but some develop chronic disease or fatal cirrhosis. Cf. neonatal hemochromatosis. Called also giant cell h."]

57760 neonatal herpes
- 
- phr.["新生儿疱疹"]
- phr.["herpes simplex in a neonate, usually contracted while passing through the birth canal of a mother with active genital herpes. It may be localized with skin eruptions or generalized, affecting the liver, adrenal glands, and lungs. In a minority of cases, virus from the mother crosses the placenta and the fetus is infected in utero; these neonates may have brain involvement such as microcephaly and seizures."]

57761 neonatal hyperbilirubinemia
- 
- phr.["新生儿高胆红素血症"]
- phr.["a type of mild, transient unconjugated hyperbilirubinemia seen in the normal neonate; a transient familial form also occurs, in which jaundice occurs within four days after birth and may lead to kernicterus."]

57762 neonatal hypoglycemia
- 
- phr.["新生儿低糖血症"]
- phr.["fasting hypoglycemia in a neonate; those most at risk have diabetic mothers or are premature or small for gestational age. Leucine-induced hypoglycemia is a type that is hereditary.","hypoglycemia during the first week of life of piglets, a common cause of death; it may result from inadequate nursing, such as when there is a large litter, or from hypothermia. Called also h. of piglets."]

57763 neonatal icterus
- 
- phr.["新生儿黄疸"]
- phr.["see under jaundice."]

57764 neonatal jaundice
- 
- phr.["新生儿黄疸"]
- phr.["a type of jaundice often seen in newborn infants around the second day of life, due either to excessive bilirubin produced by the accelerated breakdown of erythrocytes seen in most infants, or to inability of the immature liver to conjugate bilirubin efficiently. Most cases are mild (see physiologic j.); if it is more severe or does not resolve within a few days, the infant may suffer serious damage such as kernicterus. Called also neonatal icterus and icterus neonatorum"]

57765 neonatal line
- 
- phr.["新生线"]
- phr.["a line seen on longitudinal sections of a tooth, showing a demarcation between the structures present at birth and those deposited postnatally; in cross sections, the lines are seen as rings (neonatal rings), and their variations indicate adaptational changes in tooth formation. See also l's of Owen."]

57766 neonatal lupus
- 
- phr.["新生儿狼疮"]
- phr.["a condition sometimes seen in infants born to mothers with systemic lupus erythematosus, usually characterized by a rash similar to that of discoid lupus; transiently elevated levels of antinuclear antibodies and LE cells; and sometimes heart block, other cardiac conduction disturbances, hematologic abnormalities, hepatosplenomegaly, or pericarditis. It is usually benign and self-limited, but the discoid skin lesions occasionally persist."]

57767 neonatal maladjustment syndrome
- 
- phr.["新生儿失调综合征"]
- phr.["a disease of newborn foals, caused by perinatal hypoxia and characterized by behavioral disturbances such as inability to nurse, aimless wandering, apparent blindness, and uttering of a barklike sound; it may progress to convulsions, coma, and death. Affected foals are called barkers, dummies, or wanderers."]

57768 neonatal myasthenia
- 
- phr.["新生儿肌无力"]
- phr.["a transient myasthenia (lasting from a week to a month) affecting offspring of myasthenic women, characteristically marked by difficulty in sucking and swallowing."]

57769 neonatal respiratory distress syndrome
- 
- phr.["新生儿呼吸窘迫综合征，新生儿肺透明膜病"]
- phr.["dyspnea with cyanosis in the newborn, a condition caused by deficiency of surfactant. Prodromal signs include dilatation of the alae nasi, expiratory grunt, and retraction of the suprasternal notch or costal margins. It is usually seen in infants who are premature, have diabetic mothers, or were delivered by cesarean section; sometimes there is no known cause. Some infants die of respiratory failure in the first few days of life and at autopsy have eosinophilic hyaline material lining the alveoli, alveolar ducts, and bronchioles. Called also respiratory distress s. of newborn and idiopathic respiratory distress of newborn.Neonatal respiratory distress syndrome. (A), Ground-glass appearance and air bronchograms. (B), Alveoli are collapsed and the alveolar ducts and respiratory bronchioles are dilated and lined by hyaline membrane."]

57770 neonatal ring
- 
- phr.["新生环"]
- phr.["see neonatal line, under line."]

57771 neonatal tetanus
- 
- phr.["新生儿破伤风"]

57772 neonatal tetany
- 
- phr.["新生儿手足搐搦"]

57773 neonatal thrombocytopenia
- 
- phr.["新生儿血小板减少症"]

57774 neonatal tooth
- 
- phr.["新生牙"]
- phr.["a tooth that erupts within the first month of life. Called also milk t."]

57775 neonatal tyrosinemia
- 
- phr.["新生儿期高酪氨酸血症"]

It occurs most often in premature infants and usually has no sequelae; a causal relationship with mild mental retardation is possible."]

57776 neonatal volvulus
- 
- phr.["新生儿肠扭转"]

- /ˈnɪ(:)əneɪt/

- phr.["新斯的明试验"]

57937 nerve
- /nɜ:v/
- n.["神经"]
- n.["a cordlike structure made up of a collection of fibers that convey impulses between a part of the central nervous system and some other region of the body. A nerve consists of a connective tissue sheath (epineurium) enclosing bundles of fibers (funiculi or fasciculi); each bundle is in turn surrounded by its own sheath of connective tissue (perineurium), the inner surface of which is formed by a membrane of flattened mesothelial cells. Very small nerves may consist of only one funiculus derived from the parent nerve. Within each such bundle, the individual nerve fibers, which are microscopic in size, are surrounded by interstitial connective tissue (endoneurium). An individual nerve fiber (an axon with its covering sheath) consists of formed elements in a matrix of protoplasm (axoplasm), the entire structure being enclosed in a thin membrane (axolemma). Each nerve fiber is enclosed by a cellular sheath (neurilemma), from which it may or may not be separated by a lipid layer (myelin sheath) derived from neurilemmal cells. In official terminology called nervus."]

Called also cerebral nerves, encephalic nerves, and nervi encephalici."]

- phr.["尺神经指背神经"]

- 
- phr.["趾背神经"]

- phr.["正中神经指掌侧总神经"]

- phr.["尺神经指掌侧总神经"]

- phr.["正中神经指掌侧固有神经"]

58003 nervi digitales palmares proprii nervi ulnaris

58005 nervi digitales plantares communes nervi plantaris medialis
- 
- phr.["足底内侧神经趾足底总神经"]

58006 nervi digitales plantares proprii nervi plantaris lateralis
- 
- phr.["足底外侧神经趾足底固有神经"]
- phr.["proper plantar digital nerves of lateral plantar nerve: origin, common plantar digital nerves; distribution, flexor digiti minimi brevis muscle, skin and joints of lateral side of sole and little toe, and adjacent sides of fourth and fifth toes; modality, motor and general sensory."]

58007 nervi digitales plantares proprii nervi plantaris medialis
- 
- phr.["足底内侧神经趾足底固有神经"]
- phr.["proper plantar digital nerves of medial plantar nerve: origin, common plantar digital nerves; distribution, skin and joints of medial side of great toe, and adjacent sides of great and second, second and third, and third and fourth toes; the nerves extend to the dorsum to supply nail beds and tips of toes; modality, general sensory."]

58008 nervi encephalici
- 
- phr.["脑神经"]
- phr.["nervi craniales."]

58009 nervi erigentes
- 
- phr.["盆内脏神经，勃起神经"]
- phr.["radix parasympathica gangliorum pelvicorum."]

58010 nervi intercostales
- 
- phr.["肋间神经"]
- phr.["intercostal nerves: anterior rami of the first eleven thoracic spinal nerves, situated between the ribs. The first three send branches to the brachial plexus as well as to the thoracic wall; the fourth, fifth, and sixth supply only the thoracic wall; and the seventh through eleventh are thoracoabdominal in distribution. Called also rami anteriores nervorum thoracicum [TA alternative] and rami ventrales nervorum thoracicorum [TA alternative]. The primary anterior division of the twelfth thoracic nerve is subcostal rather than intercostal in position and is known as the subcostal nerve (see nervus subcostalis). It differs in course and relationship from the other anterior branches and so is classified separately."]

58011 nervi intercostobrachiales
- 
- phr.["肋间臂神经"]
- phr.["intercostobrachial nerves: two nerves arising from the intercostal nerves and supplying the skin of the upper limb. The first is constant: origin, second intercostal nerve; distribution, skin on back and medial aspect of arm; modality, general sensory. A second intercostobrachial nerve is often present; origin, third intercostal nerve; distribution, skin of axilla and medial aspect of arm; modality, general sensory."]

58012 nervi labiales anteriores
- 
- phr.["阴唇前神经"]

58013 nervi labiales posteriores
- 
- phr.["阴唇后神经"]

58014 nervi lumbales
- 
- phr.["腰神经"]

58015 nervi palatini minores

- phr.["腭小神经"]

58016 nervi perineales
- 
- phr.["会阴神经"]

58017 nervi phrenici accessorii
- 
- phr.["副膈神经"]
- phr.["accessory phrenic nerves: an inconstant contribution of the fifth cervical nerve to the phrenic nerve; when present, they run a separate course to the root of the neck or into the thorax before joining the phrenic nerve."]

58018 nervi rectales inferiores

- phr.["直肠下神经"]

58019 nervi sacrales

Upon exiting the jugular foramen, the spinal and cranial roots separate again to form the external branch (ramus externus nervi accessorii) and internal branch (ramus internus nervi accessorii), respectively; modality, motor."]
