- abbr.["d->N-methyl-d-aspartate."]

58962 NMN
- 
- abbr.["nicotinamide mononucleotide 烟酰胺单核苷酸"]
- abbr.["nicotinamide mononucleotide."]

58963 NMR
- 
- abbr.["nuclear magnetic resonance 核磁共振"]
- abbr.["nuclear magnetic resonance."]

58964 NMRI
- 
- abbr.["Naval Medical Research Institute 海军医学研究所"]
- abbr.["Naval Medical Research Institute, part of the National Naval Medical Center."]

58965 NMS
- 
- abbr.["neuroleptic malignant syndrome 神经阻滞剂恶性综合征；neuromuscular stimulation 神经肌肉刺激"]
- abbr.["neuroleptic malignant syndrome."]

58966 nn.
- 
- abbr.["nervi 神经"]
- abbr.["nervi (nerves)."]

58967 NNRTI
- 
- abbr.["non-nucleoside reverse transcriptase inhibitor 非核苷逆转录酶抑制剂"]
- abbr.["non-nucleoside reverse transcriptase inhibitor."]

58968 No
- 
- int.["nobelium 锘"]
- int.["nobelium."]

58969 No.
- 
- abbr.["numero 号码，数目"]
- abbr.["nu´mero (to the number of)."]

58970 Noack syndrome
- /ˈnəʊɑ:k/
- phr.["诺亚克综合征，尖头、多及并指［趾］畸形Ⅰ型"]
- phr.["Pfeiffer syndrome; see under syndrome."]

58971 NOAEL
- 
- abbr.["no observed adverse effect level 无明显有害效应剂量"]
- abbr.["no observed adverse effect level."]

58972 noble gas
- 
- phr.["惰性气体"]
- phr.["the gas elements of group VIII of the periodic table, i.e., helium, neon, argon, krypton, xenon, and radon."]

58973 noble metal
- 
- phr.["贵金属"]
- phr.["a metal that is highly resistant to oxidation and corrosion; cf. base m."]

58974 Nocardia
- /nəʊˈkɑ:dɪə/
- n.["诺卡菌属"]
- n.["a large genus of bacteria of the family Nocardiaceae, consisting mainly of soil saprophytes; a few are pathogenic. Organisms are gram-positive and aerobic, with branching filaments that break into bacillary or coccal forms, and produce chains of spores by simple fragmentation of hyphal branches. The type species is N. asteroi´des."]

58975 Nocardia brasiliensis
- 
- phr.["巴西诺卡菌"]
- phr.["an acid-fast pathogenic species that produces yellow to brown mycelium with branching filaments, usually found in the tropics in soil; it can cause nocardiosis and actinomycotic mycetoma. Called also Actinomyces brasiliensis."]

58976 Nocardia coeliaca
- 
- phr.["产腔诺卡菌"]
- phr.["a species that produces the antibiotic substance nocardin."]

58977 Nocardia farcinica
- 
- phr.["皮疽诺卡菌"]
- phr.["a species of acid-fast, filamentous actinomycetes of uncertain classification, which causes farcy and nocardial mastitis in cattle and actinomycotic mycetoma in humans; it may be identical to N. asteroides."]

58978 Nocardia orientalis
- 
- phr.["东方诺卡菌"]
- phr.["former name for Amycolatopsis orientalis."]

58979 Nocardiaceae
- /nəʊˌkɑ:dɪˈeɪsɪi:/
- n.["诺卡菌科"]
- n.["a family of bacteria of the suborder Corynebacterineae, order Actinomycetales, consisting of nonmotile, gram-positive microorganisms that form branching hyphae that fragment into rod-shaped to coccoid elements; organisms are aerobic, chemo-organotrophic, and catalase-positive. It includes the genera Nocardia and Rhodococcus."]

58980 nocardial
- /nəʊˈkɑ:dɪəl/
- adj.["诺卡（放线）菌的"]
- adj.["pertaining to or caused by Nocardia."]

58981 nocardial mastitis
- 
- phr.["诺卡菌乳腺炎"]
- phr.["mastitis in cattle caused by an infection with Nocardia asteroides or N. farcinica. Characteristics include granulomatous lesions of the udder with fibrosis, inflammation, abscesses, and fever; damage to the udder and milk supply is usually permanent."]

58982 nocardiasis
- /ˌnəʊkɑ:ˈdaɪəsɪs/
- n.["诺卡菌病"]
- n.["nocardiosis."]

58983 nocardin
- /nəʊˈkɑ:dɪn/
- adj.["诺卡菌素"]
- adj.["an antibiotic substance from Nocardia coeliaca, active against tubercle bacilli."]

58984 nocardioform
- /nəʊˈkɑ:dɪəˌfɔ:m/
- adj.["诺卡型的"]
- adj.["characterized by a fugacious mycelium that breaks into bacillary or coccal forms."]

58985 nocardioform actinomycetes
- 
- phr.["诺卡菌状放线菌"]
- phr.["a morphological group of actinomycetes characterized by a fugacious mycelium that breaks up into bacillary or coccal forms; all genera in this group are gram-positive and aerobic."]

58986 Nocardiopsaceae
- /nəʊˌkɑ:dɪəʊpˈseɪsɪi:/
- n.["拟诺卡菌科"]
- n.["a family of gram-positive, aerobic, non–acid-fast, filament-forming bacteria of the suborder Streptosporangineae, order Actinomycetales; organisms of medical interest are contained in the genus Nocardiopsis."]

58987 Nocardiopsis
- /nəʊˌkɑ:dɪˈɒpsɪs/
- n.["诺卡土壤菌属"]
- n.["a genus of soil bacteria of the family Nocardiopsaceae, consisting of gram-positive, aerobic, non–acid-fast organisms that form filaments. The organisms differ in cell wall type and are not resistant to lysozymes. They are potential pathogens, causing abscesses and pulmonary lesions. The type species is N. dassonvil´lei."]

58988 Nocardiopsis dassonvillei
- 
- phr.["达松维尔类诺卡菌"]
- phr.["a species, separable into a number of subspecies, that is a cause of human infection, including actinomycotic mycetoma, conjunctivitis, skin infections, and hypersensitivity pneumonitis."]

58989 nocardiosis
- /nəʊkɑ:dɪˈəʊsɪs/
- n.["诺卡菌病"]
- n.["infection with a species of Nocardia, usually N. asteroides, but occasionally N. brasiliensis, N. farcinica, or N. otitidiscaviarum. There is usually an acute or chronic suppurative lung infection (pulmonary n.) with abscesses, but there is a marked tendency to spread to other organs such as the brain, skin, or subcutaneous tissues, sometimes with a fatal outcome. Called also nocardiasis.Nocardiosis. Multiple gadolinium-enhanced brain lesions (arrows) on MRI scan."]

58990 nocebo
- /nəʊˈsi:bəʊ/
- n.["非安慰剂"]
- n.["an adverse, nonspecific side effect occurring in conjunction with a medication but not directly resulting from the pharmacologic action of the medication."]

58991 Nochtia
- /ˈnɒktɪə/
- n.["小线虫属"]
- n.["a genus of small nematode worms. N. noch´ti infests the stomach of an Indonesian monkey, causing tumors."]

58992 noci-
- 
- n.["［构词成分］伤害"]
- n.["a combining form denoting relationship to injury or to a noxious or deleterious agent or influence."]

58993 nociassociation
- /ˌnəʊsɪəˌsəʊsɪˈeɪʃən/
- n.["伤害性联合反应"]
- n.["the unconscious discharge of nervous energy under the stimulus of trauma, as in surgical shock."]

58994 nociceptin
- /ˌnəʊsɪˈseptɪn/
- n.["痛敏肽"]
- n.["a 17–amino acid neuropeptide that binds to orphan opioid receptors but not to regular opioid receptors and has analgesic properties Called also orphanin FQ."]

58995 nociception
- /ˌnəʊsɪˈsepʃən/
- n.["伤害感受"]
- n.["the ability to feel pain (q.v.), caused by stimulation of a nociceptor; called also pain sense, algesia, algesthesia, and nociperception."]

58996 nociceptor
- /ˌnəʊsɪˈseptə/
- n.["伤害性感受器"]
- n.["a receptor for pain caused by injury to body tissues; the injury may be from physical stimuli such as mechanical, thermal, or electrical stimuli, or from chemical stimuli such as the presence of a toxin or an excess of a nontoxic substance. Most nociceptors are in either the skin (cutaneous n's) or the walls of viscera (visceral n's)."]

58997 nocifensor
- /ˌnəʊsɪˈfensə/
- n.["防伤害系统，伤害防卫系统"]
- n.["protecting against injury; said of a system of nerves in the skin and mucous membranes which are concerned with local defense against injury."]

58998 nociperception
- /ˌnəʊsɪpəˈsepʃən/
- n.["伤害性知觉"]
- n.["nociception."]

58999 noctalbuminuria
- /ˌnɒktælˌbju:mɪˈnjʊərɪə/
- n.["夜蛋白尿（症）"]
- n.["albuminuria in urine secreted at night."]

59000 noctambulation
- /ˌnɒktæmbjʊˈleɪʃən/
- n.["梦行（症）"]
- n.["somnambulism."]

59001 noctiphobia
- /ˌnɒktɪˈfəʊbjə/
- n.["黑夜恐惧"]
- n.["irrational fear of night and darkness."]

59002 nocturia
- /nɒkˈtjʊərɪə/
- n.["夜尿"]
- n.["urinary frequency at night; called also nycturia."]

59003 nocturnal
- /nɒkˈtɜ:nl/
- adj.["夜间的，夜发的，夜间活动的"]
- adj.["pertaining to, occurring at, or active at night."]

59004 nocturnal amblyopia
- 
- phr.["夜发性弱视"]
- phr.["abnormal dimness of vision at night."]

59005 nocturnal dyspnea
- 
- phr.["夜间呼吸困难"]
- phr.["dyspnea that is minimal in the morning, and may gradually progress until it becomes severe at night."]

59006 nocturnal emission
- 
- phr.["遗精，梦遗"]
- phr.["reflex emission of the semen during sleep."]

59007 nocturnal epilepsy
- 
- phr.["夜发性癫痫"]
- phr.["epileptic attacks occurring at night or while the patient is asleep."]

59008 nocturnal myoclonus
- 
- phr.["夜间性肌阵挛"]
- phr.["myoclonic jerks of the limbs occurring as a person is falling asleep or is asleep; in the latter case they may disrupt sleep. Called also periodic leg or limb movement disorder."]

59009 nocturnal paroxysmal dystonia
- 
- phr.["夜间突发性张力障碍"]
- phr.["a type of parasomnia occurring during NREM sleep, characterized by paroxysms of dystonic movements; in some persons these may progress to epileptic seizures."]

59010 nocturnal penile tumescence test
- 
- phr.["夜间阴茎勃起试验"]
- phr.["monitoring of erections occurring during sleep; in the differential diagnosis of psychogenic and organic impotence, the former is generally associated with the presence of normal patterns of nocturnal erection while the latter is not. Called also NPT t."]

59011 nocturnal vertigo
- 
- phr.["夜间眩晕"]
- phr.["a sensation of falling occurring as the subject is going to sleep."]

59012 nodal arrhythmia
- 
- phr.["结性心律失常"]
- phr.["arrhythmia occurring when the atrioventricular node or surrounding junctional tissue is acting as pacemaker."]

59013 nodal artery
- 
- phr.["窦房结动脉"]
- phr.["see ramus nodi atrioventricularis arteriae coronariae dextrae and ramus nodi sinuatrialis arteriae coronariae dextrae."]

59014 nodal beat
- 
- phr.["结性搏动"]
- phr.["atrioventricular junctional escape b."]

59015 nodal bigeminy
- 
- phr.["结性二联律"]
- phr.["atrioventricular nodal b."]

59016 nodal bradycardia
- 
- phr.["结性心动过缓"]
- phr.["bradycardia in which the stimulus of the heart's contraction arises in the atrioventricular node or common bundle."]

59017 nodal cells
- 
- phr.["节细胞"]
- phr.["P c's."]

59018 nodal escape
- 
- phr.["结性逸搏"]
- phr.["atrioventricular junctional e."]

59019 nodal extrasystole
- 
- phr.["结性期外收缩"]
- phr.["atrioventricular e."]

59020 nodal points
- 
- phr.["结点，节点"]
- phr.["one of two points on the axis of an optical system so situated that a ray falling on one will produce a parallel ray emerging through the other."]

59021 nodal rhythm
- 
- phr.["结性节律"]
- phr.["atrioventricular junctional r."]

59022 nodal tachycardia
- 
- phr.["结性心动过速"]
- phr.["junctional t."]

59023 nodal tissue
- 
- phr.["结组织"]
- phr.["tissue made up of nerve and muscle fibers, such as that composing the sinoatrial node of the heart."]

59024 nodding spasm
- 
- phr.["点头痉挛"]
- phr.["spasmus nutans."]

59025 node
- /nəʊd/
- n.["结，结节"]
- n.["a small mass of tissue in the form of a swelling, knot, or protuberance, either normal or pathological.","in fungi, a swelling on a stolon where the rhizomes arise. See illustration at mold."]

59026 node of Rouvière
- 
- phr.["罗维埃结"]
- phr.["the most superior of the lateral group of the retropharyngeal lymph nodes, located at the base of the skull."]

59027 node of Tawara
- 
- phr.["田原结，房室结"]
- phr.["nodus atrioventricularis."]

59028 nodes of Ranvier
- 
- phr.["郎维埃结，郎飞结"]
- phr.["constrictions occurring on myelinated nerve fibers at regular intervals of about 1 mm; at these sites the myelin sheath is absent and the axon is enclosed only by Schwann cell processes. See illustration and Plate 39.Node of Ranvier (transmission electron micrograph)."]

59029 nodi
- /ˈnəʊdaɪ/
- n.["结，结节"]
- n.["genitive and plural of nodus."]

59030 nodi lymphoidei abdominis
- 
- phr.["腹部淋巴结"]
- phr.["abdominal lymph nodes: the lymph nodes that drain the abdomen; subdivided into parietal (nodi lymphoidei abdominis parietales) and visceral lymph nodes nodi lymphoidei abdominis viscerales."]

59031 nodi lymphoidei abdominis parietales
- 
- phr.["腹壁淋巴结"]
- phr.["parietal abdominal lymph nodes: the lymph nodes that drain the abdominal walls, comprising the left, intermediate, and lumbar lymph nodes, inferior phrenic lymph nodes, and inferior epigastric lymph nodes."]

59032 nodi lymphoidei abdominis viscerales
- 
- phr.["腹内脏淋巴结"]
- phr.["visceral abdominal lymph nodes: the numerous lymph nodes that drain the abdominal viscera."]

59033 nodi lymphoidei accessorii
- 
- phr.["副淋巴结"]
- phr.["accessory lymph nodes: a chain of lymph nodes of the inferior deep lateral cervical group that follow the spinal accessory nerve and receive lymph from the occipital, postauricular, and suprascapular nodes and from the scalp, neck, and shoulder."]

59034 nodi lymphoidei anorectales
- 
- phr.["肛门直肠淋巴结"]
- phr.["TA alternative for nodi lymphoidei pararectales."]

59035 nodi lymphoidei aortici laterales
- 
- phr.["主动脉外侧淋巴结"]
- phr.["lateral aortic lymph nodes: two chains (right and left) of the left lumbar group that are on the left side of the aorta and drain the suprarenal glands, kidneys, ureters, testes, ovaries, pelvic viscera (except the intestines), and posterior abdominal wall."]

59036 nodi lymphoidei appendiculares
- 
- phr.["阑尾淋巴结"]
- phr.["appendicular lymph nodes: lymph nodes situated along the appendicular artery and in the mesoappendix that drain into the ileocolic lymph nodes."]

59037 nodi lymphoidei axillares
- 
- phr.["腋淋巴结"]
- phr.["axillary lymph nodes: the 20 to 30 lymph nodes of the axilla, which receive lymph from all the lymph vessels of the upper limb, most of those of the breast, and the cutaneous vessels from the trunk above the level of the umbilicus. They are divided into groups: apical, central, humeral (lateral), pectoral (anterior), and subscapular (posterior)."]

59038 nodi lymphoidei axillares anteriores
- 
- phr.["腋前淋巴结"]
- phr.["TA alternative for nodi lymphoidei axillares pectorales."]

59039 nodi lymphoidei axillares apicales
- 
- phr.["腋尖淋巴结"]
- phr.["apical axillary lymph nodes: six to twelve axillary lymph nodes partly posterior to the superior part of the pectoralis minor muscle and partly in the apex of the axilla, receiving afferent vessels that accompany the cephalic vein and draining all other axillary nodes; their efferent vessels unite to form the subclavian trunk."]

59040 nodi lymphoidei axillares centrales
- 
- phr.["腋中央淋巴结"]
- phr.["central axillary lymph nodes: three or four axillary lymph nodes embedded in adipose tissue near the base of the axilla; they receive lymph from the lateral, pectoral, and subscapular nodes and drain into the apical nodes."]

59041 nodi lymphoidei axillares humerales
- 
- phr.["肱腋淋巴结"]
- phr.["humeral axillary lymph nodes: a group of four to six axillary lymph nodes lying posteromedial to the axillary vein and receiving most of the lymphatic drainage from the upper limb. Called also nodi lymphoidei axillares laterales [TA alternative] and lateral axillary lymph nodes."]

59042 nodi lymphoidei axillares laterales
- 
- phr.["腋侧淋巴结"]
- phr.["TA alternative for nodi lymphoidei axillares humerales."]

59043 nodi lymphoidei axillares posteriores
- 
- phr.["腋后淋巴结"]
- phr.["TA alternative for nodi lymphoidei axillares subscapulares."]

59044 nodi lymphoidei axillares subscapulares
- 
- phr.["腋肩胛下淋巴结"]
- phr.["subscapular axillary lymph nodes: six or seven axillary lymph nodes along the inferior margins of the posterior axillary wall along the course of the subscapular artery; they receive lymph from the skin and superficial muscles of the posterior part of the neck and the posterior thoracic wall and drain into the apical and central nodes. Called also nodi lymphoidei axillares posteriores [TA alternative] and posterior axillary lymph nodes."]

59045 nodi lymphoidei brachiales
- 
- phr.["肱淋巴结"]
- phr.["brachial lymph nodes: isolated lymph nodes, varying in number and position, located along the brachial vessels between the humeral axillary and the supratrochlear lymph nodes."]

59046 nodi lymphoidei brachiocephalici
- 
- phr.["头臂淋巴结"]
- phr.["brachiocephalic lymph nodes: thoracic lymph nodes located in the superior mediastinum, anterior to the brachiocephalic veins, receiving drainage from the thymus, thyroid gland, and pericardium and uniting with parasternal nodes to form the bronchomediastinal trunk."]

59047 nodi lymphoidei bronchopulmonales
- 
- phr.["支气管肺淋巴结"]
- phr.["bronchopulmonary lymph nodes: lymph nodes embedded in the root of the lung, mainly at the hilum that drain into the tracheobronchial lymph nodes; called also hilar lymph nodes."]

59048 nodi lymphoidei cavales laterales
- 
- phr.["腔静脉外侧淋巴结"]
- phr.["lateral caval lymph nodes: a group of lymph nodes of the right lumbar group that are on the right side of the inferior vena cava."]

59049 nodi lymphoidei cervicales anteriores
- 
- phr.["颈前淋巴结"]
- phr.["anterior cervical lymph nodes: a group of lymph nodes ventral to the larynx and trachea, consisting of superficial vessels on the anterior jugular vein (nodi lymphoidei cervicales anteriores superficiales) and deep vessels (nodi lymphoidei cervicales anteriores profundi) on the middle cricothyroid ligament as well as ventral to the trachea. Called also nodi lymphoidei colli anteriores [TA alternative]."]

59050 nodi lymphoidei cervicales anteriores profundi
- 
- phr.["颈前深淋巴结"]
- phr.["deep anterior cervical lymph nodes: a group of numerous large lymph nodes that form a chain along the internal jugular vein, extending from the base of the skull to the root of the neck, situated near the pharynx, esophagus, and trachea; they receive lymph from both superficial and deep structures."]

59051 nodi lymphoidei cervicales anteriores superficiales
- 
- phr.["颈前浅淋巴结"]
- phr.["superficial anterior cervical lymph nodes: lymph nodes along the external jugular vein as it emerges from the parotid gland, being superficial to the sternocleidomastoid muscle; they receive afferent vessels from the auricle and parotid region. Called also nodi lymphoidei jugulares anteriores [TA alternative] and anterior jugular lymph nodes."]

59052 nodi lymphoidei cervicales laterales profundi inferiores
- 
- phr.["颈下侧深淋巴结"]
- phr.["inferior deep lateral cervical lymph nodes: a group of lymph nodes adjacent to the carotid sheath, partly deep to the sternocleidomastoid muscle and extending into the subclavian triangle. They receive lymph from the back of the scalp and neck, the tongue, the superficial pectoral region, and part of the arm and drain into the jugular trunk."]

59053 nodi lymphoidei cervicales laterales profundi superiores
- 
- phr.["颈上侧深淋巴结"]
- phr.["superior deep lateral cervical lymph nodes: a group of lymph nodes adjacent to the carotid sheath deep to the sternocleidomastoid muscle; they receive lymph from a number of structures of the head and neck and drain into the inferior deep cervical nodes or the jugular trunk."]

59054 nodi lymphoidei cervicales laterales superficiales
- 
- phr.["颈外侧浅淋巴结"]
- phr.["superficial lateral cervical lymph nodes: lymph nodes situated along the external jugular vein that send efferent vessels to the deep lateral cervical lymph nodes."]

59055 nodi lymphoidei coeliaci
- 
- phr.["腹腔淋巴结"]
- phr.["celiac lymph nodes: a few nodes along the celiac trunk, which receive lymph from the stomach, spleen, duodenum, liver, and pancreas."]

59056 nodi lymphoidei colici dextri/medii/sinistri
- 
- phr.["右/中/左结肠淋巴结"]
- phr.["colic lymph nodes: a subgroup of the mesocolic lymph nodes, situated along the right, middle, and left colic arteries."]

59057 nodi lymphoidei cubitales
- 
- phr.["肘淋巴结"]
- phr.["cubital lymph nodes: lymph nodes occurring in the elbow region, mainly comprising the supratrochlear lymph nodes (nodi lymphoidei supratrochleares) but also including scattered isolated nodes, as in the cubital fossa near the bifurcation of the brachial artery; called also epitrochlear lymph nodes."]

59058 nodi lymphoidei deltopectorales
- 
- phr.["胸三角淋巴结"]
- phr.["deltopectoral lymph nodes: one or two lymph nodes in the groove between the pectoralis major and deltoid muscles, just inferior to the clavicle, which drain into the apical lymph nodes. Called also nodi lymphoidei infraclaviculares [TA alternative] and infraclavicular nodes."]

59059 nodi lymphoidei epigastrici inferiores
- 
- phr.["腹壁下淋巴结，上腹下淋巴结"]
- phr.["inferior epigastric lymph nodes: lymph nodes along the deep epigastric vessels, receiving lymph from the lower abdominal wall."]

59060 nodi lymphoidei faciales
- 
- phr.["面淋巴结"]
- phr.["facial lymph nodes: lymph nodes situated along the course of the facial artery and vein, which receive afferent vessels draining the eyelids, conjunctiva, nose, cheeks, lips, and gums, and send efferent vessels to the submandibular nodes."]

59061 nodi lymphoidei gastrici dextri/sinistri
- 
- phr.["胃右/左淋巴结"]
- phr.["gastric lymph nodes: a few nodes along the right and left gastric arteries that receive lymph from the stomach, spleen, duodenum, liver, and pancreas."]

59062 nodi lymphoidei gastroomentales dextri/sinistri
- 
- phr.["胃网膜右/左淋巴结"]
- phr.["gastro-omental lymph nodes: lymph nodes situated in the greater omentum along the pyloric half of the greater curvature of the stomach in association with the right and left gastroepiploic arteries; called also gastroepiploic lymph nodes."]

59063 nodi lymphoidei gluteales inferiores
- 
- phr.["臀下淋巴结"]
- phr.["inferior gluteal lymph nodes: the internal iliac lymph nodes situated along the inferior gluteal artery."]

59064 nodi lymphoidei gluteales superiores
- 
- phr.["臀上淋巴结"]
- phr.["superior gluteal lymph nodes: the internal iliac lymph nodes situated along the superior gluteal artery."]

59065 nodi lymphoidei hepatici
- 
- phr.["肝淋巴结"]
- phr.["hepatic lymph nodes: a variable number of lymph nodes situated along the proper and common hepatic arteries and the bile ducts that receive lymph from the stomach, spleen, duodenum, liver, and pancreas; two are fairly common: the cystic node and the foraminal node."]

59066 nodi lymphoidei ileocolici
- 
- phr.["回结肠淋巴结"]
- phr.["ileocolic lymph nodes: nodes in the region of the ileocolic junction, draining adjacent structures and draining into the superior mesenteric lymph node."]

59067 nodi lymphoidei iliaci communes
- 
- phr.["髂总淋巴结"]
- phr.["common iliac lymph nodes: the four to six lymph nodes grouped at the sides and dorsal to the common iliac vessels, comprising five groups: medial, intermediate, lateral, subaortic, and promontory; they receive afferent vessels from the lateral and internal iliac lymph nodes and send efferent vessels to the lateral aortic lymph nodes."]

59068 nodi lymphoidei iliaci communes intermedii
- 
- phr.["髂总中间淋巴结"]
- phr.["intermediate common iliac lymph nodes: the common iliac lymph nodes situated between the common iliac vessels."]

59069 nodi lymphoidei iliaci communes laterales
- 
- phr.["髂总外侧淋巴结"]
- phr.["lateral common iliac lymph nodes: the common iliac lymph nodes situated on the lateral aspect of the common iliac vessels."]

59070 nodi lymphoidei iliaci communes mediales
- 
- phr.["髂总内侧淋巴结"]
- phr.["medial common iliac lymph nodes: the common iliac lymph nodes situated on the medial aspect of the common iliac vessels."]

59071 nodi lymphoidei iliaci externi
- 
- phr.["髂外淋巴结"]
- phr.["external iliac lymph nodes: the eight to ten nodes along the external iliac vessels, comprising five groups: medial, intermediate, lateral, interiliac, and obturator lymph nodes; they receive afferent vessels from the inguinal lymph nodes, deep part of the abdominal wall below the umbilicus, and some pelvic viscera and send efferent vessels to the common iliac lymph nodes."]

59072 nodi lymphoidei iliaci externi intermedii
- 
- phr.["髂外中间淋巴结"]
- phr.["intermediate external iliac lymph nodes: the external iliac lymph nodes situated between the external iliac vessels."]

59073 nodi lymphoidei iliaci externi laterales
- 
- phr.["髂外外侧淋巴结"]
- phr.["lateral external iliac lymph nodes: the external iliac lymph nodes situated on the lateral aspect of the external iliac vessels."]

59074 nodi lymphoidei iliaci externi mediales
- 
- phr.["髂外内侧淋巴结"]
- phr.["medial external iliac lymph nodes: the external iliac lymph nodes situated on the medial aspect of the external iliac vessels."]

59075 nodi lymphoidei iliaci interni
- 
- phr.["髂内淋巴结"]
- phr.["internal iliac lymph nodes: nodes grouped around the origins of the branches of the internal iliac vessels, comprising two groups: superior and inferior gluteal and sacral lymph nodes; they receive afferent vessels from the pelvic viscera, perineum, and buttocks and send efferent vessels to the common iliac lymph nodes."]

59076 nodi lymphoidei infraauriculares
- 
- phr.["耳下淋巴结"]
- phr.["infra-auricular lymph nodes: deep parotid lymph nodes situated below the ear."]

59077 nodi lymphoidei infraclaviculares
- 
- phr.["锁骨下淋巴结"]
- phr.["TA alternative for nodi lymphoidei deltopectorales."]

59078 nodi lymphoidei infrahyoidei
- 
- phr.["舌骨下淋巴结"]
- phr.["infrahyoid lymph nodes: lymph nodes lying beneath the deep cervical fascia anterior to the thyrohyoid membrane that receive lymph from the anterior cervical nodes and epiglottic region and drain into the deep cervical nodes."]

59079 nodi lymphoidei inguinales
- 
- phr.["腹股沟淋巴结"]
- phr.["inguinal lymph nodes: lymph nodes situated along the course of the inguinal ligament; they are subdivided into superficial (nodi lymphoidei inguinales superficiales) and deep (nodi lymphoidei inguinales profundi) groups of nodes."]

59080 nodi lymphoidei inguinales profundi
- 
- phr.["腹股沟深淋巴结"]
- phr.["deep inguinal lymph nodes: one to three nodes deep to the fascia lata along the femoral vein; they receive lymph from the deep structures of the lower limb and from the penis or clitoris, and superficial inguinal lymph nodes and drain into the external iliac lymph nodes."]

59081 nodi lymphoidei inguinales superficiales
- 
- phr.["腹股沟浅淋巴结"]
- phr.["superficial inguinal lymph nodes: lymph nodes situated in the subcutaneous tissue inferior to the inguinal ligament on either side of the proximal part of the greater saphenous vein, comprising two upper (supermedial and superolateral) groups and one lower (inferior) group; they drain the skin of the lower abdominal wall, penis, scrotum or labia majora, perineum, and buttocks."]

59082 nodi lymphoidei inguinales superficiales inferiores
- 
- phr.["腹股沟下浅淋巴结"]
- phr.["inferior superficial inguinal lymph nodes: the lower superficial inguinal lymph nodes situated below the opening of the saphenous vein."]

59083 nodi lymphoidei inguinales superficiales superomediales
- 
- phr.["腹股上内侧沟浅淋巴结"]
- phr.["superomedial superficial inguinal lymph nodes: the upper superficial inguinal lymph nodes situated on the medial side of the opening of the saphenous vein."]

59084 nodi lymphoidei intercostales
- 
- phr.["肋间淋巴结"]
- phr.["intercostal lymph nodes: lymph nodes in the back of the thorax, along the intercostal vessels."]

59085 nodi lymphoidei interiliaci
- 
- phr.["髂间淋巴结"]
- phr.["interiliac lymph nodes: the external iliac lymph nodes situated between the external and internal iliac vessels and the obturator artery."]

59086 nodi lymphoidei interpectorales
- 
- phr.["胸间淋巴结"]
- phr.["interpectoral lymph nodes: small inconstant lymph nodes that may occur between the pectoralis major and minor muscles, draining into the axillary nodes."]

59087 nodi lymphoidei intrapulmonales
- 
- phr.["肺内淋巴结"]
- phr.["intrapulmonary lymph nodes: nodes located along the larger bronchi within the lung substance, through which lymph from the lung drains. Called also pulmonary lymph nodes."]

59088 nodi lymphoidei juxtaoesophageales
- 
- phr.["近食管淋巴结"]
- phr.["juxtaesophageal lymph nodes: posterior mediastinal lymph nodes situated on both sides of the esophagus."]

59089 nodi lymphoidei linguales
- 
- phr.["舌淋巴结"]
- phr.["small lymph nodes situated on the hyoglossus, receiving afferent vessels from the tongue and draining into the superior deep cervical lymph nodes."]

59090 nodi lymphoidei lumbales dextri
- 
- phr.["腰右淋巴结"]
- phr.["right lumbar lymph nodes: the chain of lumbar lymph nodes situated partly in front of the vena cava and partly behind it on the psoas major muscle, comprising three groups: lateral caval, precaval, and retrocaval (postcaval) lymph nodes."]

59091 nodi lymphoidei lumbales intermedii
- 
- phr.["腰中淋巴结"]
- phr.["intermediate lumbar lymph nodes: the chain of lumbar lymph nodes that lie in the median plane, between the left and right lumbar lymph nodes."]

59092 nodi lymphoidei lumbales sinistri
- 
- phr.["腰左淋巴结"]
- phr.["left lumbar lymph nodes: the chain of lumbar lymph nodes situated at the side of the abdominal aorta on the psoas major muscle, comprising three groups: right and left lateral aortic, preaortic, and retroaortic (postaortic) lymph nodes."]

59093 nodi lymphoidei mastoidei
- 
- phr.["乳突淋巴结"]
- phr.["mastoid lymph nodes: lymph nodes, two or three on each side, that are superficial to the mastoid attachment of the sternocleidomastoid muscle and deep to the posterior auricular muscle; they drain the nasal fossae and paranasal sinuses, hard and soft palate, middle ear, and nasopharynx and oropharynx. Called also retroauricular lymph nodes."]

59094 nodi lymphoidei membri inferioris
- 
- phr.["下肢淋巴结"]
- phr.["lymph nodes of lower limb: the groups of lymph nodes occurring in and draining the lower limb; most occur in the inguinal region, subdivided into superficial and deep groups, and in the popliteal fossa."]

59095 nodi lymphoidei membri superioris
- 
- phr.["上肢淋巴结"]
- phr.["lymph nodes of upper limb: the lymph nodes of the hand, forearm, arm, and axilla; the former three groups draining into those of the axilla. They are subdivided into superficial (nodi lymphoidei superficiales membri superioris) and deep nodes (nodi lymphoidei profundi membri superioris)."]

59096 nodi lymphoidei mesenterici inferiores
- 
- phr.["肠系膜下淋巴结"]
- phr.["inferior mesenteric lymph nodes: nodes situated along the inferior mesenteric vessels and receiving lymph from the adjacent region; they comprise two groups: the sigmoid and superior rectal lymph nodes."]

59097 nodi lymphoidei mesenterici superiores
- 
- phr.["肠系膜上淋巴结"]
- phr.["superior mesenteric lymph nodes: mesenteric lymph nodes situated along the superior mesenteric artery and draining various other groups of nodes in the region."]

59098 nodi lymphoidei mesenterici superiores centrales
- 
- phr.["肠系膜上中间淋巴结"]
- phr.["central superior mesenteric lymph nodes: the middle group of superior mesenteric nodes, situated along the ileal and jejunal branches of the superior mesenteric artery."]

59099 nodi lymphoidei mesocolici
- 
- phr.["结肠系膜淋巴结"]
- phr.["mesocolic lymph nodes: lymph nodes situated in the mesocolon, comprising two groups: paracolic and colic (right, middle, and left colic); they drain through the superior mesenteric lymph nodes."]

59100 nodi lymphoidei obturatorii
- 
- phr.["闭孔淋巴结"]
- phr.["obturator lymph nodes: the external iliac lymph nodes situated in the obturator canal."]

59101 nodi lymphoidei occipitales
- 
- phr.["枕淋巴结"]
- phr.["occipital lymph nodes: several small nodes near the occipital insertion of the semispinalis capitis muscle."]

59102 nodi lymphoidei pancreatici
- 
- phr.["胰淋巴结"]
- phr.["pancreatic lymph nodes: nodes found along the pancreatic arteries that drain lymph from the pancreas to the pancreaticosplenic lymph nodes."]

59103 nodi lymphoidei pancreatici inferiores
- 
- phr.["胰下淋巴结"]
- phr.["inferior pancreatic lymph nodes: lymph nodes associated with the inferior pancreatic artery."]

59104 nodi lymphoidei pancreatici superiores
- 
- phr.["胰上淋巴结"]
- phr.["superior pancreatic lymph nodes: lymph nodes associated with the superior pancreatic artery."]

59105 nodi lymphoidei pancreaticoduodenales
- 
- phr.["胰十二指肠淋巴结"]
- phr.["pancreaticoduodenal lymph nodes: small lymph nodes located between the head of the pancreas and the duodenum, subdivided into superior and inferior groups."]

59106 nodi lymphoidei pancreaticoduodenales inferiores
- 
- phr.["胰十二指肠下淋巴结"]
- phr.["inferior pancreaticoduodenal lymph nodes: lymph nodes situated along the inferior pancreaticoduodenal artery."]

59107 nodi lymphoidei pancreaticoduodenales superiores
- 
- phr.["胰十二指肠上淋巴结"]
- phr.["superior pancreaticoduodenal lymph nodes: lymph nodes situated along the superior pancreaticoduodenal artery."]

59108 nodi lymphoidei paracolici
- 
- phr.["结肠旁淋巴结"]
- phr.["paracolic lymph nodes: a subgroup of the mesocolic lymph nodes, situated along the medial borders of the ascending and descending colon and along the mesenteric borders of the transverse and sigmoid colon."]

59109 nodi lymphoidei paramammarii
- 
- phr.["乳旁淋巴结"]
- phr.["paramammary lymph nodes: lymph nodes on the lateral mammary gland that drain into the axillary lymph nodes."]

59110 nodi lymphoidei pararectales
- 
- phr.["直肠旁淋巴结"]
- phr.["pararectal lymph nodes: lymph nodes situated around the rectum, embedded in its muscular coat; they drain into the inferior mesenteric, sacral, internal iliac, common iliac, and superficial inguinal nodes. Called also nodi lymphoidei anorectales [TA alternative] and anorectal lymph nodes."]

59111 nodi lymphoidei parasternales
- 
- phr.["胸骨旁淋巴结"]
- phr.["parasternal lymph nodes: nodes located along the course of the internal thoracic artery, which drain the mammary gland, abdominal wall, and diaphragm."]

59112 nodi lymphoidei paratracheales
- 
- phr.["气管旁淋巴结"]
- phr.["paratracheal lymph nodes: lymph nodes on either side of the esophagus and trachea, extending upward into the neck, which receive lymph from the esophagus, trachea, and tracheobronchial lymph nodes."]

59113 nodi lymphoidei parauterini
- 
- phr.["子宫旁淋巴结"]
- phr.["parauterine lymph nodes: lymph nodes situated around the uterus, consisting of superficial (beneath the peritoneum) and deep (in the substance of the uterine wall) nodes: they drain into the lumbar, external and internal iliac, sacral, and superficial inguinal lymph nodes."]

59114 nodi lymphoidei paravaginales
- 
- phr.["阴道旁淋巴结"]
- phr.["paravaginal lymph nodes: lymph nodes situated around the vagina; they drain into the external and internal iliac, common iliac, and superficial inguinal lymph nodes."]

59115 nodi lymphoidei paravesicales
- 
- phr.["膀胱旁淋巴结"]
- phr.["paravesical lymph nodes: lymph nodes situated around the urinary bladder, comprising three groups: prevesical, postvesical, and lateral vesical lymph nodes; they drain into the external and internal iliac lymph nodes and, in association with some lymph nodes from the prostate, into the sacral and common iliac lymph nodes."]

59116 nodi lymphoidei parietales
- 
- phr.["壁淋巴结"]
- phr.["parietal lymph nodes: lymph nodes that receive lymph from the walls of a body cavity; see nodi lymphoidei abdominis parietales and nodi lymphoidei pelvis parietales. Cf. nodi lymphoidei viscerales."]

59117 nodi lymphoidei parotidei profundi
- 
- phr.["腮腺深淋巴结"]
- phr.["deep parotid lymph nodes: lymph nodes on the lateral wall of the pharynx lying deep to or embedded in the deep substance of the parotid gland, through which lymph drains from the external acoustic meatus, auditory tube, tympanum, soft palate, and posterior nasal cavity."]

59118 nodi lymphoidei parotidei superficiales
- 
- phr.["腮腺浅淋巴结"]
- phr.["superficial parotid lymph nodes: lymph nodes lying in the subcutaneous tissue of the parotid gland directly in front of the tragus."]

59119 nodi lymphoidei pelvis parietales
- 
- phr.["骨盆壁淋巴结"]
- phr.["parietal pelvic lymph nodes: the lymph nodes that drain the wall of the pelvis, including the common iliac, external iliac, and internal iliac lymph nodes."]

59120 nodi lymphoidei pelvis viscerales
- 
- phr.["盆腔脏器淋巴结"]
- phr.["visceral pelvic lymph nodes: the lymph nodes that drain the pelvic viscera, including the paravesicular, parauterine, paravaginal, and pararectal lymph nodes."]

59121 nodi lymphoidei phrenici inferiores
- 
- phr.["膈下淋巴结"]
- phr.["inferior diaphragmatic lymph nodes: parietal lymph nodes accompanying the inferior vessels of the diaphragm; called also inferior phrenic lymph nodes."]

59122 nodi lymphoidei phrenici superiores
- 
- phr.["膈上淋巴结"]
- phr.["superior diaphragmatic lymph nodes: several nodes on the thoracic surface of the diaphragm, receiving lymph from the intercostal spaces, pericardium, diaphragm, and liver; called also superior phrenic lymph nodes."]

59123 nodi lymphoidei poplitei
- 
- phr.["腘淋巴结"]
- phr.["popliteal lymph nodes: lymph nodes embedded in the fat of the popliteal fossa, comprising superficial and deep groups; their efferent vessels accompany the femoral vessels to the deep inguinal lymph nodes."]

59124 nodi lymphoidei poplitei profundi
- 
- phr.["腘深淋巴结"]
- phr.["deep popliteal lymph nodes: the popliteal lymph nodes situated at the sides of the popliteal vessels."]

59125 nodi lymphoidei poplitei superficiales
- 
- phr.["腘浅淋巴结"]
- phr.["superficial popliteal lymph nodes: the popliteal lymph nodes situated at the termination of the small saphenous vein."]

59126 nodi lymphoidei postaortici
- 
- phr.["主动脉后淋巴结"]
- phr.["TA alternative for nodi lymphoidei retroaortici."]

59127 nodi lymphoidei postcavales
- 
- phr.["腔静脉后淋巴结"]
- phr.["TA alternative for nodi lymphoidei retrocavales."]

59128 nodi lymphoidei postvesicales
- 
- phr.["膀胱后淋巴结"]
- phr.["TA alternative for nodi lymphoidei retrovesicales."]

59129 nodi lymphoidei precaecales
- 
- phr.["盲肠前淋巴结"]
- phr.["prececal lymph nodes: lymph nodes situated in front of the cecum that drain into the anterior ileocolic lymph nodes."]

59130 nodi lymphoidei precavales
- 
- phr.["腔静脉前淋巴结"]
- phr.["precaval lymph nodes: a group of lymph nodes of the right lumbar group that is in front of the inferior vena cava."]

59131 nodi lymphoidei prelaryngei
- 
- phr.["喉前淋巴结"]
- phr.["prelaryngeal lymph nodes: deep anterior cervical lymph nodes situated in front of the larynx that help drain the thyroid gland."]

59132 nodi lymphoidei pretracheales
- 
- phr.["气管前淋巴结"]
- phr.["pretracheal lymph nodes: deep anterior cervical lymph nodes situated in front of the trachea near the inferior thyroid veins."]

59133 nodi lymphoidei prevertebrales
- 
- phr.["椎前淋巴结"]
- phr.["prevertebral lymph nodes: lymph nodes situated in back of the thoracic aorta."]

59134 nodi lymphoidei prevesicales
- 
- phr.["膀胱前淋巴结"]
- phr.["prevesical lymph nodes: the paravesical lymph nodes situated in front of the urinary bladder."]

59135 nodi lymphoidei profundi membri superioris
- 
- phr.["上肢深淋巴结"]
- phr.["deep lymph nodes of upper limb: the lymph nodes situated internal to the deep fascia of the upper limb, most of which are grouped in the axilla; they accompany the radial, ulnar, interosseous, and brachial arteries and end in the brachial axillary lymph nodes."]

59136 nodi lymphoidei promontorii
- 
- phr.["骶岬淋巴结"]
- phr.["promontorial lymph nodes: the common iliac lymph nodes situated in front of the sacral promontory."]

59137 nodi lymphoidei pylorici
- 
- phr.["幽门淋巴结"]
- phr.["pyloric lymph nodes: lymph nodes found anterior to the head of the pancreas, receiving lymph from the pyloric part of the stomach. They are subdivided into three groups: suprapyloric, subpyloric, and retropyloric nodes."]

59138 nodi lymphoidei rectales superiores
- 
- phr.["直肠上淋巴结"]
- phr.["superior rectal lymph nodes: a group of lymph nodes of the inferior mesenteric group, situated along the superior rectal artery."]

59139 nodi lymphoidei retroaortici
- 
- phr.["主动脉后淋巴结"]
- phr.["retroaortic lymph nodes: a group of lymph nodes of the left lumbar group, situated behind the aorta and formed by peripheral nodes of the right and left lateral aortic lymph nodes. Called also postaortic lymph nodes and nodi lymphoidei postaortici [TA alternative]."]

59140 nodi lymphoidei retrocaecales
- 
- phr.["盲肠后淋巴结"]
- phr.["retrocecal lymph nodes: lymph nodes situated in back of the cecum that drain into the posterior ileocecal lymph nodes."]

59141 nodi lymphoidei retrocavales
- 
- phr.["腔静脉后淋巴结"]
- phr.["retrocaval lymph nodes: a group of lymph nodes of the right lumbar group situated behind the inferior vena cava. Called also postcaval lymph nodes and nodi lymphoidei postcavales [TA alternative]."]

59142 nodi lymphoidei retropharyngeales
- 
- phr.["咽后淋巴结"]
- phr.["retropharyngeal lymph nodes: deep cervical lymph nodes, one median and two lateral groups, situated behind the upper part of the pharynx, especially concerned with drainage of the nasal fossae, paranasal sinuses, hard and soft palates, middle ear, nasopharynx, and oropharynx."]

59143 nodi lymphoidei retropylorici
- 
- phr.["幽门后淋巴结"]
- phr.["retropyloric lymph nodes: pyloric lymph nodes situated posterior to the pylorus."]

59144 nodi lymphoidei retrovesicales
- 
- phr.["膀胱后淋巴结"]
- phr.["postvesical lymph nodes: the paravesical lymph nodes situated in back of the urinary bladder. Called also nodi lymphoidei postvesicales [TA alternative]."]

59145 nodi lymphoidei sacrales
- 
- phr.["骶淋巴结"]
- phr.["sacral lymph nodes: the internal iliac lymph nodes situated along the lateral and median sacral vessels; they receive lymph from the rectum and posterior pelvic wall."]

59146 nodi lymphoidei sigmoidei
- 
- phr.["乙状（结肠）淋巴结"]
- phr.["sigmoid lymph nodes: a group of lymph nodes of the inferior mesenteric group, situated along the sigmoid arteries."]

59147 nodi lymphoidei splenici
- 
- phr.["脾淋巴结"]
- phr.["splenic lymph nodes: lymph nodes in the capsule and larger trabeculae of the spleen that drain into adjacent lymph nodes; called also nodi lymphoidei lienales [TA alternative]."]

59148 nodi lymphoidei subaortici
- 
- phr.["主动脉淋巴结"]
- phr.["subaortic lymph nodes: the common iliac lymph nodes situated below the bifurcation of the aorta."]

59149 nodi lymphoidei submandibulares
- 
- phr.["下颌下淋巴结"]
- phr.["submandibular lymph nodes: the three to six nodes alongside the submandibular gland, through which lymph drains from the adjacent skin and mucous membrane."]

59150 nodi lymphoidei submentales
- 
- phr.["颌下淋巴结"]
- phr.["submental lymph nodes: nodes under the chin into which the lymph from some of the superficial tissues of the head and neck is drained."]

59151 nodi lymphoidei subpylorici
- 
- phr.["幽门下淋巴结"]
- phr.["subpyloric lymph nodes: pyloric lymph nodes located inferior to the pylorus."]

59152 nodi lymphoidei supraclaviculares
- 
- phr.["锁骨上淋巴结"]
- phr.["supraclavicular lymph nodes: the deep lateral cervical lymph nodes situated inferior to the omohyoid muscle, extending into the omoclavicular portion of the posterior triangle of the neck."]

59153 nodi lymphoidei supratrochleares
- 
- phr.["滑车上淋巴结"]
- phr.["supratrochlear lymph nodes: one or two lymph nodes superficial to the deep fascia proximal to the medial epicondyle and medial to the basilic vein and draining into the deep lymph vessels."]

59154 nodi lymphoidei thyroidei
- 
- phr.["甲状腺淋巴结"]
- phr.["thyroid lymph nodes: deep anterior cervical lymph nodes situated around the thyroid gland."]

59155 nodi lymphoidei tracheobronchiales inferiores
- 
- phr.["气管支气管下淋巴结"]
- phr.["inferior tracheobronchial lymph nodes: nodes in the angle of the bifurcation of the trachea, receiving lymph from adjacent structures."]

59156 nodi lymphoidei tracheobronchiales superiores
- 
- phr.["气管支气管上淋巴结"]
- phr.["superior tracheobronchial lymph nodes: nodes between the trachea and the bronchus on either side, receiving lymph from adjacent structures."]

59157 nodi lymphoidei viscerales
- 
- phr.["内脏淋巴结"]
- phr.["visceral lymph nodes: lymph nodes that receive lymph from the viscera in a body cavity; see nodi lymphoidei abdominis viscerales and nodi lymphoidei pelvis viscerales. Cf. nodi lymphoidei parietales."]

59158 nodose
- /ˈnəʊdəʊs/
- n.["有结的，结节状的"]
- n.["having nodes or projections."]

59159 nodose ganglion
- 
- phr.["结状神经节"]
- phr.["g. inferius nervi vagi."]

59160 nodosity
- /nəʊˈdɒsətɪ/
- n.["结节性，结节状；结节"]
- n.["the quality or condition of having nodes or nodules.","node."]

59161 nodoventricular
- /ˌnəʊdəʊvenˈtrɪkjʊlə/
- adj.["室结的"]
- adj.["connecting the atrioventricular node to the ventricle."]

59162 nodoventricular fibers
- 
- phr.["结室纤维"]
- phr.["Mahaim fibers that connect the atrioventricular node directly to the ventricle."]

59163 nodular
- /ˈnɒdjʊlə/
- adj.["小结的，结的；小结状的，结节性的"]
- adj.["like a nodule or node.","marked with nodules."]

59164 nodular adrenal hyperplasia
- 
- phr.["结节性肾上腺增生"]
- phr.["uneven adrenocortical hyperplasia with small nests or masses of nodules resembling adenomas between the columns of cortical cells. Called also macronodular adrenal or macronodular adrenocortical h."]

59165 nodular amyloidosis
- 
- phr.["结节性淀粉样变性"]
- phr.["localized amyloidosis consisting of single or multiple, amyloid-containing nodular masses beneath the mucous membranes or skin; the most common mucous membrane sites are in the lung, urinary bladder, larynx, tongue, and conjunctiva, and the most common skin sites are on the limbs, trunk, genitals, and face."]

59166 nodular basal cell carcinoma
- 
- phr.["结节性基底细胞癌"]
- phr.["the most common type of basal cell carcinoma, usually seen on the face as one or several small, waxy, translucent nodules with rolled edges around a central depression; these may be ulcerated, crusted, or bleeding and may spread laterally or invade deeply. Two subtypes are micronodular and noduloulcerative basal cell carcinoma."]

59167 nodular circumscribed lipomatosis
- 
- phr.["结节性局限性脂肪过多症"]
- phr.["formation of multiple circumscribed or encapsulated lipomas in subcutaneous tissue. When these are distributed symmetrically around the neck, the condition is called multiple symmetric lipomatosis or Madelung disease. A variety in which the lipomas press against nerves and become painful is called adiposis dolorosa."]

59168 nodular elastoidosis
- 
- phr.["结节性弹性样组织变性"]
- phr.["Favre-Racouchot syndrome."]

59169 nodular elastosis
- 
- phr.["结节性弹性组织变性"]
- phr.["Favre-Racouchot syndrome."]

59170 nodular episcleritis
- 
- phr.["结节性巩膜表层炎，结节性巩膜外层炎"]
- phr.["episcleritis characterized by a tender, localized, injected nodule within the inflamed area; it can be moved over the sclera. Cf. nodular scleritis."]

59171 nodular fasciitis
- 
- phr.["结节性筋膜炎"]
- phr.["a benign reactive proliferation of fibroblasts occurring as a rapidly growing nodular mass in the subcutaneous or deep somatic tissues, particularly of the upper limbs, usually in young adults or adults; histologically it closely resembles sarcoma. The term is sometimes used broadly to encompass variant forms such as proliferative fasciitis. Called also pseudosarcomatous f."]

59172 nodular fibromyositis
- 
- phr.["结节性纤维肌炎"]
- phr.["a disease marked by inflammation and the formation of nodules in the muscles."]

59173 nodular goiter
- 
- phr.["结节性甲状腺肿"]
- phr.["multinodular g."]

59174 nodular hidradenoma
- 
- phr.["结节性汗腺腺瘤"]
- phr.["clear cell h."]

59175 nodular hyperplasia of the liver

59215 nodus atrioventricularis

- phr.["房室结"]
- phr.["atrioventricular node: a small area of specialized cardiac muscle cells and fibers that receives the cardiac impulses from the sinoatrial node and passes them on toward the ventricles, introducing a delay in impulse conduction. It is located in the right atrium between the tricuspid valve and the orifice of the coronary sinus, is composed of a meshwork of (Purkinje) fibers continuous with the atrial muscle fibers and the bundle of His, and is supplied by a branch of the right coronary artery. The node is sometimes subdivided on the basis of electrophysiology into atrionodal (AN), nodal (N), and nodal-His (NH) regions. See illustration at nodus sinuatrialis."]

59452 normal distribution
- 
- phr.["常态分配，正态分布，高斯分布"]
- phr.["a symmetric, bell-shaped probability distribution having the density function where x is the abscissa, f(x) is the ordinate, e is the base of natural logarithms (2.718), μ is the mean, and σ is the standard deviation. The normal distribution is entirely dependent on μ and σ; it is symmetric about the mean, with both tails extending to infinity; and the mean, the median, and the mode are identical. Roughly speaking, the normal distribution characterizes a random variable that is the sum of a large number of independent random effects. More precisely, it is typically the limiting distribution of a standardized sum of an infinite series of random variables with finite variance, each making a negligible contribution to the total variance (a fact known as the central limit theorem, q.v.). For this reason it is common statistical practice to assume that random sampling distributions of statistical measures are “approximately normal” and apply tests (e.g., t-test, analysis of variance) based on the normal distribution. See illustration. Called also gaussian d.Normal distribution. The approximate percentage of the area (or frequency) lying under the curve between standard deviations is indicated."]

The nucleases are classified in subgroups on the basis of their substrate specificity; they may be endonucleases or exonucleases, each of which may be specific for the ribonucleic acids (ribonucleases) or deoxyribonucleic acids (deoxyribonucleases)."]

59662 nucleated
- /ˈnjʊklɪeɪtɪd/

- phr.["动眼神经副核"]

59667 nuclei basales
- 
- phr.["基底核，基底节"]

Although various subcortical nuclei have traditionally been considered to be part of the basal nuclei, in official anatomical terminology the term is now restricted to the corpus striatum (nucleus caudatus and nucleus lentiformis). Called also basal ganglia."]

59668 nuclei campi perizonalis

- phr.["坎珀区周核"]

59669 nuclei cerebelli
- 
- phr.["小脑核"]

59670 nuclei cochleares
- 
- phr.["蜗神经核"]
- phr.["cochlear nuclei: the two nuclei, anterior and posterior, partly encircling the restiform body at the junction of the medulla oblongata and the pons, in which the fibers of the cochlear part of the vestibulocochlear nerve terminate; called also nuclei of cochlear nerve."]

59671 nuclei corporis trapezoidei
- 
- phr.["斜方体核"]
- phr.["nuclei of trapezoid body: groups of nerve cell bodies of the superior olivary complex, lying within the fibers of the trapezoid body. The posterior receive cochlear fibers and contribute to the formation of the trapezoid body and lateral lemniscus while the anterior are mingled with the fibers of the trapezoid body and contribute to the lateral lemniscus."]

59672 nuclei dorsales thalami

- phr.["丘脑背侧核"]

59673 nuclei mediales thalami

- phr.["内侧核群，丘脑内侧核"]

59674 nuclei mediani thalami
- 
- phr.["中线核群，丘脑正中核"]

59675 nuclei of cochlear nerve
- 
- phr.["蜗神经核"]

59676 nuclei of perizonal field
- 
- phr.["周围区核"]
- phr.["nuclei campi perizonalis."]

59677 nuclei of pons
- 
- phr.["脑桥核"]
- phr.["nuclei pontis."]

59678 nuclei of thalamus
- 
- phr.["丘脑束旁核"]

Groups are the nuclei anteriores thalami, nuclei dorsales thalami, nuclei mediales thalami, nuclei mediani thalami, nuclei intralaminares thalami, nuclei posteriores thalami, and nuclei ventrales thalami. The nucleus reticularis thalami and nucleus subthalamicus are also thalamic nuclei."]

59679 nuclei of trapezoid body
- 
- phr.["斜方体核"]
- phr.["nuclei corporis trapezoidei."]

See n. mesencephalicus nervi trigemini, n. motorius nervi trigemini, n. principalis nervi trigemini, and n. spinalis nervi trigemini."]

59681 nuclei of vagus nerve

59682 nuclei parabrachiales
-

59683 nuclei parasympathici sacrales
- 
- phr.["副交感神经骶核"]
- phr.["sacral parasympathetic nuclei: a group of nerve cells in the second through the fourth sacral segments of the spinal cord, located lateral to the central canal and central gelatinous substance, between the bases of the anterior and posterior gray columns; the cells are the source of the pelvic or sacral outflow of parasympathetic preganglionic fibers."]

59684 nuclei periolivares
- 
- phr.["上橄榄核"]

59685 nuclei pontis

59686 nuclei posteriores thalami
- 
- phr.["丘脑后核"]

59687 nuclei pulvinares thalami

- phr.["丘脑垫状隆起核"]

59688 nuclei reticulares

- phr.["网状核"]

The term also encompasses several other nuclei that are not in any of the three columns, e.g., the nucleus reticularis thalami."]

59689 nuclei tractus solitarii
- 
- phr.["孤束核"]

The nuclei surround the tractus solitarius and their caudal ends join with the caudal ends of the corresponding nuclei of the opposite side. Called also solitary nuclei."]

59690 nuclei ventrales laterales thalami
- 
- phr.["丘脑腹外侧核"]

59691 nuclei ventrales mediales thalami
- 
- phr.["丘脑腹内侧核"]

59692 nuclei ventrales thalami
- 
- phr.["腹侧核群，丘脑腹侧核"]
- phr.["ventral nuclei of thalamus: a large group of nuclei lying between the internal medullary lamina and the internal capsule; it includes ventral anterior, ventral intermediate, ventral lateral, ventral medial, ventrobasal and other nuclei, which relay impulses to various specific areas of the cerebral cortex."]

59693 nuclei ventrobasales thalami
- 
- phr.["丘脑腹底核"]

Called also ventral posterior nuclei of thalamus."]

59694 nuclei vestibulares
- 
- phr.["前庭核，前庭神经核"]
- phr.["vestibular nuclei: the four cellular masses in the lateral floor of the fourth ventricle: the superior, lateral, medial, and inferior vestibular nuclei, in which the short ascending and longer descending branches of the vestibular nerve terminate and in which cerebellar projections are received. The nuclei give rise to widely dispersed projections to motor nuclei in the brainstem and cervical cord via the medial longitudinal fasciculi from all the vestibular nuclei to the cerebellum (chiefly from the inferior and medial nuclei), and to motor cells throughout the spinal cord (from the lateral nucleus). Additional connections of the nuclei provide for conscious perception of, and autonomic reactions to, labyrinthine stimulation. Called also acoustic nuclei and nuclei of acoustic nerve."]

- phr.["see under N."]

59696 nucleic acid amplification technique

59701 nucleocytoplasmic
- /ˌnju:klɪəʊˌsaɪtəʊˈplæzmɪk/

59705 nucleohistone

59706 nucleoid

59711 nucleoloid

59713 nucleolus

Multiple nucleoli occur in some cells.Prominent nucleoli (arrows) in the eccentric nuclei of ganglion cells."]

59720 nucleophile

59730 nucleoside-diphosphate kinase
- /ˈnju:klɪəsaɪd daɪˈfɒsfeɪt ˈkaɪneɪs/

59731 nucleoside-phosphate kinase
- /ˈnjʊklɪəsaɪd ˈfɒsfeɪt ˈkaɪneɪs/

The reaction is part of the mechanism that regenerates high energy nucleotides for metabolic processes and conserves the purine-pyrimidine pool. 59734 nucleosome
- /ˈnju:klɪəˌsəʊm/
- n.["核小体"]

It comprises a segment of approximately 146 base pairs of DNA wrapped twice around an octamer core of two each of the histones H2A, H2B, H3, and H4, and is connected to each adjacent nucleosome by a short linker DNA segment. The nucleosomes are further compacted into a 30-nm diameter fiber, the structure of which remains controversial; the classic model describes it as a helical solenoid (q.v.)."]

59735 nucleotidase

59736 nucleotide
- /ˈnju:klɪətaɪd/

59740 nucleus
- /ˈnju:klɪəs/
- n.["核；胞核，细胞核；神经核，原子核"]
- n.["the central core of a body or object.","cell nucleus: a spheroid body within a eukaryotic cell, separated from the cytoplasm by the nuclear envelope (which is penetrated by pores to allow communication with the cytoplasm), and containing chromatin, a nucleolus or nucleoli, and nucleoplasm. In the nucleus the cell's genetic information is stored on the chromosomes and RNA transcription and processing occur.Electron micrograph of a cell, showing the chromatin-rich nucleus bounded by the double-membraned nuclear envelope, the inner and outer membranes of which enclose the perinuclear space. The arrows point to nuclear pores.","a group of nerve cells ordinarily located within the central nervous system and bearing a direct relationship to the fibers of a particular tract or system.","in organic chemistry, the combination of atoms forming the central element or basic framework of the molecule of a specific compound or class of compounds.","see atomic n."]

- phr.["坎珀背核"]

59758 nucleus campi medialis

- phr.["坎珀内侧核"]
- phr.["nucleus of medial field: any of the groups of neurons scattered along the caudomedial border of the zona incerta in field H of Forel (prerubral field). Called also n. of prerubral field and n. of tegmental field. See also nuclei campi perizonalis."]

59759 nucleus campi ventralis

- phr.["坎珀腹核"]

59760 nucleus caudalis centralis

- phr.["尾中央核"]
- phr.["central caudal nucleus: an unpaired collection of cells in the caudal third of the oculomotor nuclear complex (nucleus nervi oculomotorii [TA]), located in the median raphe somewhat dorsal to the lateral nuclei."]

59761 nucleus centralis lateralis thalami
- 
- phr.["丘脑中央外侧核"]
- phr.["central lateral nucleus of thalamus: one of the smaller intralaminar nuclei of the dorsal thalamus, situated in the dorsal part of the internal medullary lamina."]

59762 nucleus centralis medialis thalami
- 
- phr.["丘脑中央内侧核"]
- phr.["medial central nucleus of thalamus: one of the smaller intralaminar nuclei, situated medially in the internal medullary lamina."]

59763 nucleus centromedianus thalami
- 
- phr.["丘脑中央内侧核"]
- phr.["centromedian nucleus of thalamus: the largest and most caudal of the intralaminar nuclei of the dorsal thalamus; its main connections are with the corpus striatum."]

- phr.["蓝斑核"]
- phr.["n. caeruleus."]

59765 nucleus cervicalis lateralis
- 
- phr.["颈外侧核"]

59766 nucleus cochlearis anterior
- 
- phr.["蜗神经前核"]
- phr.["anterior cochlear nucleus: the anterior of the two cochlear nuclei; located on the anterolateral aspect of the restiform body; it receives the larger, ascending branches of the cochlear nerve. Called also ventral cochlear n."]

59767 nucleus cochlearis posterior
- 
- phr.["蜗神经后核"]
- phr.["posterior cochlear nucleus: the posterior of the two cochlear nuclei, located on the dorsal aspect of the restiform body; it forms an eminence (the auditory tubercle) on the lateral part of the vestibular area of the floor of the fourth ventricle. Called also dorsal cochlear n."]

59768 nucleus coeruleus

59769 nucleus commissurae posterioris

59770 nucleus cuneatus
- 
- phr.["楔束核"]
- phr.["cuneate nucleus: a nucleus in the medulla oblongata at the rostral end of the fasciculus cuneatus, in which the fibers of this fasciculus synapse; the cells project to the thalamus via the medial lemniscus.Nucleus cuneatus and nucleus gracilis in a transverse section of the brainstem."]

59771 nucleus cuneatus accessorius

- phr.["楔束副核"]
- phr.["accessory cuneate nucleus: a group of nerve cells lying lateral to the nucleus cuneatus that relay impulses from upper limb fibers in the fasciculus cuneatus to the cerebellum (rostral spinocerebellar tract) via posterior external arcuate fibers and the inferior cerebellar peduncle; called also lateral cuneate n."]

59772 nucleus cuneiformis

- phr.["楔状核，楔形核"]

59773 nucleus dentatus
- 
- phr.["齿状核"]
- phr.["dentate nucleus: the largest and most lateral of the cerebellar nuclei, lying in the white matter of the cerebellum just lateral to the emboliform nucleus, and receiving Purkinje cell fibers primarily from the lateral cortical zone; its axons form most of the superior cerebellar peduncle and project chiefly to the contralateral red nucleus and thalamus, and also to the reticular and vestibular nuclei and inferior olive. It is the term preferred in official terminology when considering humans, and is frequently also used to describe nonhuman primates. Called also lateral cerebellar n. See also n. lateralis cerebelli."]

59774 nucleus dorsalis corporis geniculati medialis
- 
- phr.["内侧膝状体背核"]
- phr.["dorsal nucleus of medial geniculate body: the larger, dorsal part of the medial geniculate nucleus, receiving ascending auditory fibers from the inferior colliculus as well as afferent projections from some nonauditory areas of the brainstem, and projecting to the auditory cortex."]

59775 nucleus dorsalis hypothalami
- 
- phr.["下丘脑背核"]
- phr.["dorsal hypothalamic nucleus: a nerve cell nucleus situated in the dorsal portion of the intermediate hypothalamic region."]

59776 nucleus dorsalis lateralis thalami
- 
- phr.["丘脑背侧核"]

59777 nucleus dorsalis nervi oculomotorii

- phr.["动眼神经背侧核"]

Called also posterior n. of oculomotor nerve."]

59778 nucleus dorsalis nervi vagi
- 
- phr.["迷走神经背侧核"]
- phr.["TA alternative for n. posterior nervi vagi."]

59779 nucleus dorsomedialis hypothalamicae intermediae
- 
- phr.["中间下丘脑背内侧核"]

59780 nucleus emboliformis
- 
- phr.["栓状核"]
- phr.["emboliform nucleus: a small cerebellar nucleus that lies between the dentate nucleus and globose nucleus and contributes to the superior cerebellar peduncles. It is the term preferred in official terminology when considering humans, and is frequently also used to describe nonhuman primates. Cf. n. interpositus inferior."]

59781 nucleus endopeduncularis
- 
- phr.["脚内核，内蒂核"]
- phr.["endopeduncular nucleus: a small nucleus in the internal capsule of the hypothalamus adjacent to the medial edge of the globus pallidus."]

59782 nucleus fastigii
- 
- phr.["顶核"]
- phr.["fastigial nucleus: the most medial of the cerebellar nuclei, near the midline in the roof of the fourth ventricle; it projects to the pons and medulla oblongata, chiefly to the vestibular nuclei. It is the term preferred in official terminology when considering humans, and is frequently also used to describe nonhuman primates. Cf. n. medialis cerebelli."]

59783 nucleus gelatinosus
- 
- phr.["髓核，椎间盘髓核"]

- phr.["（小脑）球状核"]

It is the term preferred in official terminology when considering humans, and is frequently also used to describe nonhuman primates. Cf. n. interpositus posterior."]

59786 nucleus gracilis
- 
- phr.["薄束核"]
- phr.["gracile nucleus: a nucleus in the medulla oblongata at the rostral end of the fasciculus gracilis of the cord, in which the fibers of the fasciculus gracilis synapse; the cells project to the thalamus via the medial lemniscus. Called also Goll n. See illustration at nucleus cuneatus."]

59787 nucleus habenularis lateralis
- 
- phr.["缰外侧核"]
- phr.["lateral habenular nucleus: the more dispersed of the two nerve cell groups situated deep to the habenular trigone; it receives fibers from the stria medullaris thalami and projects to the raphe nuclei, reticular formation of mesencephalon, pars compacta of substantia nigra, and hypothalamus and basal forebrain."]

59788 nucleus habenularis medialis
- 
- phr.["缰内侧核"]
- phr.["medial habenular nucleus: the more densely packed of the two nerve cell groups situated deep to the habenular trigone; it receives fibers from the stria medullaris thalami and projects to the interpeduncular nucleus of the midbrain."]

59789 nucleus infundibularis
- 
- phr.["漏斗核"]

59790 nucleus intercalatus

59791 nucleus intermediolateralis medullae spinalis

- phr.["脊髓中间外侧核"]

59792 nucleus intermediomedialis medullae spinalis

59793 nucleus interpeduncularis

59794 nucleus interpositus anterior

- phr.["前嵌接核"]

59795 nucleus interpositus posterior

Called also lenticular n.Nucleus lentiformis (lentiform nucleus), comprising the putamen and globus pallidus, in a coronal section of the cerebrum, from the front."]

59808 nucleus mesencephalicus nervi trigemini

- phr.["三叉神经中脑核"]

It is the only central nervous system site of primary sensory neurons; its cells resemble posterior root ganglion cells. The peripheral processes of the cells, which form the mesencephalic tract, carry proprioceptive impulses; the central processes have widespread cerebellar and brainstem connections, including the motor nucleus of the trigeminal nerve."]

59813 nucleus nervi oculomotorii

- phr.["动眼神经核"]

The complex comprises larger paired dorsolateral and ventromedial somatic groups (see n. dorsalis nervi oculomotorii and n. anteromedialis nervi oculomotorii) as well as scattered small nuclei that have a parasympathetic function. Innervation of the superior rectus of one eye originates in the contralateral oculomotor nucleus; the other elements of the nucleus supply ipsilateral eye muscles via the oculomotor nerve."]

61172 operon
- /ˈɒpərɒn/
- n.["操纵子"]
- n.["in prokaryotes, a chromosomal segment constituting a functional unit of transcription and so of genetic regulation. It comprises one or more structural genes, their promoter, and an operator region that through interaction with a regulator protein controls the structural genes.Escherichia coli lac operon. In the absence of lactose, the product of the repressor gene binds the operator region and prevents transcription of genes involved in lactose utilization by blocking movement of the RNA polymerase from promoter to structural gene region; the operon is repressed. If lactose is added, an inducer binds the repressor protein, lessening its affinity for the operator. The RNA polymerase can then proceed from promoter to structural genes, so that the operon is derepressed, or expressed."]

Genera include Influenzavirus A, Influenzavirus B, Influenzavirus C, and the Thogoto-like viruses."]

In a cadaver this is the site of the so-called ileocecal valve; in the living individual the ileum here forms a conical projection called the papilla ilealis. Called also o. ileocaecale or ileocecale, ileal opening, and ileocecal opening or orifice."]

62689 oxidation

- n.["氧化"]
- n.["the act of oxidizing or state of being oxidized. Chemically it consists of the increase of positive charges on an atom or the loss of negative charges. Most biological oxidations are accomplished by the removal of a pair of hydrogen atoms (dehydrogenation) from a molecule. Such oxidations must be accompanied by reduction of an acceptor molecule. Univalent o. indicates loss of one electron; divalent o., the loss of two electrons."]

62690 oxidation number
- 
- phr.["氧化数，氧化值"]
- phr.["a number assigned to each atom in a molecule or ion that represents the number of electrons theoretically gained (positive oxidation numbers) or lost (negative numbers) in converting the atom to the elemental form. Oxidation numbers are assigned according to the following rules. The oxidation number of atoms in an elemental form is zero, and the oxidation number of a monatomic ion equals the ionic charge. Group I and Group II metals always have oxidation numbers of +1 and +2, respectively. Fluorine always has an oxidation number of -1; oxygen always of -2, except in peroxides and superoxides (where it is -1) and in compounds containing OsbondF bonds. Hydrogen always has an oxidation number of +1, except in metal hydrides (where it is -1). Oxidation numbers are assigned to other atoms so that the sum for all atoms in a neutral compound equals zero and the sum for all atoms in a polyatomic ion equals the ionic charge. Called also oxidation state."]

63183 pancreas
- /ˈpæŋkrɪəs/
- n.["胰"]
- n.["a large, elongated, racemose gland situated transversely behind the stomach, between the spleen and the duodenum. Its right extremity or head (TA, caput pancreatis) is larger and directed downward; its left extremity or tail (TA, cauda pancreatis) is transverse and terminates close to the spleen. It is subdivided into lobules by septa that extend into the gland from the thin, areolar tissue that forms an indefinite capsule. The endocrine part (endocrine pancreas) consists of the islets of Langerhans, which contain beta cells that produce insulin, alpha cells that produce glucagon, and delta cells that produce somatostatin; all three of these hormones are secreted directly into the bloodstream. Some islets contain PP cells that secrete pancreatic polypeptide. The exocrine part (exocrine pancreas) consists of pancreatic acini, secretory units that produce and secrete into the duodenum pancreatic juice, which contains enzymes essential to protein digestion.Pancreas."]

It is the essential feature of panic disorder (q.v.) but may also occur in agoraphobia and other anxiety disorders, as well as in other psychiatric disorders such as schizophrenic disorders or mood disorders. Called also anxiety a."]

63302 panic disorder
- 
- phr.["惊恐症，惊恐障碍"]

It is almost always associated with agoraphobia. (DSM-IV recognizes two types, panic d. with agoraphobia and panic d. without agoraphobia.) 63782 Paramyxoviridae

- n.["副黏病毒科"]
- n.["the paramyxoviruses: a family of RNA viruses having a pleomorphic, usually roughly spherical but occasionally filamentous virion 150–300 nm in diameter, consisting of a lipid bilayer membrane with large peplomers surrounding a helical nucleocapsid. The genome consists of a single molecule of negative-sense single-stranded RNA (MW 5–7 × 106, size 16 kb). Viruses contain six to ten major polypeptides, including a transcriptase, and are sensitive to lipid solvents, detergents, disinfectants, and extremes of pH; thermostability varies according to genus. Replication occurs in the cytoplasm and assembly is by budding through the plasma membrane. Host range is generally narrow in nature but broad in cultured cells, and transmission is horizontal, chiefly airborne. There are two subfamilies, Paramyxovirinae and Pneumovirinae."]

Pathologically, there is degeneration of dopaminergic neurones of the pars compacta of the substantia nigra, resulting in dramatic decrease in the levels of dopamine in the substantia nigra and corpus striatum."]
