- 
- phr.["杓斜肌杓会厌部"]
- phr.["aryepiglottic part of oblique arytenoid muscle: an inconstant fascicle of the oblique arytenoid muscle, originating from the apex of the arytenoid cartilage and inserting on the lateral margin of the epiglottis. Called also aryepiglottic muscle and musculus aryepiglotticus."]

64268 pars ascendens aortae
- 
- phr.["升主动脉，主动脉升部"]
- phr.["ascending part of aorta: the proximal portion of the aorta, arising from the left ventricle, and giving origin to the right and left coronary arteries before continuing as the arch of the aorta. Called also aorta ascendens [TA alternative] and ascending aorta."]

64269 pars ascendens duodeni
- 
- phr.["十二指肠升部"]
- phr.["ascending part of duodenum: the terminal part of the duodenum, which goes upwards to end at the duodenojejunal flexure."]

64270 pars atlantica arteriae vertebralis
- 
- phr.["椎动脉寰椎部"]
- phr.["atlantic part of vertebral artery: the third part of the artery, which winds behind the lateral mass of the atlas to lie in a groove on the upper surface of the posterior arch of the atlas."]

64271 pars autonomica systematis nervosi peripherici
- 
- phr.["周围神经系统自主部"]
- phr.["TA alternative for divisio autonomica systematis nervosi peripherici; see autonomic nervous system, under system."]

64272 pars basilaris ossis occipitalis
- 
- phr.["枕骨底部"]
- phr.["basilar part of occipital bone: a quadrilateral plate of the occipital bone that projects superiorly and anteriorly from the foramen magnum."]

64273 pars basilaris pontis
- 
- phr.["脑桥底部，脑桥基底部"]
- phr.["basilar part of pons: the part of the pons connecting the cerebrum, cerebellum, and medulla oblongata. It is a broad transverse band that arches across the anterior surface of the superior end of the rhombencephalon; on each side it narrows to enter the cerebellum as the middle cerebellar peduncle. It comprises longitudinal fibers originating at the cerebral cortex, transverse fibers, and the pontine nuclei."]

64274 pars buccopharyngea musculi constrictoris pharyngis superioris
- 
- phr.["咽上缩肌颊咽部，颊咽肌"]
- phr.["buccopharyngeal part of superior constrictor muscle of pharynx: the part of the superior constrictor muscle arising from the pterygomandibular raphe; called also buccopharyngeal muscle and musculus buccopharyngeus."]

64275 pars calcaneocuboidea ligamenti bifurcati
- 
- phr.["分歧韧带跟骰部，跟骰韧带"]
- phr.["calcaneocuboid part of bifurcate ligament: former name for the ligamentum calcaneocuboideum."]

64276 pars calcaneonavicularis ligamenti bifurcati
- 
- phr.["分歧韧带跟舟部，跟舟韧带"]
- phr.["calcaneonavicular part of bifurcate ligament: former name for the ligamentum calcaneonaviculare."]

64277 pars canalis nervi optici
- 
- phr.["视神经管部"]
- phr.["intracanalicular part of optic nerve: the part of the nerve that runs through the optic canal."]

64278 pars cartilaginea septi nasi
- 
- phr.["鼻中隔软骨部"]
- phr.["cartilaginous part of nasal septum: the plate of cartilage forming the anterior part of the nasal septum."]

64279 pars cartilaginea systematis skeletalis
- 
- phr.["骨骼系统软骨部"]
- phr.["cartilaginous part of skeletal system: the cartilages of the body."]

64280 pars cartilaginea tubae auditivae
- 
- phr.["咽鼓管软骨部"]
- phr.["cartilaginous part of auditory tube: the part of the tube that is chiefly supported by the tubal cartilage, extending from the pars ossea to the pharyngeal orifice of the auditory tube."]

64281 pars cavernosa arteriae carotidis internae
- 
- phr.["颈内动脉海绵部"]
- phr.["cavernous part of internal carotid artery: the part located in the cavernous sinus; it has numerous branches, including tentorial basal, tentorial marginal, meningeal, and cavernous branches, branches to trigeminal ganglion, and the inferior hypophysial artery."]

64282 pars centralis systematis nervosi
- 
- phr.["神经系统中枢部，中枢神经系统"]
- phr.["the central nervous system, consisting of the brain and spinal cord. Called also systema nervosum centrale [TA alternative]."]

64283 pars centralis ventriculi lateralis
- 
- phr.["侧脑室中央部"]
- phr.["central part of lateral ventricle: the part of the lateral ventricle found within the parietal lobe; it communicates with the frontal, occipital, and temporal horns. Called also body of lateral ventricle."]

64284 pars ceratopharyngea musculi constrictoris pharyngis medii
- 
- phr.["咽中缩肌大角咽部，大角咽肌"]
- phr.["ceratopharyngeal part of middle constrictor muscle of pharynx: the part of the middle constrictor muscle arising from the greater cornu of the hyoid bone; called also musculus ceratopharyngeus and ceratopharyngeal muscle."]

64285 pars cerebralis arteriae carotidis internae
- 
- phr.["颈内动脉大脑部"]
- phr.["cerebral part of internal carotid artery: the terminal part of the artery, which gives off branches comprising the ophthalmic, superior hypophysial, posterior communicating, anterior choroidal, and uncal arteries, and clival and meningeal branches, and then divides into the anterior and middle cerebral arteries in the middle cranial fossa."]

64286 pars cervicalis arteriae carotidis internae
- 
- phr.["颈内动脉颈部"]
- phr.["cervical part of internal carotid artery: an unbranched part located in the carotid triangle of the neck."]

64287 pars cervicalis arteriae vertebralis
- 
- phr.["椎动脉颈部"]
- phr.["TA alternative for p. transversaria arteriae vertebralis."]

64288 pars cervicalis ductus thoracici
- 
- phr.["胸导管颈部"]
- phr.["the cervical part of the thoracic duct; see ductus thoracicus."]

64289 pars cervicalis medullae spinalis
- 
- phr.["脊髓颈部［段］"]
- phr.["cervical part of spinal cord: the part of the cord that is within the cervical part of the vertebral canal and gives rise to the eight pairs of cervical spinal nerves (segmenta cervicalia medullae spinalis [1–8])."]

64290 pars cervicalis oesophagi
- 
- phr.["食管［道］颈部"]
- phr.["cervical part of esophagus: the part of the esophagus located in the cervical region, posterior to the trachea and the recurrent laryngeal nerves, anterior to the longus colli muscle and vertebral column, and medial to the lobes of the thyroid gland and the common carotid arteries. Called also cervical esophagus and p. colli oesophagi [TA alternative]."]

64291 pars cervicalis tracheae
- 
- phr.["气管颈部"]
- phr.["the part of the trachea located in the cervical region, related anteriorly to the jugular venous arch, sternohyoid and sternothyroid muscles, isthmus of thyroid gland, inferior thyroid veins, thymus, arteria thyroidea ima, posteriorly to the esophagus and recurrent laryngeal nerves, and laterally to the lobes of the thyroid gland and common carotid arteries."]

64292 pars chondropharyngea musculi constrictoris pharyngis medii
- 
- phr.["咽中缩肌小角咽部，小角咽部"]
- phr.["chondropharyngeal part of middle constrictor muscle of pharynx: the part of the middle constrictor muscle arising from the lesser cornu of the hyoid bone; called also chondropharyngeal muscle and musculus chondropharyngeus."]

64293 pars ciliaris retinae
- 
- phr.["视网膜睫状体部"]
- phr.["ciliary part of retina: the two layers of epithelium lining the basal lamina of the ciliary body."]

64294 pars clavicularis musculi deltoidei
- 
- phr.["三角肌锁骨部"]
- phr.["clavicular part of deltoid muscle: the anterior unipennate portion of the deltoid muscle, originating on the clavicle and assisting pectoralis major in drawing the arm forward and rotating it medially."]

64295 pars clavicularis musculi pectoralis majoris
- 
- phr.["胸大肌锁骨部"]
- phr.["clavicular part of pectoralis major muscle: the portion of the muscle that originates from the clavicle."]

64296 pars coccygea medullae spinalis
- 
- phr.["脊髓尾部，脊髓尾段"]
- phr.["coccygeal part of spinal cord: the part of the spinal cord that gives rise to the coccygeal spinal nerves (segmenta coccygea medullae spinalis [1–3])."]

64297 pars convoluta lobuli corticalis renis
- 
- phr.["肾皮质小叶纡曲部"]
- phr.["convoluted part of cortical lobule of kidney: the part of the renal cortex that surrounds the intracortical prolongations of the pyramids and is composed of convoluted tubules."]

64298 pars copularis lobuli paramediani
- 
- phr.["腹侧小叶连接部"]
- phr.["TA alternative for p. lateralis lobuli biventralis cerebelli."]

64299 pars corneoscleralis reticuli trabecularis
- 
- phr.["小梁网巩膜角膜部"]
- phr.["corneoscleral part of trabecular reticulum: the anterior part of the trabecular reticulum, situated between the venous sinus of the sclera, the scleral spur, and the posterior limiting lamina of the cornea."]

64300 pars costalis diaphragmatis
- 
- phr.["膈肌肋部"]
- phr.["costal part of diaphragm: the part of the thoracic diaphragm arising from the inner surfaces of the ribs and their cartilages."]

64301 pars cricopharyngea musculi constrictoris pharyngis inferioris
- 
- phr.["咽下缩肌环咽部，环咽肌"]
- phr.["cricopharyngeal part of inferior constrictor muscle of pharynx: the part of the inferior constrictor muscle arising from the cricoid cartilage; called also cricopharyngeal muscle or sphincter and musculus cricopharyngeus [TA alternative]."]

64302 pars cruciformis vaginae fibrosae digitorum manus
- 
- phr.["手指纤维鞘交叉部，指十字韧带"]
- phr.["cruciate or cruciform part of fibrous sheaths of fingers: one of the diagonal bundles of the fascia of the fingers that cross each other on the dorsal surface of each digit at the level of the distal end of the proximal phalanx; called also ligamenta cruciata digitorum manus and cruciate ligaments of fingers."]

64303 pars cruciformis vaginae fibrosae digitorum pedis
- 
- phr.["足趾纤维鞘交叉部，趾十字韧带"]
- phr.["cruciate or cruciform part of fibrous sheaths of toes: one of the bundles of fascial fibers in the toes resembling those of similar name in the fingers; called also ligamenta cruciata digitorum pedis and cruciate ligaments of toes."]

64304 pars cuneiformis vomeris
- 
- phr.["犁骨楔状部"]
- phr.["the wedge-shaped anterior part of the vomer."]

64305 pars cupularis recessus epitympanici
- 
- phr.["鼓室上隐窝顶部"]
- phr.["cupular space: the part of the epitympanic recess above the head of the malleus."]

64306 pars descendens aortae
- 
- phr.["降主动脉，主动脉降部"]
- phr.["the continuation of the aorta from the arch of the aorta, in the thorax, to the point of its division into the common iliac arteries, in the abdomen; divided anatomically into a thoracic part (pars thoracica aortae) and an abdominal part (pars abdominalis aortae). Called also aorta descendens [TA alternative] and descending aorta."]

64307 pars descendens duodeni
- 
- phr.["十二指肠降部"]
- phr.["descending part of duodenum: the part between the superior and inferior parts, into which the bile and pancreatic ducts open."]

64308 pars dextra faciei diaphragmaticae hepatis
- 
- phr.["肝膈面右部"]
- phr.["right part of diaphragmatic surface of liver: the portion that is directed toward the right side of the body, near the ribs on that side."]

64309 pars distalis adenohypophyseos
- 
- phr.["腺垂体远部"]
- phr.["distal part of adenohypophysis: the part that makes up the main body of the gland."]

64310 pars dorsalis alaris lobuli centralis cerebelli
- 
- phr.["小脑中央小叶翼后部"]
- phr.["TA alternative for p. superior alaris lobuli centralis cerebelli."]

64311 pars dorsalis culminis
- 
- phr.["小脑小山背后部"]
- phr.["TA alternative for p. posterior culminis."]

64312 pars dorsalis lobuli centralis cerebelli
- 
- phr.["小脑中央小叶背后部"]
- phr.["TA alternative for p. posterior lobuli centralis cerebelli."]

64313 pars dorsalis lobuli quadrangularis anterioris
- 
- phr.["前方形小叶背部"]
- phr.["TA alternative for pars posterior lobuli quadrangularis anterioris."]

64314 pars duralis fili terminalis
- 
- phr.["终丝硬膜部"]
- phr.["dural part of filum terminale: the downward prolongation of the spinal dura mater from the lower end of the dural sac, about the level of the second sacral vertebra, to the first coccygeal vertebral segment. Called also filum terminale externum."]

64315 pars extraocularis arteriae centralis retinae
- 
- phr.["视网膜中央动脉眼外部"]
- phr.["extraocular part of central retinal artery: the portion of the artery outside the eyeball, coursing within the dural sheath along with the optic nerve, then piercing the nerve approximately 1.2 cm behind the eyeball, and traveling forward within the center of the nerve to the retina."]

64316 pars fibrosa
- 
- phr.["（核仁）纤维区［部］"]
- phr.["the dense fibrillar region of nucleolus, where transcription of the ribosomal RNA genes occurs."]

64317 pars flaccida membranae tympanicae
- 
- phr.["鼓膜松弛部"]
- phr.["a small, lax and thin portion of the tympanic membrane between the anterior and posterior malleolar folds. Called also membrana flaccida and Rivinus or Shrapnell membrane."]

64318 pars glossopharyngea musculi constrictoris pharyngis superioris
- 
- phr.["咽上缩肌舌咽部，舌咽肌"]
- phr.["glossopharyngeal part of superior constrictor muscle of pharynx: the part of the superior constrictor muscle arising from the side of the root of the tongue. Called also glossopharyngeal muscle and musculus glossopharyngeus."]

64319 pars hepatis dextra
- 
- phr.["右肝部"]
- phr.["right part of liver: the part that receives blood from the right branches of the hepatic portal vein and hepatic artery proper and whose bile flows out through the right hepatic duct. Called also right liver."]

64320 pars hepatis sinistra
- 
- phr.["左肝部"]
- phr.["left part of liver: the part that receives blood from the left branches of the hepatic portal vein and hepatic artery proper and whose bile flows out through the left hepatic duct. Called also left liver."]

64321 pars horizontalis arteriae cerebri mediae
- 
- phr.["大脑中动脉水平部"]
- phr.["TA alternative for p. sphenoidalis arteriae cerebri mediae."]

64322 pars horizontalis duodeni
- 
- phr.["十二指肠水平部"]
- phr.["horizontal part of duodenum: the third, more horizontal or transverse, part of the duodenum, located between the descending and ascending parts, crossing from right to left anterior to the third lumbar vertebra. Called also p. inferior duodeni [TA alternative] and inferior or transverse part of duodenum."]

64323 pars iliaca fasciae iliopsoas
- 
- phr.["髂腰肌筋膜髂部"]
- phr.["ciliac part of iliopsoas fascia: the part of the fascia that invests the iliacus muscle."]

64324 pars inferior alaris lobuli centralis cerebelli
- 
- phr.["小脑中央小叶翼下部"]
- phr.["the inferior part of the wing of the central lobule of the cerebellum (HII); called also p. ventralis alaris lobuli centralis cerebelli [TA alternative] and ventral part of wing of central lobule of cerebellum."]

64325 pars inferior duodeni
- 
- phr.["十二指肠下部"]
- phr.["TA alternative for p. horizontalis duodeni."]

64326 pars inferior nervi vestibularis
- 
- phr.["前庭神经下部"]
- phr.["inferior part of vestibular nerve: the inferior branch of the nerve, which has filaments that end in the ampullary crest of the posterior semicircular ducts and the macula of the saccule."]

64327 pars inferior venae lingularis
- 
- phr.["舌静脉下部"]
- phr.["inferior part of lingular vein: a venous branch that drains the inferior lingular segment of the left lung and drains into the lingular vein. Called also inferior lingular segmental vein."]

64328 pars infraclavicularis plexus brachialis
- 
- phr.["臂丛锁骨下部"]
- phr.["infraclavicular part of brachial plexus: the part of the brachial plexus that lies in the axilla, below the level of the clavicle. In it arise the medial and lateral pectoral, musculocutaneous, medial brachial cutaneous, medial antebrachial cutaneous, median, ulnar, radial, subscapular, thoracodorsal, and axillary nerves."]

64329 pars infralobaris venae posterioris
- 
- phr.["静脉后叶下部"]
- phr.["infralobar part of posterior vein: a tributary to the posterior branch of the right superior pulmonary vein; called also infralobar vein."]

64330 pars insularis arteriae cerebri mediae
- 
- phr.["大脑中动脉岛部"]
- phr.["insular part of middle cerebral artery: collectively, the segment of the middle cerebral artery and the branches from it that supply the insula and adjacent areas (M2 segment); the branches comprise the arteriae insulares. See also segments of middle cerebral artery, under segment."]

64331 pars intercartilaginea rimae glottidis
- 
- phr.["声门裂软骨间部"]
- phr.["the part of the rima glottidis between the arytenoid cartilages; called also intercartilaginous glottis, respiratory glottis, and interarytenoid space."]

64332 pars intermedia adenohypophyseos
- 
- phr.["腺垂体中间部"]
- phr.["intermediate part of adenohypophysis: an ill-defined region between the two lobes of the hypophysis; some systems of nomenclature consider it part of the neurohypophysis. In humans a defined structure develops during embryogenesis, but only scattered cells are retained when the gland matures."]

64333 pars intermedia urethrae masculinae
- 
- phr.["男性尿道中间部"]
- phr.["intermediate part of male urethra: a short portion of the urethra between the pars prostatica and the pars spongiosa, traversing the deep perineal space. Called also membranous urethra, membranous part of male urethra and p. membranacea urethrae masculinae [TA alternative]."]

64334 pars intermembranacea rimae glottidis
- 
- phr.["声门裂膜间部"]
- phr.["the part of the rima glottidis between the vocal folds. Called also glottis vocalis."]

64335 pars intersegmentalis
- 
- phr.["段间部，叶内部"]
- phr.["intersegmental part: any of the veins lying between and draining adjacent bronchopulmonary segments and supplying a main branch of a right or left pulmonary vein; called also infrasegmental or intersegmental vein."]

64336 pars intracranialis arteriae vertebralis
- 
- phr.["椎动脉颅内部"]
- phr.["intracranial part of vertebral artery: the fourth part of the artery; it pierces the dura and arachnoid mater and ascends anterior to the hypoglossal roots and then medially in front of the medulla oblongata where, at about the lower border of the pons, it joins the opposite artery to form the basilar artery."]

64337 pars intracranialis nervi optici
- 
- phr.["视神经颅内部"]
- phr.["intracranial part of optic nerve: the part of the nerve that lies between the optic canal and the optic chiasm."]

64338 pars intralaminaris nervi optici intraocularis
- 
- phr.["眼内视神经板内部"]
- phr.["intralaminar part of intraocular optic nerve: the portion of the intraocular part of the optic nerve that runs through the lamina cribrosa of the sclera."]

64339 pars intraocularis arteriae centralis retinae
- 
- phr.["视网膜中央动脉眼内部"]
- phr.["intraocular part of central retinal artery: the portion of the artery within the eyeball."]

64340 pars intraocularis nervi optici
- 
- phr.["视神经球内部"]
- phr.["intraocular part of optic nerve: the part of the nerve that is within the eyeball, separated into postlaminar, intralaminar, and prelaminar parts (see p. postlaminaris nervi optici, p. intralaminaris nervi optici, and p. prelaminaris nervi optici)."]

64341 pars intraocularis venae centralis retinae
- 
- phr.["视网膜中央静脉眼内部"]
- phr.["intraocular part of central retinal vein: the portion of the vein that is within the eyeball."]

64342 pars intrasegmentalis
- 
- phr.["段内部"]
- phr.["intrasegmental part: any of the small veins lying within a bronchopulmonary segment and draining into one of the main branches of a right or left pulmonary vein."]

64343 pars iridica retinae
- 
- phr.["视网膜虹膜部"]
- phr.["iridial part of retina: the two layers of pigmented epithelium lining the posterior part of the iris."]

64344 pars labialis musculi orbicularis oris
- 
- phr.["口轮匝肌唇部"]
- phr.["labial part of orbicularis oris muscle: the part of the muscle whose fibers are restricted to the lips."]

64345 pars laryngea pharyngis
- 
- phr.["喉咽，咽喉部"]
- phr.["laryngopharynx: the portion of the pharynx that lies below the upper edge of the epiglottis and opens into the larynx and esophagus."]

64346 pars lateralis arcus pedis longitudinalis
- 
- phr.["足纵弓外侧部"]
- phr.["lateral part of longitudinal arch of foot: the part of the arch formed by the calcaneus, the cuboid bone, and the lateral two metatarsal bones. Called also lateral longitudinal arch of foot."]

64347 pars lateralis fornicis vaginae
- 
- phr.["阴道穹侧部"]
- phr.["the lateral part of the fornix of the vagina; called also lateral fornix."]

64348 pars lateralis lobuli biventralis cerebelli
- 
- phr.["小脑二腹小叶外侧部"]
- phr.["the more lateral part of the biventral lobule of the cerebellum (HVIIIA), separated from the medial part by the intrabiventral fissure and from the lobulus gracilis by the prebiventral fissure. Called also p. copularis lobuli paramediani [TA alternative]."]

64349 pars lateralis ossis occipitalis
- 
- phr.["枕骨侧部"]
- phr.["lateral part of occipital bone: one of the paired parts of the occipital bone that form the lateral boundaries of the foramen magnum, each being prominently characterized by the presence of one of the occipital condyles."]

64350 pars lateralis ossis sacri
- 
- phr.["骶骨侧部"]
- phr.["lateral part of sacrum: the part or mass of the sacrum on either side lateral to the dorsal and pelvic sacral foramina; called also lateral mass of sacrum."]

64351 pars lateralis venae lobi medii
- 
- phr.["中叶静脉外侧部"]
- phr.["lateral part of middle lobe vein: a venous branch draining the lateral segment of the middle lobe of the right lung, emptying into the middle lobe vein. Called also lateral segmental vein."]

64352 pars libera membri inferioris
- 
- phr.["自由下肢，下肢游离部"]
- phr.["the bones of the thigh, leg, and foot. Called also skeleton membri inferioris liberi."]

64353 pars libera membri superioris
- 
- phr.["自由上肢，上肢游离部"]
- phr.["the bones of the arm, forearm, and hand. Called also skeleton membri superioris liberi."]

64354 pars lumbalis diaphragmatis
- 
- phr.["膈腰部"]
- phr.["lumbar part of diaphragm: the portion of the thoracic diaphragm that arises from the lumbar vertebrae, comprising the right and left diaphragmatic crura, the right crus arising from the superior three or four vertebrae, and the left from the superior two or three."]

64355 pars lumbalis medullae spinalis
- 
- phr.["脊髓腰部"]
- phr.["lumbar part of spinal cord: the part of the cord that is within the lower thoracic part of the vertebral canal (in adults) and gives rise to the five pairs of lumbar spinal nerves (segmenta lumbalia medullae spinalis [1–5])."]

64356 pars lumbalis musculi iliocostalis lumborum
- 
- phr.["腰髂肋肌腰部"]
- phr.["lumbar part of iliocostalis lumborum: origin, iliac crest; insertion, angles of lower six or seven ribs; innervation, branches of thoracic and lumbar; action, extends lumbar spine. Called also divisio lateralis musculi erectoris spinae lumborum [TA alternative]."]

64357 pars lumbalis musculi longissimus thoracis
- 
- phr.["胸最长肌腰部"]
- phr.["lumbar part of longissimus thoracis: the portion of the longissimus thoracis occurring specifically in the lumbar region; see musculus longissimus thoracis. Called also divisio medialis musculi erectoris spinae lumborum [TA alternative]."]

64358 pars magnocellularis nuclei rubri
- 
- phr.["红核大细胞部"]
- phr.["magnocellular part of red nucleus: in humans, the posterior part of the red nucleus, containing a complement of large multipolar cells; the number of these cells is relatively decreased in comparison to the small cells scattered throughout the nucleus; cf. p. parvocellularis nuclei rubri."]

64359 pars marginalis musculi orbicularis oris
- 
- phr.["口轮匝肌缘部"]
- phr.["marginal part of orbicularis oris muscle: the part of the muscle whose fibers blend with those of adjacent muscles."]

64360 pars medialis arcus pedis longitudinalis
- 
- phr.["足纵弓内侧部"]
- phr.["medial part of longitudinal arch of foot: the part of the longitudinal arch formed by the calcaneus, talus, navicular, cuneiform, and the first three metatarsal bones. Called also medial longitudinal arch of foot."]

64361 pars medialis lobuli biventralis cerebelli
- 
- phr.["小脑二腹小叶内侧部"]
- phr.["the more medial part of the biventral lobule of the cerebellum (HVIIIB), separated from the lateral part by the intrabiventral fissure and from the tonsilla by the secondary fissure. Called also lobulus parafloccularis dorsalis [TA alternative] and dorsal paraflocculus."]

64362 pars medialis venae lobi medii
- 
- phr.["中叶静脉内侧部"]
- phr.["medial part of middle lobe vein: a venous branch draining the medial segment of the middle lobe of the right lung, emptying into the middle lobe vein. Called also medial segmental vein."]

64363 pars membranacea septi interventricularis
- 
- phr.["室间隔膜部"]
- phr.["membranous part of interventricular septum: the very small, completely membranous area of the interventricular septum of the heart; situated near the root of the aorta, it can be viewed between the opposed margins of the right and posterior semilunar valves of the aorta."]

64364 pars membranacea septi nasi
- 
- phr.["鼻中隔膜部"]
- phr.["membranous part of nasal septum: the anterior inferior part of the nasal septum, beneath the cartilaginous part; it is composed of skin and subcutaneous tissues. Called also membranous nasal septum and membranous septum of nose."]

64365 pars membranacea urethrae masculinae
- 
- phr.["男性尿道膜部"]
- phr.["TA alternative for p. intermedia urethrae masculinae."]

64366 pars mobilis septi nasi
- 
- phr.["鼻中隔活动部"]
- phr.["mobile part of nasal septum: the part of the nasal septum at the apex of the nose, formed by skin, subcutaneous tissue, the greater alar cartilages, the membranous septum, and the columella; called also septum mobile nasi."]

64367 pars muscularis septi interventricularis
- 
- phr.["室间隔肌部"]
- phr.["muscular part of interventricular septum of heart: the thick muscular partition forming the greater part of the septum between the ventricles of the heart."]

64368 pars mylopharyngea musculi constrictoris pharyngis superioris
- 
- phr.["咽上缩肌下颌咽部，下颌咽肌"]
- phr.["mylopharyngeal part of superior constrictor muscle of pharynx: the part of the superior constrictor muscle arising from the mylohyoid ridge of the mandible; called also mylopharyngeal muscle and musculus mylopharyngeus."]

64369 pars nasalis ossis frontalis
- 
- phr.["额骨鼻部"]
- phr.["nasal part of frontal bone: the small, irregularly shaped process that projects inferiorly from the medial part of the squama of the frontal bone to articulate with the nasal bones and the frontal processes of the maxillae. Called also prefrontal bone."]

64370 pars nasalis pharyngis
- 
- phr.["鼻咽（部）"]
- phr.["nasopharynx: the part of the pharynx that lies above the level of the soft palate."]

64371 pars obliqua musculi cricothyroidei
- 
- phr.["环甲肌斜部"]
- phr.["the fibers of the cricothyroid muscle that are inserted into the inferior horn, caudal margin, and inner surface of the thyroid cartilage."]

64372 pars occlusa arteriae umbilicalis
- 
- phr.["脐动脉闭塞部"]
- phr.["the portion of an umbilical artery that atrophies at birth when the placental circulation ceases to become the medial umbilical ligament. Cf. p. patens arteriae umbilicalis."]

64373 pars olfactoria cavitatis nasi
- 
- phr.["鼻腔嗅部"]
- phr.["olfactory region: the superior part of the nasal cavity, the mucosa of which contains most of the receptors for the sense of smell."]

64374 pars opercularis gyri frontalis inferioris
- 
- phr.["额下回盖部"]
- phr.["opercular part of inferior frontal gyrus: the part of the inferior frontal gyrus lying posterior to the ascending ramus of the lateral sulcus and pars triangularis and overlapping the insular lobe (insula). In the hemisphere dominant for speech, it is Broca's motor speech area. See also operculum frontale and operculum frontoparietale."]

64375 pars optica retinae
- 
- phr.["视网膜视部"]
- phr.["optic part of retina: the part of the retina that contains receptors sensitive to light, extending posteriorly from the ora serrata on the inner surface of the choroid and continuous at the optic disk with the optic nerve; it consists of an outer pigmented layer (stratum pigmentosum retinae) and an inner, multilayered nervous layer (stratum nervosum retinae). See also retina."]

64376 pars oralis pharyngis
- 
- phr.["口咽，口咽部"]
- phr.["oropharynx: the division of the pharynx lying between the soft palate and the upper edge of the epiglottis."]

64377 pars orbitalis glandulae lacrimalis
- 
- phr.["泪腺眶部"]
- phr.["orbital part of lacrimal gland: the main part of the lacrimal gland, limited in front by the orbicularis muscle and the orbital septum."]

64378 pars orbitalis gyri frontalis inferioris
- 
- phr.["额下回眶部"]
- phr.["orbital part of inferior frontal gyrus: the part of the inferior frontal gyrus lying below the anterior ramus of the lateral sulcus, which curves around the superciliary border to the orbital surface of the frontal lobe of the cerebral hemisphere anterior to the pars triangularis. See also operculum frontale (defs. 1 and 2)."]

64379 pars orbitalis musculi orbicularis oculi
- 
- phr.["眼轮匝肌眶部"]
- phr.["orbital part of orbicularis oculi muscle: the part of the orbicularis oculi muscle that arises from the medial margin of the orbit and surrounds it and the palpebral part of the muscle, inserting near the site of origin."]

64380 pars orbitalis nervi optici
- 
- phr.["视神经眶部"]
- phr.["orbital part of optic nerve: the part of the nerve located between the optic canal and the eyeball."]

64381 pars orbitalis ossis frontalis
- 
- phr.["额骨眶部"]
- phr.["orbital part of frontal bone: the horizontal part of the bone; it forms the greater part of the roof of the orbit and of the floor of the anterior cranial fossa and is separated from its fellow of the other side by the ethmoid incisure. Called also orbital plate of frontal bone."]

64382 pars ossea septi nasi
- 
- phr.["鼻中隔骨部"]
- phr.["bony part of nasal septum: the posterior part of the septum, consisting of the perpendicular plate of the ethmoid bone superiorly and of the vomer inferiorly. Called also bony nasal septum, bony septum of nose, and septum nasi osseum [TA]."]

64383 pars ossea systematis skeletalis
- 
- phr.["骨骼系统骨部"]
- phr.["bony part of skeletal system: the bones of the body."]

64384 pars ossea tubae auditivae
- 
- phr.["咽鼓管骨部"]
- phr.["bony part of auditory tube: the part of the tube that lies within the temporal bone, extending from the tympanic orifice to the pars cartilaginea of the auditory tube."]

64385 pars palpebralis glandulae lacrimalis
- 
- phr.["泪腺眼睑部"]
- phr.["palpebral part of lacrimal gland: the part of the gland that projects laterally into the upper eyelid; called also Rosenmüller gland."]

64386 pars palpebralis musculi orbicularis oculi
- 
- phr.["眼轮匝肌睑部"]
- phr.["palpebral part of orbicularis oculi muscle: the part of the orbicularis oculi muscle that is contained in the eyelids, originating from the medial palpebral ligament and inserting in the lateral canthus."]

64387 pars parvocellularis nuclei rubri
- 
- phr.["红核小细胞部"]
- phr.["parvocellular part of red nucleus: the complement of small multipolar cells scattered throughout the red nucleus; in humans, these cells predominate over the large cells in the caudal part of the nucleus; cf. p. magnocellularis nuclei rubri."]

64388 pars patens arteriae umbilicalis
- 
- phr.["脐动脉开放部"]
- phr.["patent part of umbilical artery: the proximal section of the fetal umbilical cord, which remains patent in the adult, although reduced in size. Cf. p. occlusa arteriae umbilicalis."]

64389 pars pelvica ureteris
- 
- phr.["输尿管盆部"]
- phr.["pelvic part of ureter: the portion of the ureter that extends from the terminal line of the pelvis to the urinary bladder."]

64390 pars peripherica systematis nervosi
- 
- phr.["神经系统周围部"]
- phr.["the peripheral part of the nervous system, consisting of the nerves and ganglia outside the brain and spinal cord; called also peripheral nervous system and systema nervosum periphericum [TA alternative]."]

64391 pars petrosa arteriae carotidis internae
- 
- phr.["颈内动脉岩部"]
- phr.["petrous part of internal carotid artery: the portion of the artery located in the carotid canal; its branches include the caroticotympanic arteries."]

64392 pars petrosa ossis temporalis
- 
- phr.["颞骨岩部"]
- phr.["petrous part of temporal bone: a pyramid of dense bone located at the base of the cranium; one of the three parts of the temporal bone, it houses the organ of hearing. Some anatomists divide it into petrous and mastoid subparts and call it the petromastoid part of temporal bone. Called also pyramid of temporal bone."]

64393 pars pialis fili terminalis
- 
- phr.["终丝软膜部"]
- phr.["pial part of filum terminale: the prolongation of the spinal pia mater from the conus medullaris downward through the lumbar cistern, surrounded by the cauda equina, to attach to the inner aspect of the dural sac about the level of the second sacral vertebra. Called also filum terminale internum."]

64394 pars plana corporis ciliaris
- 
- phr.["睫状体平坦部，睫状环"]
- phr.["orbiculus ciliaris."]

64395 pars planitis
- /pɑ:z plæˈnaɪtɪs/
- phr.["睫状体扁平部炎"]
- phr.["a granulomatous uveitis of the pars plana of the ciliary body."]

64396 pars plicata corporis ciliaris
- 
- phr.["睫状体皱部，睫状冠"]
- phr.["corona ciliaris."]

64397 pars postcommunicalis arteriae cerebri anterioris
- 
- phr.["大脑前动脉后交通支"]
- phr.["postcommunicating part of anterior cerebral artery: collectively, the branches of the anterior cerebral artery that supply the cortex of the medial parts of the frontal and parietal lobes, comprising the distal medial striate, medial frontobasal, polar frontal, callosomarginal (and its branches), and pericallosal (and its branches) arteries."]

64398 pars postcommunicalis arteriae cerebri posterioris
- 
- phr.["大脑后动脉后交通支"]
- phr.["postcommunicating part of posterior cerebral artery: collectively, the branches of the posterior cerebral artery that supply cerebral peduncles, posterior thalamus, colliculi, and pineal and medial geniculate bodies, and choroid plexuses of lateral and third ventricles, comprising the posterolateral central and thalamogeniculate arteries, and posterior medial choroidal, posterior lateral choroidal, and peduncular branches."]

64399 pars posterior commissurae anterioris
- 
- phr.["前连合后部"]
- phr.["posterior part of anterior commissure: the larger posterior portion of the commissure, whose fibers interconnect the middle and inferior temporal gyri, the parahippocampal gyri, and the amygdaloid bodies of the two sides."]

64400 pars posterior dorsi linguae
- 
- phr.["舌背沟后部"]
- phr.["posterior part of dorsum of tongue: the part of the dorsum of the tongue posterior to the terminal sulcus. Called also p. postsulcalis dorsi linguae [TA alternative]."]

64401 pars posterior faciei diaphragmaticae hepatis
- 
- phr.["肝膈面后部"]
- phr.["posterior part of diaphragmatic surface of liver: the part directed toward the posterior surface of the body."]

64402 pars posterior fornicis vaginae
- 
- phr.["阴道穹后部"]
- phr.["the posterior part of the fornix of the vagina; called also posterior fornix."]

64403 pars posterior hepatis
- 
- phr.["肝后部"]
- phr.["posterior part of liver: term used to refer to the posterior region that is not part of either the left part (TA, pars hepatis sinistra) or the right part (TA, pars hepatis dextra); this part is coextensive with the caudate lobe. Called also posterior liver."]

64404 pars posterior lobuli centralis cerebelli
- 
- phr.["小脑中央小叶后部"]
- phr.["the posterior part of the central lobule of the cerebellum (III); called also p. dorsalis lobuli centralis cerebelli [TA alternative] and dorsal part of central lobule of cerebellum."]

64405 pars posterior lobuli quadrangularis anterioris
- 
- phr.["前小脑方叶后部"]
- phr.["posterior part of anterior quadrangular lobule (HV): the posterior division of the lobulus quadrangularis anterior cerebelli. Called also p. dorsalis lobuli quadrangularis anterioris [TA alternative] and dorsal part of anterior quadrangular lobule."]

64406 pars postlaminaris nervi optici intraocularis
- 
- phr.["眼内视神经板后部"]
- phr.["postlaminar part of intraocular optic nerve: that portion of the intraocular part of the optic nerve that is posterior to the lamina cribrosa of the sclera."]

64407 pars postsulcalis dorsi linguae
- 
- phr.["舌背沟后部"]
- phr.["TA alternative for p. posterior dorsi linguae."]

64408 pars precommunicalis arteriae cerebri anterioris
- 
- phr.["大脑前动脉前交通支"]
- phr.["precommunicating part of anterior cerebral artery: collectively, the branches of the anterior cerebral artery that supply the hypothalamus and lower parts of the corpus striatum, comprising the arteriae centrales anteromediales."]

64409 pars precommunicalis arteriae cerebri posterioris
- 
- phr.["大脑后动脉前交通支"]
- phr.["precommunicating part of posterior cerebral artery: collectively, the branches of the posterior cerebral artery anterior to its point of junction with the posterior communicating artery, comprising the posteromedial central arteries, short circumferential arteries, thalamoperforating artery, and collicular artery."]

64410 pars prelaminaris nervi optici intraocularis
- 
- phr.["眼内视神经板前部"]
- phr.["prelaminar part of intraocular optic nerve: that portion of the intraocular part of the optic nerve that is anterior to the lamina cribrosa of the sclera."]

64411 pars presulcalis dorsi linguae
- 
- phr.["舌背沟前部"]
- phr.["TA alternative for p. anterior dorsi linguae."]

64412 pars prevertebralis arteriae vertebralis
- 
- phr.["椎动脉椎前部"]
- phr.["prevertebral part of vertebral artery: the first part of the artery, from its branching off from the subclavian artery to the point at which it enters the transverse process of the sixth cervical vertebra."]

64413 pars profunda glandulae parotideae
- 
- phr.["腮腺深部"]
- phr.["deep part of parotid gland: that part of the gland located deep to the facial nerve."]

64414 pars profunda musculi masseteris
- 
- phr.["咬肌深部"]
- phr.["deep part of masseter muscle: the part whose fibers arise from the medial surface of the zygomatic arch and the fascia over the temporal muscle, and are directed in a vertical inferior direction."]

64415 pars profunda partis palpebralis musculi orbicularis oculi
- 
- phr.["眼轮匝肌上睑提肌深部"]
- phr.["deep part of palpebral part of orbicularis oculi muscle: the part of the orbicularis oculi muscle that arises from the posterior lacrimal ridge of the lacrimal bone, to become continuous with the palpebral portion."]

64416 pars prostatica urethrae masculinae
- 
- phr.["男性尿道前列腺部"]
- phr.["prostatic part of male urethra: the part of the urethra that passes through the prostate; called also prostatic urethra."]

64417 pars psoatica fasciae iliopsoas
- 
- phr.["髂腰肌筋膜腰肌部"]
- phr.["psoas part of iliopsoas fascia: the part of the fascia that invests the psoas major muscle."]

64418 pars pterygopharyngea musculi constrictoris pharyngis superioris
- 
- phr.["咽上缩肌翼咽部，翼咽肌"]
- phr.["pterygopharyngeal part of superior constrictor muscle of pharynx: the part of the superior constrictor muscle arising from the caudal part and hamulus of the medial pterygoid plate; called also pterygopharyngeal muscle and musculus pterygopharyngeus."]

64419 pars recta musculi cricothyroidei
- 
- phr.["环甲肌直部"]
- phr.["the fibers of the cricothyroid muscle that are inserted into the caudal margin of the thyroid cartilage."]

64420 pars recta tubuli renalis
- 
- phr.["肾小管直部"]
- phr.["straight tubule; see tubulus rectus proximalis and tubulus rectus distalis."]

64421 pars respiratoria cavitatis nasi
- 
- phr.["鼻腔呼吸部"]
- phr.["respiratory region: the part of the nasal cavity inferior to the olfactory region."]

64422 pars reticularis substantiae nigrae
- 
- phr.["黑质网状部"]
- phr.["reticular part of substantia nigra: the anterior part of the substantia nigra, which contains fewer cells than the pars compacta, only some of which contain a small amount of pigment."]

64423 pars retrolentiformis capsulae internae
- 
- phr.["内囊豆状核后部"]
- phr.["retrolentiform part of internal capsule: that part of the internal capsule resting on the lateral surface of the thalamus behind the lentiform nucleus, and containing the posterior thalamic radiation. Called also retrolenticular or retrolentiform limb of internal capsule."]

64424 pars sacralis medullae spinalis
- 
- phr.["脊髓骶部"]
- phr.["sacral part of spinal cord: the part of the cord that is within the lumbar part of the vertebral canal and gives rise to the five pairs of sacral spinal nerves (segmenta sacralia medullae spinalis [1–5])."]

64425 pars sphenoidalis arteriae cerebri mediae
- 
- phr.["大脑中动脉蝶骨部"]
- phr.["sphenoid part of middle cerebral artery: collectively, the segment of the middle cerebral artery and the branches from it that supply the internal capsule, thalamus, and corpus striatum (M1 segment); the branches comprise the anterolateral central arteries, anterior temporal artery, and polar temporal artery. Called also p. horizontalis arteriae cerebri mediae [TA alternative]. See also segments of middle cerebral artery, under segment."]

64426 pars spinalis musculi deltoidei
- 
- phr.["三角肌脊髓部"]
- phr.["spinal part of deltoid muscle: the posterior unipennate portion of the deltoid muscle, originating on the lower border of the spine of scapula and acting with latissimus dorsi and teres major in drawing the arm backwards and rotating it laterally."]

64427 pars spinalis nervi accessorii
- 
- phr.["副神经脊髓部"]
- phr.["TA alternative for radix spinalis nervi accessorii."]

64428 pars spongiosa urethrae masculinae
- 
- phr.["男性尿道海绵体部"]
- phr.["spongy part of male urethra: the portion of the urethra within the corpus spongiosum of the penis. Called also spongiose or spongy urethra."]

64429 pars squamosa ossis temporalis
- 
- phr.["颞骨鳞部"]
- phr.["squamous part of temporal bone: the flat, scalelike, anterior and superior portion of the temporal bone; called also squama temporalis."]

64430 pars sternalis diaphragmatis
- 
- phr.["膈胸骨部"]
- phr.["sternal part of diaphragm: the portion of the thoracic diaphragm that arises from the inner aspect of the xiphoid process of the sternum."]

64431 pars sternocostalis musculi pectoralis majoris
- 
- phr.["胸大肌胸肋部"]
- phr.["sternocostal part of pectoralis major muscle: the portion of the muscle that originates from the sternum and the ribs."]

64432 pars sublentiformis capsulae internae
- 
- phr.["内囊豆状核下部"]
- phr.["sublentiform part of internal capsule: the part of the internal capsule lying inferior to the posterior part of the lentiform nucleus, and containing the temporopontine, geniculocalcarine, and auditory radiation fibers. Called also sublenticular limb of internal capsule and sublentiform limb of internal capsule."]

64433 pars superficialis glandulae parotideae
- 
- phr.["腮腺浅部"]
- phr.["superficial part of parotid gland: that part of the parotid gland located superficial to the facial nerve."]

64434 pars superficialis musculi masseteris
- 
- phr.["咬肌浅部"]
- phr.["superficial part of masseter muscle: the part of the muscle whose fibers arise from the anterior part of the zygomatic arch and are directed inferiorly and posteriorly."]

64435 pars superior alaris lobuli centralis cerebelli
- 
- phr.["小脑中央小叶翼上部"]
- phr.["the superior part of the wing of the central lobule of the cerebellum (HIII); called also p. dorsalis alaris lobuli centralis cerebelli [TA alternative] and dorsal part of wing of central lobule of cerebellum."]

64436 pars superior duodeni
- 
- phr.["十二指肠上部"]
- phr.["superior part of duodenum: the most proximal part of the duodenum, adjacent to the pylorus; it forms the superior duodenal flexure."]

64437 pars superior faciei diaphragmaticae hepatis
- 
- phr.["肝膈面上部"]
- phr.["superior part of diaphragmatic surface of liver: the most superior part of the diaphragmatic surface, projecting convexly upward."]

64438 pars superior nervi vestibularis
- 
- phr.["前庭神经上部"]
- phr.["superior part of vestibular nerve: the superior branch of the nerve, which has filaments that end in the ampullary crests of the anterior and lateral semicircular ducts and the macula of the utricle."]

64439 pars superior venae lingularis
- 
- phr.["小舌静脉上部"]
- phr.["superior part of lingular vein: a venous branch that drains the superior lingular segment of the left lung and drains into the lingular vein. Called also superior lingular segmental vein."]

64440 pars supraclavicularis plexus brachialis
- 
- phr.["臂丛锁骨上部"]
- phr.["supraclavicular part of brachial plexus: the part of the brachial plexus lying in the cervical region above the level of the clavicle, in which arise the dorsal scapular, long thoracic, and suprascapular nerves, and the nerve to the subclavius muscle."]

64441 pars tecta duodeni
- 
- phr.["十二指肠上部"]
- phr.["hidden part of duodenum: a portion of the duodenum that is concealed by the overlying transverse colon, ascending colon, and root of the mesentery."]

64442 pars terminalis ilei
- 
- phr.["肠梗阻尾部"]
- phr.["terminal part of ileum: the part just before the ileum meets the cecum at the ileal orifice and ileal papilla; called also terminal ileum."]

64443 pars thoracica aortae
- 
- phr.["胸主动脉，主动脉胸部"]
- phr.["thoracic part of aorta: the proximal portion of the descending aorta, which proceeds from the arch of the aorta and gives rise to the bronchial, esophageal, pericardiac, and mediastinal branches, and the superior phrenic, posterior intercostal III to XI, and subcostal arteries; it is continuous through the diaphragm with the abdominal aorta. Called also thoracic aorta and aorta thoracica [TA alternative].Pars thoracica aortae (thoracic aorta) and the arteries and branches to which it gives rise."]

64444 pars thoracica ductus thoracici
- 
- phr.["胸导管胸部"]
- phr.["the thoracic part of the thoracic duct; see ductus thoracicus."]

64445 pars thoracica medullae spinalis
- 
- phr.["脊髓胸段"]
- phr.["thoracic part of spinal cord: the part of the cord that is within the upper three fourths of the thoracic part of the vertebral canal (in the adult) and gives rise to the twelve pairs of thoracic spinal nerves (segmenta thoracica medullae spinalis [1–12])."]

64446 pars thoracica musculi iliocostalis lumborum
- 
- phr.["腰髂肋肌胸部"]
- phr.["thoracic part of iliocostalis lumborum: origin, upper borders of angles of six lower ribs; insertion, angles of six upper ribs and transverse process of seventh cervical vertebra; innervation, branches of thoracic; action, keeps thoracic spine erect."]

64447 pars thoracica oesophagi
- 
- phr.["食管胸部，食道胸部"]
- phr.["thoracic part of esophagus: the part of the esophagus located in the thoracic region, posterior to the trachea and pericardium and anterior to the vertebral column. Called also thoracic esophagus."]

64448 pars thoracica tracheae
- 
- phr.["气管胸部"]
- phr.["the part of the trachea that lies posteriorly in the superior mediastinum, separated from the upper four thoracic vertebrae by the esophagus."]

64449 pars thyroepiglottica musculi thyroarytenoidei
- 
- phr.["甲杓肌甲状会厌部"]
- phr.["thyroepiglottic part of thyroarytenoid muscle: fibers of the thyroarytenoid muscle that continue to the margin of the epiglottis; it closes the inlet to the larynx. Called also thyroepiglottic muscle."]

64450 pars thyropharyngea musculi constrictoris pharyngis inferioris
- 
- phr.["咽下缩肌甲咽部"]
- phr.["thyropharyngeal part of inferior constrictor muscle of pharynx: the part of the inferior constrictor muscle arising from the thyroid cartilage; called also thyropharyngeal muscle and musculus thyropharyngeus [TA alternative]."]

64451 pars tibiocalcanea ligamenti collateralis medialis
- 
- phr.["内侧副韧带胫跟部"]
- phr.["tibiocalcaneal part of medial collateral ligament: the middle portion of the superficial fibers of the medial collateral ligament of the ankle joint, attached superiorly to the medial malleolus of the tibia and inferiorly into nearly the entire length of the sustentaculum tali of the calcaneus. Called also calcaneotibial ligament, ligamentum calcaneotibiale, and tibiocalcaneal or tibiocalcanean ligament."]

64452 pars tibionavicularis ligamenti collateralis medialis
- 
- phr.["内侧副韧带胫舟部"]
- phr.["tibionavicular part of medial collateral ligament: the anterior portion of the superficial fibers of the medial collateral ligament of the ankle joint, attached superiorly to the anterior surface of the medial malleolus of the tibia and inferiorly to the navicular bone and the margin of the calcaneonavicular ligament. Called also ligamentum tibionaviculare and tibionavicular ligament."]

64453 pars tibiotalaris anterior ligamenti collateralis medialis
- 
- phr.["内侧副韧带胫距前部"]
- phr.["anterior tibiotalar part of medial collateral ligament: the deeper portion of the medial collateral ligament of the ankle joint, attached superiorly to the medial malleolus of the tibia and inferiorly to the medial surface of the talus. Called also ligamentum talotibiale anterius and anterior talotibial ligament."]

64454 pars tibiotalaris posterior ligamenti collateralis medialis
- 
- phr.["内侧副韧带胫距后部"]
- phr.["posterior tibiotalar part of medial collateral ligament: the posterior portion of the superficial fibers of the medial collateral ligament of the ankle joint, attached superiorly to the posterior part of the medial malleolus of the tibia and inferiorly to the medial surface of the talus. Called also ligamentum talotibiale posterius and posterior talotibial ligament."]

64455 pars transversa musculi nasalis
- 
- phr.["鼻肌横部"]
- phr.["transverse part of nasalis muscle: the part of the nasalis muscle arising from the maxilla on either side just lateral to the nasal notch and inserting on the bridge of the nose; it compresses the nasal opening. Called also compressor muscle of naris and compressor naris."]

64456 pars transversa rami sinistri venae portae hepatis
- 
- phr.["肝门静脉左支横部"]
- phr.["the transverse part of the left branch of the hepatic portal vein."]

64457 pars transversaria arteriae vertebralis
- 
- phr.["椎动脉横突部"]
- phr.["cervical part of vertebral artery: the second part of the vertebral artery, ascending through the transverse foramina of the upper six cervical vertebrae; it has spinal and muscular branches. Called also p. cervicalis arteriae vertebralis [TA alternative]."]

64458 pars triangularis gyri frontalis inferioris
- 
- phr.["额下回三角部"]
- phr.["triangular part of inferior frontal gyrus: the wedge-shaped part of the inferior frontal lobe that lies between the anterior and ascending branches of the lateral sulcus of the cerebral hemisphere bordered by the pars orbitalis anteriorly and the pars opercularis posteriorly. See also operculum frontale (defs. 1 and 2)."]

64459 pars tuberalis adenohypophyseos
- 
- phr.["腺垂体结节部"]
- phr.["tuberal part of adenohypophysis: a part consisting of a thin cloak of cells on the anterior and lateral surfaces of the infundibulum. It provides a vascular communication between the hypothalamus and the pituitary gland and secretes some hormones."]

64460 pars tympanica ossis temporalis
- 
- phr.["颞骨鼓部"]
- phr.["tympanic part of temporal bone: the curved bony plate, developed from the annulus tympanicus of the fetus, forming the anterior and inferior walls and part of the posterior wall of the external auditory meatus in the adult; called also tympanic plate."]

64461 pars umbilicalis rami sinistri venae portae hepatis
- 
- phr.["肝门静脉左支脐部"]
- phr.["umbilical part of left branch: the part of the left branch of the hepatic portal vein that passes from the hilum of the liver to the umbilicus."]

64538 Parvoviridae
- /ˌpɑ:vəʊˈvɪrɪdi:/
- n.["细小病毒科"]
- n.["the parvoviruses: a family of DNA viruses having a nonenveloped virion 18–26 nm in diameter composed of 60 copies of the capsid protein with icosahedral symmetry. The genome consists of a single molecule of linear single-stranded DNA (MW 1.5–2.2 × 106, size 4–6 kb). Viruses contain 2–4 major polypeptides, depending on the species, and are resistant to heat, lipid solvents, deoxycholate, and nucleases but sensitive to formalin, β-propiolactone, hydroxylamine, oxidizing agents, and ultraviolet radiation. Replication and assembly occur in the nucleus and require S-phase cellular function in the host cell or the presence of helper virus. Host range is narrow and transmission may be vertical or by mechanical vectors. There are two subclasses: Densovirinae, comprising genera that infect invertebrates, and Parvovirinae, comprising genera that infect vertebrates."]

Viruses multiply in the nucleus and require S-phase cellular functions for replication. Transmission is transplacental or by mechanical vector. Human parvoviruses cause transient aplastic crisis, acute arthritis, erythema infectiosum, hydrops fetalis, spontaneous abortion, and fetal death. Animal pathogens include bovine, canine, feline, and goose parvoviruses, feline panleukopenia virus, mink enteritis virus, Aleutian mink disease virus, and various murine parvoviruses."]

The pelvis is divided by a plane passing through the terminal lines into the p. major superiorly and the p. minor inferiorly. The superior boundary of the pelvic cavity is the inlet (apertura pelvis superior [TA]), and the inferior boundary of the pelvis minor is the outlet (apertura pelvis inferior [TA]), which is bounded by the coccyx, the symphysis pubis, and the ischium of either side. The outlet is closed by the coccygeus and levator ani muscles and the perineal fascia, which form the floor of the pelvis. The inlet and outlet each have three important diameters: an anteroposterior (conjugate), an oblique, and a transverse, the relations of which determine types variously classified by different authors (see illustration under diameter).Anterior aspect of female (A) and male (B) pelvis.","any basinlike structure."]

Then comes the paroxysmal stage, lasting three to four weeks, with the characteristic paroxysmal cough that gives the condition its name: the patient has a deep inspiration followed by a series of quick, short coughs that continue until the air is expelled from the lungs to end with a long shrill, whooping inspiration because of spasmodic closure of the glottis. Phosphorus is an essential element in the diet; it is a major component of the mineral phase of bone and is abundant in all tissues, being involved in some form in almost all metabolic processes. - n.["the picornaviruses: a family of RNA viruses having a nonenveloped icosahedral virion 22–30 nm in diameter without surface features. The genome consists of a single molecule of positive-sense single-stranded RNA (MW approximately 2.5 × 106, size 7.2–8.5 kb). Viruses contain four major polypeptides and are resistant to lipid solvents but sensitive to ultraviolet radiation. Replication and assembly occur in the cytoplasm; virions are released by cell destruction. Host range is narrow and transmission is chiefly mechanical. Genera of medical or veterinary importance include Aphthovirus, Cardiovirus, Enterovirus, Hepatovirus, Parechovirus, and Rhinovirus."]

67869 placenta
- /pləˈsentə/
- n.["胎盘"]
- n.["a fetomaternal organ characteristic of true mammals during pregnancy, joining mother and fetus, providing endocrine secretion and selective exchange of soluble, bloodborne substances through an apposition of uterine and trophoblastic vascularized parts. According to species, the area of vascular apposition may be diffuse, cotyledonary, zonary, or discoid; the nature of apposition may be labyrinthine or villous; and the intimacy of apposition may vary according to what layers are lost of those originally interposed between maternal and fetal blood (maternal endothelium, uterine connective tissue, uterine epithelium, chorion, extraembryonic mesoderm, and endothelium of villous capillary). The chorion may be joined by and receive blood vessels from either the yolk sac or the allantois, and the uterine lining may be largely shed with the chorion at birth (deciduate p.) or may separate from the chorion and remain (nondeciduate p.). The human placenta is discoid, villous, hemochorial, chorioallantoic, and deciduate. After birth, it weighs about 600 g and is about 16 cm in diameter and 2 cm thick, discounting the decidua basalis and the maternal blood in the intervillous space (a principal functional part into which the chorionic villi dip and which leaks out at birth). The villi are grouped into adjoining cotyledons making about 20 velvety bumps on the side of the placenta facing the uterus; the side facing the fetus is smooth and covered with amnion, a thin avascular layer that continues past the edges of the placenta to line the entire hollow sphere of chorion except where it is reflected to cover the umbilical cord. The umbilical cord joins fetus and placenta and usually joins the placenta near the center, although it sometimes inserts at the edge, on the nonplacental chorion, or on an accessory placenta.Structural features of the placenta."]

Plasmin solubilizes fibrin clots and also degrades various proteins including fibrinogen and coagulation factors V and VII. Plasminogen is activated for therapeutic thrombolysis by recombinant forms of physiologic activators and by streptokinase, a streptococcal enzyme. Bovine plasmin is used for the débridement of wounds. Called also fibrinolysin."]

68086 Plasmodium
- /plæzˈməʊdɪəm/
- n.["疟原虫属"]
- n.["the malarial parasites: a genus of coccidian protozoa of the suborder Haemosporina, order Eucoccidiida. Several species are parasitic in the erythrocytes of mammals; others parasitize birds and reptiles. Protozoal sporozoites concentrate in the salivary glands of female anopheline mosquitoes and are transmitted to the bloodstream of mammals when the mosquito bites them. The first stage inside the mammal's body is the preerythrocytic or exoerythrocytic stage; the sporozoites migrate through the bloodstream and enter the liver (intrahepatic stage). In the liver they develop and multiply within the hepatic cells and become merozoites. Eventually the merozoites burst the hepatic cells and invade erythrocytes to begin the erythrocytic stage. Inside the erythrocytes, schizogony takes place and the merozoites are capable of invading other erythrocytes. Some merozoites develop into gametocytes, and when these are ingested by bloodsucking mosquitoes, they begin the gametocyte stage, a sexual stage that completes the life cycle, ending with development of new sporozoites inside the mosquito. Malaria in birds is transmitted by culicine mosquitoes."]
