- n.["胸膜肺松解术"]
- n.["division of adhesions between the lung and the parietal pleura; see also pleurolysis."]

68317 pleuropulmonary
- /ˌplʊərəʊˈpʌlmənərɪ/
- adj.["胸膜肺的"]
- adj.["pertaining to the pleura and lungs."]

68318 pleuropulmonary amebiasis
- 
- phr.["胸膜肺阿米巴病"]
- phr.["amebic infection in the thoracic space, secondary to intestinal amebiasis and usually associated with amebic liver abscesses; it may affect the pleura, diaphragm, lung, or bronchi."]

68319 pleuroscopy
- /plʊəˈrɒskəpɪ/
- n.["胸腔镜检查"]
- n.["thoracoscopy."]

68320 pleurosoma
- /ˌplʊərəˈsəʊmə/
- n.["体侧露脏畸胎"]
- n.["pleurosomus."]

68321 pleurosomus
- /ˌplʊərəˈsəʊməs/
- n.["体侧露脏畸胎"]
- n.["a fetus with protrusion of the intestine and imperfect development of one upper limb."]

68322 pleurothotonos
- /ˌplʊərəˈθɒtənɒs/
- n.["侧弓反张"]
- n.["tetanic bending of the body to one side."]

68323 pleurothotonus
- /ˌplʊərəˈθɒtənəs/
- n.["侧弓反张"]
- n.["pleurothotonos."]

68324 pleurotome
- /ˈplʊərətəʊm/
- adj.["肺节"]
- adj.["an area of the lung supplied with afferent nerve fibers by a single posterior spinal root."]

68325 pleurotomy
- /plʊəˈrɒtəmɪ/
- n.["胸膜切开术"]
- n.["thoracotomy."]

68326 pleurotyphoid
- /ˌplʊərəˈtaɪfɔɪd/
- adj.["胸膜型伤寒"]
- adj.["acute pleurisy followed by and complicated with typhoid fever."]

68327 pleurovisceral
- /ˌplʊərəˈvɪsərəl/
- adj.["胸膜内脏的"]
- adj.["pertaining to the pleura and the viscera."]

68328 PLEVA
- 
- abbr.["pityriasis lichenoides et varioliformis acuta 急性苔藓痘疮样糠疹"]
- abbr.["pityriasis lichenoides et varioliformis acuta."]

68329 plexectomy
- /plekˈsektəmɪ/
- n.["丛切除术"]
- n.["surgical excision of a plexus."]

68330 plexiform
- /ˈpleksɪfɔ:m/
- adj.["丛状的"]
- adj.["resembling a plexus or network. Cf. reticular."]

68331 plexiform ameloblastoma
- 
- phr.["丛状型成釉细胞瘤"]
- phr.["ameloblastoma, often cystic, in which the neoplastic cells have formed an interconnected network of strands."]

68332 plexiform layer of cerebellar cortex
- 
- phr.["小脑皮质丛状层"]
- phr.["stratum moleculare corticis cerebelli."]

68333 plexiform layer of cerebral cortex
- 
- phr.["大脑皮质丛状层"]
- phr.["lamina molecularis."]

68334 plexiform neurofibroma
- 
- phr.["丛状神经纤维瘤"]
- phr.["a fusiform, ropelike enlargement of a nerve, consisting of Schwann cells, fibroblasts, and inflammatory cells in a loose myxoid ground, usually occurring as multiple lesions in neurofibromatosis 1, although occasionally arising as a solitary, spontaneous lesion. Called also plexiform or Verneuil neuroma."]

68335 plexiform neuroma
- 
- phr.["丛状神经瘤，蔓状神经瘤"]
- phr.["see under neurofibroma."]

68336 plexiform schwannoma
- 
- phr.["丛状神经鞘瘤"]
- phr.["a rare type of schwannoma characterized by an interconnecting multinodular pattern of intraneural growth, arising most often in soft tissues of the head and neck."]

68337 plexiform unicystic ameloblastoma
- 
- phr.["丛状单囊性成釉细胞瘤"]
- phr.["a variant of unicystic ameloblastoma in which there is ameloblastic proliferation in an epithelial network on the cyst wall; it occurs in young adults, usually in the mandibular molar area."]

68338 pleximeter
- /plekˈsɪmɪtə/
- n.["叩诊板；皮像板，透皮玻片"]
- n.["diascope.","originally, a hard plate, now most often the terminal phalanx of the middle finger of the nondominant hand, placed against the chest and struck with the plexor in mediate percussion."]

68339 pleximetric percussion
- 
- phr.["间接叩诊"]
- phr.["mediate p."]

68340 plexitis
- /plekˈsaɪtɪs/
- n.["神经丛炎"]
- n.["inflammation of a nerve plexus."]

68341 plexogenic
- /ˈpleksəˌʤenɪk/
- adj.["丛原的"]
- adj.["giving rise to a plexus or plexiform structure."]

68342 plexogenic arteriopathy
- 
- phr.["丛源性动脉病"]
- phr.["hypertrophy of arterial walls in part of the pulmonary vasculature, which may become obstructed, leading to plexiform thin-walled vessels distally; seen in some cases of pulmonary hypertension. Cf. Ayerza syndrome."]

68343 plexopathy
- /plekˈsɒpəθɪ/
- n.["丛病"]
- n.["any disorder of a plexus, especially of nerves."]

68344 plexor
- /ˈpleksə/
- n.["叩诊槌"]
- n.["percussion hammer, or the index or middle finger of the dominant hand used as a hammer in percussion."]

68345 plexus
- /ˈpleksəs/
- adj.["丛"]
- adj.["a network of lymphatic vessels, nerves, or veins. See also net, network, and rete."]

68346 plexus anesthesia
- 
- phr.["神经丛麻醉"]
- phr.["anesthesia produced by the injection of a local anesthetic around a nerve plexus."]

68347 plexus aorticus
- 
- phr.["主动脉丛"]
- phr.["a network of lymphatic vessels about the aorta."]

68348 plexus aorticus abdominalis
- 
- phr.["腹主动脉丛"]
- phr.["abdominal aortic plexus: an unpaired nerve plexus composed of interconnecting bundles of fibers that arise from the celiac and superior mesenteric plexuses and descend along the aorta. Receiving branches from the lumbar splanchnic nerves, it becomes the superior hypogastric plexus below the bifurcation of the aorta. Branches of the plexus are distributed along the adjacent branches of the aorta."]

68349 plexus aorticus thoracalis
- 
- phr.["胸主动脉丛"]
- phr.["thoracic aortic plexus: a nerve plexus around the thoracic aorta formed by filaments from the sympathetic trunks and vagus nerves, and from which fine twigs accompany branches of the aorta. It is continuous below with the celiac plexus and the abdominal aortic plexus."]

68350 plexus arteriae ovaricae
- 
- phr.["卵巢动脉丛"]
- phr.["p. ovaricus."]

68351 plexus autonomicus
- 
- phr.["自主神经丛"]
- phr.["autonomic plexus: any of the extensive networks of nerve fibers and cell bodies associated with the autonomic nervous system; found particularly in the thorax, abdomen, and pelvis, and containing sympathetic, parasympathetic, and visceral afferent fibers. Called also visceral p."]

68352 plexus basilaris
- 
- phr.["基底丛"]
- phr.["basilar plexus: a venous plexus of the dura mater situated over the basilar part of the occipital bone and the posterior portion of the body of the sphenoid, extending from the cavernous sinus to the foramen magnum, and communicating with other dural sinuses."]

68353 plexus brachialis
- 
- phr.["臂丛"]
- phr.["brachial plexus: a plexus originating from the anterior branches of the last four cervical spinal nerves and most of the anterior branch of the first thoracic spinal nerves. Situated partly in the neck and partly in the axilla, it is composed successively of anterior branches and trunks (supraclavicular part) which are related to the subclavian artery and which give off the dorsal scapular, long thoracic, subclavius, and suprascapular nerves. The infraclavicular part consists of divisions which lie approximately behind the clavicle and cords and branches in the axilla in relation to the axillary artery. Its branches are medial and lateral pectoral, medial brachial cutaneous, medial antebrachial cutaneous, median, ulnar radial, subscapular, thoracodorsal, and axillary nerves.Plexus brachialis (brachial plexus). Anterior view, showing the most major branches."]

68354 plexus cardiacus
- 
- phr.["心丛"]
- phr.["cardiac plexus: the plexus around the base of the heart, chiefly in the epicardium. It is formed by cardiac branches from the vagus nerves and the sympathetic trunks and ganglia, contains visceral afferent fibers, and shows subdivisions related to the arch of the aorta, right and left atria, and right and left coronary arteries. The cardiac plexus is continuous with the right and left pulmonary plexuses."]

68355 plexus caroticus communis
- 
- phr.["颈总动脉丛"]
- phr.["common carotid plexus: a nerve plexus on the common carotid artery, formed by branches of the internal and external carotid plexuses and the cervical sympathetic ganglia."]

68356 plexus caroticus externus
- 
- phr.["颈外动脉丛"]
- phr.["external carotid plexus: a nerve plexus located around the external carotid artery, formed by the external carotid nerves from the superior cervical ganglion, and supplying sympathetic fibers which accompany the branches of the external carotid artery."]

68357 plexus caroticus internus
- 
- phr.["颈内动脉丛"]
- phr.["internal carotid plexus: a nerve plexus on the internal carotid artery, formed by the internal carotid nerve, which supplies sympathetic fibers to the branches of the internal carotid artery, to the tympanic plexus, to the nerves in the cavernous sinus, and, directly or indirectly, to the cranial parasympathetic ganglia through which they pass."]

68358 plexus cavernosus
- 
- phr.["海绵丛；海绵窦丛"]
- phr.["a plexus of sympathetic nerve fibers related to the cavernous sinus of the dura mater."]

68359 plexus cavernosus conchae
- 
- phr.["鼻甲海绵丛"]
- phr.["cavernous plexus of concha: any of the numerous venous plexuses in the thick mucous membrane of the nasal conchae."]

68360 plexus cervicalis
- 
- phr.["颈丛"]
- phr.["cervical plexus: a nerve plexus formed by the anterior branches of the upper four cervical nerves; arranged as an irregular series of loops, it gives off superficial branches (lesser occipital, greater auricular, transverse cervical, and supraclavicular nerves), and deep branches (phrenic, accessory phrenic, ansa cervicalis, and muscular nerves)."]

68361 plexus choroideus ventriculi lateralis
- 
- phr.["侧脑室脉络丛"]
- phr.["choroid plexus of lateral ventricle: vascular, fringelike folds of the pia mater in the floor of the pars centralis and the roof of the temporal horn of the lateral ventricle, concerned with production of the cerebrospinal fluid."]

68362 plexus choroideus ventriculi quarti
- 
- phr.["第四脑室脉络丛"]
- phr.["choroid plexus of fourth ventricle: vascular fringelike folds of the pia mater in the roof of the posterior part of the fourth ventricle and extending into and through the lateral recesses and the foramina of Luschka; concerned with production of the cerebrospinal fluid."]

68363 plexus choroideus ventriculi tertii
- 
- phr.["第三脑室脉络丛"]
- phr.["choroid plexus of third ventricle: vascular, fringelike folds of the pia mater in the roof of the third ventricle, concerned with production of the cerebrospinal fluid."]

68364 plexus coccygeus
- 
- phr.["尾丛"]
- phr.["coccygeal plexus: a small plexus formed by the anterior branches of the coccygeal and the fifth sacral nerves, and a communication from the fourth sacral nerve, and giving off the anococcygeal nerves."]

68365 plexus coeliacus
- 
- phr.["腹丛；腹腔淋巴丛"]
- phr.["celiac plexus: a prevertebral plexus that lies on the front and sides of the aorta at the origins of the celiac trunk and superior mesenteric and renal arteries. It contains the paired celiac ganglia, the superior mesenteric ganglion (or ganglia), and small unnamed ganglionic masses. Branches of the plexus extend along all of the adjacent arteries. Called also solar p. Also spelled p. celiacus.","a plexus composed of lymphatic vessels, the superior mesenteric lymph nodes, and the celiac lymph nodes behind the stomach, duodenum, and pancreas. Called also celiac p. and p. celiacus."]

68366 plexus deferentialis
- 
- phr.["输精管丛"]
- phr.["deferential plexus: the subdivision of the inferior hypogastric plexus that supplies nerve fibers to the ductus deferens. Called also p. of ductus deferens."]

68367 plexus dentalis inferior
- 
- phr.["下牙丛"]
- phr.["inferior dental plexus: a plexus of nerve fibers from the inferior alveolar nerve, situated around the roots of the lower teeth."]

68368 plexus dentalis superior
- 
- phr.["上牙丛"]
- phr.["superior dental plexus: a plexus of fibers from the superior alveolar nerves, situated around the roots of the upper teeth."]

68369 plexus entericus
- 
- phr.["肠丛"]
- phr.["enteric plexus: a plexus of autonomic nerve fibers within the wall of the intestine, and made up of the submucosal, myenteric, and subserosal plexuses; it contains visceral afferent fibers, sympathetic postganglionic fibers, parasympathetic preganglionic and postganglionic fibers, and parasympathetic postganglionic cell bodies."]

68370 plexus femoralis
- 
- phr.["股丛"]
- phr.["femoral plexus: a plexus accompanying the femoral artery, derived chiefly from the aortic plexus by way of the common and external iliac plexuses."]

68371 plexus gastrici
- 
- phr.["胃丛"]
- phr.["gastric plexuses: subdivisions of the celiac portion of the prevertebral plexuses, accompanying the gastric arteries and branches and supplying nerve fibers to the stomach."]

68372 plexus hepaticus
- 
- phr.["肝丛"]
- phr.["hepatic plexus: a subdivision of the celiac plexus accompanying the hepatic artery to the liver."]

68373 plexus hypogastricus
- 
- phr.["腹下丛"]
- phr.["the hypogastric portion of the prevertebral plexuses; see p. hypogastricus inferior and p. hypogastricus superior.","a plexus of lymphatic vessels in the hypogastric region."]

68374 plexus hypogastricus inferior
- 
- phr.["下腹下丛"]
- phr.["inferior hypogastric plexus: the plexus formed on each side anterior to the lower part of the sacrum, formed by the junction of the hypogastric and pelvic splanchnic nerves; branches are given off to the pelvic organs. Called also pelvic p., p. pelvicus [TA alternative] and p. pelvina."]

68375 plexus hypogastricus superior
- 
- phr.["上腹下丛"]
- phr.["superior hypogastric plexus: the downward continuation of the abdominal aortic plexus; it lies in front of the upper part of the sacrum, just below the bifurcation of the aorta, receives fibers from the lower lumbar splanchnic nerves, and divides into the right and left hypogastric nerves. Called also nervus presacralis [TA alternative] or presacral nerve."]

68376 plexus iliacus
- 
- phr.["髂丛"]
- phr.["iliac plexus: any of the plexuses derived chiefly from the aortic plexus and accompanying the common iliac arteries."]

68377 plexus iliacus externus
- 
- phr.["髂外丛"]
- phr.["a lymphatic plexus situated about the external iliac vessels."]

68378 plexus inguinalis
- 
- phr.["腹股沟（淋巴）丛"]
- phr.["inguinal plexus: a lymphatic plexus situated near the end of the long saphenous vein and along the femoral artery and vein in the iliopectineal fossa."]

68379 plexus intermesentericus
- 
- phr.["肠系膜间丛"]
- phr.["intermesenteric plexus: the part of the aortic plexus that is located between the origins of the superior and inferior mesenteric arteries."]

68380 plexus intraparotideus
- 
- phr.["腮脉内丛"]
- phr.["parotid plexus: a plexus formed by anastomosis of the terminal branches of the temporal, zygomatic, buccal, marginal mandibular, and cervical rami of the facial nerve, arising in the parotid gland. Called also p. parotideus."]

68381 plexus jugularis
- 
- phr.["颈静脉丛"]
- phr.["jugular plexus: a plexus of lymphatic vessels along the internal jugular vein."]

68382 plexus lienalis
- 
- phr.["脾丛"]
- phr.["TA alternative for p. splenicus."]

68383 plexus lumbalis
- 
- phr.["腰丛；腰淋巴丛"]
- phr.["lumbar plexus: a plexus formed by the anterior branches of the second to fifth lumbar nerves in the psoas major muscle (the branches of the first lumbar nerve often are included). The lower division of the fourth lumbar nerve joins the fifth, and the lumbosacral trunk thus formed becomes part of the sacral plexus. The branches of the first lumbar nerve are the ilioinguinal and iliohypogastric nerves; branches of the plexus proper are the genitofemoral, lateral femoral cutaneous, obturator, and femoral nerves.","a lymphatic plexus in the lumbar region.Plexus lumbalis (lumbar plexus), in yellow, in lateral (A) and anterior (B) views, with the divisions forming the lumbosacral trunk shown in white, as is the sacral plexus."]

68384 plexus lumbaris
- 
- phr.["腰丛"]
- phr.["p. lumbalis (def. 1)."]

68385 plexus lumbosacralis
- 
- phr.["腰骶丛"]
- phr.["lumbosacral plexus: a term applied to the lumbar and sacral nerve plexuses together, because of their continuous nature."]

68386 plexus lymphaticus axillaris
- 
- phr.["腋淋巴管丛"]
- phr.["axillary lymphatic plexus: a plexus of lymph vessels and nodes in the fossa axillaris."]

68387 plexus mesentericus inferior
- 
- phr.["肠系膜下丛"]
- phr.["inferior mesenteric plexus: a subdivision of the aortic plexus accompanying the inferior mesenteric artery."]

68388 plexus mesentericus superior
- 
- phr.["肠系膜上丛"]
- phr.["superior mesenteric plexus: a subdivision of the celiac plexus accompanying the superior mesenteric artery."]

68389 plexus myentericus
- 
- phr.["肠肌丛"]
- phr.["myenteric plexus: that part of the enteric plexus within the tunica muscularis. Called also Auerbach p."]

68390 plexus nervorum spinalium
- 
- phr.["脊神经丛"]
- phr.["plexus of spinal nerves: a plexus formed by the intermingling of the fibers of two or more spinal nerves, such as the brachial or lumbosacral plexus."]

68391 plexus of anterior cerebral artery
- 
- phr.["大脑前动脉丛"]
- phr.["a thin plexus of sympathetic nerve fibers accompanying the anterior cerebral artery."]

68392 plexus of ductus deferens
- 
- phr.["输精管丛"]
- phr.["p. deferentialis."]

68393 plexus of medial cerebral artery
- 
- phr.["大脑中动脉丛"]
- phr.["a thin plexus of sympathetic nerve fibers accompanying the middle cerebral artery."]

68394 plexus of spinal nerves
- 
- phr.["脊神经丛"]
- phr.["p. nervorum spinalium."]

68395 plexus ovaricus
- 
- phr.["卵巢丛"]
- phr.["ovarian plexus: a subdivision of the aortic plexus, accompanying the ovarian arteries; called also p. arteriae ovaricae."]

68396 plexus pancreaticus
- 
- phr.["胰丛"]
- phr.["pancreatic plexus: a subdivision of the celiac plexus, accompanying pancreatic arteries."]

68397 plexus pelvicus
- 
- phr.["下腹下丛，盆丛"]
- phr.["TA alternative for p. hypogastricus inferior."]

68398 plexus pelvina
- 
- phr.["盆丛，下腹下丛"]
- phr.["p. hypogastricus inferior."]

68399 plexus periarterialis
- 
- phr.["动脉周丛"]
- phr.["periarterial plexus: a network of autonomic and sensory nerve fibers in the adventitia of an artery, some of which follow the course of the artery to reach and innervate other structures and some of which innervate the artery itself."]

68400 plexus pharyngealis
- 
- phr.["咽静脉丛，咽丛"]
- phr.["p. pharyngeus."]

68401 plexus pharyngealis nervi vagi
- 
- phr.["迷走神经咽丛"]
- phr.["p. pharyngeus nervi vagi."]

68402 plexus pharyngeus
- 
- phr.["咽丛"]
- phr.["pharyngeal plexus: a venous plexus posterolateral to the pharynx, formed by the pharyngeal veins, communicating with the pterygoid venous plexus, and draining into the internal jugular vein. Called also p. pharyngealis."]

68403 plexus pharyngeus nervi vagi
- 
- phr.["迷走神经咽丛"]
- phr.["pharyngeal plexus of vagus nerve: a plexus formed chiefly by fibers from branches of the vagus nerves, but also containing fibers from the glossopharyngeal nerves and sympathetic trunks, and supplying motor, general sensory, and sympathetic innervation to the muscles and mucosa of the pharynx and soft palate, except for the tensor veli palatini muscle. Called also p. pharyngealis nervi vagi."]

68404 plexus prostaticus
- 
- phr.["前列腺丛"]
- phr.["prostatic plexus: a subdivision of the inferior hypogastric plexus that supplies nerve fibers to the prostate and adjacent organs. Called also Santorini p."]

68405 plexus pterygoideus
- 
- phr.["翼丛"]
- phr.["pterygoid plexus: a network of veins corresponding to the second and third parts of the maxillary artery; situated on the lateral surface of the medial pterygoid muscle and on both surfaces of the lateral pterygoid muscle, and draining into the facial vein. Called also p. venosus pterygoideus."]

68406 plexus pulmonalis
- 
- phr.["肺丛"]
- phr.["a nerve plexus formed by several strong trunks of the vagus nerve that are joined at the root of the lung by branches from the sympathetic trunk and cardiac plexus. The plexus is often described as having anterior and posterior parts (see anterior pulmonary p. and posterior pulmonary p.); filaments from each accompany the blood vessels and bronchi into the lungs."]

68407 plexus rectalis inferior
- 
- phr.["直肠下丛"]
- phr.["inferior rectal plexus: a plexus accompanying the inferior rectal artery, derived chiefly from the inferior rectal nerve; called also inferior hemorrhoidal p."]

68408 plexus rectalis medius
- 
- phr.["直肠中丛"]
- phr.["middle rectal plexus: a subdivision of the inferior hypogastric plexus, in proximity with and supplying nerve fibers to the rectum; called also middle hemorrhoidal p."]

68409 plexus rectalis superior
- 
- phr.["直肠上丛"]
- phr.["superior rectal plexus: a plexus accompanying the superior rectal artery to the rectum, derived from the inferior mesenteric and hypogastric plexuses. Called also superior hemorrhoidal p."]

68410 plexus renalis
- 
- phr.["肾丛"]
- phr.["renal plexus: a subdivision of the celiac plexus, accompanying the renal artery."]

68411 plexus sacralis
- 
- phr.["骶丛"]
- phr.["sacral plexus: a plexus that lies in front of the piriform muscle, arising from the anterior branches of the last two lumbar nerves (which form the lumbosacral trunk) and the first four sacral nerves. It has twelve named branches, five supplying pelvic structures (the nerves to the piriformis, to levator ani and coccygeus, and to sphincter ani muscles, the pelvic splanchnic nerves, and the pudendal nerve) and seven helping supply the buttocks and lower limbs (superior and inferior gluteal, posterior femoral cutaneous, perforating cutaneous, and sciatic nerves, and nerves to the quadratus femoris and obturator internus muscles).Plexus sacralis (sacral plexus), in yellow, in anterior (A) and lateral (B) views. The lumbar plexus is shown in white."]

68412 plexus splenicus
- 
- phr.["脾丛"]
- phr.["splenic plexus: a subdivision of the celiac plexus, which accompanies the splenic artery; called also lienal p. and p. lienalis [TA alternative]."]

68413 plexus subclavius
- 
- phr.["锁骨下动脉丛"]
- phr.["subclavian plexus: a sympathetic nerve plexus on the subclavian artery, arising from the cervicothoracic ganglion, contributing fibers to the phrenic nerve and to the branches of the subclavian artery, and continuing to the axillary artery."]

68414 plexus submucosus
- 
- phr.["黏膜下丛"]
- phr.["submucosal plexus: the part of the enteric plexus that is situated in the submucosa."]

68415 plexus subserosus
- 
- phr.["浆膜下丛"]
- phr.["subserosal plexus: the part of the enteric plexus situated deep to the serosal surface of the tunica serosa."]

68416 plexus suprarenalis
- 
- phr.["肾上腺丛"]
- phr.["suprarenal plexus: a subdivision of the celiac plexus, in proximity with and supplying nerve fibers to an adrenal (suprarenal) gland."]

68417 plexus testicularis
- 
- phr.["睾丸丛"]
- phr.["testicular plexus: a subdivision of the aortic plexus accompanying the testicular arteries; called also spermatic p."]

68418 plexus tympanicus
- 
- phr.["鼓室丛"]
- phr.["tympanic plexus: a nerve plexus on the promontory of the middle ear, formed by the tympanic and caroticotympanic nerves. It gives off the lesser petrosal nerve and a branch of the greater petrosal nerve and sends sensory fibers to the mucous membrane of the tympanic cavity, the auditory tube, and the mastoid air cells."]

68419 plexus uretericus
- 
- phr.["输尿管丛"]
- phr.["ureteric plexus: a plexus supplying the ureter and derived from the renal and hypogastric plexuses."]

68420 plexus uterovaginalis
- 
- phr.["子宫阴道丛"]
- phr.["uterovaginal plexus: the subdivision of the inferior hypogastric plexus that supplies nerve fibers to the uterus, ovary, vagina, urethra, and erectile tissue of the vestibule.","see p. venosus uterinus and p. venosus vaginalis."]

68421 plexus vascularis
- 
- phr.["血管丛"]
- phr.["vascular plexus: a plexus of peripheral nerves through which blood vessels receive innervation."]

68422 plexus vasculosus
- 
- phr.["血管丛"]
- phr.["vascular plexus: a network of intercommunicating blood vessels."]

68423 plexus venosus
- 
- phr.["静脉丛"]
- phr.["venous plexus: a network of interconnecting veins."]

68424 plexus venosus areolaris
- 
- phr.["乳晕静脉丛"]
- phr.["areolar venous plexus: a venous plexus in the areola around the nipple, formed by branches of the internal thoracic veins and draining into the lateral thoracic vein. Called also p. venosus mamillae."]

68425 plexus venosus caroticus internus
- 
- phr.["颈内动脉静脉丛"]
- phr.["internal carotid venous plexus: a venous plexus around the petrosal portion of the internal carotid artery, through which the cavernous sinus communicates with the internal jugular vein."]

The major illness, which may or may not be preceded by the minor illness, is characterized by involvement of the central nervous system, stiff neck, pleocytosis in the spinal fluid, and sometimes paralysis. (See nonparalytic p. and paralytic p.) There may be subsequent atrophy of groups of muscles, ending in contraction and permanent deformity. Called also polio. The major illness is also called infantile paralysis and acute anterior p."]

Autosomal recessive polycystic kidney disease (ARPKD, formerly called the infantile form) may be congenital or may appear at any time during childhood and has a high perinatal mortality rate; almost all cases lead to hypertension. In older children it may be associated with cystic and fibrotic disease of the liver. A similar acquired disease sometimes accompanies end-stage renal disease and is called acquired cystic disease of kidney. Called also polycystic kidneys and polycystic renal d.Autosomal dominant polycystic kidney disease viewed from the external surface (A) and bisected (B), the kidney showing marked enlargement and numerous dilated cysts. (C), Autosomal recessive polycystic kidney disease, characterized by smaller cysts and dilated channels at right angles to the cortical surface."]

Structural isomers are indicated by roman numerals. Free porphyrins are rarely found in tissues except in disorders of heme biosynthesis (porphyrias), but they do occur in the prosthetic groups of hemoglobin, myoglobin, and cytochromes, complexed with metal ions. The term is sometimes used to include porphin or to denote porphin specifically. See also porphyrinogen and chlorophyll.Porphyrin. (A), Pyrrole ring; (B), porphin ring; (C), protoporphyrin IX."]

Host range is narrow and transmission is by fomites, airborne particles, arthropod vectors, or contact. There are two subfamilies: Chordopoxvirinae (poxviruses of vertebrates) and Entomopoxvirinae (poxviruses of insects)."]

70349 precipitin reaction
- 
- phr.["沉淀素反应"]
- phr.["the formation of an insoluble precipitate by reaction of antigen and antibody; it occurs only with multivalent antigens and is dependent on electrolyte concentration, pH, temperature, and the relative concentrations of antigen and antibody, the amount of precipitate formed increasing to a maximum and then decreasing as the relative antigen concentration is increased.Schematic of precipitin reactions with different proportions of antigen and antibody. Antigenic proteins that elicit antibody responses are depicted as having three different antibody-binding sites on their surface. Polyclonal antibodies with three different specificities (box, triangle, circle) are also depicted. (A), Under conditions of antigen–antibody equivalence, there is maximum cross-linking and visible precipitin formation. (B), With antigen excess, the resulting small soluble immune complexes do not form a visible precipitate. (C), With antibody excess, small soluble complexes are also formed; lattice formation is insufficient to cause visible precipitation. (D), Under conditions of equivalence but in the presence of monoclonal, rather than polyclonal, antibodies, each antigen binds only at a single site; there is no cross-linking and no visible precipitate."]

71574 prospective study
- 
- phr.["前瞻性研究"]
- phr.["a longitudinal epidemiologic study in which the groups of individuals (cohorts) are selected on the basis of factors that are to be examined for their effects on outcomes, e.g., the effect of exposure to a specific risk factor on the eventual development of a particular disease, and are then followed over a period of time to determine the incidence rates of the outcomes in question in relation to the original factors. Called also cohort s. “Prospective” usually implies a cohort selected in the present and followed into the future, but the cohort method can also be applied to existing longitudinal historical data, such as insurance or medical records: a cohort is identified and classified as to exposure to some factor at some date in the past and followed up to the present to determine incidence rates of the outcome. This is called a historical prospective study, prospective study of past data, or retrospective cohort study. Cf. retrospective s."]

71577 prostaglandin
- /ˌprɒstəˈglændɪn/
- n.["前列腺素"]
- n.["any of a group of components derived from unsaturated 20-carbon fatty acids, primarily arachidonic acid, via the cyclooxygenase pathway; they are potent mediators of numerous different physiologic processes. The abbreviation for prostaglandin is PG; specific compounds are designated by adding a letter to indicate the type of ring structure and a numerical subscript to indicate the number of double bonds in the hydrocarbon skeleton (e.g., PGE2, etc.). Most naturally occurring prostaglandins have two double bonds and are synthesized from arachidonic acid (see illustration). The 1 series and 3 series are produced by the same pathway starting with fatty acids that have one fewer or one more double bond than arachidonic acid. The subscript α or β indicates the three-dimensional configuration of alcoholic groups attached to the ring structures (α denotes a substituent below the plane of the ring, β, above the plane). The naturally occurring PGFs all have the α configuration. Prostaglandins act in the cells in which they are synthesized and on surrounding cells, and their actions and effects vary with concentration, hormonal environment, and cell type.Cyclooxygenase pathway of prostaglandin and thromboxane synthesis."]

- phr.["假肥大性肌麻痹"]

Most species are strict aerobes and some produce pigments; some are fluorescent. The organisms are usually saprophytic, being found in soil, water, and decomposing matter; some are pathogenic for plants and animals. Historically, many unrelated bacteria were classified in the genus. More recently, this genus has been restricted to species related to the type species P. aerugino´sa."]

Symptoms may include weight loss, lassitude and fatigue, night sweats, and wasting, with purulent sputum, hemoptysis, and chest pain. See also primary t. and postprimary t. Called also t. of lungs.Pulmonary tuberculosis. (A), Frontal view chest radiograph showing extensive tuberculosis that resulted in respiratory failure. (B), Detail view of tubercle, characterized by caseation (arrow) surrounded by epithelioid and multinucleated giant cells."]

73399 pyruvate carboxylase
- /ˈpaɪərʊveɪt kɑ:ˈbɒksɪleɪs/
- phr.["丙酮酸羧化酶"]

The enzyme is a mitochondrial protein containing a biotin prosthetic group, requiring Mg2+ or Mn2+ and acetyl CoA, and occurs in liver but not in muscle. The reaction is necessary for gluconeogenesis from lactate or amino acids forming pyruvate and also provides four-carbon compounds for the tricarboxylic acid cycle. Deficiency of the enzyme, an autosomal recessive trait, causes severe psychomotor retardation and lactic acidosis in infants; there is a particularly severe, rapidly fatal form, in which hyperammonemia, hypercitrullinemia, and hyperlysinemia are also present."]

73401 pyruvate dehydrogenase complex
- 
- phr.["丙酮酸脱氢酶复合物"]

The integrated enzyme complex requires the cofactors thiamine pyrophosphate, lipoic acid, coenzyme A, FAD, and NAD+. It catalyzes the formation of acetyl coenzyme A from pyruvate and coenzyme A, using NAD+ as an electron acceptor; the acetyl coenzyme A is used in fatty acid synthesis, for acetylations, and for oxidation via the tricarboxylic acid cycle. Deficiency of any component of the complex results in lacticacidemia, ataxia, and psychomotor retardation."]

Pyruvate can be converted to acetyl coenzyme A, which can enter the tricarboxylic acid cycle for aerobic production of energy or be used for fatty acid synthesis. Energy can be obtained anaerobically by conversion of pyruvate to lactate (which occurs in mammalian muscle tissue) or to ethanol, small organic acids, and many other compounds (microbial fermentations). Pyruvate can also be converted to oxaloacetate, the first step in gluconeogenesis."]

73677 rabies
- /ˈreɪbi:z，-bɪi:z/
- n.["狂犬病"]
- n.["an acute infectious disease of the central nervous system that can affect almost any mammal, caused by a virus of the genus Lyssavirus. It is usually spread by contamination with virus-laden saliva of bites from infected animals, although aerosol infection can occur via the respiratory route, transplantation, or ingestion of infected tissues. Many different mammals can be vectors. The incubation period is highly variable, depending on the size of the inoculum and the site of the bite, being shorter after a bite near the brain than after one farther away. Symptoms usually include paresthesia, pain, or a burning sensation at the site of inoculation; periods of hyperexcitability, hallucinations, delirium, and bizarre behavior alternating with periods of calmness and lucidity; painful spasms of pharyngeal and laryngeal muscles, hypersalivation, and fearfulness provoked by attempts to drink or even by the sight of fluids (hydrophobia); convulsions; meningismus; paralysis; and coma. Recovery is rare, with death usually associated with respiratory depression and cardiorespiratory failure. Formerly the term hydrophobia was used as a synonym for rabies in general rather than for just the symptom of the paralytic phase."]

In official terminology, the term is used specifically to denote the human diploid cell vaccine."]

74051 radium
- /ˈreɪdjəm/
- n.["镭"]
- n.["a rare radioactive element in the uranium decay series. It has an atomic weight of 226, an atomic number of 88, and a half-life of 1600 years. It is found mainly in pitchblende and undergoes spontaneous disintegration with formation of a gas called radon (half-life = 3.85 days). In this process it emits alpha particles. Radon (alpha emitter) on deposit in solid form disintegrates into a series of decay products: radium A (half-life = 3 minutes), radium B (half-life = 26.7 minutes), and radium C (half-life = 19.5 minutes). The beta particles and gamma radiation used in clinical therapy originate from radium B and C. With radium in a sealed container and the same number of atoms of each decay product disintegrating per second, radium and its decay products are in equilibrium. In this state, the formation of beta particles and gamma rays reaches its maximum. In clinical gamma-ray therapy, shielding off of the beta particles can be accomplished by a metallic container, e.g., of gold or platinum. A glass-walled container permits irradiation with beta particles as well as gamma rays."]

74140 rami anteriores nervorum lumbalium
- 
- phr.["腰神经前支"]
- phr.["anterior branches of lumbar nerves: the anterior branches of the five lumbar spinal nerves; the upper four form the lumbar plexus, and the fifth and a part of the fourth form part of the sacral plexus. Called also rami ventrales nervorum lumbalium [TA alternative]."]

74141 rami anteriores nervorum sacralium
- 
- phr.["骶神经前支"]
- phr.["anterior branches of sacral nerves: branches of the five sacral spinal nerves; the upper four emerge from the sacrum through the anterior foramina and contribute to the sacral plexus, and the fifth emerges through the sacral hiatus and, with a communication from the fourth, contributes to the coccygeal plexus. Called also rami ventrales nervorum sacralium [TA alternative]."]

74142 rami anteriores nervorum thoracicorum
- 
- phr.["胸神经前支"]
- phr.["TA alternative for nervi intercostales. note: Although the term is official alternative terminology for the nervi intercostales, it encompasses both the 11 nervi intercostales and also the nervus subcostalis, which is the anterior ramus from the twelfth thoracic nerve."]

74143 rami articulares arteriae descendentis genicularis
- 
- phr.["膝降动脉关节支"]
- phr.["articular branches of descending genicular artery: branches that pass downward in the vastus medialis muscle and help supply the knee joint."]

74144 rami atriales arteriae coronariae dextrae
- 
- phr.["右冠状动脉心房支"]
- phr.["atrial branches of right coronary artery: branches of the right coronary artery, consisting of anterior and lateral branches chiefly distributed to the right atrium, and usually a single posterior branch distributed to the right and left atria."]

74145 rami atriales rami circumflexi arteriae coronariae sinistrae
- 
- phr.["左冠状动脉回旋支心房支"]
- phr.["atrial branches of circumflex branch of left coronary artery: branches distributed to the left atrium, consisting of anterior, lateral, and posterior groups."]

74146 rami atrioventriculares rami circumflexi arteriae coronariae sinistrae
- 
- phr.["左冠状动脉回旋支房室支"]
- phr.["atrioventricular branches of circumflex branch of left coronary artery: small recurrent branches distributed to the atria and ventricles."]

74147 rami auriculares anteriores arteriae temporalis superficialis
- 
- phr.["颞浅动脉耳前支"]
- phr.["anterior auricular branches of superficial temporal artery: branches that supply the lateral aspect of the pinna and the external acoustic meatus. Called also anterior auricular arteries."]

74148 rami bronchiales arteriae thoracicae internae
- 
- phr.["胸内动脉支气管支"]
- phr.["bronchial branches of internal thoracic artery: small, variable branches of the internal thoracic artery, with distribution to the bronchi and trachea. Called also anterior bronchial arteries."]

74149 rami bronchiales nervi vagi
- 
- phr.["迷走神经支气管支"]
- phr.["branches of the vagus that supply the bronchi and the pulmonary vessels, both directly and by way of the anterior and posterior parts of the pulmonary plexus; there are two or three short anterior branches and numerous longer posterior branches; modality, parasympathetic and visceral afferent."]

74150 rami bronchiales partis thoracicae aortae
- 
- phr.["主动脉胸部支气管支"]
- phr.["bronchial branches of thoracic part of aorta: branches arising from the thoracic aorta to supply the bronchi and lower trachea, and passing along the posterior sides of the bronchi to ramify about the respiratory bronchioles; distributed also to adjacent lymph nodes, pulmonary vessels, and pericardium, and to part of the esophagus. Called also bronchial arteries."]

74151 rami buccales nervi facialis
- 
- phr.["面神经颊支"]
- phr.["buccal branches of facial nerve: branches that innervate the zygomatic, levator labii superioris, buccinator, and orbicularis oris muscles; modality, motor and general sensory."]

74152 rami calcanei arteriae tibialis posterioris
- 
- phr.["胫后动脉跟支"]
- phr.["calcaneal branches of posterior tibial artery: branches that arise from the posterior tibial artery and are distributed to the medial aspect and back of the heel."]

74153 rami calcanei laterales nervi suralis
- 
- phr.["腓肠神经根外侧支"]
- phr.["lateral calcaneal branches of sural nerve: branches that innervate the skin on the back of the leg and the lateral side of the foot and heel; modality, general sensory."]

74154 rami calcanei mediales nervi tibialis
- 
- phr.["胫神经跟内侧支"]
- phr.["medial calcaneal branches of tibial nerve: branches supplying the medial side of the heel and of the posterior part of the sole; modality, general sensory."]

74155 rami calcanei ramorum malleolarium lateralium arteriae fibularis
- 
- phr.["腓动脉外踝支跟骨支"]
- phr.["calcaneal branches of lateral malleolar branches of peroneal artery: branches distributed to the lateral aspect and back of the heel."]

74156 rami capsulares arteriae renalis
- 
- phr.["肾动脉囊支"]
- phr.["capsular branches of renal artery: branches that supply the renal capsule. Called also capsular arteries and perirenal arteries."]

74157 rami cardiaci cervicales inferiores nervi vagi
- 
- phr.["迷走神经颈下心支，颈胸支"]
- phr.["inferior cardiac branches of the vagus nerve: branches (sometimes called cervicothoracic) arising from the vagi and from the recurrent laryngeal nerves at the thoracic inlet, and joining cervicothoracic sympathetic cardiac nerves, the combined nerves passing to the cardiac plexus; modality, parasympathetic and visceral afferent."]

74158 rami cardiaci cervicales superiores nervi vagi
- 
- phr.["迷走神经颈上心支"]
- phr.["superior cervical cardiac branches of vagus nerve: variable branches arising from the vagus in the cervical region and usually joining the cervical sympathetic cardiac nerves. The conjoined nerves then descend in front of, or behind, the arch of the aorta to the cardiac plexus; modality, parasympathetic and visceral afferent."]

74159 rami cardiaci thoracici
- 
- phr.["胸心支"]
- phr.["thoracic cardiac branches: branches of the second through fourth or fifth thoracic ganglia of the sympathetic trunk, supplying the heart and having a sympathetic (accelerator) modality as well as a visceral afferent one (chiefly for pain). Called also thoracic cardiac nerves and nervi cardiaci thoracici."]

74160 rami cardiaci thoracici nervi vagi
- 
- phr.["迷走神经胸心支"]
- phr.["thoracic cardiac branches of the vagus nerve: branches which arise in the thorax from the right and left vagus and left recurrent laryngeal nerves. They go directly to the posterior walls of the atria, to the coronary plexuses, and to the anterior pulmonary plexuses."]

74161 rami caudae nuclei caudati arteriae choroideae anterioris
- 
- phr.["脉络膜前动脉尾状核尾支"]
- phr.["branches of anterior choroidal artery to tail of caudate nucleus: small branches that supply the tail of the caudate nucleus."]

74162 rami chiasmatici arteriae choroideae anterioris
- 
- phr.["脉络膜前动脉视交叉支"]
- phr.["branches of anterior choroidal artery to optic chiasm: small branches that supply the optic chiasm."]

74163 rami choroidei posteriores laterales arteriae cerebri posterioris
- 
- phr.["大脑后动脉脉络膜后外侧支"]
- phr.["lateral choroidal branches of the posterior cerebral artery: branches that supply the choroid plexus of the lateral ventricle and the thalamus."]

74164 rami choroidei ventriculi lateralis arteriae choroideae anterioris
- 
- phr.["脉络膜前动脉侧脑室脉络丛支"]
- phr.["choroidal branches to lateral ventricle: small branches of the anterior choroidal artery that supply the choroid plexus of the lateral ventricle."]

74165 rami choroidei ventriculi tertii arteriae choroideae anterioris
- 
- phr.["脉络膜前动脉第三脑室脉络丛支"]
- phr.["choroidal branches to third ventricle: small branches of the anterior choroidal artery that supply the third ventricle."]

74166 rami coeliaci nervi vagi
- 
- phr.["迷走神经腹腔支"]
- phr.["celiac branches of vagus nerve: branches that arise from both the anterior and posterior vagal trunks and join the celiac plexus; modality, parasympathetic and visceral afferent. Called also celiac nerves."]

74167 rami communicantes
- 
- phr.["交通支"]
- phr.["communicating branches between two nerves; in official terminology called rami communicantes nervorum spinalium.","branches connecting two arteries. Called also rami anastomotici."]

74168 rami communicantes nervi auriculotemporalis cum nervo faciali
- 
- phr.["耳颞神经面神经交通支"]
- phr.["communicating branches of auriculotemporal nerve with facial nerve: branches containing sensory fibers from the auriculotemporal nerve that join the facial nerve within the parotid gland, to be distributed with branches of the latter."]

74169 rami communicantes nervi lingualis cum nervo hypoglosso
- 
- phr.["舌神经舌下神经交通支"]
- phr.["communicating branches of lingual nerve with hypoglossal nerve: plexiform terminal branches interconnecting the lingual and hypoglossal nerves just in front of the hyoglossus muscle."]

74170 rami communicantes nervorum spinalium
- 
- phr.["脊神经交通支"]
- phr.["communicating branches of spinal nerves: branches connecting spinal nerves with sympathetic ganglia, each spinal nerve receiving a gray communicating ramus, and the thoracic and upper lumbar spinal nerves having in addition a white communicating ramus. Called also rami communicantes."]

74171 rami corporis geniculati lateralis arteriae choroideae anterioris
- 
- phr.["脉络膜前动脉外侧膝状体支"]
- phr.["branches of anterior choroidal artery to lateral geniculate body: small branches that supply the lateral geniculate body."]

74172 rami cutanei anteriores nervi femoralis
- 
- phr.["股神经前皮支"]
- phr.["anterior cutaneous branches of femoral nerve: branches that innervate the skin on the front and medial aspect of the thigh and patella and contribute to the subsartorial and patellar plexuses; modality, general sensory."]

74173 rami cutanei cruris mediales nervi sapheni
- 
- phr.["隐神经小腿内侧支"]
- phr.["medial crural cutaneous branches of saphenous nerve: branches distributed by the saphenous nerve to the skin of the medial aspect of the leg; modality, general sensory."]

74174 rami dentales arteriae alveolaris inferioris
- 
- phr.["下牙槽动脉牙支"]
- phr.["dental branches of inferior alveolar artery: branches arising from the inferior alveolar artery in the mandibular canal and supplying the inferior teeth."]

74175 rami dentales arteriae alveolaris superioris posterioris
- 
- phr.["上牙槽后动脉牙支"]
- phr.["dental branches of posterior superior alveolar artery: branches that supply the molar and premolar teeth."]

74176 rami dentales arteriarum alveolarium superiorum anteriorum
- 
- phr.["上牙槽前动脉牙支"]
- phr.["dental branches of anterior superior alveolar arteries: branches that supply the incisor and canine teeth."]

74177 rami dentales inferiores plexus dentalis inferioris
- 
- phr.["下牙神经丛下牙支"]
- phr.["inferior dental branches of inferior dental plexus: branches that innervate the lower teeth; modality, general sensory."]

74178 rami dentales superiores plexus dentalis superioris
- 
- phr.["上牙神经丛上牙支"]
- phr.["superior dental branches of superior dental plexus: branches that innervate the teeth of the upper jaw; modality, general sensory."]

74179 rami dorsales linguae arteriae lingualis
- 
- phr.["舌动脉舌背支"]
- phr.["dorsal lingual branches of lingual artery: branches of the lingual artery arising beneath the hyoglossus muscle and supplying the tonsil and the back of the tongue."]

74180 rami dorsales nervorum cervicalium
- 
- phr.["颈神经背支"]
- phr.["TA alternative for rami posteriores nervorum cervicalium."]

74181 rami dorsales nervorum lumbalium
- 
- phr.["腰神经背支"]
- phr.["TA alternative for rami posteriores nervorum lumbalium."]

74182 rami dorsales nervorum sacralium
- 
- phr.["骶神经背支"]
- phr.["TA alternative for rami posteriores nervorum sacralium."]

74183 rami dorsales nervorum thoracicorum
- 
- phr.["胸神经背支"]
- phr.["TA alternative for rami posteriores nervorum thoracicorum."]

74184 rami epididymales arteriae testicularis
- 
- phr.["睾丸动脉附辜支"]
- phr.["epididymal branches of testicular artery: they are distributed to the epididymis."]

74185 rami ganglionares nervi lingualis ad ganglion submandibulare
- 
- phr.["下颌下神经节舌神经节支"]
- phr.["ganglionic branches of lingual nerve to submandibular ganglion: branches which interconnect the lingual nerve and the submandibular ganglion, and by which the ganglion is suspended from the nerve; they carry preganglionic fibers that derive from the chorda tympani and synapse in the submandibular ganglion and postganglionic fibers. Called also radix sensoria ganglii submandibularis [TA alternative] and motor or sensory root of submandibular ganglion."]

74186 rami ganglionares nervi maxillaris ad ganglion pterygopalatinum
- 
- phr.["翼腭神经节上颌神经神经节支"]
- phr.["ganglionic branches of maxillary nerve to pterygopalatine ganglion: fibers connecting the maxillary nerve to the pterygopalatine ganglion. Called also radix sensoria ganglii pterygopalatini [TA alternative] and sensory root of pterygopalatine ganglion."]

74187 rami ganglionares trigeminales arteriae carotidis internae
- 
- phr.["颈内动脉三叉神经支"]
- phr.["branches of internal carotid artery to trigeminal ganglion: short branches from the cavernous part of the internal carotid artery that supply the trigeminal ganglion."]

74188 rami gastrici anteriores trunci vagalis anterioris
- 
- phr.["迷走神经前干胃前支"]
- phr.["anterior gastric branches of anterior vagal trunk: branches arising from the anterior trunk of the vagus near the cardiac end of the stomach, innervating the anterior aspect of the lesser curvature and the anterior surface of the stomach almost to the pylorus; modality, parasympathetic and visceral afferent."]

74189 rami genus capsulae internae arteriae choroideae anterioris
- 
- phr.["脉络膜前动脉膝内囊支"]
- phr.["branches of anterior choroidal artery to genu of internal capsule: small branches that supply the genu of the internal capsule of the cerebrum."]

74190 rami gingivales inferiores plexus dentalis inferioris
- 
- phr.["下牙神经丛下齿龈支"]
- phr.["inferior gingival branches of inferior dental plexus: branches originating from the inferior dental plexus and innervating the gingivae of the lower jaw; modality, general sensory."]

74191 rami gingivales nervi mentalis
- 
- phr.["颏神经齿龈支"]
- phr.["gingival branches of mental nerve: branches that innervate the gums; modality, general sensory."]

74192 rami gingivales superiores plexus dentalis superioris
- 
- phr.["上牙神经丛上齿龈支"]
- phr.["superior gingival branches of superior dental plexus: branches arising from the superior dental plexus and innervating the gingivae of the upper jaw; modality, general sensory."]

74193 rami glandulares arteriae facialis
- 
- phr.["面动脉腺支"]
- phr.["glandular branches of facial artery: branches given off to the submandibular gland by the facial artery as it passes over the lateral surface of the gland."]

74194 rami helicini arteriae uterinae
- 
- phr.["子宫动脉螺旋支"]
- phr.["helicine branches of uterine artery: the exceedingly tortuous terminal branches of the uterine artery in the uterine muscle. Called also helicine arteries."]

74195 rami hepatici trunci vagalis anterioris
- 
- phr.["迷走神经前干肝支"]
- phr.["hepatic branches of anterior vagal trunk: branches (sometimes only one) arising from the anterior vagal trunk, contributing to the hepatic plexus, and helping innervate the liver, gallbladder, pancreas, pylorus, and duodenum; modality, parasympathetic and visceral afferent."]

74196 rami inferiores nervi transversi colli
- 
- phr.["颈横神经下支"]
- phr.["inferior branches of transverse nerve of neck: the more inferior of the branches that arise from the transverse cervical nerve near the anterior border of the sternocleidomastoid muscle, innervating skin and subcutaneous tissue in the anterior cervical region; modality, general sensory."]

74197 rami inguinales arteriae pudendae externae profundae
- 
- phr.["阴部外深动脉腹股沟支"]
- phr.["inguinal branches of deep external pudendal artery: branches arising from the deep external pudendal arteries and supplying the inguinal region."]

74198 rami intercostales anteriores arteriae thoracicae internae
- 
- phr.["胸廓内动脉肋间前支"]
- phr.["anterior intercostal branches of internal thoracic artery: twelve branches, two in each of the upper six intercostal spaces, that supply the intercostal spaces and the pectoralis major muscle. Within each space both branches run laterally, the upper anastomosing with the posterior intercostal artery, the lower with the collateral branch of that artery."]

74199 rami interganglionares trunci sympathici
- 
- phr.["交感神经干节间支"]
- phr.["interganglionic branches of sympathetic trunk: the branches that interconnect the ganglia of the sympathetic trunk."]

74200 rami isthmi faucium nervi lingualis
- 
- phr.["舌神经咽峡支"]
- phr.["branches from the lingual nerve to the isthmus of the fauces; modality, general sensory."]

74201 rami labiales anteriores arteriae pudendae externae profundae
- 
- phr.["下阴外深动脉前阴唇支"]
- phr.["anterior labial branches of deep external pudendal artery: branches that arise from the deep external pudendal artery and supply the labium majus; called also anterior labial arteries of vulva."]

74202 rami labiales nervi mentalis
- 
- phr.["颏神经唇支"]
- phr.["labial branches of mental nerve: branches of the mental nerve that innervate the lower lip; modality, general sensory."]

74203 rami labiales posteriores arteriae pudendae internae
- 
- phr.["内阴动脉后阴唇支"]
- phr.["posterior labial branches of internal pudendal artery: two branches arising from the internal pudendal artery in the anterior part of the ischiorectal fossa, helping to supply the ischiocavernosus and bulbospongiosus muscles, and supplying the labium majus and labium minus. Called also posterior labial arteries of vulva."]

74204 rami labiales superiores nervi infraorbitalis
- 
- phr.["眶下神经上唇支"]
- phr.["superior labial branches of infraorbital nerve: branches of the infraorbital nerve that are distributed to mucous membranes of the mouth and skin of the upper lip; modality, general sensory."]

74205 rami laryngopharyngei ganglii cervicalis superioris
- 
- phr.["颈上神经节咽喉支"]
- phr.["laryngopharyngeal branches of superior cervical ganglion: branches from the superior cervical ganglion to the larynx and walls of the pharynx; modality, sympathetic."]

74206 rami lienales arteriae lienalis
- 
- phr.["脾动脉脾支"]
- phr.["TA alternative for rami splenici arteriae splenicae."]

74207 rami linguales nervi glossopharyngei
- 
- phr.["舌咽神经舌支"]
- phr.["lingual branches of glossopharyngeal nerve: branches of the glossopharyngeal nerve that innervate the posterior third of the tongue; modality, general and special sensory."]

74208 rami linguales nervi hypoglossi
- 
- phr.["舌下神经舌支"]
- phr.["lingual branches of hypoglossal nerve: branches of the hypoglossal nerve that innervate the intrinsic and extrinsic muscles of the tongue; modality, motor."]

74209 rami linguales nervi lingualis
- 
- phr.["舌神经舌支"]
- phr.["lingual branches of lingual nerve: branches that innervate the anterior two-thirds of the tongue, adjacent areas of the mouth, and the gums; modality, general and special sensory."]

74210 rami malleolares laterales arteriae fibularis
- 
- phr.["腓动脉外踝支"]
- phr.["lateral malleolar branches of peroneal artery: branches that supply the lateral aspect of the ankle and give off calcaneal branches to the lateral aspect and back of the heel."]

74211 rami malleolares mediales arteriae tibiales posterioris
- 
- phr.["胫后动脉内踝支"]
- phr.["medial malleolar branches of posterior tibial artery: vessels supplying the area of the medial malleolus and giving off calcaneal branches to the medial aspect and back of the heel."]

74212 rami mammarii laterales arteriae thoracicae lateralis
- 
- phr.["胸外动脉乳房外侧支"]
- phr.["lateral mammary branches of lateral thoracic artery: branches that supply the mammary gland."]

74213 rami mammarii laterales rami cutanei lateralis pectoralis nervi intercostalis
- 
- phr.["肋间神经胸外侧皮支乳房外侧支"]
- phr.["the lateral mammary branches of the lateral pectoral cutaneous branch of the intercostal nerve: modality, general sensory."]

74214 rami mammarii mediales rami cutanei anterioris pectoralis nervi intercostalis
- 
- phr.["肋间神经胸前皮支乳房内侧支"]
- phr.["the medial mammary branches of the anterior pectoral cutaneous branch of the intercostal nerve; modality, general sensory."]

74215 rami mastoidei arteriae auricularis posterioris
- 
- phr.["耳后动脉乳突支"]
- phr.["mastoid branches of posterior auricular artery: branches that supply the mastoid cells."]

74216 rami mediales pontis
- 
- phr.["脑桥内侧髓支"]
- phr.["medial pontine branches: the shorter pontine arteries, which arise from the posterior aspect of the basilar artery and enter the pons along its anterior median groove. Called also paramedian pontine branches."]

74217 rami mediastinales arteriae thoracicae internae
- 
- phr.["胸内动脉纵隔支"]
- phr.["mediastinal branches of internal thoracic artery: branches that supply areolar tissue, pericardium, lymph nodes, and the thymus in the anterior and superior mediastina. Called also anterior mediastinal arteries."]

74218 rami medullares laterales arteriae vertebralis
- 
- phr.["椎动脉外侧髓支"]
- phr.["lateral medullary branches of posterior inferior cerebellar artery: branches supplying the undersurface of the hemisphere of the cerebellum and anastomosing with the anterior inferior cerebellar and superior cerebellar branches of the basilar artery."]

74219 rami medullares mediales arteriae vertebralis
- 
- phr.["椎动脉内侧髓支"]
- phr.["medial medullary branches of posterior inferior cerebellar artery, ramifying on the cerebellar vermis between the hemispheres."]

74220 rami meningei arteriae vertebralis
- 
- phr.["椎动脉脑膜支"]
- phr.["meningeal branches of vertebral artery: branches, anterior and posterior, arising from the vertebral artery in the foramen magnum and ramifying in the posterior cranial fossa to supply the dura mater, including the falx cerebelli and bone."]

74221 rami mentales nervi mentalis
- 
- phr.["颏神经颏支"]
- phr.["mental branches of mental nerve: branches that innervate the skin of the chin; modality, general sensory."]

74222 rami musculares arteriae vertebralis
- 
- phr.["椎动脉肌支"]
- phr.["muscular branches of vertebral artery: branches of the transverse part of the vertebral artery that supply the deep muscles of the neck and anastomose with the descending branch of the occipital artery and the deep cervical artery."]

74223 rami musculares nervi axillaris
- 
- phr.["腋神经肌支"]
- phr.["muscular branches of axillary nerve: branches that innervate the deltoid and teres minor muscles; modality, motor."]

74224 rami musculares nervi femoralis
- 
- phr.["股神经肌支"]
- phr.["muscular branches of femoral nerve: branches that innervate the anterior thigh muscles; modality, motor."]

74225 rami musculares nervi fibularis profundi
- 
- phr.["腓深神经肌支"]
- phr.["muscular branches of deep peroneal nerve: branches that innervate the tibialis anterior, extensor hallucis longus, extensor digitorum longus, and peroneus tertius muscles; modality, motor."]

74226 rami musculares nervi fibularis superficialis
- 
- phr.["腓浅神经肌支"]
- phr.["muscular branches of superficial peroneal nerve: branches that innervate the peroneus longus and peroneus brevis muscles; modality, motor."]

74227 rami musculares nervi mediani
- 
- phr.["正中神经肌支"]
- phr.["muscular branches of median nerve: branches that innervate most of the flexor muscles on the front of the forearm and most of the short muscles of the thumb; modality, motor."]

74228 rami musculares nervi musculocutanei
- 
- phr.["肌皮神经肌支"]
- phr.["muscular branches of musculocutaneous nerve: branches that innervate muscles of the upper arm; modality, motor and general sensory. See branch to biceps brachii, branch to brachialis, and branch to coracobrachialis, under branch."]

74229 rami musculares nervi radialis
- 
- phr.["桡神经肌支"]
- phr.["muscular branches of radial nerve: branches that innervate the triceps, anconeus, brachioradialis, and extensor carpi radialis muscles; a branch to the brachialis muscle is probably sensory; modality, motor and sensory."]

74230 rami musculares nervi tibialis
- 
- phr.["胫神经肌支"]
- phr.["muscular branches of tibial nerve: branches that supply muscles of the back of the leg; modality, motor."]

74231 rami musculares nervi ulnaris
- 
- phr.["尺神经肌支"]
- phr.["muscular branches of ulnar nerve: branches that innervate the flexor carpi ulnaris muscle and the ulnar half of the flexor digitorum profundus; modality, motor."]

74232 rami musculares nervorum intercostalium
- 
- phr.["肋间神经肌支"]
- phr.["muscular branches of intercostal nerves: branches that supply numerous muscles of the lateral and ventral regions of the thorax and abdomen."]

74233 rami musculares rami anterioris nervi obturatorii
- 
- phr.["闭孔神经前支肌支"]
- phr.["muscular branches of anterior branch of obturator nerve: branches arising from the anterior ramus of the obturator nerve and innervating the gracilis and adductor longus muscles, usually the adductor brevis, and often the pectineus; modality, motor."]

74234 rami musculares rami externi nervi accessorii
- 
- phr.["副神经外侧支"]
- phr.["muscular branches of external branch of accessory nerve: the branches of the external branch of the accessory nerve that supply the sternocleidomastoid and trapezius muscles."]

74235 rami musculares rami posterioris nervi obturatorii
- 
- phr.["闭孔神经后支肌支"]
- phr.["muscular branches of posterior branch of obturator nerve: branches arising from the posterior ramus of the obturator nerve and innervating the obturator externus and adductor brevis muscles, and sometimes the adductor magnus; modality, motor."]

74236 rami nasales anteriores laterales arteriae ethmoidalis anterioris
- 
- phr.["筛前动脉鼻前外侧支"]
- phr.["anterior lateral nasal branches of anterior ethmoidal artery; twigs of the anterior ethmoidal artery that descend into the nasal cavity with the anterior ethmoidal nerve and supply the lateral nasal wall."]

74237 rami nasales interni mediales nervi ethmoidalis anterioris
- 
- phr.["筛前神经鼻内支"]

- phr.["肩胛上动脉肩峰支"]
