74343 ramus anastomoticus arteriae lacrimalis cum arteria meningea media
- 
- phr.["泪腺动脉脑膜中动脉吻合支"]
- phr.["anastomotic branch of lacrimal artery with middle meningeal artery: a recurrent meningeal branch of the lacrimal artery that passes back via the lateral part of the orbital fissure and anastomoses with the anastomotic branch of the middle meningeal artery."]

74344 ramus anterior arteriae obturatoriae
- 
- phr.["闭孔动脉前支"]
- phr.["anterior branch of obturator artery: a branch that passes forward around the medial margin of the obturator foramen, on the obturator membrane, and is distributed to the obturator and adductor muscles."]

74345 ramus anterior arteriae recurrentis ulnaris
- 
- phr.["尺侧返动脉前支"]
- phr.["anterior branch of ulnar recurrent artery: a branch that helps supply the pronator teres and brachialis muscles and runs to the front of the medial epicondyle, supplying the elbow joint and adjacent structures."]

74346 ramus anterior arteriae renalis
- 
- phr.["肾动脉前支"]
- phr.["anterior branch of renal artery: a branch supplying the anterior, superior, and inferior segments of the kidney."]

74347 ramus anterior ductus hepatici dextri
- 
- phr.["右肝管前支"]
- phr.["the anterior branch of the right hepatic duct, draining anterior segments of the right liver."]

74348 ramus anterior nervi auricularis magni
- 
- phr.["耳大神经前支"]
- phr.["anterior branch of great auricular nerve; a branch distributed to the skin of the face over the parotid gland; modality, general sensory."]

74349 ramus anterior nervi coccygei
- 
- phr.["尾神经前支"]
- phr.["anterior branch of coccygeal nerve: a branch of the last spinal nerve, emerging from the sacral hiatus and contributing to the coccygeal plexus; called also r. ventralis nervi coccygei [TA alternative]."]

74350 ramus anterior nervi cutanei antebrachii medialis
- 
- phr.["前臂内侧皮神经前支"]
- phr.["anterior branch of medial cutaneous nerve of forearm: a branch that innervates the skin of the front and medial aspect of the forearm; modality, general sensory."]

74351 ramus anterior nervi obturatorii
- 
- phr.["闭孔神经前支"]
- phr.["anterior branch of obturator nerve: a branch that supplies the gracilis and the adductor longus and brevis muscles and the pectineus, and occasionally gives off a branch to the skin of the medial side of the thigh and leg; modality, motor and general sensory."]

74352 ramus anterior nervi spinalis
- 
- phr.["脊神经前支"]
- phr.["anterior branch of spinal nerve: the anterior and usually larger of the two branches into which each spinal nerve divides almost as soon as it emerges from the intervertebral foramen; the anterior branches supply anterior and lateral parts of the trunk and all parts of the limbs."]

74353 ramus anterior sulci lateralis cerebri
- 
- phr.["大脑外侧沟前支"]
- phr.["anterior branch of lateral cerebral sulcus: a branch that runs forward a short distance into the inferior frontal gyrus."]

74354 ramus anterior venae pulmonalis dextrae superioris
- 
- phr.["右上肺静脉前支"]
- phr.["TA alternative for vena anterior lobi superioris pulmonis dextri."]

74355 ramus anterior venae pulmonalis sinistrae superioris
- 
- phr.["左上肺静脉前支"]
- phr.["TA alternative for vena anterior lobi superioris pulmonis sinistri."]

74356 ramus apicalis venae pulmonalis dextrae superioris
- 
- phr.["右上肺静脉尖支"]
- phr.["TA alternative for vena apicalis."]

74357 ramus apicoposterior venae pulmonalis sinistrae superioris
- 
- phr.["左上肺静脉尖后支"]
- phr.["TA alternative for vena apicoposterior."]

74358 ramus ascendens arteriae circumflexae femoris lateralis
- 
- phr.["旋股外侧动脉升支"]
- phr.["ascending branch of lateral circumflex femoral artery: a branch that runs upward along the trochanteric line of the femur and between the gluteus medius and minimus muscles, and anastomoses with branches of the superior gluteal artery. It helps supply the upper thigh muscles."]

74359 ramus ascendens arteriae circumflexae femoris medialis
- 
- phr.["旋股内侧动脉升支"]
- phr.["ascending branch of medial circumflex femoral artery: a branch that ascends in front of the quadratus femoris muscle to the trochanteric fossa, and there anastomoses with gluteal arteries."]

74360 ramus ascendens arteriae circumflexae ilium profundae
- 
- phr.["旋髂深动脉升支"]
- phr.["ascending branch of deep circumflex iliac artery: a branch leaving the deep circumflex iliac artery near the anterior superior iliac spine, rising between and distributing to the transversus abdominis and internal oblique muscles."]

74361 ramus ascendens sulci lateralis cerebri
- 
- phr.["大脑外侧沟升支"]
- phr.["ascending branch of lateral cerebral sulcus: a branch that runs superiorly a short distance into the inferior frontal gyrus."]

74362 ramus atrialis anastomoticus rami circumflexi arteriae coronariae sinistrae
- 
- phr.["左冠状动脉回旋支心房吻合支"]
- phr.["atrial anastomotic branch of circumflex branch of left coronary artery: a branch of the circumflex branch of the left coronary artery that passes the interatrial septum to anastomose with the right coronary artery; called also atrial anastomotic artery and anastomotic atrial artery."]

74363 ramus atrialis intermedius arteriae coronariae dextrae
- 
- phr.["右冠状动脉房间支"]
- phr.["intermediate atrial branch of right coronary artery: a branch of the right coronary artery arising opposite to the marginal branch and ascending to over the right atrium; called also right intermediate atrial artery."]

74364 ramus auricularis arteriae auricularis posterioris
- 
- phr.["耳后动脉耳支"]
- phr.["auricular branch of posterior auricular artery: a branch supplying the pinna and adjacent skin."]

74365 ramus auricularis arteriae occipitalis
- 
- phr.["枕动脉耳支"]
- phr.["auricular branch of occipital artery: an inconstant branch of the occipital artery that helps supply the medial aspect of the pinna."]

74366 ramus auricularis nervi vagi
- 
- phr.["迷走神经耳支"]
- phr.["auricular branch of vagus nerve: a branch arising from the superior ganglion of the vagus, innervating the cranial surface of the auricle, the floor of the external acoustic meatus, and the adjacent part of the tympanic membrane; modality, general sensory."]

74367 ramus basalis tentorii arteriae carotidis internae
- 
- phr.["颈内动脉基底幕支"]
- phr.["tentorial basal branch of internal carotid artery: a twig from the cavernous part of the internal carotid artery that supplies the base of the tentorium."]

74368 ramus calcarinus arteriae occipitalis medialis
- 
- phr.["枕内动脉距支"]
- phr.["calcarine branch of medial occipital artery: a branch that supplies the calcarine fissure."]

74369 ramus carpalis dorsalis arteriae radialis
- 
- phr.["桡动脉腕背支"]
- phr.["dorsal carpal branch of radial artery: a branch running medially deep to the extensor tendons and helping form the dorsal carpal rete."]

74370 ramus carpalis dorsalis arteriae ulnaris
- 
- phr.["尺动脉腕背支"]
- phr.["dorsal carpal branch of ulnar artery: a variable branch of the ulnar artery that runs laterally deep to the tendons of the ulnar muscles of the wrist, helping to form the dorsal carpal rete."]

74371 ramus carpalis palmaris arteriae radialis
- 
- phr.["桡动脉腕掌支"]
- phr.["palmar carpal branch of radial artery: a branch that passes medially behind the flexor tendons on the palmar aspect of the wrist and forms a network with a corresponding branch of the ulnar artery."]

74372 ramus carpalis palmaris arteriae ulnaris
- 
- phr.["尺动脉腕掌支"]
- phr.["palmar carpal branch of ulnar artery: a branch that passes laterally behind the flexor tendons on the palmar aspect of the wrist and forms a network with a corresponding branch of the radial artery."]

74373 ramus chiasmaticus arteriae communicantis posterioris
- 
- phr.["后交通动脉视交叉支"]
- phr.["chiasmatic branch of posterior communicating artery: a branch that supplies the optic chiasm."]

74374 ramus cingularis arteriae callosomarginalis
- 
- phr.["胼胝体缘动脉扣带支"]
- phr.["the cingular branch of the callosomarginal artery, supplying the cingulate gyrus."]

74375 ramus circumflexus arteriae coronariae sinistrae
- 
- phr.["左冠状动脉回旋支"]
- phr.["circumflex branch of left coronary artery: a branch that curves around to the back of the left ventricle in the coronary sulcus, supplying the left ventricle and left atrium. Called also circumflex artery.Left coronary artery with circumflex branch (ramus circumflexus arteriae coronariae sinistrae) and interventricular septal branches (rami interventriculares septales arteriae coronariae sinistrae), shown in anterior oblique view in a left coronary arteriogram."]

74376 ramus circumflexus fibularis arteriae tibialis posterioris
- 
- phr.["胫后动脉旋腓骨支"]
- phr.["fibular circumflex branch of posterior tibial artery: a branch that winds laterally around the neck of the fibula, helping supply the soleus muscle and contributing to the anastomosis around the knee joint; called also r. circumflexus peronealis arteriae tibialis posterioris [TA alternative]. and fibular circumflex artery."]

74377 ramus clavicularis arteriae thoracoacromialis
- 
- phr.["胸肩峰动脉锁骨支"]
- phr.["clavicular branch of thoracoacromial artery: a vessel that passes medially to supply the subclavius muscle."]

74378 ramus cochlearis arteriae vestibulocochlearis
- 
- phr.["前庭蜗动脉蜗支"]
- phr.["cochlear branch of vestibulocochlear artery: a branch that supplies the cochlea."]

74379 ramus colicus arteriae ileocolicae
- 
- phr.["回结肠动脉结肠支"]
- phr.["colic branch of ileocolic artery: a branch that passes upward on the ascending colon and anastomoses with the right colic artery; called also ascending ileocolic artery."]

74380 ramus collateralis arteriae intercostalis posterioris
- 
- phr.["后肋间动脉侧副支"]
- phr.["collateral branch of posterior intercostal artery: a branch helping supply the thoracic wall, arising from a posterior intercostal artery near the angle of the rib and running forward in the lower part of the corresponding intercostal space."]

74381 ramus colli nervi facialis
- 
- phr.["面神经颈支"]
- phr.["cervical branch of facial nerve: a branch lying deep to and innervating the platysma muscle; modality, motor. Called also r. cervicalis nervi facialis [TA alternative]."]

74382 ramus communicans albus nervi spinalis
- 
- phr.["脊神经白交通支"]
- phr.["white communicating branch of spinal nerve: one of the two types of communicating nerve branches between a sympathetic ganglion and a spinal nerve; the white type are mostly myelinated, send impulses from the spinal nerves to and through the ganglia, and are located mainly in the thoracic and upper lumbar region. Cf. r. communicans griseus nervi spinalis."]

74383 ramus communicans arteriae fibularis
- 
- phr.["腓动脉交通支"]
- phr.["communicating branch of peroneal artery: a communicating branch between the peroneal and the posterior tibial arteries, distributed to the interosseous membrane and supramalleolar region."]

74384 ramus communicans cochlearis nervi vestibularis
- 
- phr.["前庭神经蜗交通支"]
- phr.["cochlear communicating branch of vestibular nerve: a branch of the vestibular nerve that unites with the cochlear nerve."]

74385 ramus communicans fibularis nervi fibularis communis
- 
- phr.["腓总神经腓神经交通支"]
- phr.["sural communicating branch of common peroneal nerve: a small branch arising from the common peroneal nerve, either with the lateral cutaneous sural nerve or separately; distally it joins the medial sural cutaneous nerve to form the sural nerve. Called also r. communicans peroneus nervi peronei communis [TA alternative]."]

74386 ramus communicans griseus nervi spinalis
- 
- phr.["脊神经灰交通支"]
- phr.["gray communicating branch of spinal nerve: one of the two types of communicating nerve branches between a sympathetic ganglion and a spinal nerve; these branches are gray (unmyelinated) and carry postganglionic impulses back to the spinal nerves and then to the periphery, supplying blood vessels, sweat glands, and smooth muscles. Cf. r. communicans albus nervi spinalis."]

74387 ramus communicans nervi facialis cum nervo glossopharyngeo
- 
- phr.["面神经舌咽神经交通支"]
- phr.["communicating branch of facial nerve with glossopharyngeal nerve: a branch that interconnects the glossopharyngeal nerve and the facial nerve after emergence of the latter from the stylomastoid foramen."]

74388 ramus communicans nervi glossopharyngei cum chorda tympani
- 
- phr.["舌咽神经鼓索交通支"]
- phr.["communicating branch of glossopharyngeal nerve with chorda tympani: a small branch that interconnects the glossopharyngeal nerve and the chorda tympani."]

74389 ramus communicans nervi glossopharyngei cum nervo auriculotemporali
- 
- phr.["舌咽神经耳颞神经交通支"]
- phr.["communicating branch of glossopharyngeal nerve with auriculotemporal nerve: a branch carrying postganglionic parasympathetic fibers from the glossopharyngeal nerve to the auriculotemporal nerve for distribution to the parotid gland."]

74390 ramus communicans nervi glossopharyngei cum ramo auriculari nervi vagi
- 
- phr.["舌咽神经迷走神经耳支交通支"]
- phr.["communicating branch of glossopharyngeal nerve with auricular branch of vagus nerve: a small branch connecting the glossopharyngeal nerve with the auricular branch of the vagus nerve."]

74391 ramus communicans nervi glossopharyngei cum ramo meningeo nervi vagi
- 
- phr.["舌咽神经迷走神经脑膜支交通支"]
- phr.["communicating branch of glossopharyngeal nerve with meningeal branch of vagal nerve: a branch that carries autonomic fibers destined for the meninges from the glossopharyngeal nerve to the meningeal branch of the vagal nerve."]

74392 ramus communicans nervi intermedii cum nervo vago
- 
- phr.["中间神经迷走神经交通支"]
- phr.["communicating branch of intermediate nerve with vagus nerve: a branch of the intermediate nerve that communicates with the vagus nerve."]

74393 ramus communicans nervi intermedii cum plexu tympanico
- 
- phr.["中间神经鼓室丛交通支"]
- phr.["communicating branch of intermediate nerve with tympanic plexus: a branch of the intermediate nerve that communicates with the tympanic plexus."]

74394 ramus communicans nervi lacrimalis cum nervo zygomatico
- 
- phr.["泪腺神经颧神经交通支"]
- phr.["communicating branch of lacrimal nerve with zygomatic nerve: a branch that carries parasympathetic postganglionic fibers originating in the pterygopalatine ganglion and destined for the lacrimal gland."]

74395 ramus communicans nervi laryngei superioris cum nervo laryngeo recurrente
- 
- phr.["喉上神经喉返神经交通支"]
- phr.["communicating branch of superior laryngeal nerve with recurrent laryngeal nerve: a small branch interconnecting the internal branch of the superior laryngeal nerve with the recurrent laryngeal nerve, behind or in the posterior cricoarytenoid muscle. Called also Galen nerve."]

74396 ramus communicans nervi mediani cum nervo ulnari
- 
- phr.["正中神经尺神经交通支"]
- phr.["communicating branch of median nerve with ulnar nerve: a small branch across the flexor digitorum profundus muscle, connecting the median with the ulnar nerve."]

74397 ramus communicans nervi nasociliaris cum ganglio ciliari
- 
- phr.["鼻睫神经睫毛节交通支"]
- phr.["TA alternative for radix sensoria ganglii ciliaris."]

74398 ramus communicans nervi vagi cum nervo glossopharyngeo
- 
- phr.["迷走神经舌咽神经交通支"]
- phr.["communicating branch of vagus nerve with glossopharyngeal nerve; see r. communicans nervi glossopharyngei cum ramo auriculari nervi vagi."]

74399 ramus communicans peroneus nervi peronei communis
- 
- phr.["腓总神经腓神经交通支"]
- phr.["TA alternative for r. communicans fibularis nervi fibularis communis."]

74400 ramus communicans ulnaris nervi radialis
- 
- phr.["桡神经尺神经交通支"]
- phr.["ulnar communicating branch of radial nerve: a small branch in the hand that interconnects the most medial dorsal digital nerve from the superficial branch of the radial nerve with the adjacent most lateral dorsal digital nerve from the dorsal branch of the ulnar nerve."]

74401 ramus coni arteriosi arteriae coronariae dextrae
- 
- phr.["右冠状动脉圆锥支"]
- phr.["conus arteriosus branch of right coronary artery: the first ventricular branch of the right coronary artery, which supplies the conus arteriosus, and anastomoses with the left conus artery (branch) of the anterior interventricular branch of the left coronary artery; called also conal or conus artery, right conus artery, and third conus artery."]

74402 ramus coni arteriosi arteriae coronariae sinistrae
- 
- phr.["左冠状动脉圆锥支"]
- phr.["conus arteriosus branch of left coronary artery: a small branch of the anterior interventricular branch of the left coronary artery, which supplies the conus arteriosus, and anastomoses with the right conus artery (branch) of the right coronary artery; called also conal or conus artery and left conus artery."]

74403 ramus corporis callosi dorsalis arteriae occipitalis medialis
- 
- phr.["枕内动脉胼胝体背支"]
- phr.["dorsal branch to corpus callosum: a branch of the medial occipital artery that supplies the dorsum of the corpus callosum."]

74404 ramus costalis lateralis arteriae thoracicae internae
- 
- phr.["胸内动脉肋骨外侧支"]
- phr.["lateral costal branch of internal thoracic artery: an occasional branch passing inferolaterally behind the ribs, supplying ribs and costal cartilages, and anastomosing with the posterior intercostal arteries."]

74405 ramus cricothyroideus arteriae thyroideae superioris
- 
- phr.["甲状腺上动脉环甲支"]
- phr.["cricothyroid branch of superior thyroid artery: a vessel running medially over the cricothyroid muscle, toward the cricothyroid ligament, and anastomosing with its fellow of the opposite side. Called also cricothyroid artery."]

74406 ramus cutaneus
- 
- phr.["皮支"]
- phr.["cutaneous branch: a branch of a mixed (afferent or efferent) peripheral nerve innervating a region of the skin."]

74407 ramus cutaneus anterior abdominalis nervi intercostalis
- 
- phr.["肋间神经腹部前皮支"]
- phr.["anterior abdominal cutaneous branch of intercostal nerve: a branch from the intercostal nerve that contributes to innervation of the skin in the anteromedial abdominal region. Its modality is general sensory."]

74408 ramus cutaneus anterior nervi iliohypogastrici
- 
- phr.["髂腹下神经前皮支"]
- phr.["anterior cutaneous branch of iliohypogastric nerve: a branch that runs forward between the internal and external oblique muscles and innervates the skin over the pubis; modality, general sensory."]

74409 ramus cutaneus lateralis abdominalis nervi intercostalis
- 
- phr.["肋间神经腹外侧皮支"]
- phr.["lateral abdominal cutaneous branch of intercostal nerve: a branch from the intercostal nerve that, through its anterior and posterior subdivisions, innervates the skin of the lateral and posterior body wall; it has a general sensory modality."]

74410 ramus cutaneus lateralis arteriae intercostalis posterioris
- 
- phr.["后肋间动脉外侧皮支"]
- phr.["lateral cutaneous branch of posterior intercostal artery: a branch arising from a posterior intercostal artery, supplying the anterolateral thoracic wall. The branches of the third through fifth posterior intercostal arteries give off small mammary branches."]

74411 ramus cutaneus lateralis nervi iliohypogastrici
- 
- phr.["髂腹下神经外侧皮支"]
- phr.["lateral cutaneous branch of iliohypogastric nerve: a nerve branch distributed to the skin over the side of the buttock; modality, general sensory."]

74412 ramus cutaneus nervi obturatorii
- 
- phr.["闭孔神经皮支"]
- phr.["cutaneous branch of obturator nerve: a variable branch arising from the anterior branch of the obturator nerve, forming part of the subsartorial plexus, and supplying the skin of the medial aspect of the thigh and leg; modality, general sensory."]

74413 ramus cutaneus posterior rami posterioris nervi thoracici
- 
- phr.["胸神经背支后侧皮支"]
- phr.["posterior cutaneous branch of posterior branch of thoracic nerve: cutaneous branches of either of the two divisions of a dorsal branch; see r. lateralis rami posterior nervi thoracici and r. medialis rami posterior nervi thoracici."]

74414 ramus deltoideus arteriae profundae brachii
- 
- phr.["肱深动脉三角肌支"]
- phr.["deltoid branch of profunda brachii artery: a branch distributed to the brachialis and deltoid muscles, and anastomosing with the posterior circumflex humeral artery."]

74415 ramus deltoideus arteriae thoracoacromialis
- 
- phr.["胸肩峰动脉三角肌支"]
- phr.["deltoid branch of thoracoacromial artery: a branch of the thoracoacromial artery descending with the cephalic vein and helping to supply the deltoid and pectoralis major muscles."]

74416 ramus descendens arteriae circumflexae femoris lateralis
- 
- phr.["外侧旋股动脉降支"]
- phr.["descending branch of lateral circumflex femoral artery: a branch passing from the lateral circumflex artery (sometimes directly from the deep femoral) to the knee, and supplying the thigh muscles."]

74417 ramus descendens arteriae occipitalis
- 
- phr.["枕动脉降支"]
- phr.["descending branch of occipital artery: a branch that arises from the occipital artery on the obliquus capitis superior muscle and divides into superficial and deep branches, supplying the trapezius and deep neck muscles."]

74418 ramus descendens arteriae segmentalis anterioris pulmonis dextri
- 
- phr.["右肺动脉前段降支"]
- phr.["descending branch of anterior segmental artery of right lung: one of the branches of the anterior segmental artery that supply the anterior segment of the superior lobe of the right lung."]

74419 ramus descendens arteriae segmentalis anterioris pulmonis sinistri
- 
- phr.["左肺动脉前段降支"]
- phr.["descending branch of anterior segmental artery of left lung: one of the branches of the anterior segmental artery that supply the anterior segment of the superior lobe of the left lung."]

74420 ramus descendens arteriae segmentalis posterioris pulmonis dextri
- 
- phr.["右肺动脉后段降支"]
- phr.["descending branch of posterior segmental artery of right lung: one of the branches of the posterior segmental artery that supply the posterior segment of the superior lobe of the right lung."]

74421 ramus descendens arteriae segmentalis posterioris pulmonis sinistri
- 
- phr.["左肺动脉后段降支"]
- phr.["descending branch of posterior segmental artery of left lung: one of the branches of the posterior segmental artery that supply the posterior segment of the superior lobe of the left lung."]

74422 ramus descendens rami superficialis arteriae transversae colli
- 
- phr.["颈横动脉浅降支"]
- phr.["descending branch of the superficial branch of the transverse cervical artery."]

74423 ramus dexter arteriae hepaticae propriae
- 
- phr.["肝固有动脉右支"]
- phr.["right branch of hepatic artery proper: the right of the two branches into which the hepatic artery proper normally divides; it supplies the right liver, and a branch, the cystic artery, supplies the gallbladder."]

74424 ramus dexter venae portae hepatis
- 
- phr.["肝门静脉右支"]
- phr.["right branch of hepatic portal vein: a branch distributed to the right liver."]

74425 ramus digastricus nervi facialis
- 
- phr.["面神经二腹肌支"]
- phr.["digastric branch of facial nerve: a branch that innervates the posterior belly of the digastric muscle; modality, motor; called also digastric nerve."]

74426 ramus diploicus arteriae supraorbitalis
- 
- phr.["眶上动脉板障支"]
- phr.["diploic branch of supraorbital artery: a small branch arising as the artery passes through the supraorbital notch and supplying the diploë of the frontal bone and the lining of the frontal sinus."]

74427 ramus dorsalis arteriae intercostalis posterioris
- 
- phr.["后肋间动脉背支"]
- phr.["dorsal branch of posterior intercostal artery: a branch arising from a posterior intercostal artery, passing backward with the dorsal branch of the corresponding intercostal nerve to supply the posterior thoracic wall; it has several spinal branches and a medial and a lateral cutaneous branch."]

74428 ramus dorsalis arteriae intercostalis posterioris primae
- 
- phr.["第一后肋间动脉背支"]
- phr.["dorsal branch of first intercostal artery: the dorsal branch arising from the first posterior intercostal artery. Its distribution is similar to that of the other posterior intercostals; see r. dorsalis arteriae intercostalis posterioris."]

74429 ramus dorsalis arteriae intercostalis posterioris secundae
- 
- phr.["第二后肋间动脉背支"]
- phr.["dorsal branch of second intercostal artery: the dorsal branch arising from the second posterior intercostal artery. Its distribution is similar to that of the other posterior intercostals; see r. dorsalis arteriae intercostalis posterioris."]

74430 ramus dorsalis arteriae lumbalis
- 
- phr.["腰动脉背支"]
- phr.["dorsal branch of lumbar artery: the larger of the two branches into which each lumbar artery (four or five) divides; it supplies lumbar back muscles, joints, and skin, and gives off a spinal branch."]

74431 ramus dorsalis nervi coccygei
- 
- phr.["尾神经背支"]
- phr.["TA alternative for r. posterior nervi coccygei."]

74432 ramus dorsalis nervi ulnaris
- 
- phr.["尺神经手背支"]
- phr.["dorsal branch of ulnar nerve: a large cutaneous branch that arises from the ulnar nerve and passes down the distal portion of the forearm to the medial side of the back of the hand, where it divides usually into three, sometimes four, dorsal digital nerves; modality, general sensory."]

74433 ramus dorsalis venae intercostalis posterioris
- 
- phr.["后肋间静脉背支"]
- phr.["TA alternative for vena dorsalis venae intercostalis posterioris."]

74434 ramus externus nervi accessorii
- 
- phr.["副神经外侧支"]
- phr.["external branch of accessory nerve: the branch of the accessory nerve that originates from the spinal roots of the nerve; it sends muscular branches to supply the sternocleidomastoid and trapezius muscles."]

74435 ramus externus nervi laryngei superioris
- 
- phr.["喉上神经外侧支"]
- phr.["external branch of superior laryngeal nerve: the smaller of the two branches into which the superior laryngeal nerve divides, descending under cover of the sternothyroid muscle and innervating the cricothyroid and the inferior constrictor of the pharynx; modality, motor."]

74436 ramus femoralis nervi genitofemoralis
- 
- phr.["生殖股神经股支"]
- phr.["femoral branch of genitofemoral nerve: a branch arising by division of the genitofemoral nerve above the inguinal ligament; entering the femoral sheath, it turns forward and supplies the skin of the femoral triangle; modality, general sensory. Called also nervus lumboinguinalis."]

74437 ramus frontalis anteromedialis arteriae callosomarginalis
- 
- phr.["胼胝体缘动脉额叶前内侧支"]
- phr.["the anteromedial frontal branch of the callosomarginal artery."]

74438 ramus frontalis arteriae meningeae mediae
- 
- phr.["脑膜中动脉额支"]
- phr.["frontal branch of middle meningeal artery: a branch lodged in grooves on the sphenoid and parietal bones and supplying the dura mater of the front of the brain. A part of it is sometimes enclosed in a bony canal."]

74439 ramus frontalis arteriae temporalis superficialis
- 
- phr.["颞浅动脉额支"]
- phr.["frontal branch of superficial temporal artery: a tortuous terminal branch that supplies the forehead and frontal scalp."]

74440 ramus frontalis posteromedialis arteriae callosomarginalis
- 
- phr.["胼胝体缘动脉额叶后内侧支"]
- phr.["the posteromedial frontal branch of the callosomarginal artery."]

74441 ramus genitalis nervi genitofemoralis
- 
- phr.["生殖股神经生殖支"]
- phr.["genital branch of genitofemoral nerve: a branch arising from the genitofemoral nerve above the inguinal ligament; entering the inguinal canal through the deep ring, it supplies the cremaster and continues to the skin of the scrotum or of the labium majus, and that of the adjacent area of the thigh; modality, general sensory and motor."]

74442 ramus hypothalamicus arteriae communicantis posterioris
- 
- phr.["后交通动脉下丘脑支"]
- phr.["hypothalamic branch of posterior communicating artery: a branch that supplies the hypothalamus."]

74443 ramus ilealis arteriae ileocolicae
- 
- phr.["回结肠动脉回肠支"]
- phr.["ileal branch of ileocolic artery: a branch that passes upward and to the left of the lower ileum and anastomoses with the end of the superior mesenteric artery."]

74444 ramus iliacus arteriae iliolumbalis
- 
- phr.["髂腰动脉髂骨支"]
- phr.["iliac branch of iliolumbar artery: one of the two branches into which the iliolumbar artery divides in the iliac fossa; it supplies the iliacus muscle and sends a large nutrient branch to the ilium."]

74445 ramus inferior nervi oculomotorii
- 
- phr.["动眼神经下支"]
- phr.["inferior branch of oculomotor nerve: the branch of the oculomotor nerve that innervates the medial and inferior rectus and inferior oblique muscles of the eyeball and, via the motor root of the ciliary ganglion and then the short ciliary nerves, supplies the sphincter pupillae and ciliary muscles; modality, motor and parasympathetic."]

74446 ramus inferior ossis pubis
- 
- phr.["耻骨下支"]
- phr.["inferior ramus of pubic bone: the short flattened bar of bone that projects from the body of the pubic bone in a posteroinferolateral direction to meet the ramus of the ischium. See illustration at ramus ossis ischii."]

74447 ramus infrahyoideus arteriae thyroideae superioris
- 
- phr.["甲状腺上动脉舌骨下支"]
- phr.["infrahyoid branch of superior thyroid artery: a vessel running along the inferior border of the hyoid bone, supplying the infrahyoid region, and anastomosing with its fellow of the opposite side."]

74448 ramus infrapatellaris nervi sapheni
- 
- phr.["隐神经髌下支"]
- phr.["infrapatellar branch of saphenous nerve: a branch running inferolaterally from the saphenous nerve to the patellar plexus; modality, general sensory."]

74449 ramus internus nervi accessorii
- 
- phr.["副神经内侧支"]
- phr.["internal branch of accessory nerve: the branch of the trunk of accessory nerve that begins as what has been called cranial root of the accessory nerve (now identiified as part of the vagus nerve), and joins the vagus nerve immediately upon branching off the trunk; it carries motor fibers that are distributed to the soft palate, pharyngeal constrictors, and larynx."]

74450 ramus internus nervi laryngei superioris
- 
- phr.["喉上神经内侧支"]
- phr.["internal branch of superior laryngeal nerve: the larger of the two branches of the superior laryngeal nerve, which innervates the mucosa of the epiglottis, base of the tongue, and larynx; modality, general sensory."]

74451 ramus interventricularis anterior arteriae coronariae sinistrae
- 
- phr.["左冠状动脉前室间支"]
- phr.["anterior interventricular branch of left coronary artery: the branch of the left coronary artery that runs to the apex of the heart in the anterior interventricular sulcus, supplying the ventricles and most of the interventricular septum. See illustration at ramus marginalis dexter arteriae coronariae dextrae. Called also anterior interventricular artery."]

74452 ramus interventricularis posterior arteriae coronariae dextrae
- 
- phr.["右冠状动脉后室间支"]
- phr.["posterior interventricular branch of right coronary artery: a branch running toward the apex of the heart in the posterior interventricular sulcus, supplying the diaphragmatic surface of the ventricles and part of the interventricular septum."]

74453 ramus lateralis arteriae superioris cerebelli
- 
- phr.["小脑上动脉外侧支"]
- phr.["the lateral branch of the superior cerebellar artery."]

74454 ramus lateralis ductus hepatici sinistri
- 
- phr.["左肝管外侧支"]
- phr.["the lateral branch of the left hepatic duct, draining lateral segments of the left liver."]

74455 ramus lateralis interventricularis anterioris arteriae coronariae sinistrae
- 
- phr.["左冠状动脉前室间外侧支"]
- phr.["lateral branch of the anterior interventricular branch of the left coronary artery."]

74456 ramus lateralis nasi arteriae facialis
- 
- phr.["面动脉鼻外侧支"]
- phr.["lateral nasal branch of the facial artery: a branch supplying the ala and dorsum of the nose."]

74457 ramus lateralis nervi supraorbitalis
- 
- phr.["眶上神经外侧支"]
- phr.["lateral branch of supraorbital nerve: a branch of the supraorbital nerve that supplies the frontal sinus, upper eyelid, and skin and subcutaneous tissue of the forehead and scalp laterally as far as the temporal region; modality, general sensory."]

74458 ramus lateralis rami posterioris nervi cervicalis
- 
- phr.["颈神经后支外侧支"]
- phr.["lateral branch of posterior branch of cervical nerve: the lateral branch that arises from the posterior branch of a cervical nerve and supplies adjacent muscles."]

74459 ramus lateralis rami posterioris nervi lumbalis
- 
- phr.["腰神经后支外侧支"]
- phr.["lateral branch of posterior branch of lumbar nerve: a branch that runs inferolaterally from the posterior branch of each lumbar nerve and innervates adjacent muscle; these branches have upper terminal branches that constitute the superior cluneal nerves and innervate the skin of the buttock."]

74460 ramus lateralis rami posterioris nervi sacralis
- 
- phr.["骶神经后支外侧支"]
- phr.["lateral branch of posterior branch of sacral nerve: a branch that arises from the posterior branch of one of the three upper sacral nerves and supplies the posterior gluteal skin."]

74461 ramus lateralis rami posterioris nervi thoracici
- 
- phr.["胸神经后支外侧支"]
- phr.["lateral branch of posterior branch of thoracic nerve: the lateral of the terminal divisions of the posterior branch; it supplies first its corresponding levator costae muscle and then the longissimus thoracis and iliocostalis thoracis muscles. The lower branches pierce the latissimus dorsi and supply the skin of the back."]

74462 ramus lingualis nervi facialis
- 
- phr.["面神经舌支"]
- phr.["lingual branch of facial nerve: an inconstant branch of the facial nerve sometimes arising together with the stylohyoid branch, and helping to supply the styloglossal and glossopalatine muscles; modality, motor."]

74463 ramus lingularis venae pulmonalis sinistrae superioris
- 
- phr.["左肺上静脉舌支"]
- phr.["TA alternative for vena lingularis."]

74464 ramus lobi medii venae pulmonalis dextrae superioris
- 
- phr.["右肺上静脉中叶支"]
- phr.["TA alternative for vena lobi medii."]

74465 ramus lumbalis arteriae iliolumbalis
- 
- phr.["髂腰动脉腰支"]
- phr.["lumbar branch of iliolumbar artery: a branch that arises from the iliolumbar artery in the iliac fossa and ascends to supply the psoas and quadratus lumborum muscles, sending a spinal branch through the intervertebral foramen just above the sacrum."]

74466 ramus mandibulae
- 
- phr.["下颌支"]
- phr.["ramus of mandible: a quadrilateral process projecting superiorly from the posterior part of either side of the mandible. Called also r. of jaw.Ramus mandibulae (ramus of mandible), which together with the corpus mandibulae (body of the mandible) composes the mandible."]

74467 ramus marginalis dexter arteriae coronariae dextrae
- 
- phr.["右冠状动脉右缘支"]
- phr.["right marginal branch of right coronary artery: a branch that passes toward the apex of the heart along the acute margin of the heart and ramifies over the right ventricle; called also right marginal artery. See illustration.Anterior view of the heart showing several rami of the coronary arteries."]

74468 ramus marginalis mandibularis nervi facialis
- 
- phr.["面神经下颌缘支"]
- phr.["marginal mandibular branch of facial nerve: a branch of the facial nerve that runs forward from the front of the parotid gland along the border of the mandible, deep to the platysma and depressor anguli oris muscles, supplying the latter and the risorius, depressor labii inferioris, and mentalis muscles; modality, motor."]

74469 ramus marginalis sinister rami circumflexi arteriae coronariae sinistrae
- 
- phr.["左冠状动脉旋支左缘支"]
- phr.["left marginal branch of circumflex branch of left coronary artery: a branch that follows the left margin of the heart and supplies the left ventricle. Called also left marginal artery."]

74470 ramus marginalis sulci cinguli
- 
- phr.["扣带沟幕缘支"]
- phr.["marginal branch of cingulate sulcus: the posterior portion of the cingulate sulcus that turns off at a right angle and is directed toward the dorsal margin of the cerebral hemisphere, separating the precuneus and the paracentral lobule. Called also sulcus marginalis [TA alternative] and marginal sulcus."]

74471 ramus marginalis tentorii arteriae carotidis internae
- 
- phr.["颈内动脉幕缘支"]
- phr.["tentorial marginal branch of internal carotid artery: a twig from the cavernous part of the internal carotid artery that supplies the margin of the tentorium."]

74472 ramus mastoideus arteriae occipitalis
- 
- phr.["枕动脉乳突支"]
- phr.["mastoid branch of occipital artery: a branch that enters the cranial cavity through the mastoid foramen and supplies the dura mater, diploe, and mastoid cells. Called also mastoid artery."]

74473 ramus medialis arteriae superioris cerebelli
- 
- phr.["小脑上动脉内侧支"]
- phr.["the medial branch of the superior cerebellar artery."]

74474 ramus medialis ductus hepatici sinistri
- 
- phr.["左肝管内侧支"]
- phr.["the medial branch of the left hepatic duct, draining medial segments of the left liver."]

74475 ramus medialis nervi supraorbitalis
- 
- phr.["眶上神经内侧支"]
- phr.["medial branch of supraorbital nerve: a nerve branch that supplies the frontal sinus, upper eyelid, and skin and subcutaneous tissue of the forehead and adjacent scalp as far back as the parietal bone; modality, general sensory."]

74476 ramus medialis rami posterioris nervi cervicalis
- 
- phr.["颈神经后支内侧支"]
- phr.["medial branch of posterior branch of cervical nerve: the medial branch that arises from the posterior branch of a cervical nerve and supplies muscle, periosteum, ligaments, and joints; all except the first and sometimes the sixth through eighth have an eventual cutaneous distribution."]

74477 ramus medialis rami posterioris nervi lumbalis
- 
- phr.["腰神经后支内侧支"]
- phr.["medial branch of posterior branch of lumbar nerve: a branch of the posterior branch of each lumbar nerve, mainly innervating deep muscle but also helping supply ligaments, periosteum, and joints."]

74478 ramus medialis rami posterioris nervi sacralis
- 
- phr.["骶神经后支内侧支"]
- phr.["medial branch of posterior branch of sacral nerve: a branch arising from the posterior branch of one of the three upper sacral nerves and innervating the multifidus muscle."]

74479 ramus medialis rami posterioris nervi thoracici
- 
- phr.["胸神经后支内侧支"]
- phr.["medial branch of posterior branch of thoracic nerve: one of the terminal divisions of the posterior branch of the thoracic nerve, supplying periosteum, ligaments, and joints. Those of the upper thoracic nerves supply the skin of the back, and those of the lower nerves supply primarily the erector spinae muscle."]

74480 ramus membranae tympani nervi auriculotemporalis
- 
- phr.["耳颞神经鼓膜支"]
- phr.["branch to tympanic membrane of auriculotemporal nerve: a branch given to the tympanic membrane by the nerve of the external acoustic meatus, a branch of the auriculotemporal nerve; modality, general sensory."]

74481 ramus meningeus anterior arteriae ethmoidalis anterioris
- 
- phr.["筛前动脉脑膜前支"]
- phr.["anterior meningeal branch of anterior ethmoidal artery; a branch that supplies the dura mater. Called also anterior meningeal artery."]

74482 ramus meningeus arteriae occipitalis
- 
- phr.["枕动脉脑膜支"]
- phr.["meningeal branch of occipital artery: one or more variable branches of the occipital artery that enter the posterior fossa and supply the dura mater."]

74483 ramus meningeus nervi mandibularis
- 
- phr.["下颌神经脑膜支"]
- phr.["meningeal branch of mandibular nerve: a branch that arises from the trunk of the mandibular nerve, re-enters the cranium through the foramen spinosum, accompanies the middle meningeal artery to supply the dura mater, and also helps innervate the mucous membrane of the mastoid air cells. Called also nervus spinosus [TA alternative]."]

74484 ramus meningeus nervi maxillaris
- 
- phr.["上颌神经脑膜支"]
- phr.["meningeal branch of maxillary nerve: a branch arising from the maxillary nerve in the middle cranial fossa, accompanying the middle meningeal artery, and supplying the dura mater; modality, general sensory. Called also meningeal nerve and nervus meningeus medius."]

74485 ramus meningeus nervi spinalis
- 
- phr.["脊神经脑膜支"]
- phr.["meningeal branch of spinal nerve: the small branch of each spinal nerve that re-enters the intervertebral foramen to supply the dura mater, vertebral column, and associated ligaments. Called also r. recurrens nervi spinalis [TA alternative]."]

74486 ramus meningeus nervi vagi
- 
- phr.["迷走神经脑膜支"]
- phr.["meningeal branch of vagus nerve: a branch that arises in the jugular foramen from the superior ganglion of the vagus nerve, innervating dura mater of the posterior cranial fossa."]

74487 ramus meningeus partis cavernosae arteriae carotidis internae
- 
- phr.["颈内动脉海绵体部脑膜支"]
- phr.["meningeal branch of cavernous part of internal carotid artery: a twig from the cavernous part of the internal carotid artery that supplies the meninges of the anterior cranial fossa."]

74488 ramus meningeus partis cerebralis arteriae carotidis internae
- 
- phr.["颈内动脉大脑部脑膜支"]
- phr.["meningeal branch of cerebral part of internal carotid artery: a twig from the cerebral part of the internal carotid artery that supplies the meninges of the anterior cranial fossa."]

74489 ramus meningeus recurrens arteriae ophthalmicae
- 
- phr.["眼动脉脑膜返支"]
- phr.["recurrent meningeal branch of ophthalmic artery: a branch that passes back through the superior orbital fissure and anastomoses with a branch of the meningeal artery between the internal and external carotid arteries."]

74490 ramus meningeus recurrens nervi ophthalmici
- 
- phr.["眼神经脑膜返支"]
- phr.["tentorial branch of ophthalmic nerve: a branch that arises from the ophthalmic nerve close to its origin from the trigeminal ganglion, turning back to innervate the dura mater of the tentorium cerebelli and falx cerebri; modality, general sensory. Called also r. tentorius nervi ophthalmici [TA alternative]."]

74491 ramus musculi stylopharyngei nervi glossopharyngei
- 
- phr.["舌咽神经茎突咽肌支"]
- phr.["stylopharyngeal branch of glossopharyngeal nerve: a branch that supplies the stylopharyngeal muscle; modality, motor."]

74492 ramus mylohyoideus arteriae alveolaris inferioris
- 
- phr.["下牙槽动脉下颌舌骨肌支"]
- phr.["mylohyoid branch of inferior alveolar artery: a branch that descends with the mylohyoid nerve in the mylohyoid sulcus to supply the floor of the mouth."]

74493 ramus nasalis externus nervi ethmoidalis anterioris
- 
- phr.["筛前神经鼻外侧支"]
- phr.["external nasal branch of anterior ethmoidal nerve: a branch that is essentially a continuation, or terminal branch, of the anterior ethmoidal nerve, innervating the skin of the dorsal part of the nose; modality, general sensory."]

74494 ramus nervi oculomotorii ad ganglii ciliare
- 
- phr.["睫状神经节和动眼神经支"]
- phr.["TA alternative for r. parasympathica ganglii ciliaris."]

74495 ramus nervi oculomotorii arteriae communicantis posterioris
- 
- phr.["后交通动脉动眼神经支"]
- phr.["oculomotor nerve branch of posterior communicating artery: the branch that supplies the oculomotor nerve."]

74496 ramus nodi atrioventricularis arteriae coronariae dextrae
- 
- phr.["右冠状动脉房室结支"]
- phr.["atrioventricular nodal branch of right coronary artery: a branch of the right coronary artery usually arising opposite the origin of the posterior interventricular artery and inserting into the atrioventricular node. Called also atrioventricular nodal artery."]

74497 ramus nodi atrioventricularis rami circumflexi arteriae coronariae sinistrae
- 
- phr.["左冠状动脉旋支房室结支"]
- phr.["atrioventricular nodal branch of circumflex branch of left coronary artery: a branch of the left coronary artery occasionally found supplying the atrioventricular node."]

74498 ramus nodi sinuatrialis arteriae coronariae dextrae
- 
- phr.["右冠状动脉窦房结支"]
- phr.["sinoatrial nodal branch of right coronary artery: a branch of the right coronary artery that supplies the right atrium, encircles the base of the superior vena cava, and inserts into the sinoatrial node. Called also nodal artery, sinoatrial or sinuatrial nodal artery, and sinus node artery."]

74499 ramus occipitalis arteriae auricularis posterioris
- 
- phr.["耳后动脉枕支"]
- phr.["occipital branch of posterior auricular artery: a branch distributed to the epicranial muscle."]

74500 ramus occipitalis nervi auricularis posterioris
- 
- phr.["耳后神经枕支"]
- phr.["occipital branch of posterior auricular nerve: a branch supplying the occipital belly of the occipitofrontalis muscle; modality, motor."]

74501 ramus occipitotemporalis arteriae occipitalis medialis
- 
- phr.["枕内动脉枕颞支"]
- phr.["occipitotemporal branch of medial occipital artery: a branch that supplies the occipital and temporal areas of the cerebral cortex."]

74502 ramus of ischium
- 
- phr.["坐骨支"]
- phr.["r. ossis ischii."]

74503 ramus of jaw
- 
- phr.["颌骨支，颌支"]
- phr.["r. mandibulae."]

74504 ramus of pubis
- 
- phr.["耻骨支"]
- phr.["see r. inferior ossis pubis and r. superior ossis pubis."]

74505 ramus orbitalis arteriae meningeae mediae
- 
- phr.["脑膜中动脉眶支"]
- phr.["the orbital branch of the middle meningeal artery."]

74506 ramus ossis ischii
- 
- phr.["坐骨支"]
- phr.["ramus of ischium: the flattened bar of bone that projects from the inferior end of the body of the ischium in an anterosuperomedial direction to meet the inferior ramus of the pubis. It forms part of the border of the obturator foramen. See illustration.Lateral surface of left hip bone, showing the ramus ossis ischii, ramus superior ossis pubis, and ramus inferior ossis pubis."]

74507 ramus palmaris nervi mediani
- 
- phr.["正中神经掌支"]
- phr.["palmar branch of median nerve: a branch arising from the median nerve in the lower part of the forearm and supplying the skin of the central palm and of the thenar eminence; modality, general sensory."]

74508 ramus palmaris nervi ulnaris
- 
- phr.["尺神经掌支"]
- phr.["palmar branch of ulnar nerve: a branch arising from the ulnar nerve in the lower part of the forearm, supplying the cutaneous structures of the medial part of the palm; modality, general sensory."]

74509 ramus palmaris profundus arteriae ulnaris
- 
- phr.["尺动脉掌深支"]
- phr.["deep palmar branch of ulnar artery: a branch that accompanies the deep palmar branch of the ulnar nerve and joins the radial artery to form the deep palmar arch."]

74510 ramus palmaris superficialis arteriae radialis
- 
- phr.["桡动脉掌浅支"]
- phr.["superficial palmar branch of radial artery: a branch arising from the radial artery in the lower part of the forearm and supplying the thenar eminence."]

74511 ramus parietalis arteriae meningeae mediae
- 
- phr.["脑膜中动脉顶支"]
- phr.["parietal branch of middle meningeal artery: a vessel that arises in the middle cranial fossa, grooves the temporal and parietal bones, and supplies the posterior dura mater."]

74512 ramus parietalis arteriae occipitalis medialis
- 
- phr.["枕内动脉顶支"]
- phr.["parietal branch of medial occipital artery: the branch of the medial occipital artery that supplies the parietal lobe."]

74513 ramus parietalis arteriae temporalis superficialis
- 
- phr.["颞浅动脉顶支"]
- phr.["parietal branch of superficial temporal artery: the posterior terminal branch of the superficial temporal artery, supplying the scalp in the parietal region."]

74514 ramus parotideus arteriae auricularis posterioris
- 
- phr.["耳后动脉腮腺支"]
- phr.["parotid branch of the posterior auricular artery: a branch supplying the parotid gland."]

74515 ramus parotideus arteriae temporalis superficialis
- 
- phr.["颞浅动脉腮腺支"]
- phr.["parotid branch of superficial temporal artery: a branch supplying the parotid gland and the temporomandibular joint."]

74516 ramus perforans arteriae fibularis
- 
- phr.["腓动脉穿支"]
- phr.["perforating branch of peroneal artery: a branch passing forward from the peroneal artery where the interosseous membrane and the tibiofibular syndesmosis are continuous and descending to supply the syndesmosis and the ankle joint."]

74517 ramus pericardiacus nervi phrenici
- 
- phr.["膈神经心包支"]
- phr.["pericardiac branch of phrenic nerve: a branch arising from the phrenic or accessory phrenic nerve and supplying the pericardium; modality, general sensory."]

74518 ramus petrosus arteriae meningeae mediae
- 
- phr.["脑膜中动脉岩浅支"]
- phr.["petrosal branch of middle meningeal artery: a branch that arises in the region of the petrous part of the temporal bone, entering the hiatus for the greater petrosal nerve and anastomosing with the stylomastoid artery."]

74519 ramus pharyngeus arteriae canalis pterygoidei
- 
- phr.["翼管动脉咽支"]
- phr.["pharyngeal branch of artery of pterygoid canal: a branch lying medial to the pterygopalatine ganglion."]

74520 ramus pharyngeus nervi vagi
- 
- phr.["迷走神经咽支"]
- phr.["pharyngeal branch of vagus nerve: any of several branches that innervate the pharyngeal muscles and mucosa and have motor and general sensory modalities."]

74521 ramus postcentralis rami dorsalis arteriae intercostalis posterioris
- 
- phr.["肋间后动脉中央后支背支"]
- phr.["postcentral branch of dorsal branch of posterior intercostal artery: one of the spinal branches of the dorsal branch of a posterior intercostal artery; it is the branch that tracks behind the vertebral body."]

74522 ramus posterior arteriae obturatoriae
- 
- phr.["闭孔动脉后支"]
- phr.["posterior branch of obturator artery: a branch passing backward around the lateral margin of the obturator foramen, on the obturator membrane, supplying muscles around the ischial tuberosity and giving off an acetabular branch."]

74523 ramus posterior arteriae pancreaticoduodenalis inferioris
- 
- phr.["胰十二指肠下动脉后支"]
- phr.["posterior branch of inferior pancreaticoduodenal artery: a branch that ascends behind the head of the pancreas, which it sometimes pierces, and anastomoses with the posterior superior pancreaticoduodenal artery; it supplies the head of the pancreas and adjoining parts of the duodenum."]

74524 ramus posterior arteriae recurrentis ulnaris
- 
- phr.["尺返动脉后支"]
- phr.["posterior branch of ulnar recurrent artery: a branch running to the back of the medial epicondyle, supplying the elbow joint and neighboring muscles."]

74525 ramus posterior arteriae renalis
- 
- phr.["肾动脉后支"]
- phr.["posterior branch of renal artery: a branch supplying the posterior segment of the kidney."]

74526 ramus posterior ductus hepatici dextri
- 
- phr.["右肝管后支"]
- phr.["the posterior branch of the right hepatic duct, draining posterior segments of the right liver."]

74527 ramus posterior nervi coccygei
- 
- phr.["尾神经后支"]
- phr.["posterior branch of coccygeal nerve: a branch of the last spinal nerve, helping to innervate the skin over the coccyx. Called also r. dorsalis nervi coccygei [TA alternative]."]

74528 ramus posterior nervi cutanei antebrachii medialis
- 
- phr.["前臂内侧皮神经后支"]
- phr.["posterior branch of medial antebrachial cutaneous nerve: a branch that innervates the skin of the posteromedial and medial aspects of the forearm; modality, general sensory."]

74529 ramus posterior nervi obturatorii
- 
- phr.["闭孔神经后支"]
- phr.["posterior branch of obturator nerve: a branch that descends to innervate the knee joint, giving muscular branches to the obturator externus, adductor magnus, and sometimes the adductor brevis muscle; modality, general sensory and motor."]

74530 ramus posterior nervi spinalis
- 
- phr.["脊神经后支"]
- phr.["posterior branch of spinal nerve: the posterior and usually smaller of the two branches into which each spinal nerve divides almost as soon as it emerges from the intervertebral foramen; the posterior branches supply the skin, muscles, joints, and bone of the posterior part of the neck and trunk. Most of these branches further subdivide into a medial and a lateral portion.Posterior (ramus posterior nervi cervicalis) and anterior (ramus anterior nervi cervicalis) branches of the fifth cervical nerve, the nerve itself forming from the union of ventral and dorsal nerve roots, just distal to the ganglion on the dorsal root, within the intervertebral foramen."]

74531 ramus posterior sulci lateralis cerebri
- 
- phr.["大脑外侧沟后支"]
- phr.["posterior branch of lateral cerebral sulcus: the part of the lateral cerebral sulcus that runs obliquely posteriorly between the temporal and the parietal lobes."]

74532 ramus posterior ventriculi sinistri rami circumflexi arteriae coronariae sinistrae
- 
- phr.["左冠状动脉旋支左室后支"]
- phr.["posterior left ventricular branch of circumflex branch of left coronary artery: an interventricular continuation of the circumflex branch; there may be two or three vessels."]

- phr.["桡神经深支"]

Its continuation, the posterior interosseous nerve, supplies distal forearm muscles and the carpal and intercarpal joints; modality, motor."]

74615 rank sum test
-

It is based on the value of the rank sum statistic, which is calculated as the sum of the ranks of each sample after the observations in both samples are jointly ranked in ascending order; if and only if the null hypothesis is true, the average ranks of the two samples will be similar. Called also t.>Mann-Whitney U t., Mann-Whitney-Wilcoxon t., and Wilcoxon rank sum t."]

See illustration.Double diffusion used to indicate the relationship between antigens (blue, with numerals indicating epitopes present) and a particular test antibody (yellow). (Top), Reaction of identity; the antibody is precipitating identical epitopes in each preparation. (Middle), Reaction of nonidentity; the antibody preparation distinguishes the three different antigens, each of which forms an arc. (Bottom), Reaction of partial identity; the antibody preparation reacts with both epitopes, forming a line of identity (anti&#38;ndash;epitope 1) with the addition of a spur of nonidentity (anti&#38;ndash;epitope 2)."]

The values obtained from a statistical sample are used to establish a reference interval that covers 95 per cent of the values of the healthy general population or of specific subpopulations differing in age and sex. These concepts were originally and are still widely referred to as “normal values” and the “normal range,” but the use of these terms is now discouraged because of their implication that values falling outside of the reference interval are “abnormal” or “unhealthy,” which has led to much confusion. The ray before refraction is called the incident ray; after refraction it is the refracted ray. The point of junction of the incident and the refracted ray is known as the point of incidence. During the febrile periods, symptoms include chills, headache, fatigue, myalgia, arthralgia, anorexia, cough, abdominal pain, and sometimes coagulation disturbance, hepatosplenomegaly, psychic disturbances, petechial rash, and vomiting. The genome consists of 10 to 12 structural segments of linear double-stranded RNA (total MW 12–20 × 106, 10–27 kbp depending on the genus). Virions contain 10–12 structural proteins, including a transcriptase, and are resistant to heat but sensitive to lipid solvents. Replication and assembly occur in the cytoplasm. Transmission is by the fecal-oral route, by fomites, or by arthropod vectors. Vertebrate pathogens are included in the genera Orthoreovirus, Orbivirus, Rotavirus, Coltivirus, and Aquareovirus. Other genera contain arthropod and plant pathogens."]

75971 retina
- /ˈretɪnə/
- n.["视网膜"]
- n.["the innermost of the three tunics of the eyeball, surrounding the vitreous body and continuous posteriorly with the optic nerve. It is divided into the pars optica, which rests upon the choroid, the pars ciliaris, which rests upon the ciliary body, and the pars iridica, which rests upon the posterior surface of the iris. The pars optica is subdivided into an outer, pigmented layer (stratum pigmentosum) and an inner, transparent layer (stratum nervosum). The stratum nervosum is divided into nine layers, as follows (see illustration): (1) the internal limiting membrane; (2) the nerve fiber layer; (3) the layer of ganglion cells; (4) the inner plexiform layer; (5) the inner nuclear layer; (6) the outer plexiform layer; (7) the outer nuclear layer; (8) the external limiting membrane; (9) the layer of rods and cones. The layer of rods and cones is the percipient part of the retina, responding to visual stimuli by a photochemical reaction; it is connected with the nerve fiber layer by nerve fibers that join to form the optic nerve. In the center of the posterior part of the retina is the macula lutea, the most sensitive portion of the retina, with the fovea centralis at its center. About 0.25 cm inside the fovea is the point of entrance of the optic nerve and the central artery of the retina; at this point the retina is incomplete and forms the blind spot.Retina.Layers of the optic part of the retina."]

Those outside the fovea centralis have dendritic inner segments that are relatively short and squat with blunt, rounded tips; those within the fovea centralis have inner segments that are more elongated and narrow, so that these cones resemble rods. There are 6 million to 7 million cones, of which about 10 per cent are concentrated in the fovea centralis and the remainder are distributed fairly uniformly over the rest of the retina. Called also cone and cone cell."]

76190 retrospective study
- 
- phr.["回顾性研究"]
- phr.["a longitudinal epidemiologic study in which participating individuals are classified as either having (cases) or lacking (controls) some outcome and their histories are examined for the presence of specific factors possibly associated with that outcome. Cases and controls are often matched with respect to certain demographic or other variables but need not be. As compared with prospective studies, retrospective studies suffer from drawbacks: although they can measure the odds ratio, which often approximates relative risk, they cannot reveal true incidence rates or attributable risk. Also, large biases can be introduced both in the selection of controls and in the recall of past exposure to risk factors. The advantage of the retrospective study is its small scale, usually short time for completion, and its applicability to rare diseases, which would require study of very large cohorts in prospective studies. See also prospective s."]

76211 Retroviridae
- /ˌretrəʊˈvɪrɪdi:/
- n.["反转录病毒科"]
- n.["the retroviruses: a family of RNA viruses having a virion 80–100 nm in diameter consisting of a lipid-containing envelope with peplomers, surrounding an icosahedral capsid. The genome consists of two identical molecules of polyadenylated positive-sense single-stranded RNA; the monomers are connected at the 5′ end by hydrogen bonds and each has a molecular weight of approximately 3 × 106 and a size of 3.5–9 kb, depending on the genus. Viruses contain seven major polypeptides, including a reverse transcriptase, and are resistant to ultraviolet light but sensitive to lipid solvents and detergents. Replication is unique: genomic RNA serves as a template for DNA synthesis via reverse transcriptase; complementary DNA is synthesized from viral DNA and integrated into the host cell DNA, where it is used for transcription. Assembly occurs by budding through the plasma membrane. Most retroviruses are oncogenic. Genera of medical or veterinary importance are Alpharetrovirus, Betaretrovirus, Gammaretrovirus, Deltaretrovirus, Lentivirus, and Spumavirus."]

See also reverberating circuit, under circuit."]

- 
- phr.["逆转反应"]

It is a type of delayed hypersensitivity reaction with “upgrading” of cell-mediated immunity to Mycobacterium leprae; this process tends to move the disease toward the tuberculoid pole. The reaction is chiefly characterized by erythema, edema, tenderness of preexisting quiescent lesions, appearance of new lesions, neuritis with nerve damage, fever, adenopathy, and an elevated leukocyte count. Called also upgrading r. See also downgrading r."]

Cholesterol released into plasma during cell turnover is adsorbed to HDL where it is esterified by lecithin–cholesterol acyltransferase; most of the cholesteryl esters then are transferred to intermediate-density or very-low-density lipoproteins by a specific transfer protein and these lipoproteins are ultimately taken up by the liver."]

76287 Rh blood group
- 
- phr.["Rh 血型"]
- phr.["the most complex of all human blood groups because the genes differ by determining different numbers of antigens (Rh factors) and do so with remarkably different quality; over 40 antigens have been described to date. People of African descent show the greatest degree of diversity and East Asians the least. The major antigen, Rh1 (Rh0, D, or Rh0D), is highly immunogenic and before the development of passive immunization prophylaxis it was responsible for serious hemolytic disease of the newborn. Two other pairs of alternative antigens are inherited with or without Rh1; these are Rh21 (rhG or CG) and Rh4 (hr′ or c), and Rh3 (rh′ or E) and Rh5 (hr′ or e). The most common groups of antigens are R-1,-3,-21 (in Caucasians), R1,-3,-21 (in blacks), R1,-3,21 (in East Asians and Caucasians), and R1,3,-21 (in East Asians and Caucasians). Another antigen Rh10 (hrv, V) is common in blacks."]

See also Rh0 (D) immune globulin, under globulin."]

76322 Rhabdoviridae
- /ˌræbdəʊˈvɪrɪdi:/
- n.["弹状病毒科"]
- n.["the rhabdoviruses: a family of RNA viruses having a bullet- or rod-shaped virion 130–430 × 45–100 nm consisting of a lipid-containing envelope, with large G-protein peplomers, surrounding a helical nucleocapsid. The genome consists of a single molecule of negative-sense single-stranded RNA (MW 3.5–4.6 × 106, size 11–15 kb). Viruses contain four or five major polypeptides, including a transcriptase, and are sensitive to lipid solvents, detergents, and proteolytic enzymes. Replication occurs in the cytoplasm and assembly is by budding on the plasma membrane or intracytoplasmic membranes. Transmission is by biologic or mechanical vectors. Vertebrate pathogens are included in the genera Vesiculovirus, Lyssavirus, and Ephemerovirus; at least six serogroups of viruses that infect animals and a large number of ungrouped viruses have not yet been assigned to genera."]

There must exist either a segment of slow conduction or overall slow conduction with a locus of unidirectional block, and total conduction time in the circuit must exceed the refractory period of the fibers so that an excitable gap exists between a wavefront head and the tail of that preceding. 77249 rubella
- /rʊˈbelə/
- n.["风疹"]
- n.["an acute, usually benign, infectious disease caused by viruses of genus Rubivirus, a togavirus, affecting most often children and nonimmune young adults. The virus enters the respiratory tract via droplet nuclei and spreads to the lymphatic system. The first symptoms are a slight cold, sore throat, and fever, followed by enlargement of the postauricular, suboccipital, and cervical lymph nodes, and later appearance of a fine pink rash that begins on the head and spreads to become generalized. Transplacental infection of the fetus as a result of maternal infection in the first trimester can cause death of the conceptus or developmental anomalies in the newborn infant (see congenital rubella syndrome, under syndrome). Called also German measles and three-day measles. In French and Spanish the word rubeola is used for this disease."]

77720 Salmonella

- n.["沙门菌属"]
- n.["a genus of gram-negative bacteria of the family Enterobacteriaceae, consisting of non–spore-forming, facultatively anaerobic rods, usually motile with peritrichous flagella. The genus comprises two species, S. bongori and S. enterica, the latter containing six subspecies, and is separable into over 2400 serovars on the basis of O (somatic), Vi (capsular), and H (flagellar) antigens; O antigens are grouped into serogroups, of which six (A, B, C1, C2, D, and E) cause nearly all infections of warm-blooded animals. Pathogenic members are widely distributed in the animal kingdom and cause enteric fevers (typhoid and paratyphoid), septicemia, and gastroenteritis. In reporting Salmonella infections, the full taxonomic designation may be abbreviated, so that S. enterica subs. enterica serovar Typhi can become Salmonella serovar Typhi or Salmonella Typhi. The type species is S. ente´rica."]

Heavy infections in cattle and other animals may be associated with anorexia, emaciation, fever, nervousness, lameness, hypersalivation, anemia, and abortion. A positive reaction consists of redness at the test site only, appearing in 24 to 36 hours and persisting for 4 to 5 days, leaving a brown spot on the skin; this indicates lack of immunity to diphtheria. The definition and clinical application of the concept of schizophrenia have varied greatly. The DSM-IV criteria emphasize marked disorder of thought (delusions, hallucinations, or other thought disorder accompanied by disordered affect or behavior), deterioration from a previous level of functioning, and chronicity (duration of more than 6 months), thus excluding from this classification conditions referred to by others as acute, borderline, simple, or latent schizophrenia."]

The A2 segment continues from the anterior communicating artery to the genu of the corpus callosum; A3 corresponds to the pericallosal artery and continues around the genu until turning posteriorly; A4 and A5 continue posteriorly, above the plane of the corpus callosum, their division marked by the plane of the coronal fissure."]

The M1 segment is the sphenoid part (pars sphenoidalis), the horizontal portion of the vessel from the termination of the internal carotid artery to the point of branching at the limen insulae; M2 is the insular part (pars insularis), the segment running in the lateral cerebral (sylvian) fissure and serving the insular cortex; M3 is the opercular part, the segment emerging from the sylvian fissure, supplying the inner aspects of the opercula, and ending at the lateral surface of the cerebral hemisphere; M4 is the cortical part, the terminal branches supplying the lateral surface of the cerebral hemisphere. The artery usually bifurcates into inferior and superior trunks at the end of the M1 segment, so there are two each of the segments M2–M4, the inferior distributing below the sylvian fissure, and the superior distributing above."]

Acute selenium poisoning (called also blind staggers) is characterized by impaired vision, an unsteady gait, and increasing incoordination with respiratory failure and often death within 24 hours. Clinical characteristics include initial chills and fever, warm flushed skin, increased cardiac output, and a lesser degree of hypotension than with hypovolemic shock; if therapy is ineffective, it may progress to the clinical picture associated with hypovolemic shock."]

The sick role also involves behavioral changes, including increased attention to the body and bodily functions, regression (increase in dependent behavior), narrowing of interests, and emotional overreactions."]

80079 sickle cell anemia
- 
- phr.["镰状细胞性贫血"]
- phr.["a hereditary hemolytic anemia, seen primarily in West Africa and in people of West African descent, and less often in the Mediterranean basin and a few other areas. It is an autosomal recessive disorder in which mutation of the HBB gene (locus: 11p15.5), which encodes the β-globin chain, results in hemoglobin S, which has decreased solubility in the deoxygenated state and results in abnormal sickle-shaped erythrocytes (sickle cells). Homozygous individuals have 85 to 95 percent sickle cells and have the full-blown syndrome with accelerated hemolysis, increased blood viscosity and vaso-occlusion, arthralgias, acute attacks of abdominal pain, ulcerations of the lower extremities, and periodic attacks of any of the conditions called sickle cell crises. The heterozygous condition is called sickle cell trait and is usually asymptomatic. See also sickle cell disease, under disease. Called also sicklemia."]

If the null hypothesis is true and there is no difference between the two populations, the median difference in rankings between matched pairs in the population approximates 0. The lesions would evolve to become papules and vesicles, umbilicate, crust, and scab, leaving small depressed, depigmented scars called pockmarks. Varieties included hemorrhagic smallpox and variola minor. Called also variola.Smallpox."]

Type III is Kugelberg-Welander syndrome, the least severe type. During fetal life and in the newborn it gives rise to new red blood cells. It has other important functions whose full scope has not been entirely determined. Deficiency of the enzyme, an autosomal recessive trait, is called 17α-hydroxylase deficiency and causes congenital adrenal hyperplasia (type V). Eosinophils from subjects with asthma (A) and nonasthmatic, nonatopic control subjects (B) were stained with goat polyclonal antibody to IL-9, followed by biotin-labeled rabbit anti-goat streptavidin alkaline phosphatase, then counterstained with hematoxylin. Goat IgG was used as a negative control (B, D). The intensity of red staining indicates the level of expression of IL-9 by the cells."]

- /ˌstreptəʊˌmaɪkrəʊˈdæktɪlɪ/

83323 Streptomyces
- /ˌstreptəʊˈmaɪsiːz/
- n.["链霉菌属"]
- n.["a genus of bacteria of the family Streptomycetaceae, consisting of aerobic, gram-positive, non–acid-fast organisms that form a nonfragmented aerial mycelium. There are several hundred different species, usually soil forms but occasionally parasitic on plants or animals. Most species produce pigments. More than half of the antibiotics of practical value, including the aminoglycosides, tetracyclines, and macrolides, are produced from species of Streptomyces. The type species is S. al´bus."]

-

-

-

-

- phr.["a species that is a source of bambermycins."]

-

- phr.["a species that produces the antibiotic sinefungin."]

-

- phr.["a species that produces streptomycin."]

-

- phr.["a species that is the source of cycloserine."]

83345 Streptomyces rimosus
- 
- phr.["土霉素链霉菌，龟裂链霉菌"]
- phr.["a species containing a variant, S. rimo´sus var. paromomyci´nus, that produces the antibiotic paromomycin."]

83346 Streptomyces roseosporus
- 
- phr.["玫瑰孢链霉菌"]
- phr.["a species that produces the antibiotic daptomycin."]

83347 Streptomyces somaliensis
- 
- phr.["索马里链霉菌"]
- phr.["a species commonly found in Africa, North and South America, Israel, and India, causing actinomycotic mycetoma in which the granules in the discharged pus are white to yellow."]

83348 Streptomyces spectabilis
- 
- phr.["壮观链霉菌"]
- phr.["a species from which the antibiotic spectinomycin is derived."]

83349 Streptomyces tenebrarius
- 
- phr.["黑暗链霉菌"]
- phr.["a species that produces nebramycin, the antibiotic complex from which tobramycin is derived."]

- 
- phr.["苏库巴链霉菌"]

83352 Streptomycetaceae
- /ˌstreptəʊˌmaɪsɪˈteɪsɪiː/
- n.["链霉菌科"]
